jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer Windows Agent
jobs.description: ### **Location: California, Texas, Colorado, Atlanta \- Remote** ### **Who Are We?** ### **About Airlock Digital:** Airlock Digital is a global leader in application control and allowlisting. We seek to empower every organization to run only what they trust and operate free from malware and ransomware. With rapid growth across Australia, North America, and EMEA. We are committed to our core values, respect, determination, and integrity. We support a diverse and expanding global customer base. At Airlock, we pride ourselves on being a team of humble, collaborative, and driven professionals who support one another and share a passion for cybersecurity. ### **What We are Looking For:** We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build and improve Airlock Digital's Windows endpoint Agent. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role focused on native C and C\+\+ development. You will design and implement features, review code, and resolve complex defects in software that controls application execution on customer endpoints. The Windows Agent combines a file\-system minifilter driver with user\-mode services, local policy databases, and user notifications. You will help ship reliable enforcement, secure communications, installation, and updates alongside product, QA, security, support, and cloud engineering. ### **Key Responsibilities:** * Design, implement, test, and sustain Windows Agent features in C and C\+\+, including policy evaluation, process and file monitoring, enforcement, secure communications, installation, and recovery. * Contribute to designs and code reviews across the minifilter driver, privileged Windows service, and user\-facing components. Preserve secure kernel\-to\-user communication and consistent policy decisions. * Diagnose production crashes, hangs, memory leaks, resource exhaustion, and performance issues involving Windows processes, threads, filesystems, drivers, and service lifecycle behavior. * Improve automated testing, diagnostic tools, and build and release workflows. Validate enforcement, upgrades, and recovery across supported Windows versions and configurations. * Mentor engineers, share Windows platform knowledge, identify technical risks, and coordinate with other Agent and cloud engineers on policy behavior and service integration. ### **Required Skills \& Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience building production systems software, endpoint software, operating\-system services, or another always\-on product. * Strong native Windows systems development experience using C and C\+\+, including Win32 APIs, Windows services, process and thread behavior, filesystem operations, and debugging production software. * A record of taking security\-critical or reliability\-sensitive software through design, implementation, testing, release, and production support, with close attention to correctness, stability, performance, and safe failure behavior. * Strong knowledge of concurrency, synchronization, memory ownership, handle and resource lifetime, and error handling. Experience diagnosing native crashes and analyzing performance with Windows debugging tools. * Sound security judgment around Windows privilege boundaries, access control, kernel\-to\-user IPC, code and publisher trust, secure communications, local policy data, and signed software updates. * Clear written and verbal communication, experience mentoring other engineers, and the ability to work across engineering, product, and customer\-facing teams in a distributed organization. * A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field is preferred but not required; equivalent practical experience is welcomed. ### **Bonus Points:** Experience in any of the following areas is useful; we do not expect candidates to have every skill listed. * Windows file\-system minifilter development, the Windows Driver Kit, Filter Manager, process callbacks, driver communication ports, or related endpoint enforcement technology. * Kernel debugging with WinDbg, crash\-dump analysis, Driver Verifier, or Event Tracing for Windows. * Windows service and desktop integration, MSI packaging, installer upgrades and rollback, driver signing, or Authenticode signature verification. * Application control, allowlisting, endpoint protection, EDR, anti\-malware, or other prevention\-focused security products. * SQLite, OpenSSL, libcurl, Visual Studio and MSBuild, or maintaining native software across Windows architectures. ### **What We Offer:** We don't think money is everything, but we know it is an important part of your decision to apply for a role. This position has a salary range of USD $170,000 \- $200,000\. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include responsibilities of the job, education, location, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and internal equity, alignment with market data, or applicable laws. At Airlock Digital we offer a wide range of benefits to our eligible team members. Our benefit programs vary by location and can include Medical, dental, and vision insurance – 401K Plan with 4% Company Match – Life and Disability Programs – Paid Parental Leave \- Paid time off and Paid Holidays – Volunteer and Birthday Time off – Home Office Allowance ### **Our Commitment:** We believe in supporting our team members both personally and professionally. Named one of the USA's Greatest Places to Work in 2024 and 2025, we value flexibility, trust, and a work environment that empowers our team to do their best work. *We will be assessing applications as they come in, so we encourage you to send your resume through to us as soon as possible. All official job offers from our company are extended directly by our recruitment team and will be sent through an official BambooHR document for your review and signature. Please be aware that we do not ask for any personal information in the process of extending offers of employment, such as financial details or social security numbers. Upon acceptance of any offer, we will request such information as part of the onboarding process prior to or on your first day of employment, and only after completing a background check through an authorized third\-party vendor. If you receive any communication asking for personal details outside of these processes, please contact us immediately to verify the authenticity of the request. Your security is important to us, and we are committed to a safe and transparent hiring experience. No contact from recruitment agencies, thank you*

jobs.title: Cloud Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Title: Cloud Security Engineer** **Job Summary:** We are seeking a skilled Cloud Security Engineer with a strong background in AWS security and cloud platform operations. The ideal candidate will be responsible for implementing and managing security measures across our cloud infrastructure, ensuring compliance with industry standards and best practices. This role requires a proactive approach to security, with a focus on automation and continuous improvement. **Responsibilities:** * Implement and manage AWS security services including IAM, KMS, Cognito, Lambda, containers, and API Gateway. * Integrate logging and monitoring solutions into a Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) system, preferably Splunk. * Establish security controls within CI/CD pipelines and manage infrastructure as code using Terraform or CloudFormation. * Conduct hardening of cloud environments, manage SSL/TLS certificates, and perform dependency and configuration reviews. * Collaborate with development and operations teams to ensure security best practices are integrated into all phases of the software development lifecycle. * Stay updated on the latest security threats and vulnerabilities, and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies. * Document security policies, procedures, and guidelines to ensure compliance and awareness across the organization. **Mandatory Skills:** * Proven experience with AWS security services (IAM, KMS, Cognito, Lambda, API Gateway). * Strong understanding of logging and monitoring tools, specifically experience with SIEM solutions like Splunk. * Hands on experience with CI/CD security controls and infrastructure as code using Terraform or CloudFormation. * Demonstrated ability to perform hardening of cloud environments and manage certificate lifecycles. * Experience in cloud platform operations (AWS is mandatory; Azure or Google Cloud is a plus). **Preferred Skills:** * Familiarity with security frameworks and compliance standards (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, GDPR). * Experience with container security and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes). * Knowledge of scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash) for automation tasks. * Certifications in cloud security (e.g., AWS Certified Security Specialty, Certified Information Systems Security Professional CISSP). **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. * 5 7 years of experience in cloud security engineering or a related role. * Strong analytical and problem solving skills. * Excellent communication and collaboration abilities. Pay: From $55\.00 per hour Experience: * AWS Security : 7 years (Required) * SIEM: 6 years (Required) * Security frameworks: 7 years (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Austin, TX 78799

jobs.title: AI & Automation Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are:** Aldridge is a leading Managed Service Provider (MSP) offering scalable IT and cybersecurity solutions to fast\-growing, small to mid\-market businesses in the US. Founded in 1984, this private equity\-backed company is a technology management consulting, and outsourcing firm that provides best\-fit solutions through a tailored approach and local relationships. With offices in Houston, Dallas, Fort Worth, San Antonio, Austin, Alexandria, Monroe and Seattle, the company’s unwavering dedication, superior technical expertise, and keen understanding of business processes have transformed it into a trusted partner for its clients. With a strong reputation for delivering high\-quality services, Aldridge is committed to helping its clients optimize their technology infrastructure and achieve their business goals. **Position Overview:** The AI \& Automation Solutions Engineer owns the day\-to\-day success of assigned client AI and automation engagements from discovery through operational handoff. The AI \& Automation Solutions Engineer translates client problems into outcome\-oriented technical plans, leads solution scoping, coordinates the Architect and engineering specialists, manages delivery mechanics, drives adoption, and verifies that the client received the intended result. The AI \& Automation Solutions Engineer is accountable for the engagement outcome; the VP of AI retains executive accountability and client satisfaction. The Solution Architect is the Solution Neiger peer for technical integrity. Neither role automatically overrides the other across that boundary; unresolved material tradeoffs escalate to the VP of AI. **Client Discovery and Outcome Shaping** * Lead discovery with client stakeholders to understand the current process, business problem, desired outcome, users, constraints, environment and readiness risks. * Turn vague client requests into decision\-ready technical engagement definitions with expected outcomes, success criteria, assumptions, dependencies, risks and an initial delivery approach. * Identify when the client problem is primarily adoption, data readiness, process design, platform configuration, custom engineering or some combination rather than defaulting every request to a build. **Solution Scoping and Pre\-Sales Technical Support** * Lead technical solution scoping for AI and automation engagements and provide the delivery perspective required before work is sold. * Pull in the Forward Deployment Architect for consequential design decisions and the AI \& Automation Lead, Developers or Data Engineer for implementation estimates and specialist input. * Make technical assumptions and delivery dependencies explicit so commercial scope is based on a credible implementation plan. * Support sales and account teams with technical explanations and solution demonstrations without becoming the owner of pricing or commercial approval. **Engagement Delivery and Project Management** * Own the day\-to\-day delivery plan for assigned engagements, including milestones, actions, dependencies, risks, client follow\-up, status communication and coordination of Aldridge contributors. * Maintain enough technical depth to recognize when requirements, scope or architecture assumptions are changing and drive the appropriate decision before work drifts. * Coordinate AI \& Automation Developers, the Data Engineer and other Aldridge specialists while respecting their functional reporting lines. * Escalate material scope, client relationship, architecture or delivery\-risk issues to the VP of AI early. **Platform and Environment Deployment** * Coordinate client deployment and readiness for platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude and other AI or automation environments used by the engagement. * Coordinate identity, permissions, connectors, tenant configuration, data\-readiness and specialist engineering activities required to make the solution work in the client environment. * Do not independently act as the final authority on consequential security or architecture design. Work with the Forward Deployment Architect and appropriate Aldridge Security or IT specialists. **Adoption, Enablement and Change Support** * Treat adoption as part of engagement success rather than a post\-project courtesy. Identify low or uneven adoption and make it visible to Aldridge and client leadership. * Build or coordinate corrective adoption plans that may include training, documentation, workflow changes, communications, feedback loops, manager reinforcement and engineering changes. * Create or coordinate training materials, client documentation, demos and enablement sessions needed for successful use. * Partner with client leadership, which remains responsible for reinforcing behavior and holding its own teams accountable for adoption. **Measurement, Acceptance and Value Realization** * Ensure each engagement has an agreed success measure before the solution is treated as complete. * Partner with t oing support once the solution is production\-ready. * Confirm that runbooks, documentation, monitoring, known issues, support ownership, client support path and unresolved enhancement work are clearly documented. * After handoff, routine technical support and remediation move to the AI \& Automation Developers and Lead. Re\-enter when an issue affects adoption, client outcome, scope or relationship management. * Demonstrated experience leading technical client engagements, implementations or consulting work from discovery through deployment and acceptance. * Strong technical fluency across AI/LLM platforms, automation, APIs and integrations, cloud services, identity and data\-readiness concepts sufficient to shape solutions and coordinate specialists. * Ability to translate business problems into technical requirements, delivery plans and measurable success criteria. * Practical project\-management discipline: milestones, dependencies, risk management, status communication, follow\-up and scope control. * Strong client communication and facilitation skills, including working sessions, demos, difficult expectation\-setting and adoption conversations. * Enough hands\-on technical ability to prototype, troubleshoot or validate when useful, without needing to be the primary developer for every engagement. **Preferred Experience** * Managed service provider, professional services, systems integration, consulting or technical customer\-success environment. * Hands\-on deployment or administration experience with Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude or comparable enterprise AI platforms. * Microsoft 365, Azure, Power Platform, Microsoft Graph or identity\-and\-permissions experience. * Change enablement, training design or user\-adoption work tied to technology deployments. * Experience scoping fixed\-fee or outcome\-oriented technical work and managing assumptions through delivery. **Hybrid work schedule** * Optional work from home days are Mondays and Fridays * Required in\-office days are Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays **Additional Requirements** * Physical ability to stand, walk or sit for extended periods * Must be comfortable with periodically lifting 25 pounds * Travel will be required up to 50% **Aldridge Core Values:** * Build Trust – We continuously earn the trust of our partners through genuine, transparent communication, and unflinching accountability. * Take Swift, Meaningful Action – When every second matters, we drill to the core question and act decisively. * Create Best\-Fit Solutions – More is not always better – We create the most value for the least added overhead and complexity. * Evolve \& Improve – We know the power of a growth mindset. We do not let fear of failure stop us from finding new, and better ways to do things. **Benefits:** * Competitive Salary and Incentive Plan * Generous Employer Contribution to Health Benefits Package * 401(k) Matching * 4 Weeks Paid Time Off per year, plus additional days for community service * Ongoing Training and Professional Development Opportunities * Free Snacks and Beverages! *Aldridge is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender, age, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications associated with the position. jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer II, Amazon OpenSearch
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon OpenSearch Service is a fully managed search and analytics service. It runs search, observability, and generative AI workloads for tens of thousands of customers, from application search and log analytics to vector and hybrid retrieval. We're building the next generation of OpenSearch Migration Assistant: an AI\-powered system that makes moving search and analytics workloads to Amazon OpenSearch far easier. Customers run these workloads today on self\-managed OpenSearch and Elasticsearch, and on other search, observability, and analytics platforms. Migration Assistant will: * understand a customer's existing environment * work out how its workloads, queries, and downstream applications map to OpenSearch * automate the transformations * orchestrate data and configuration migration * validate correctness and performance * help customers cut over production traffic safely As a Software Development Engineer on the team, you'll help define and build this system from the ground up. You'll turn ambiguous customer problems into technical designs, prototype new approaches, and take them to production as reliable AWS services. The work spans: * AI agents: the agent harness, the tools, and the evals that keep conclusions grounded in evidence * Workload discovery and translation: queries, mappings, query optimization, and the applications built on them * Distributed systems: data movement, pipeline orchestration, cluster management, and multi\-tenant infrastructure * Validation: correctness and performance at production scale You'll build with Rust, Java, Python, Go, and AWS services, on systems that must be secure, highly available, and run across AWS regions. jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Tech, Sales and Financial Integrity
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon has hundreds of millions of customers, sellers, and developers all over the world that rely on Amazon products and services. Selling Partner Services (SPS) is the organization that constantly makes high judgment decisions across a wide breadth of constituents. Preserving Trust in Amazon with every customer, every transaction, every second is our mission. We do this by identifying and removing bad actors from the platform, while supporting a best\-in\-class customer experience. We ensure that Amazon is a safe and trustworthy place to shop and an amazing place to build a successful business selling products. One of the key functions within SPS is to keep the financial relationship between Amazon and its sellers secure, transparent, and trustworthy. To that end, we own controls, verification, and validation for the payment instruments sellers use to pay Amazon and get paid, preventing fraud, money laundering, and financial abuse before it reaches customers or Amazon. We're looking for a Principal Product Manager – Technical to set the long\-term vision and technical product strategy for these SPS seller experiences. The role covers Bank Account Verification (BAV), Credit Card Verification (CCV), and other related seller experiences at Amazon's scale. You'll handle highly ambiguous problems that span multiple organizations, balancing fraud prevention, regulatory compliance (KYC/AML), and seller friction for millions of selling partners worldwide. You'll partner with engineering and science teams to build machine learning–driven risk decisioning and automated verification systems that detect and stop bad actors in real time, while giving legitimate sellers a fast, low\-friction onboarding and payments experience. Your decisions will directly affect seller trust, onboarding success, payment reliability, fraud losses, and the integrity of Amazon's stores. Key job responsibilities * Own the multi\-year vision, strategy, and product tenets for payment instrument verification (BAV/CCV) and related seller financial experiences, working backwards from sellers * Set the technical direction with engineering and science leaders. Finally, this role is crucial for coordinating resources, managing our test fleet, and ensuring we meet our test objectives and throughput targets. Test Planning \& Execution: plan and coordinate test campaigns across release testing, feature testing, wholesale testing of new hardware platforms, and operational processes and devices. Ensure test objectives are clearly defined, scheduled, and met, and that results are captured, reproducible, and actionable. Fleet \& Resource Allocation: manage and allocate the Austin site’s test resources, including personnel, shifts/schedules, equipment, and the fleet of test units, to ensure test programs are completed on time and within budget. Safety \& Compliance: ensure all test and operational activities comply with company policies, industry regulations, and safety standards. jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description: At American Express, AI is reshaping the future of commerce and redefining the experiences our commercial customers and card members expect. Within Amex Technology, we are building platforms, products, and governance that enable agentic AI systems to operate responsibly and at scale across the enterprise. Our focus is on agentic AI development: designing intelligent, adaptive systems that can plan, reason, and act across complex workflows with appropriate levels of autonomy. These systems power autonomous workflows, decision support, and customer\-facing experiences—while meeting the high standards for security, explainability, reliability, and compliance required in financial services. We partner closely with product, design, and business teams to deliver agentic capabilities that reduce operational friction, improve decision\-making, and transform how customers interact, transact, and grow. Global Commercial Services (GCS) serves millions of business customers around the world, from mom\-and\-pop shops to Fortune 500 companies. We back businesses so they can do more business, with a mission to be the undisputed leader in financial and membership services — responsibly driving double\-digit revenue growth. We do that by offering a diverse range of payment and cashflow tools, from a wide range of traditional card products, to working capital and supply chain financing, to new digital solutions that make it easy for our customers to manage a full range of their financial and payment needs. **The Role** As a Staff AI Engineer on the Commercial Cross Platform Delivery Team you will operate as a senior individual contributor within Amex Technology, helping define how AI systems are designed, built, and operated across the company. You will work at the intersection of AI system architecture and hands\-on execution: designing core frameworks, writing production code, reviewing critical designs, and guiding teams through complex technical decisions. This role does not include people management; your impact comes from technical leadership, sound judgment, and the ability to turn ambiguity into reliable, scalable agentic systems. You will work closely with Product and UX partners to shape a shared vision for AI experiences. While product teams own prioritization, Staff engineers are expected to actively influence*what* gets built and*how* agentic systems come together across teams. jobs.description: **About Analog Devices** Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X . **About the Role** As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you will be a founding engineer on an API\-First platform for managing ADI's product specifications, building a single trusted source for product specification data. This role sits at the intersections of software, hardware, design, and marketing. The data you will model describes integrated circuits, including parametric and non\-parametric data. You will need to understand what that data means to the engineers who write it and the customers who design with it. Working closely with the hiring manager, you will deepen your knowledge of the product specification domain, help shape the architecture, and build and ship usable software in early, incremental releases. You will also own the migration of existing specification data into the new platform, making sure it arrives complete, accurate, and traceable. This is a hands\-on, high\-visibility role working with cross\-functional teams across the business. As the platform and team expand, this role will grow into the platform's technical lead. As a core technical member of this system\-driven software product development team, you will collaborate with experienced colleagues representing a well\-rounded team, e.g., product management, project management, software engineering, software QA, business analysis, user experience, etc. Our goal is to set new standards of software product development excellence together. **Key Responsibilities** **Build the platform** * Design, build, test, and deploy the services and APIs of an API\-first specification platform, from data model through to downstream consumers. * Implement a structured data model for product specifications, aligned with industry standards and supporting traceability from requirements to specification to verification. * Build stable, versioned, well\-documented APIs that let teams across ADI read and use specification content. * Integrate with existing systems and tooling, such as Jama requirements management, document control, and data sheet generation. * Work directly with design, applications, and test engineers to understand how specifications are defined, measured, and guaranteed, and reflect that faithfully in the data model, including parameters, conditions, units, MIN/TYP/MAX limits, and test coverage. **Own the data migration** * Own the migration of large volumes of specification data from existing systems into the new platform, including source analysis, data mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and cutover planning. * Reconcile specification content during migration: identify values that are missing, inconsistent, or stated without their conditions, and work with engineering owners to resolve them. * Keep the migration transparent: define measurable completeness and accuracy criteria, report progress and data quality to stakeholders, and ensure every migrated record can be traced back to its source. **Deliver production\-quality software** * Take end\-to\-end ownership of what you build, from design through production operation, including fixing what breaks. * Deliver reliable, secure, observable, and maintainable software in incremental releases, starting with an early usable release and evolving it toward a production platform. * Apply and help establish industry\-standard product development practices: backlog management, design and code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, and release management. **Grow with the team** * Learn the product specification domain quickly, contribute to architecture decisions with the hiring manager, and take increasing ownership of the technical design over time * Help interview, onboard, and mentor new team members, and work with Technical Documentation, product engineering, and business unit stakeholders to understand needs and communicate progress and trade\-offs **Must Have Skills** * **Product Development Practices:** Experience delivering production software with disciplined engineering processes, including agile planning, code review, and release management. * **Programming:** Strong software design and hands\-on development skills in at least one modern backend language. * **API \& System Design:** Hands\-on evolution. * **Learning Agility \& Leadership Potential:** Demonstrated ability to ramp up quickly in an unfamiliar domain, experience mentoring others or leading technical work, and the desire to grow into a technical lead role * **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, including when intercting with software engineers, hardware engineers, documentation teams, and product teammates in roles other than SWE. * **Discernment:** Must be able to give and receive effective, specific, accountable feedback that prioritizes process and continuous improvement. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Commercial
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ As an Applied AI Engineer on the Commercial team at Anthropic, you will be a trusted technical advisor to the companies that run the real economy, across software, financial services, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, and professional services, as they go from using Claude to building on it. Commercial is one of Anthropic's largest and fastest\-moving books of business, covering thousands of mid\-market and small companies. Some of these companies put Claude inside the product they sell, and others put agents to work inside their own engineering, operations, finance, and support teams, and this role works with both. You'll lead deep technical engagements, partnering directly with customer engineering teams to take their hardest agent builds from idea to production on the Claude API, the Agent SDK, Claude Managed Agents, Claude Code, and Claude for Enterprise. Many of these teams are lean, with years of existing systems and no dedicated AI function, and you will bridge the gap between what Claude can do and what it takes to run it inside a business that already has customers depending on it. Working closely with Applied AI Architects, Account Executives, and Anthropic's Product, Engineering, and Research teams, you'll go deep where hands\-on engineering changes the outcome, then turn what you learn into something the rest of the book can use. You'll leverage your AI engineering expertise to develop custom evaluation frameworks, design scalable architectures, and create the reference implementations, tooling, and technical resources that enable Commercial customers to succeed with Claude. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Serve as a deep technical advisor to high\-potential Commercial customers, whether Claude sits inside the product they sell or inside the way they run their own business, bringing them use cases worth building and pushing the boundaries of what agents can do in engineering, operations, finance, customer support, and more * Work hands\-on with customer engineering teams through build sprints, pair programming, and architecture reviews that move agents from idea to production, and understand their stack, data, and workflows end to end so that your guidance fits the systems, security requirements, and team they have today * Ship working code. Develop prototypes, near\-production examples, and technical documentation, including evaluation suites that become the customer's acceptance criteria, AI engineering techniques, and architecture diagrams, that enable customers to build, operate, and scale with Claude * Create reference implementations, blueprints, and sample code that many companies can adopt without starting from scratch, for example multi\-agent systems on the Agent SDK or Claude Managed Agents, MCP servers for common business systems, or Claude Code running across the software development lifecycle * Collaborate closely with Applied AI Architects and Account Executives to decide where engineering depth changes the outcome, and to maintain context and continuity across customer engagements * Identify patterns across engagements, including what is hard about running agents inside established companies such as legacy systems, messy data, permissions and security review, cost and latency at scale, and model migrations, then build repeatable evaluations and solutions and contribute insights back to Product, Engineering, Research, and the broader Applied AI team * Build the demos, agents, and internal tooling that scale the Commercial Applied AI team itself, and pair with architects on their hardest technical problems * Create technical content for customer and partner engineering audiences including documentation, tutorials, and sample code * Foster community engagement through hackathons, webinars, technical office hours, and customer events * Travel to customer sites for workshops, implementation guidance, and relationship building **You may be a good fit if you have** ------------------------------------- * Deep software engineering experience, gained by designing, building, and operating production systems, along with strong opinions of your own about how to bridge the gap between what AI can do today and how established companies get work done * 4\+ years of technical experience as a software engineer, forward deployed engineer, ML engineer, product engineer, or technical founder, with production experience building LLM\-powered applications, including prompting, context engineering, agent architectures, MCP, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale, and the ability to work in  degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **For roles performing work in California:** We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. You will lead your partners in implementing security early in the design phase through threat modeling and security guidance. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community. **The Role** ------------ We are seeking a Senior Automation and AI\-Driven Quality Engineer to design, implement, and scale intelligent quality, automation, and performance engineering solutions across enterprise\-grade, AI\-enabled platforms. This role is hands\-on and technically deep, with strong ownership across test automation, performance engineering, AI\-assisted quality workflows, and SAFe\-based delivery pipelines. observability and APM tools (metrics, logs, traces). * Collaborate with architecture and DevOps teams to improve scalability, resilience, and system reliability. * Support production performance validation using telemetry\-driven feedback loops. * Act as a senior technical contributor across Agile Release Trains (ARTs) in a SAFe environment. * Partner with Product Owners, Architects, and RTEs to embed automation, performance, and quality objectives into PI Planning. * Contribute to backlog refinement by defining automation and quality enablers. * Lead root cause analysis for complex jobs.title: Senior Director, AI, Data & Systems Engineering
jobs.description: **Aspire Public Schools NorCal — Senior Director, AI, Data \& Systems Engineering** **Job Description****About Aspire NorCal** Founded in 1998, Aspire Public Schools has served scholars and communities across California for nearly three decades. With Aspire Los Angeles transitioning into an independent organization, the Bay Area and Central Valley regions are coming together to form Aspire NorCal, operating 22 schools serving approximately 10,000 scholars across Northern California (Oakland, Richmond, East Palo Alto, Sacramento, Stockton, Modesto, and Ceres). This evolution comes at an important moment for Aspire. Changes in California’s funding, policy, enrollment, and operating environment have created an opportunity to rethink how the organization supports its schools and scholars in its next chapter. The formation of Aspire NorCal creates an opportunity to strengthen support for schools across teams previously organized by geography, improve the consistency and effectiveness of school support, and create clear accountability systems for organizational and scholar outcomes. The new model will require the organization to balance greater coherence across Aspire NorCal with responsiveness to the different communities and contexts of its schools. Aspire NorCal enters this transition with a long\-standing mission focused on post\-secondary success and a deep commitment to educational equity, along with decades of institutional knowledge across its schools and teams. Preserving those strengths while building Aspire NorCal as a unified region will be central to the work ahead. **About the AI, Data \& Systems Enablement team** The Data \& Systems team exists to give principals, teachers, and teammates their time back. We are responsible for Aspire NorCal's data and the key software systems that cross departments, and we measure ourselves by the experience of the people we serve: a principal gets a trusted answer in minutes if not seconds, a new hire is entered once, and no one navigates five systems to do one job. We use AI to get there, and we set the policy and training that keep it useful and appropriately safe. The team is made up of an Enablement team that builds the shared foundation, plus pods that each serve a customer group: School Operations \& Principals, Academics \& Teachers, and People \& Resources. Our working principles: go deep with users, one shared foundation, self\-serve first, learning is the job, and nobody works alone. **About the role** Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer (CTO), the Senior Director, AI, Data \& Systems Engineering leads the engineering that makes Aspire NorCal's data trustworthy. As the team's technical lead, you are the dedicated owner of the data warehouse, semantic layer, integrations, data governance, and the AI platform. You set and uphold the engineering practices every pod builds on: code control, review, testing, and standard toolkits. You own the integration strategy, set the integration priorities, and write the migration plan, then move the 40\+ legacy integrations onto a governed, version\-controlled platform, and you mentor pod members in AI\-supported data modeling and semantic layer management through pairing and review. This role works closely with the Senior Director, AI, Data \& Systems Enablement, a peer who also reports to the CTO, and with the Senior Analyst for AI, Data \& Systems (Enablement). It has no direct reports, but mentors pod members. This posting is for one opening. **Key Responsibilities** * Own the data warehouse (in partnership with our vendor, KAE) and ensure it remains useful and relevant to achieve the team’s broader goals. Retire legacy data warehouse. * Own Lightdash administration and the semantic layer, which holds the shared definitions and documentation that let teammates and AI find and trust the data. * Own data governance: the data access rules for Lightdash and the warehouse, data classification, and data quality, so that AI answers come only from governed sources, under the asker’s own access rights. * Own the AI platform: approved AI tools, data rules, and technical guardrails, and the technical review of each AI use case. The Senior Director, AI, Data \& Systems Enablement drafts the AI policy and runs the use\-case pipeline with you. * Create and execute an appropriate strategy for maintaining systems integrations, set integration priorities, write the migration plan, and migrate/retire existing integrations. * In the first six months, serve as technical lead for the implementation of the new HRIS. * Set engineering practices: code control, code review, and standard toolkits, and socialize them throughout the team. * Mentor pod members in AI\-supported data modeling and semantic layer management, through pairing and review. **Qualifications** **Mindsets (required)** * **Intellectual humility:** curious enough to ask the question that shows what you don't know, and secure enough to laugh at yourself. * **Interest in AI that serves Aspire's mission:** has used AI tools on real work, can describe what worked and what did not, and wants to help colleagues use AI to give time back to teachers, principals, and teammates. * **Teaches, coaches, and keeps learning:** leaves people more capable than you found them, and learns from colleagues, customers, and mistakes. * **Service\-minded:** treats principals, teachers, and teammates as customers, with a track record of empathy for the people you serve and curiosity about how schools really work. **Experience (required)** * 15\+ years in data engineering or analytics engineering. * 5\+ years as part of a high performing, mature development team leveraging modern software practices. * Hands\-on experience with a modern cloud data warehouse (BigQuery preferred), dbt, and data pipelines. * Has created AI workflows and automations that colleagues actually used. * Has written or enforced data governance and access controls. * Has migrated legacy data jobs or integrations onto a governed, version\-controlled platform without losing what users relied on. * Track record of teaching and developing others effectively and treating knowledge\-sharing as part of the job. * Communicates clearly with non\-technical users. * Understands student or employee data privacy obligations (FERPA, California privacy law) and handles sensitive data carefully. **Bonus points for** * K\-12 data experience. * Experience with a semantic layer, Lightdash, or similar AI\-enabled data tool. * A teaching, coaching, or mentoring background. **Compensation and benefits** ----------------------------- The salary range for this role is $168,050 to $215,728 annually in accordance with our salary schedule policy, commensurate with experience. This full\-time, exempt position offers a comprehensive benefits package, including: * Eligible for Aspire health benefits * Retirement through CalSTRS or CalPERS, depending on the role's credential requirements, with a 403(b) option * Paid time off and additional teammate benefits to be determined in accordance with updated employee value proposition to be shared prior to offer. Aspire NorCal is conducting a comprehensive study of our employee value proposition, which could lead to material changes in July 2027\. **Location and work arrangement** --------------------------------- * Preference is given to candidates who reside in a county where Aspire NorCal schools are located (San Mateo, Alameda, Contra Costa, San Joaquin, Stanislaus, or Sacramento) or in an adjacent county. Periodic travel is required across schools, from East Palo Alto to the East Bay and from Sacramento to Modesto. This is a remote or hybrid role; the arrangement will be determined by the Chief Technology Officer. Employment with Aspire is at\-will. **Application Deadline:** December 4, 2026 **Equal opportunity** Aspire Public Schools is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Aspire Public Schools provides reasonable accommodations during the application and interview process. #### **Disclaimer** *We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.*

jobs.title: Principal Cloud Architect
jobs.description: Overview: The Principal Cloud Architect is the senior technical authority for AssistRx's AWS environments. This role designs, builds, and guides the operation of highly available, resilient, and secure AWS architectures, and leads the migration of workloads from on\-premises and other cloud platforms, including Azure, to the cloud solutions that best support the business. The architect brings working knowledge of both AWS and Azure, with demonstrated depth in AWS design, build, and run, and applies FinOps discipline so that cost is a design input, not an afterthought. The Principal Cloud Architect partners with the Director, Cloud \+ Infrastructure Engineering, infrastructure and network engineers, Security, Compliance, DevOps, Operations, and Engineering counterparts (including Product Engineering), IT Service Desk, and external vendors. The architect is expected to set technical direction, mentor engineers, and raise cloud capability across the team through coaching, design reviews, and knowledge sharing. Responsibilities: ***Architecture and Design*** * Design and document AWS reference architectures, landing zones, and standards for compute, storage, network, identity, and data services that are highly available, resilient, scalable, and secure by design. * Define multi\-account structure, governance, guardrails, and policy\-based controls (for example, AWS Organizations, Control Tower, service control policies, and IAM Identity Center). * Design network connectivity and segmentation for cloud and hybrid environments, including VPC design, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, VPN, and DNS, in partnership with network engineering and Security. * Apply the AWS Well\-Architected Framework across operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimization, and sustainability; lead architecture and design reviews. * Design for recovery: define RTO and RPO targets, multi\-AZ and multi\-region patterns, backup, and disaster recovery architectures, and validate them through regular testing. * Maintain working knowledge of Azure services and identity integration (for example, Microsoft Entra ID), and guide interoperability and migration paths between Azure and AWS. * Evaluate emerging cloud services and industry trends, and recommend adoption where they improve resilience, security, efficiency, or cost. ***Cloud Migration*** * Lead workload discovery and assessment, applying migration strategies (rehost, replatform, refactor, retire, retain) with business cases, dependency mapping, and sequencing. * Architect and guide migrations of on\-premises workloads to AWS, and from Azure to AWS where applicable, using tools such as AWS Application Migration Service, Database Migration Service, and Migration Hub. * Design and maintain hybrid solutions where they best serve the business, including data center and colocation exit planning in partnership with infrastructure leadership. * Define cutover, rollback, and validation plans; partner with application owners and Product Engineering to minimize risk and downtime. ***Build and Automation*** * Champion infrastructure as code (for example, Terraform or AWS CloudFormation), standardized builds, CI/CD pipelines, and self\-service patterns. * Build reusable, version\-controlled modules and patterns that engineers can consume consistently across accounts and environments. * Provide hands\-on technical leadership for complex builds, proofs of concept, and escalations. ***Operations and Reliability*** * Guide the operation of AWS environments, including observability and monitoring (for example, Amazon CloudWatch and centralized logging) that supports proactive issue detection. * Serve as a senior technical escalation point for major cloud incidents; contribute to problem management and root cause analysis. * Partner with IT Operations on change management, patching, vulnerability remediation, and capacity planning for cloud workloads. * Define service level objectives and operational runbooks, and maintain documentation for architectures, configurations, and operational procedures. ***FinOps and Cost Management*** * Lead cloud financial management practices, including cost allocation and tagging standards, spend visibility and reporting, rightsizing, commitment planning (Savings Plans and Reserved Instances), and anomaly detection. * Build cost and unit\-economics models into designs and migration business cases; forecast and report cloud spend with finance and technology leadership. * Establish guardrails and recurring optimization reviews with engineering and application teams. ***Security, Compliance, and Risk*** * Embed least privilege, encryption in transit and at rest, key management, segmentation, logging, and threat detection (for example, GuardDuty, Security Hub, and AWS Config) into every design, in partnership with Security and Compliance. * Align cloud architectures to applicable regulatory and security frameworks such as HIPAA, HITRUST, SO ITRUST) and audit support. * FinOps Certified Practitioner or equivalent. * Experience with ITIL\-based incident, problem, and change management; ITIL v4 Foundation or higher. * Experience with containers and serverless (for example, Amazon EKS, ECS, and Lambda) and hybrid connectivity at scale. **COMPETENCIES** * **Technical Expertise \-** Maintains deep, current knowledge of cloud platforms; Applies sound architectural principles; Evaluates new technology objectively; Shares knowledge with peers; Produces designs that others can build and operate. * **Strategic Thinking \-** Develops strategies to achieve organizational goals; Understands organization's strengths \& weaknesses; Identifies external threats and opportunities; Adapts strategy to changing conditions. * **Business Acumen \-** Understands business implications of decisions; Aligns work with strategic goals; Weighs cost, risk, and value in design choices. * **Leadership \-** Exhibits confidence in self and others; Inspires and motivates others to perform well; Effectively influences actions and opinions of others without formal authority; Accepts feedback from others; Gives appropriate recognition to others. * **Collaboration \-** Builds productive working relationships across DevOps, Operations, and Engineering; Shares context openly; Seeks input and resolves conflicts constructively; Aligns priorities across teams. * **Mentoring and Coaching \-** Develops skills of others through guidance and feedback; Makes self available to staff; Encourages growth and certification; Raises the technical bar of the team. * **Vendor Management \-** Evaluates and holds vendors accountable; Negotiates effectively; Builds productive partner relationships; Manages performance against SLAs. * **Change Management \-** Develops workable implementation plans; Communicates changes effectively; Builds commitment and overcomes resistance; Monitors transition and evaluates results. * **Innovation \-** Displays original thinking and creativity; Meets challenges with resourcefulness; Develops innovative approaches and ideas. * **Judgement \-** Displays willingness to make decisions; Exhibits sound and accurate judgment; Supports and explains reasoning for decisions; Makes timely decisions. * **Problem Solving \-** Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; Gathers and analyzes information skillfully; Develops alternative solutions; Uses reason even when dealing with emotional topics. * **Cost Consciousness \-** Works within approved budget; Develops and implements cost saving measures; Conserves organizational resources. * **Oral Communication \-** Speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; Listens and gets clarification; Responds well to questions; Demonstrates group presentation skills. * **Written Communication \-** Writes clearly and informatively; Edits work for spelling and grammar; Varies writing style to meet needs; Presents numerical data effectively; Able to read and interpret written information. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT** * Occasionally required to stand * Occasionally required to walk * Continually required to sit * Continually required to utilize hand and finger dexterity * Occasionally required to climb, balance * Occasionally required to bend, stoop, kneel or crawl * Continually required to talk or hear * While performing the duties of this job, the noise level in the work environment is usually moderate * Specific vision abilities required by this job include depth perception and ability to adjust focus. * Additional remarks regarding work environment: Standard office lighting and white noise. * Tight deadlines must be met with limited staff to support projects. * This job operates in a professional office environment. * Occasional evening and weekend work may be required, including planned maintenance windows and escalation for major incidents. * Occasional travel required. Pay Range: USD $163,239\.00 \- USD $204,048\.00 /Yr.

jobs.title: Machinery Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description **Your role** ------------- Imagine yourself working in a company shaped by endless innovation. With us, you are given plenty of freedom to follow your ambitions and act as an entrepreneur, surrounded by the stability of a leading company. When you join Atlas Copco you get a great deal of responsibility from day one. Why? Because we know that you have the drive and the ability to make sound decisions – and will ask for help when you need it. As a global company, we are proud to be a diverse and multi\-talented group of people that provides fresh ideas on how to best serve our customers. We feel strongly about promoting equal opportunities and growing sustainably with a long\-term perspective. In the role of Machinery Engineer with Atlas Copco Mafi\-Trench Company you will work with a multidisciplinary engineering team on a wide variety of technical challenges. Working on cutting edge technology and innovation, you’ll have a strong desire to obtain experience in the aerodynamic design of turbines and the rotordynamics of high\-speed rotating machinery. ACMTC is a custom, build to order environment where you’ll need to have a natural curiosity and genuine interest in new technologies and are flexible with ideas and abstract concepts, able to self\-learn/self\-develop. **Your day\-to\-day** --------------------- * Analyze and Design Turboexpanders to create a custom product for each customer. * Continually Improve product performance, quality, and value as well as the design process. * Maintain up to date documentation on all responsible projects. Observe and participate in the build and test of the parts you’ve designed in our onsite manufacturing facility. * **Physical Requirements/Essential Functions:** * Working Conditions \- Office and Manufacturing environment * Essential Physical Tasks – ability to stand and squat to evaluate parts. * Ability to lift/carry up to 15 lbs. Occasional domestic and international travel * **What you will learn:** * You’ll learn how to design a Turboexpander. * You’ll learn how to manufacture a Turboexpander. * You’ll learn how to document the analysis and design process for each machine. * You’ll learn how to update and improve the design guide. * You’ll learn how to communicate with customers and members of your project team. **Your skills and experience** ------------------------------ * + You have excellent interpersonal skills. You communicate well with others, have an ability to self\-start, have a positive make\-it\-happen attitude, and are a team player. + You are creative and can refine ideas through open minded collaboration with colleagues and customers. + You are curious and want to understand why something works the way it does. + You are an active promotor of collaboration, able to identify needs and act with minimal supervision. You take complex issues and break them down into simple actionable steps – providing effective solutions. + You know that failure is a first attempt in learning and you demonstrate the ability to self\-correct and self\-improve. · You can hear customer needs and translate them into functional requirements. · You are proficient in Solidworks, CAD/CAE, 2D or 3D modeling. + You understand or are interested in the principles of Computational Fluid Dynamics, Finite Element Analysis and Rotordynamics. + Understand the thermodynamic process of expansion and compression. You have a BS in Mechanical Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering or a similar field. + We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. We value diverse experiences and perspectives and are excited to see what you bring to the role. **Your compensation and benefits** ---------------------------------- The compensation range for this position is $97,560 to $127,510 annually. The compensation package may also include incentive compensation opportunities in the form of discretionary annual bonus. Atlas Copco provides industry\-leading benefits including healthcare, 401K savings plan, company holidays, vacation, sick time, parental leave, tuition assistance, referral bonus and an employee assistance program. Eligibility requirements apply. Beyond compensation, we believe that a rewarding career is about having opportunities to learn, grow, contribute, and develop in an environment built on trust, collaboration, and continuous improvement. At Atlas Copco Group, we support our people in building long\-term careers while making a meaningful impact through their work. **Your job location** --------------------- This role requires you to work on\-site at our office in Santa Maria CA, United States (US). You will be part of a dynamic team and enjoy the benefits of face\-to\-face collaboration. This role reports to the Core Engineering Manager and will work and collaborate as an integral part of a team with diverse technical backgrounds, a wealth of knowledge and specialty and with co\-workers averaging 20\+ years’ experience resulting in collaborative discussions and innovation. Atlas Copco Mafi\-Trench Company LLC is located on the beautiful Central Coast of California. We manufacture a wide range of Turbo Expanders and equipment that support sustainable resources. Locally our facility is a California Certified Green Business. Our Think GREEN Initiative has reduced our landfill impact significantly by implementing ambitious recycling programs and reduced our carbon footprint. **Why it is great to work with us** ----------------------------------- Your career grows through your skills, your curiosity, and the people you work with. You join a global network where we learn from each other and share knowledge openly. We focus on long‑term development and encourage you to explore new ideas that help us move forward. Innovation is part of how we think and act – we test, improve, and use what we learn to create solutions that matter. You can make a meaningful impact by contributing with your insights and taking ownership of your work, supported by flexible ways of working and leaders who empower you. Apply now **Uniting curious minds** ------------------------- Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we are uniting curious minds, and you could be one of them. Information at a Glance Atlas Copco delivers innovative products and solutions that help businesses grow and drive progress. Our portfolio spans compressed air and gas systems and treatment, vacuum solutions, industrial power tools, assembly systems, and power and flow solutions. We bring a commitment to long\-term success built on expertise, reliable service, and uptime. When you level up to the Atlas Copco experience you enter a partnership based on quality, sustainability, and ease of collaboration. The technology we bring, and the decades of experience support the future\-proofing of your business. Atlas Copco is a brand within Atlas Copco Group. Visit the Atlas Copco website **Uniting curious minds** ------------------------- Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we are uniting curious minds, and you could be one of them. jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Engineering
jobs.description: At Auction.com, we’re transforming real estate. As the nation’s leading online platform for buying and selling residential bank\-owned and foreclosure properties, we connect buyers, sellers, and investors with innovative technology. With over $70 billion in assets, our success is driven by a culture of innovation, collaboration, and impact. We go beyond the bid—empowering our people to thrive and shape the future of the industry About the Role We operate one of the largest digital marketplaces in residential real estate, where buyers, sellers, servicers, and agents transact on real property with real money at stake. Every listing that moves through our platform touches valuation, bidding, contracts, payments, and a broad ecosystem of external systems. Our technology platform continues to evolve to meet the needs of a dynamic market. We're seeking an Sr. Engineering Manager, Full Stack Engineering to lead and develop engineering talent while driving the architecture, delivery, and ongoing evolution of our core technology platform. This is a hands\-on engineering leadership role responsible for managing and developing a team of software engineers, establishing technical direction, and ensuring the delivery of scalable, secure, high\-quality software. You'll partner closely with Product, UX, Data, and business leaders to translate strategic priorities into technical solutions and deliver meaningful business outcomes. jobs.title: Staff ML Engineer
jobs.description: **About Axiado Corporation** Axiado is redefining how AI infrastructure gets secured and managed. Founded in 2019, we’re a fast\-growing, well\-funded team of over 180 people worldwide, building the Trusted Control/Compute Unit (TCU), a new class of semiconductor that integrates hardware security, real\-time platform management, and AI\-driven optimization. Our TCU\-based Platform Efficiency Controller is shipping hardware that makes AI servers measurably more efficient, more secure, and more reliable, and we’re extending that foundation into a hardware\-anchored management fabric that scales from a single board to the whole fleet. Backed by strong funding and validated by commercial programs with Tier 1 industry leaders, Axiado has earned recognition through numerous industry awards, including the 2026 AI in Cybersecurity Innovation Award from TMCnet, a Diamond award for Zero Trust Solution of the Year at the 2026 Pinnacle Awards, and Gold at the 2026 Cybersecurity Excellence Awards for AI Security Solution, as well as being a finalist for the Start\-Up to Watch Award from the Global Semiconductor Alliance. We’re small enough that every person’s work visibly shapes the company, and we look for people who want to build, not just execute. Every employee holds equity, meaning your work directly builds your stake in the company’s future, not just a paycheck. If you want to help define what comes next, let’s talk.**Job Description** ------------------- **About the role** We're looking for an ML engineer who works across the full stack from model to silicon — comfortable optimizing training and inference performance on GPU/AI\-accelerator infrastructure, building or tuning models, and adapting model and inference\-engine design to the constraints of the underlying chip and its NPU. You'll move fluidly between algorithm work, systems\-level software, and infrastructure work, closing the loop end\-to\-end rather than owning just one layer of the stack. This is a rare chance to work the full cycle of AI silicon, from model down to chip — something most ML engineers at large companies never get access to. **What you'll do** * Optimize training and inference performance across GPU and AI\-accelerator infrastructure, including MLOps pipelines * Design, train, and evaluate ML models (deep learning, LLM, CV, or recommendation systems) and take them into production * Harden and extend NPU cores (e.g. building on an open RVV/tensor core like CoralNPU) into production silicon * Build or optimize inference engines and serving runtimes against real hardware constraints — latency, memory, and power * Work below the application layer where needed — BMC firmware, embedded Linux, or RTOS (e.g. Zephyr) — so AI features run reliably on real systems * Build automated test/verification harnesses that close the loop for AI\-assisted RTL/DV, hardware bring\-up, or manufacturing test * Apply ML to security — AI\-driven log/intrusion analysis, AI\-assisted penetration testing, or firmware/hardware security work * Collaborate closely with RTL/hardware, firmware, and QA teams to ship AI features end\-to\-end, from training through deployment and monitoring **Qualifications** ------------------ **What we're looking for** * 5–7\+ years of hands\-on AI/ML experience; Master's required, PhD preferred * Hands\-on experience with AI/ML infrastructure and performance — GPU clusters, distributed training, inference\-serving optimization, MLOps pipelines * Model / algorithm development experience — designing, training, and evaluating ML models * Experience taking models into production — feature engineering, data pipelines, deployment * AI chip / hardware\-aware ML experience — optimizing inference engines for a specific chip, or adapting model architecture/quantization to chip constraints * Deep, hands\-on expertise in at least 2 of the following 5 specialty areas — we don't expect all five: * + **NPU / AI\-accelerator —** hardening or extending an NPU core into production silicon, mapping models onto MAC/tensor\-engine constraints, or NPU\-aware RTL/DV work + **Systems / Sys\-level software —** BMC firmware, embedded Linux, RTOS (e.g. Zephyr), or other low\-level system software + **Inference engine / runtime —** built or materially optimized an inference engine or serving runtime against real hardware constraints + **Test / verification harness —** built an automated harness that closes a loop, e.g. an agent\-driven RTL/DV test runner or a hardware bring\-up / MFG test harness + **Cyber security —** AI\-driven log/intrusion analysis, AI\-assisted penetration testing, or firmware/hardware security **Additional Information** -------------------------- Axiado is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber talent in a diverse and multifaceted environment. We are headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, with access to the world's leading research, technology and talent. We are building an exceptional team to secure every node on the internet. For us, solving real\-world problems takes precedence over purely theoretical problems. As a result, we prefer individuals with persistence, intelligence and high curiosity over pedigree alone. Working hard and smart, continuous learning and mutual support are all part of who we are. Axiado is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Axiado does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non\-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

jobs.description: **Youngblood Automation’s Engineered Solutions Group in Grand Rapids, MI** designs and builds custom solutions for a wide range of environments, from workstations and shelving to protection enclosures and guarding systems to conveyor integration and light automation systems. Youngblood Automation’s Engineered Solutions team is designed to add value to the products we sell, as well as develop solid solutions to issues our customers face. We handle products such as Maytec, ABB Robotics, Yaskawa and Kollmorgen servos, SICK safety, and Aventics. We often integrate our capital equipment products such as Hoosier Feeder feeding solutions. Each opportunity is often something new. develop accurate, competitive cost estimates for custom automation equipment. * **Define Scopes:** Partner with customers to transform vague or high\-level requests into clear, actionable technical specifications. * **Develop Proposals:** Build comprehensive budgetary and firm proposals that align with customer goals and protect project margins. **Project Execution \& Build Management** * **End\-to\-End Ownership:** Manage secured orders through design, fabrication, assembly, and commissioning phases. * **Lead Shop Floor Teams:** Direct and coordinate assembly technicians and controls wiring personnel to ensure precision and on\-time delivery. * **Technical Liaison:** Serve as the primary technical point of contact for project management and external stakeholders. **Controls Design \& Programming** * **PLC/HMI Development:** Design and program clean, maintainable, and well\-documented control systems for custom machinery. * **Hardware Integration:** Support electrical design, panel builds, and field wiring layouts. * **System Debugging:** Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize systems during internal integration and final customer runoff. **Documentation \& Communication** * **Technical Writing:** Produce professional quotes, functional specifications, wiring diagrams, manuals, and as\-built records. * **Stakeholder Management:** Maintain proactive communication with customers, internal teams, and vendors regarding progress, risks, and milestones. **Ideal Candidate Profile** **Required Experience \& Skills:** * **Custom Machinery Background:** Proven track record in industrial controls engineering specifically for custom or special\-purpose machinery. * **Technical Estimation:** Strong ability to extract real requirements from incomplete scopes to build accurate equipment cost estimates. * **Leadership Capabilities:** Hands\-on experience directing mechanical assembly and electrical wiring teams during a machine build. * **PLC/HMI Proficiency:** Strong PLC programming skills (**Allen\-Bradley / Rockwell Preferred**; other platforms a plus) along with HMI development. * **Communication \& Organization:** Excellent documentation habits and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience working within a custom machine builder or systems integrator environment. * Familiarity with electrical design, panel layout, and industrial networking protocols. * Formal or practical project management experience tracking machine builds from order to runoff. **What Success Looks Like** In this role, you will deliver accurate quotes that win business while protecting profitability. You will seamlessly translate ambiguous customer requests into clear, buildable scopes. jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, AI Products
jobs.description: **Overview** ============ Baker Tilly is a leading advisory, tax and assurance firm, providing clients with a genuine coast\-to\-coast and global advantage in major regions of the U.S. and in many of the world’s leading financial centers – New York, London, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago and Boston. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP (Baker Tilly) provide professional services through an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable laws, regulations and professional standards. Baker Tilly US, LLP is a licensed independent CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities provide tax and business advisory services to their clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities are not licensed CPA firms. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP, trading as Baker Tilly, are independent members of Baker Tilly International, a worldwide network of independent accounting and business advisory firms in 141 territories, with 43,000 professionals and a combined worldwide revenue of $5\.2 billion. Visit bakertilly.com or join the conversation on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram. Please discuss the work location status with your Baker Tilly talent acquisition professional to understand the requirements for an opportunity you are exploring. *Baker Tilly is an equal* *opportunity/affirmative* *action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state or local law.* *Any unsolicited resumes submitted through our website or to Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, employee e\-mail accounts are considered property of Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.* **Job Description:** ==================== **What we're building** ======================= We're building AI agents that do real work for Baker Tilly's tax, assurance, and advisory teams. They read client files, find risks and opportunities, draft financial statement disclosures, and show their sources, and a practitioner always makes the final call. The data is some of the most sensitive in the business, so we build security in from the start. Baker Tilly is the sixth\-largest accounting and advisory firm in the U.S., with more than 11,000 people, and the firm is investing seriously in AI. We're a small team at the start of that work, and the engineers who join now will help decide what we build and how.
