jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **COMPANY OVERVIEW:** Balchem is committed to making the world a healthier place by delivering trusted, innovative, and science\-based solutions for the health and nutritional needs of the world. Balchem employs approximately 1,400 employees worldwide who provide the service, quality, and technology that enables our customers to win with their customers. We have built a reputation for delivering results to all of our stakeholders. Founded in 1967, Balchem, a Maryland corporation, became a publicly\-traded company in 1970 and is listed on Nasdaq under the symbol “BCPC.” Our corporate headquarters is located in Montvale, New Jersey, and we have a broad network of sales offices, manufacturing sites, and R\&D centers, primarily located in the U.S. and Europe. The Company consists of three business segments: Human Nutrition and Health, Animal Nutrition and Health, and Specialty Products. **POSITION SUMMARY:** The AI Engineer will design, build, and deploy AI agents and AI\-enabled automations for Balchem's supporting functions (Finance, Operations, HR, Legal, etc.) and Business Segments. This is a hands\-on technical role focused on applying commercially available AI platforms and large language models to real business processes, not on building or training foundation models. Success in this role requires strong software development and integration skills, practical experience with generative AI and agent tooling, and the business acumen to turn a process problem into a working, reliable solution. The AI Engineer will collaborate with functional teams to understand how work gets done today, then build agents that connect to Balchem's systems and data and deliver measurable productivity gains. While working closely with specific business segments and functions to ensure each solution fits its context, the AI Engineer builds with an enterprise\-wide perspective, favoring reusable components, common standards, and secure, supportable designs that can scale across Balchem. The AI Engineer will work within Balchem's AI Governance Process, helping to execute the Corporate AI Strategy by delivering prioritized use cases and ensuring every solution meets the organization's AI guardrails for security, privacy, and responsible use. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:** **AI Agent Design \& Development** * Design, build, and deploy AI agents, copilots, and assistants using existing AI platforms, large language models, and agent frameworks to automate and improve business processes across Balchem's functions and business segments. **Systems Integration \& Automation** * Integrate AI agents with Balchem's enterprise applications and data sources (ERP, CRM, collaboration, and data platforms) using APIs, connectors, and workflow tools. * Build AI\-driven automations that reduce manual steps, shorten cycle times, and improve the accuracy of routine work. **Solution Delivery \& Lifecycle Management** * Own the full delivery lifecycle for AI solutions, from requirements and prototyping through testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing support. * Translate business requirements into technical designs and help prioritize the delivery backlog based on potential benefit and business objectives. * Ensure solutions are delivered on time, within scope, and with measurable business impact. **Use Case Discovery \& Prototyping** * Work with business stakeholders to identify and assess high\-value use cases for AI agents and automation across the organization. * Build rapid prototypes and proofs of concept to validate feasibility and value before committing to full development. **Prompt Engineering \& Knowledge Grounding** * Apply prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, and tool calling to ground agents in Balchem's data and knowledge, improving the accuracy, relevance, and reliability of their output. **User Enablement \& Adoption** * Support the rollout of new AI solutions with clear documentation, demonstrations, and hands\-on guidance for end users. * Partner with functional teams to gather feedback, resolve issues, and refine solutions so they are adopted and continue to deliver value. **Security, Compliance \& Responsible AI** * Build solutions that protect company data by applying appropriate access controls, data handling practices, and testing for accuracy and misuse. * Ensure all solutions comply with Balchem's AI Policy and IT security standards. **Monitoring \& Continuous Improvement** * Monitor the usage, quality, and cost of deployed agents, track KPIs, and continuously tune solutions to improve their performance and impact. **Collaboration \& Technology Awareness** * Work closely with IT, cybersecurity, and business teams, and stay current on emerging AI tools and practices to recommend those that fit Balchem's needs. **REQUIREMENTS:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of experience in software development, automation, or systems integration, including at least a year of hands\-on work building generative AI solutions. * Demonstrated experience building and deploying AI agents or LLM\-powered applications into production using existing platforms and APIs (for example, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI services, or comparable agent frameworks). * Working knowledge of large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, agent orchestration, and solution evaluation. Experience training or building foundation models is not required. * Proficiency in Python or a similar language, REST APIs, and low\-code automation tools, with experience integrating solutions into enterprise systems such as ERP, CRM, and Microsoft 365\. * Understanding of data security, privacy, and responsible AI practices, with a commitment to continuous learning as AI technologies and best practices evolve. * Strong communication, collaboration skills and documentation skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical audiences and work effectively with business stakeholders. The expected salary range for this position is $150,000 \- $180,000 a year Balchem is committed to a workplace culture that values and promotes diversity, inclusion, equal employment opportunities, and a work environment free of harassment and hostility.

jobs.title: Data & Analytics Engineer III
jobs.description: **Department Name:** Rev Cycle Analytics\-Corp**Work Shift:** Day**Job Category:** Information Technology Banner Health was named to Fortune’s Most Innovative Companies in America 2025 list for the third consecutive year and named to Newsweek's list of Most Trustworthy Companies in America for the second year in a row. We’re proud to be recognized for our commitment to the latest health care advancements and excellent patient care. Banner Health's Revenue Cycle Data \& Analytics team serves as the backbone of enterprise\-wide financial and operational intelligence, architecting and governing the data products that power critical decision\-making across the organization. Our team owns the Unified Data Model for Revenue Cycle, setting the gold standard for data quality, semantic layer strategy, and analytics engineering — delivering trusted, actionable insights that directly advance Banner Health's mission of exceptional patient care and operational excellence. As a Data \& Analytics Engineer III, you will serve as the technical authority across multiple business domains — architecting scalable Gold and Semantic Layer data products, leading cross\-functional initiatives to harmonize KPI definitions and business logic, and independently designing AI automation workflows and LLM\-powered tools. You will also mentor less experienced engineers and shape team\-wide best practices. This is a fully remote position open to candidates residing in any Banner Health approved remote state. The ideal candidate will possess a Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field with a minimum of 4 years of experience in analytics engineering. Deep expertise in SQL, Python, Databricks, and advanced BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau is required. Databricks certifications and experience with large\-scale datasets (300 TB\+) are strongly preferred.. **This is a remote position. In this role you would work Monday through Friday normal business hours and can be a remote position if you live in the following states only: AL, AK, AR, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IA, ID, IN, KS, KY, LA, MD, MI, MN, MO, MS, NC, ND, NE, NH, NM, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WV \& WY. No other states will be considered.** Your pay and benefits (Total Rewards) are important components of your Journey at Banner Health. Banner Health offers a variety of benefit plans to help you and your family. We provide health and financial security options, so you can focus on being the best at what you do and enjoying your life. Within Banner Health Corporate, you will have the opportunity to apply your unique experience and expertise in support of a nationally\-recognized healthcare leader. We offer stimulating and rewarding careers in a wide array of disciplines. Whether your background is in Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Legal, Managed Care Programs or Public Relations, you'll find many options for contributing to our award\-winning patient care. POSITION SUMMARY This position operates as a technical authority, architecting and governing enterprise\-wide data products, semantic layer strategies, and self\-service analytics frameworks. Sets organizational standards for data quality, modeling, and observability across multiple business domains. Leverages advanced expertise in dbt, Databricks, Python, PowerBI, Tableau, and AI automation to bridge data engineering pipelines and business intelligence consumption while mentoring less experienced engineers and leading cross\-functional initiatives to align data strategy with broader organizational goals. CORE FUNCTIONS 1\. Foundational Development: Architects, owns, and governs end\-to\-end Gold and Semantic Layer data products across multiple business domains, ensuring enterprise\-wide consistency, production\-grade reliability, and a trusted single source of truth. Drives the design of scalable dimensional models, metrics layers, and self\-service analytics frameworks aligned to organizational KPIs and business strategy. Leads cross\-functional initiatives to harmonize data definitions, business logic, and data quality SLAs across teams and domains. Establishes, enforces, and continuously evolves data quality, observability, lineage, and testing standards — embedding governance into every stage of the analytics engineering lifecycle. Serves as the primary technical authority bridging data engineering pipelines and business intelligence consumption layers, while actively mentoring less experienced engineers and elevating team\-wide engineering standards and best practices. 2\. Data Modeling: Architects and leads the design of scalable, production\-ready Databricks Gold layer tables, enforcing advanced star schema, dimensional modeling, and data vault techniques across teams. Uses YAML to define and version control table schema configurations, column metadata, and model properties within dbt or similar frameworks. 3\. Semantic Layer Development: Owns and governs the ly identifies, diagnoses, and resolves Databricks cluster and query performance bottlenecks, implementing long\-term optimization strategies. 9\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Leads technical discovery sessions with data engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders, translating complex business needs into scalable technical architectures. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS Must possess strong knowledge of analytics engineering and data modeling as normally obtained through the completion of a Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Must have 4 years of experience in analytics engineering, data modeling, business intelligence, or data platform development. Must have hands\-on experience designing and owning enterprise\-scale Gold and Semantic Layer data products across multiple business domains. Deep expertise in SQL and proficiency in Python or equivalent scripting languages. Must have a strong understanding of dimensional modeling, metrics layer design, data lineage, and self\-service analytics frameworks. Experience implementing data quality, observability, and testing standards in production environments. Must have strong hands\-on experience with Databricks, including Databricks SQL warehouse configuration and optimization, Unity Catalog governance and data access management, Delta Lake table design and performance tuning. Familiarity with orchestration, DevOps, and CI/CD practices for analytics workflows. Databricks workflows and job orchestration, and integration of Databricks with dbt and front\-end BI platforms for end\-to\-end analytics delivery. Must have advanced proficiency in front\-end BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent, including enterprise\-scale report and dashboard architecture, semantic model governance, row\-level security, performance optimization, and the ability to establish BI development standards and best practices across teams. Demonstrated ability to mentor less experienced analytics engineers and lead cross\-functional data initiatives. Must have strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. Proven ability to balance multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining high engineering standards. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Databricks accreditations and certifications. Experience in healthcare, payer\-provider, clinical, or regulated data environments. Experience mentoring engineers and influencing cross\-functional technical direction. Knowledge and experience working with large datasets 300 TB and greater. Strong experience with analytics engineering frameworks such as dbt, semantic layer tools, and cloud\-based data platforms on AWS, Azure, or GCP. Experience with governance and secure access models using tools such as Unity Catalog, Lake Formation, or equivalent. Experience supporting AI/ML, feature engineering, vector or unstructured data pipelines, or data products for GenAI use cases. Exposure to infrastructure\-as\-code, automated testing, and platform engineering practices. Additional related education and/or experience preferred. **Estimated Pay Range:** $47\.78 \- $79\.63 / hour Banner Health is committed to pay equity and transparency. The posted compensation range is a reasonable estimate that extends from the lowest to the highest pay Banner Health in good faith believes it might pay for this particular job, based on the circumstances at the time of posting. This range is based on possible base salaries and does not include the value of our total rewards package. Actual pay determined at offer will be based on years of relevant work experience, education, certifications, skills, and geographic location, along with a review of current employees in similar roles to ensure pay equity is achieved and maintained. **EEO Statement:** EEO/Disabled/Veterans Our organization supports a drug\-free work environment. **Privacy Policy:** Privacy Policy

jobs.title: Sr. AI Business Analyst, Enterprise Data Analytics, Remote Eligible, Baptist Health
jobs.description: About Baptist Health Recognized as a top place to work in health care, Baptist Health cares for more patients in Northeast Florida than any other provider, ranking as “most preferred” for more than 30 years. We’re Jacksonville's only locally governed, faith\-based, not\-for\-profit health system and provide a full spectrum of preventive and specialty care through 200\+ locations and six hospitals. Our centers of excellence include Baptist MD Anderson Cancer Center, Baptist Heart Hospital, Baptist Neurological Institute and Wolfson Children's Hospital. **Sr. AI Business Analyst, Enterprise Data Analytics, Remote Eligible, Baptist Health** Senior AI Business Analyst helps Baptist Health determine where AI, machine learning, or automation can deliver the greatest value and whether those investments deliver the expected results. The analyst leads each assessment from the initial opportunity through evaluation after launch. They define the clinical or business problem, assess data readiness and feasibility, compare options, and translate statistically sound findings into clear recommendations for senior clinical and business leaders. As the portfolio grows, this work spans clinical care, operations, revenue cycle, and supply chain. The Senior AI Business Analyst oversees all seven analytics domains and sets standards for how the AI Practice analyzes data, evaluates models and vendor tools, and measures outcomes. They govern the AI use cases in their portfolio and are accountable for the quality of each business case, evaluation method, and outcome measure. After launch, they track performance and measure actual benefits against the original business case. The Senior AI Business Analyst mentors the AI Analyst and Associate AI Analyst and partners with AI Engineers, Data Scientists, MLOps Engineers, Enterprise Architects, and business stakeholders. The analyst leads evaluation and measurement and explains what the results mean for Baptist Health. Engineering teams own production software and the implementation of models and agents. **Sr. AI Business Analyst Responsibilities:** * Lead the assessment and prioritization of AI opportunities across Baptist Health. * Build business cases with clear assumptions, quantitative evidence, and a comparison of available approaches. * Set standards for use\-case assessment, statistical analysis, model evaluation, and value measurement. * Evaluate models, applications, and vendor products; define acceptance criteria before implementation. * Analyze enterprise data and work with engineers and data scientists to check that solutions address the original problem. * Set baselines, measure results after deployment, and lead portfolio reviews when investments underperform. * Present findings, risks, and recommendations to clinical and business leaders; coordinate governance evidence and escalate material concerns. * Mentor AI Analysts and Associate AI Analysts and improve the team's analytical methods and templates. **Sr. AI Business Analyst Experience** * 7\+ years of professional experience in advanced analytics, healthcare analytics, data science, or comparable quantitative roles. * Experience evaluating AI or machine learning solutions in production or controlled pilots. * Strong SQL and practical Python or R skills; advanced understanding of statistics, model evaluation, experimental design, and data quality. * Experience building business cases and measuring operational or financial outcomes using large enterprise datasets. * Experience leading complex, cross\-department analyses independently and explain findings to nontechnical executives. * Strong written and verbal communication and experience mentoring analysts or providing technical leadership * Experience working with clinical, revenue\-cycle, supply\-chain, or operational healthcare data, including Epic and enterprise data platforms. * Experience with evaluation of generative AI, LLM applications, and autonomous agents. **Education Requirements:** * BA/BS *required* * Degree in Data analytics, statistics, health informatics, or a related field *preferred* * Master's degree *preferred* **Certification** * Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\) Or a similar current Microsoft expert credential, within 6 months of hire, held active throughout tenure Primary Location: Remote \- Florida 123 Remote St Tallahassee, FL 32301 United States of America

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: **About BeSmartee** BeSmartee is building what commercial lending needs to move forward, starting with FlashSpread. By reducing manual data entry, FlashSpread helps lenders review deals faster, improve financial data accuracy, standardize analysis, and increase credit team capacity. Trusted by 1,000\+ financial institutions, BeSmartee is expanding its technology to support more of the commercial lending process while continuing to serve mortgage lenders with our established origination solutions. **Role Opportunity** We are seeking a Product Engineer is to turn customer problems into reliable, production\-quality software, owning each outcome from discovery and design through release and operation, while building the shared Platform as a Service (PaaS) and the document processing, financial data, and loan application workflows it powers. **Responsibilities** * Own outcomes end to end: take a customer workflow or application problem from discovery and design through implementation, validation, release, and production follow\-up. * Architect with judgment: translate business goals into technical options, acceptance criteria, and a practical delivery plan; produce clear designs for substantial changes, seek feedback early, and make explicit trade\-offs between customer value, delivery time, quality, and maintainability. * Build the shared platform: develop reusable services and APIs for document processing, financial data, and mortgage loan application workflows, with clear contracts, tenant isolation, configuration, observability, and a practical path for existing applications to migrate onto the platform. * Build across boundaries: implement frontend, backend, data, and integration changes, including REST or GraphQL APIs, asynchronous workflows, data\-heavy user interfaces, and relational data models and migrations, collaborating with specialists where appropriate. * Prevent escaped defects: define meaningful automated test coverage, review edge cases with the Quality Engineer, and own code through review, deployment, secure configuration, and monitoring. * Troubleshoot and improve: lead investigation of complex defects and incidents across application code, data, queues, integrations, and cloud infrastructure; communicate impact clearly, document root cause, and deliver durable fixes. * Partner with stakeholders: work with business, design, quality engineering, and security to clarify workflows, surface customer and delivery risks, and turn strategic initiatives and customer commitments into achievable increments. * Raise the team’s standard: review code and designs, mentor peers, document decisions, and improve developer tooling and delivery practices. * Use AI responsibly: apply AI tools to explore requirements, prototype, write and review code, generate tests, and investigate failures, while choosing appropriate tools and models, managing context and cost, protecting customer and company data, and independently verifying the results. **Qualifications** * Proven ownership: at least 7 years of experience building and operating production software, with a record of designing and shipping complex features or systems and being able to explain the decisions, trade\-offs, and post\-release results. * Agentic engineering (required): hands\-on experience with agentic engineering or AI\-driven development in software delivery, including reviewing, testing, and maintaining AI\-generated work. * Full\-stack depth: strong production experience with TypeScript/JavaScript, modern frontend development, APIs, and backend services (Node.js, React, C\#/.NET, or Ruby valued; equivalent depth in a comparable stack welcome), plus strong data modeling, testing, and debugging skills. * Platform and cloud fluency: understanding of multi\-tenant SaaS and PaaS architecture, authorization, and auditability, and working experience with AWS (or equivalent), CI/CD, containers, and production monitoring. * Clear communication: the ability to explain a technical solution to business and technical stakeholders in clear English, and to communicate directly about risks, estimates, incidents, and trade\-offs. * Domain curiosity: experience in financial services, document processing, workflow systems, or legacy modernization is valuable; the ability to learn the domain quickly is essential. * Independent and aligned: comfortable working independently in a small team as requirements evolve, on an agreed schedule with substantial overlap with US Eastern business hours. **Benefits** * 80% of the Employee medical base plan covered by the company * Medical, Vision, Dental, Short/Long Term Disability, and Voluntary Life plans available * 401K with match * Unlimited PTO * Remote office environment with a great value driven culture *BeSmartee, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion or religious creed, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, marital status, family or parental status, disability, military or veteran status, age, or any other basis protected by law. jobs.title: SR Data Engineer
jobs.description: The Senior Data Engineer delivers insights and supports data\-driven decision\-making at Beacon. The engineer will help grow and maintain the enterprise analytics platform and design and implement enhancements within Oracle Health Data Intelligence (HDI) on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC). This role owns analytics solutions end to end: partnering with stakeholders to understand the problem, defining requirements and solution design, building data pipelines and models, translating measure and KPI definitions into validated calculation logic, developing OAC dashboards and scorecards, and supporting testing, deployment, adoption, and ongoing improvement. The Senior Data Engineer will provide technical insight, mentor team members, and ensure accurate, trusted data for clinical, operational, and financial stakeholders. The Senior Data Engineer is expected to work independently and as part of the Enterprise Analytics and Insights team, supporting modernization initiatives across Beacon. **MISSION, VALUES and SERVICE GOALS** * **MISSION:** We deliver outstanding care, inspire health, and connect with heart. * **VALUES:** Trust. Respect. Integrity. Compassion. * **SERVICE GOALS:** Personally connect. Keep everyone informed. Be on their team. **Supports the development and maintenance of a system\-wide clinical analytics platform by:** * Providing technical guidance and recommendations for organizational data needs. * Leading architecture and ETL pipeline development for Oracle HDI on OCI and OAC. * Ensuring ongoing accuracy of inbound and outbound feeds; monitoring for changes in source systems. * Serving as a subject matter expert on clinical, quality, payer, and financial data sources. * Building and maintaining source\-of\-truth relationship tables to support registries, attribution, and performance reporting. * Implementing standard practices and nomenclature for use within HDI/OCI, aligned with analytics governance policies. * Collaborating with Clinical Analytics, Finance, Quality, Nursing, Care Coordination, and Information Systems to optimize data usage. * Partnering with IS and other departments to optimize the platform through software upgrades and enhancements. * Structuring data in a way that is easy to understand, query, and display. Building reusable data products, semantic models, measures, and analytics components that scale across the enterprise rather than one\-off reporting solutions. Helping develop OAC and OCI as a scalable enterprise analytics platform that supports governed self\-service analytics, trusted KPIs, and consistent decision support. **Leads Clinical Analytics team data engineering activities that deliver future\-state data architecture by:** * Providing technical guidance and advice across the enterprise. * Mentoring, training, and coaching data engineers and analysts. * Leading projects using sound project management methods, including documenting requirements, data flows, and governance alignment. * Researching and implementing modern cloud\-native data management techniques to ensure sustainability. * Developing documentation to support team knowledge and continuity. * Promoting a culture of data\-driven decision making across Beacon, embedding predictive analytics and workflow\-integrated dashboards. Engaging directly with clinical, operational, and business stakeholders to clarify needs, challenge assumptions constructively, recommend solutions, and build support for adoption. Managing multiple concurrent initiatives, communicating priorities and risks clearly, and driving work from discovery through delivery and measurable use. **ORGANIZATIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES** Associate complies with the following organizational requirements: * Attends and participates in department meetings and is accountable for all information shared. * Completes mandatory education, annual competencies and department specific education within established timeframes. * Completes annual employee health requirements within established timeframes. * Maintains license/certification, registration in good standing throughout fiscal year. * Direct patient care providers are required to maintain current BCLS (CPR) and other certifications as required by position/department. * Consistently utilizes appropriate universal precautions, protective equipment, and ergonomic techniques to protect patient and self. * Adheres to regulatory agency requirements, survey process and compliance. * Complies with established organization and department policies. * Available to work overtime in addition to working additional or other shifts and schedules when required. **Education and Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Engineering, Informatics, or related field; Master’s preferred. * 5\+ years in data engineering, including 2\+ years with cloud\-based healthcare analytics platforms. * Experience in application support, data management, programming, or database management, preferably in a healthcare setting. **Knowledge \& Skills** * Ability to lead major projects or multiple smaller projects simultaneously. * Expertise in database platforms with emphasis on clinical analytics quality. * Ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate information with urgency and accuracy. * Deep understanding of relational database structures and concepts. * Familiarity with healthcare revenue cycle and delivery systems. * Strong prioritization, organization, and communication skills. * Strong consultative and presentation skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts in plain language, influence decisions, and establish credibility with stakeholders and leaders. * Ability to translate business and clinical measure definitions into documented, testable, and validated calculation logic. * Ability to mentor and coach team members. * Determination and perseverance through ambiguous or challenging work. Preferred Skills * Integration of multiple source systems into HDI/OCI. * ETL pipeline design, development, and optimization. * SQL expertise; experience with Oracle Analytics Cloud for dashboards, scorecards, and KPI delivery. * Knowledge of Cerner CCL, HL7/FHIR, and event\-driven models. * Experience with NQF\-certified measures, regulatory reporting, and payer attribution models. * Familiarity with predictive analytics and risk stratification models. * Hands\-on experience embedding analytics into clinical workflows (dot phrases, auto\-populated registries). Experience using AI\-assisted development and analytics tools to accelerate engineering, documentation, testing, and solution delivery. Familiarity with AI agents, secure API\-based integrations, and emerging interoperability approaches such as Model Context Protocol (MCP). **Working Conditions** * Works in an office, hybrid, or remote work environment. * May be required to vary hours and days, and work on holidays, weekends, etc., depending upon the needs of the department. **Physical Demands** * Requires the physical ability and stamina to perform the essential functions of the position. Location: Beacon Health System · Information Systems Schedule: Full\-time, Day, Monday \- Friday 8:00 \- 5:00

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer, AI Security
jobs.description: Beacon is looking for a Sr. Security Engineer, AI Security to own the safe use of AI at Beacon and across the companies in our portfolio. You will design and operate the security controls, harden the systems that AI tools and agents connect to, and work closely with engineering on identity, authorization, and network protections for AI agents and other non\-human workloads. **Key Responsibilities:** ------------------------- * Give every agent an owner, scoped credentials, least privilege, and approvals where the action calls for it, and track it from creation to offboarding like a user. * Own the security requirements for AI integrations (MCP connections, OAuth grants), memory, and retrieval, and set tenant defaults and approved connectors. * Keep a live view of AI tools and agents, including AI features that vendors turn on inside tools we already use. * Put limits on tool calls, network access, data egress, and resource use. * Threat model and adversarially test our internal AI platform and agents, covering prompt injection, data disclosure, unsafe tool use, and unauthorized actions. Turn findings into regression tests and release gates. * Define the logs AI systems must produce, build detections for risky grants and sensitive data going into AI tools, lead the AI side of incidents, and join the on\-call rotation. * Give a quick yes with conditions on new tools, and keep approved patterns and a pre\-cleared list so most requests need no review. * Add an AI inventory and the same standards to the security baseline for each acquisition. **What we are looking for:** ---------------------------- * About 5 to 7 years in security engineering, application security, or cloud security. * Hands\-on experience securing LLM applications, agents, or AI developer tools, including prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency, and insecure tool use. * Strong in non\-human identity: OAuth, SSO, SCIM, service accounts, and secrets. * Writes and ships code, building the tooling instead of stopping at a recommendation. * Explains risk clearly to engineers and non\-engineers, and can say yes with conditions. * Works independently, is comfortable in greenfield work, and is willing to join the on\-call rotation. * Uses AI in everyday work and has informed judgment about where it is useful. **Nice to have:** * Experience building evaluations or adversarial tests for AI systems. * Experience with AI gateways, SSPM, CASB, or DLP tools. * Familiarity with the NIST AI Risk Management Framework or ISO 42001\. **Our Values at Beacon Holdings:** ---------------------------------- * Humility: We acknowledge that the path to getting to the right answer involves being wrong along the way. We have strong beliefs which are weakly held. We actively seek new ideas and believe we can learn from anyone at any time. * Honesty: We are truth seeking in our approach to business problems. Business is a repeat game and we believe that human relationships generate alpha. We understand that trust is earned over a lifetime and can be lost in an instant. * Hunger: We play to win. We hold ourselves to high standards and will not be outworked. We take pride in having a deep sense of responsibility to ourselves, each other, our partners, and our customers. We believe to whom much is given much is expected. * Horizon: We seek to build a generational software company. This will take decades. We manage our expectations and those of our partners to take advantage of the 8th wonder of the world \- compounding growth. ***How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process:*** *To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Beacon Software uses Artificial Intelligence and AI\-enabled tools to assist with screening, reviewing, organizing and highlighting profiles and applications that match the key requirements for each role.* ***AI does not make hiring decisions:*** *Every application is reviewed by a member of our team, and all decisions throughout the process are made by humans. We use AI to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment. We are committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable experience for every candidate.*

jobs.description: **About This Role:** As Biogen's Head of AI Cybersecurity Engineering, you will be the senior\-most technical and strategic leader responsible for all Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning security engineering at Biogen. This pivotal role encompasses the complete AI security engineering lifecycle, including AI/ML Model Security, LLM Application Protection, AI Agent Governance, Data Pipeline Integrity, and Adversarial Threat Defense. You will be accountable for securing, scaling, and enabling compliant AI capabilities across every business unit and platform within Biogen's global ecosystem. Reporting directly to the Global Leader of Cybersecurity, you will serve as a key member of the Cybersecurity leadership team, driving strategic accountability through purpose\-built detection systems, automated guardrails, secure\-by\-design AI architectures, and cross\-functional partnerships with Data Science, Digital, and Research stakeholders. Your leadership will be instrumental in shaping AI security engineering strategy and executing a multi\-year roadmap to automate model risk assessment, reduce manual security review cycles, and position Biogen's AI security capabilities as a competitive advantage in regulatory compliance, responsible AI governance, and operational resilience. **What You’ll Do:** * Own the multi\-year AI security engineering strategy and technology roadmap aligned to Cybersecurity, Data Science, and enterprise objectives. * Establish stakeholder credibility through data\-driven planning, clear prioritization frameworks, and measurable outcomes. * Identify and prioritize automation opportunities across the AI security portfolio, driving the manual review rate toward full autonomous assessment. * Lead strategic evaluation and adoption of emerging AI security technologies, including adversarial ML detection and LLM guardrails. * Develop business cases for AI security investments Manage deliverables, resource allocation, change management, and stakeholder communications. * Drive AI security automation transitioning manual model risk assessments to automated evaluation pipelines. * Lead adoption of MLSecOps and AI\-augmented workflows to accelerate secure AI deployment. * Serve as the AI security subject matter authority across Biogen, engaging with business leaders on AI risk posture. * Work cross\-functionally with Data Science, Digital, Research, Compliance, and Legal teams to drive secure AI adoption. * Establish and maintain AI security policies, procedures, and standards through periodic review and change management. * Support regulatory requirements and serve as AI security authority for audits. **Who You Are:** You are a visionary leader with a rare blend of technical mastery and strategic acumen in AI cybersecurity domains. You possess a strong ability to engage and influence senior executives, guiding them through complex AI security landscapes. Your proactive mindset and innovative approach enable you to anticipate threats and forge solutions that enhance Biogen's AI security posture. You are committed to fostering an environment of continuous learning and improvement, nurturing teams that thrive on autonomy and excellence. Your passion for AI and cybersecurity drives you to push boundaries, securing Biogen's AI capabilities while ensuring compliance and governance remain top priorities. **Required Skills:** * Master's Degree in cybersecurity, computer science, machine learning, or related field preferred. * At least 15 years of experience in cybersecurity, with expertise in adversarial and defensive operations. * Proven track record in designing, building, and deploying production security systems at scale. * Deep expertise in AI/ML security, including adversarial ML, prompt injection, and training data poisoning. * Demonstrated success in managing budgets of $5M\+ and leading teams of 15\+. * Experience in driving large\-scale automation transformations and developing autonomous teams. **Preferred Skills:** * Proficiency in Python, Go, or equivalent production\-grade programming languages. * Strong knowledge of transformer architectures and agentic frameworks. * Experience engaging with Data Science, Research, and Digital leadership on enterprise\-wide initiatives. Job Level: Management **Additional Information** The base compensation range for this role is: $208,000\.00\-$286,000\.00 Base salary offered is determined through an analytical approach utilizing a combination of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills \& experience, job location, and internal equity. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Self-Host Orchestration
jobs.description: Bitwarden empowers enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely store and share sensitive data. With a transparent, open\-source approach to password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations, Bitwarden makes it easy for users to extend robust security practices across all online activities. Founded in 2016 with headquarters in Santa Barbara, California, Bitwarden is supported by a passionate global community of security experts and enthusiasts. As a Software Engineer on the Self\-host Orchestration team at Bitwarden, you will directly contribute to projects that our customers use to deploy Bitwarden into their infrastructure. You'll be a part of the team that builds and maintains the packaging, testing, and deployment for our self\-host product, including our Helm chart project. This role also offers the opportunity to interact directly with our open source community through pull request and triaging community issues. This is an all remote team and we are looking for a US based engineer. We don not offer sponsorship at this time **RESPONSIBILITIES** * Be the expert and authority on our Self\-host Helm charts and our wider self\-host architecture including: backend infrastructure, APIs, database, web app, and how the mobile apps, browser extensions, desktop apps, interact with self\-host * Build and maintain our Self\-host Helm charts and self\-host infrastructure, delivery pipeline, automation, SDLC and development practices. * Collaborate with the rest of the team on system design for our owned tools and codebase. * Collaborate closely with our Implementation Engineering and Customer Success teams to understand client needs and implement technical solutions to address them * Build and maintain tools that deploy \& test our self\-host stacks on diverse infrastructure setups * Participate in hands\-on development of Bitwarden products * Use, maintain, and augment or AI skills and infrastructure as part of our AI\-driven product delivery lifecycle. * Participate in code reviews, learning and spreading technical knowledge * Contribute bug fixes for issues submitted by the user community **WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN** * High proficiency with containerization and container orchestrators, such as Kubernetes with experience with at least one cloud hosted Kubernetes service (EKS, AKS, GKE) * Proficiency creating and maintaining Helm charts * Experience with Argo CD, Fluxcd, or alternative GitOps delivery tools * Proficiency with at least one cloud platform, Azure preferred * Proficiency with Git and dependency management * Experience writing code in at least one programming language, .NET or Python preferred * Proficiency with Linux server administration including Nginx and Bash and/or PowerShell scripting * Excellent communication skills, collaborative mindset, and a zeal for learning — your first phase will be learning everything you can from other team members and documentation **NICE\-TO\-HAVES** * User of Bitwarden * Startup experience * Open source experience * Remote work experience within an Agile sprint\-based project management workflow * Experience with CI/CD tooling such as GitHub Actions * Experience self\-hosting; extra points for experience self\-hosting Bitwarden and/or self\-hosting on Windows * Experience with Ansible, Terraform, Packer, etc. * Experience with Kubernetes security **WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS** Selected candidates will be invited to schedule a 30\-minute screening call and then progress through the following stages: * Interview with Hiring Manager * A take\-home test where you can show off your skills * Interview with the Team * Additional Interviews as required **A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US** * Our user community loves us and we love them. You'll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. * We are dedicated to building an incredible team. jobs.description: **WHAT IS BOX?** Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI\-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including AstraZeneca, JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia. By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It's the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift. **WHY BOX NEEDS YOU** Box Shield is an add\-on security control that helps you protect the flow of information and reduce content\-centric risks with precision — without slowing down work. It allows classification\-based security controls to automatically prevent data loss, and AI\-powered, context\-aware alerts to detect potential data theft and malicious content. Box Shield enables secure hybrid work from anywhere, anytime, and any device with native tools that help secure content at scale. The Shield team is looking for ML engineers with a passion for building out enterprise security features that are able to handle complex use\-cases in a robust and easy\-to\-use way. Shield's mission is to protect the flow of an enterprise's information while delivering frictionless user experience so that Box is the tool of choice for secure Cloud Content Management. Shield helps customers keep their content secure by detecting malicious software in their content, potentially compromised accounts, and anomalous behavior so that Administrators have the right information to act before a problem occurs. As an engineer on our team, you will join a diverse, fast\-paced, mainly backend/core team that works together to build new capabilities that help Box's customers protect their Box content. Security being a horizontal product, you will work across teams to design and implement capabilities that power high\-demand use\-cases in a future\-proof way. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Build Threat Detection Models: Design, train, and deploy ML models for ransomware detection, suspicious session identification, and user behavior analytics, anomaly detection * Scale Data Pipelines: Own end\-to\-end ML pipelines that process high\-volume security event streams using Apache Spark, GCP Dataflow, GCP Dataproc, BigQuery and Vertex AI * Feature Engineering: Create and maintain feature stores that power real\-time and batch anomaly detection systems * Production ML Systems: Deploy, monitor, and iterate on ML models in production, serving enterprise customers at scale * Cross\-functional Collaboration: Partner with Platform, Application Engineering, and Product teams to translate security requirements into ML solutions * Participate in our on\-call rotation, available at all times while on\-call to help respond to and triage any issues that arise. **WHO YOU ARE** We are an AI\-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box. * 5\+ years of experience in applied machine learning * Lead design and implementation efforts in building, deploying and supporting scalable ML systems * Experience with GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Dataflow) or equivalent (AWS SageMaker, Azure ML) * Strong communication skills with ability to explain complex ML concepts to non\-technical stakeholders * Ownership mindset with focus on delivering high\-quality work both technically \& collaboratively **MUST\-HAVE EXPERIENCE** * Bachelors or above degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. * Strong command of machine learning fundamentals, including model training and evaluation (model weights, loss functions, precision, recall, F1, calibration), feature engineering, embeddings, and real\-world data issues such as class imbalance, label noise, and model drift. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Internal Platform & AI Tooling (TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL)
jobs.description: BusinessRate's product team ships fast. This team builds what the rest of the company runs on: the internal software our staff use every day, and the systems that keep AI\-assisted development safe. What we're looking for \- 3–5 years writing production software in TypeScript or Node.js. \- You've built software other people use to do their jobs, and you've watched them use it. \- You've run PostgreSQL in production: migrations, indexes, query plans on large tables. \- You've owned CI/CD or a release process, not just used one. \- You think about failure modes, and you've built alerts or checks that caught a real problem. \- You use AI coding tools and have opinions about where they need limits. How to apply Send a link to code you wrote, plus 2–3 sentences on the hardest bug in it. Applications without a code link won't be reviewed. You must live in the Phoenix metro area now; we don't offer relocation. Process 1\. A 20\-minute call where you walk us through the code you linked. 2\. An onsite practical in a TypeScript/Postgres codebase. You'll fix a bug and add a feature, with AI tools allowed, then explain what you changed. jobs.title: Principal Search AI Engineer
jobs.description: We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. ### **Position Summary** The Principal Search AI Engineer is a senior individual contributor responsible for defining the technical vision, architecture, and engineering direction for large\-scale **Search and AI platforms**. The role combines deep expertise in information retrieval, distributed systems, machine learning, Generative AI, and agentic architectures to build intelligent search capabilities that are scalable, reliable, observable, and production\-ready. This individual serves as a technical authority across engineering teams, establishing reference architectures, reusable patterns, and paved\-road capabilities while remaining hands\-on with architecture, prototyping, design reviews, and complex engineering challenges. The role drives outcomes through technical leadership and influence rather than direct people management. ### **Primary Responsibilities** * Define the **technical vision and reference architecture for Search AI**, including search, retrieval, ranking, relevance, AI\-assisted retrieval, and intelligent query processing. * Architect highly scalable **distributed search and retrieval systems** capable of supporting high\-volume, low\-latency, mission\-critical applications. * Establish architecture and engineering patterns for **Generative AI and agentic systems**, including LLM orchestration, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool integration, memory/context management, workflow orchestration, and multi\-agent systems. These capabilities align with the broader architectural patterns being used for production agentic systems. * Design and evolve **search relevance and ranking architectures**, including lexical retrieval, semantic/vector retrieval, hybrid search, query understanding, intent detection, learning\-to\-rank, reranking, personalization, and related ML techniques. * Establish patterns for **AI\-enabled retrieval and reasoning**, balancing deterministic search techniques with probabilistic AI/ML approaches based on quality, latency, cost, explainability, operational complexity, and measurable outcomes. * Lead architectural decisions for **agentic search**, including how agents discover and use tools, access data, retrieve knowledge, maintain context, orchestrate workflows, and interact with external services. * Define the **evaluation strategy for Search AI**, including offline evaluation, relevance metrics, online experimentation, production telemetry, AI quality evaluation, regression testing, and continuous improvement. * Establish operational standards for Search AI covering **availability, resiliency, latency, scalability, observability, incident response, capacity, and cost efficiency**. Your architecture discussions have similarly emphasized performance, resiliency, technical debt, cross\-team dependencies, and engineering consistency * Partner with platform and infrastructure teams to ensure AI capabilities can move successfully from **experimentation and prototypes into secure, scalable production systems**. Enterprise guidance also specifically calls out reference architectures and standardized frameworks to accelerate this transition. * Provide technical direction for **data ingestion, indexing, enrichment, embeddings, retrieval, and serving architectures**, clearly separating platform responsibilities where doing so improves scale and ownership. * Lead architectural reviews and provide **design authority** on significant Search AI initiatives, identifying architectural risks, unnecessary complexity, scalability concerns, and long\-term technical debt. * Remain **hands\-on with critical technology decisions**, prototypes, reference implementations, performance investigations, and complex production issues rather than operating solely as an architecture governance role. * Evaluate emerging technologies and frameworks through **engineering evidence rather than technology hype**, using prototypes, benchmarks, quality metrics, operational characteristics, security, cost, and maintainability to guide adoption. * Influence technology strategy across multiple teams and establish **consistent engineering patterns** without requiring direct organizational authority. * Balance near\-term delivery with **long\-term architectural sustainability**, ensuring platforms can evolve as search algorithms, AI models, agent technologies, and product requirements change. \*\*Ideal candidate can be located anywhere in the US , work remote and EST coast time\*\* ### **Required Qualifications** * 10\+ years of software engineering experience buildin e designing **large\-scale distributed systems**, including APIs, microservices, asynchronous/event\-driven architectures, caching, databases, messaging, and high\-throughput data\-processing systems. * Strong understanding of **machine learning applied to search**, such as classification, ranking, embeddings, semantic retrieval, reranking, recommendations, or personalization. * Experience with modern **Generative AI architectures**, including LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector retrieval, prompt/context engineering, model evaluation, and AI application patterns. * Understanding of **agentic AI architecture**, including agents, tools, orchestration, planning, memory/context, routing, evaluation, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop patterns. * Experience architecting production capabilities on at least one major cloud platform such as **AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform**, with the ability to reason across cloud technologies rather than being tied to one vendor. Internal AI architecture guidance similarly spans AWS, Azure, and GCP rather than prescribing a single stack. * Strong understanding of production engineering practices including **automated testing, CI/CD, DevSecOps, observability, performance engineering, resiliency, security, and operational readiness**. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Demonstrated ability to influence architecture and engineering direction across **multiple teams without direct reporting authority**. * Proven ability to communicate complex technical decisions, tradeoffs, and architecture to both highly technical audiences and senior business/product stakeholders. * Experience building or modernizing **enterprise\-scale search platforms** or other high\-volume information\-retrieval systems. * Experience with **learning\-to\-rank, neural retrieval, embeddings, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, personalization, or recommendation systems**. * Experience designing **multi\-agent or agentic applications** that integrate models, enterprise data, APIs, tools, workflows, and external systems. * Experience defining **Search/AI quality metrics**, experimentation frameworks, evaluation pipelines, production monitoring, and feedback loops. **Education** * Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent experience (HS diploma \+ 4 years relevant experience) **Pay Range** The typical pay range for this role is: $144,200\.00 \- $288,400\.00 This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full\-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. jobs.title: Director, AI Engineer - Data ML Platform
jobs.description: Director, AI Engineer \- Data ML Platform At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real\-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world\-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI \& ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world\-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high\-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build. **Team Description:** The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand\-in\-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI at scale, and where it matters most. How well our sequential models perform depends on the data they learn from, and on how fast we can turn a question about that data into an answer. We’re hiring a Director of AI Engineering to lead the engineering behind that data. That means building the pipelines and systems that bring new data sources in, turn them into model\-ready representations at scale, and let our scientists test a data hypothesis in days instead of months. . **What You’ll Do:** * Partner with a cross\-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI\-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One. * Oversee the design, development, testing, deployment, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc. * Make high judgment build\-vs\-buy decisions across a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more. * Invent and introduce state\-of\-the\-art foundation model optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems. * Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One. * Attract and retain top talent in the AI industry and nurture personal and professional development for your team. Foster a culture of learning and staying abreast of the state\-of\-the\-art in AI. * Translate the enterprise AI strategy into portfolio\-level execution plans across multiple product areas, balancing innovation with delivery discipline * Scale AI engineering practices across teams through shared infrastructure, reusable components, and unified observability and governance frameworks * Establish enterprise standard for Responsible AI, including fairness metrics, model evaluation protocols, documentation requirements, and audit readiness * Partner with research, compliance, and enterprise risk teams to ensure deployed systems meet emerging ethical and regulatory standards **The Ideal Candidate:** * We’re looking for an engineering leader who thrives embedded in science and research teams. You work side by side with scientists, help shape experiments from the start, and turn research ideas into data systems quickly, without waiting for a handoff. * You design infrastructure that is reliable, reproducible, and versioned, so every experiment can be traced back to exactly the data it used. You know when to harden a pipeline and when to keep it fast and disposable. * You’ll lead a team of engineers who work the same way, partnering closely with our science leadership, but your edge is leverage: knowing which engineering investments will speed up the whole research loop, and delivering them. * You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good * Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production * You get fulfillment from empowering others to achieve their potential nce building and leading multi\-team AI organization delivering multiple enterprise products or capabilities concurrently * Proven ability to expand and execute long\-term AI platform strategies aligned to enterprise priorities and regulatory frameworks * Experience establishing cross\-functional operating rhythms and review cadences (OKRs, AI governance councils, quarterly reviews) * Experience right\-sizing models, instance counts, and hardware types given requirements (e.g., context length, token inputs, token outputs) ***Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.*** The minimum and maximum full\-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. jobs.description: Principal Associate, Data Scientist (Deep Learning) Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast\-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data\-driven decision\-making. As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives. **In this role, you will:** * Partner with a cross\-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers love * Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data * Build machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation * Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals **The Ideal Candidate is:** * Customer first. You stay current on published state\-of\-the\-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. * Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. * A leader. jobs.description: 8116 \- Midtown Office \- 2220 W. Broad Street, Richmond, Virginia, 23220 CarMax, the way your career should be! **About this job** At CarMax, we are industry disruptors. At the heart of our innovation is new digital products. The CarMax Conversational AI team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer as we continue to push the boundaries of conversational AI in Retail settings – specifically through webchat on CarMax.com. Experience in the following Required * 4\+ years hands on development with RESTful APIs and event based integrations. Preferably in Azure using .NET. * Extensive knowledge and experience with Object Oriented Design and Principles. Hands\-on experience with Microsoft.NET (\#C) and .NET Core * Knowledge and experience with Cloud services, CI/CD pipelines, and coding best practices * Experienced in troubleshooting and monitoring production integrations. * Hands on UX/UI programming experience with Angular/React and HTML/CSS. Experience in the following preferred: * Azure experience preferred. * Experience with prompt engineering and LLM as a judge preferred. Work Location and Arrangement: This role will be based out of the Richmond Midtown or Plano Tech hub and have a Hybrid work arrangement. * Associates based in Richmond work on\-site 4 days per week. * Associates based in Plano work onsite 2 days per week. Work Authorization: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. Sponsorship will **not** be considered for this specific role. **About CarMax** CarMax disrupted the auto industry by delivering the honest, transparent and high\-integrity experience customers want and deserve. This innovative thinking around the way cars are bought and sold has helped us become the nation’s largest retailer of used cars, with over 200 locations nationwide. Our amazing team of more than 25,000 associates work together to deliver iconic customer experiences. Along the way, we help every associate grow their career and achieve their best, at work and in their community. We are recognized for our commitment to training and diversity and are one of the FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For®. jobs.title: Lead Field Engineer - Automated Logic
jobs.description: **About Carrier** Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting\-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world\-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier. **About ALC** At Automated Logic, we've been developing and supporting intelligent building solutions that have helped customers, including small businesses to Fortune 500 corporations, operate their buildings more efficiently for over 40 years. Our solutions help reduce energy consumption, lower utility, operating and maintenance costs, and improve indoor air quality, occupant comfort, and productivity. Technology that supports the buildings and industry of today and tomorrow requires a wide range of talents and skill sets. **About This Role** At Automated Logic, a Carrier Company, we provide a work home for seasoned experts. As a Lead Field Engineer, you are the primary technical owner for turn\-key project delivery. We are looking for trusted advisors who can navigate complex system architectures and provide high\-level mentorship to the field team. This role demands proficiency of ALC and/or building automation systems and the flexibility to travel as project priorities shift. If you are a proactive leader who thrives on end\-to\-end accountability and solving high\-stakes automation challenges, you’ll fit right in. Our technicians say: “I finally found it. Not just a job. Not just a paycheck. A work home.” If that sounds like you, welcome home. **Key Responsibilities** * **Turn\-Key Delivery:** Own the install, commissioning, and troubleshooting of DDC systems. Deliver full software solutions, including sequencing, graphics, and alarms. * **Technical Leadership:** Act as the lead resource and mentor for junior techs. Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, ensuring predictable, high\-quality outcomes. * **Risk \& Coordination:** Partner with Project Managers to manage risk and align execution. Coordinate with teams to ensure clear communication and reliable delivery. * **Travel \& Flexibility:** Travel as needed and stay adaptable to shifting priorities, project demands, and field workloads. * **Proficiency \& Growth:** Demonstrate deep proficiency with ALC products, system architectures, and ASHRAE guidelines. Apply this expertise to deliver safe, high\-performance systems across complex customer environments. * **Project Integrity:** Maintain expert\-level documentation, including commissioning logs and progress tracking, to ensure safe and compliant system delivery. **Required Qualifications** * High School Diploma or GED. * 4\+ Years of professional experience in HVAC, Building Automation, Information Technology, or Industrial Networking, including direct experience with IP networking, Modbus protocols, or PLC programming. * Must possess a valid, current Driver’s License and be insurable by the company’s insurance carrier. * Ability to lift items up to 50 lbs and perform physical tasks such as squatting and climbing for extended periods. * Capable of working over 8 feet above grade and proficient in the use of ladders and motorized lift equipment. **Preferred Qualifications** * **Leadership \& Mentorship:** Proven ability to act as a technical authority and mentor junior engineers in a collaborative field environment. * **Complex Project Delivery:** Executes turnkey building automation solutions with minimal oversight, focusing on high\-quality field execution and resource management. * **Advanced Integration \& Networking:** High skills\-level proficiency in integrating diverse platforms and managing complex TCP/IP and wireless networking. * **System Troubleshooting:** Advanced diagnostic skills for resolving high\-level technical challenges in controls, sensors, and software, at the equipment and system level. * **Training \& Communication:** Dedicated to delivering site\-specific technical training to building owners and operators while maintaining clear documentation. **Pay Range** The annual salary for this position is between $64,500\.00 \- $129,500\.00 annually. Factors which may affect pay within this range include, but are not limited to, skills, education, experience, and other unique qualifications of the successful candidate. The pay range will not be below the minimum wage applicable to the jurisdiction in which the applicant is to be employed.**Other Compensation** This position may be entitled to short\-term cash incentives, subject to plan requirements.**Benefits** Employees are eligible for benefits, including: * **Health Care Benefits**: Medical, Dental, Vision; Wellness incentives * **Retirement Benefits** * **Time off and Leave**: Paid vacation days, up to 15 days; paid sick days, up to 5 days; paid personal leave, up to 5 days; paid holidays, up to 13 days; birth and adoption leave; parental leave; family and medical leave; bereavement leave; jury duty leave; military leave; purchased vacation * **Disability**: Short\-term and long\-term disability * **Life Insurance and Accidental Death and Dismemberment** * **Tax\-Advantaged Accounts:** Health Savings Account; Health Care Spending Account; Dependent Care Spending Account * **Tuition Assistance** **To learn more about our benefits offering, please click here** **Work with us \| Carrier Corporate****.** The specific benefits available to any employee may vary depending on state and local laws and eligibility factors, such as date of hire and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements. **Carrier EEO Statement and Accommodations Process** Carrier is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
