If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete the application process, participate in an interview, or otherwise engage in the hiring process, please contact us at Carrier.Recruiting@carrier.com. We will make every effort to meet your needs in accordance with applicable laws. **Application Deadline** Applications will be accepted for at least 3 days from Job Posting Date: 19 November 2026**Job Applicant's Privacy Notice** Please click on the link to review the Job Applicant Privacy Notice. **Use of AI** Technology\-enabled tools may support parts of the recruitment process, with oversight by people.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Voices
jobs.description: **About Cartesia** ================== Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do. We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large\-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design\-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences. We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90\+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI. **About the Role** ------------------ Cartesia builds real\-time multimodal intelligence: fast, state\-of\-the\-art voice models and the products that make them useful. We started as a research lab, pioneered the state space model architecture, and now we're bringing that research to customers through intuitive tools for creating, testing, and shipping with voice. We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our Voices team. Every conversation powered by Cartesia starts with a voice. The Voices team builds how customers find, clone, and design voices that sound right for their product, in any language. The work reaches across the company. You’ll work closely with: * **Research**: Turn new model capabilities into product features, such as turning voices multilingual and steering voices to match the ideal profile. * **Platform and infra**: Serve every voice reliably at the scale of our API traffic. * **On\-prem**: Build adaptable interfaces and systems so that voices are available and compatible in a variety of settings and hardware. * **Customer\-facing teams**: Help every customer get a great voice on their own. **Your Impact** --------------- * Build polished product experiences for finding, cloning, and designing voices, from the first listen to a voice running in production. * Design the APIs developers build on, so every capability is as easy to use in code as it is in the product. * Turn early research into features customers use every day, like voice cloning, localization, and voice design. * Build the backend systems that train, store, and serve custom voices at scale, in the cloud and on\-prem. * Raise the quality bar for every voice we launch, with internal tools, automated evaluations, and analytics that show how voices sound and perform. **What You Bring** ------------------ * 3\+ years of experience building and operating customer\-facing software in production, ideally at a high\-growth startup, including owning systems that serve high traffic reliably. We care more about what you’ve shipped and kept running at scale than strict years of experience. * Strong product instincts: you think in customer outcomes, usability, quality, and developer experience, and you have opinions on what to build and why. * Full\-stack range and the ability to own a product surface across frontend, backend, APIs, data, and operational concerns. * Fluent use of coding agents and a habit of keeping pace with the frontier. * Clear communication with technical and non\-technical audiences, strong cross\-functional partnership, and a sharp presence in product and design reviews. **Nice\-To\-Haves** ------------------- * Experience building developer tools, creative tools, playgrounds, or API\-adjacent products. * Experience building AI\-powered products and translating model capabilities, limitations, and quality tradeoffs into understandable user experiences. * Strong frontend craft with React and TypeScript, including polished, highly interactive workflows. * Experience with audio, media, real\-time systems, product analytics, experimentation, or evaluation infrastructure. * Working familiarity with deploying, monitoring, and troubleshooting services on Kubernetes, especially in multi\-cluster setups *Note: Cartesia participates in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with Form I\-9 information to confirm employment eligibility after hire.* **More Details** ================ **In\-office policy:** We’re an in\-person team based out of offices in San Francisco, London and Bangalore. We love being in the office, hanging out together, and learning from each other every day. **Visa sponsorship:** We provide visa sponsorship support and assess each circumstance on a case\-by\-case basis. However, visa sponsorship is dependent on many factors, including the role you are applying for, and the location you are going to be based, and so we can't always guarantee success. Your Recruiter will work with you to understand your visa sponsorship needs from the first call. **We ship fast.** All of our work is novel and cutting edge, and execution speed is paramount. We have a high bar, and we don’t sacrifice quality or design along the way. **We support each other.** We have an open \& inclusive culture that’s focused on giving everyone the resources they need to succeed. **Our Benefits (US Employees Only)** ==================================== **Compensation** Competitive base salary alongside attractive equity package. **Health Insurance** Fully covered medical insurance along with dental and vision for you and your family. **Parental Leave** 9 weeks paternity \& 12 weeks maternity leave **401(k)** **Commuter Allowance** A monthly stipend to help you get to and from the office. **Flexible PTO** Take as much time as you need to recharge your batteries. **Meals \& Snacks** Lunch, dinner and plenty of snacks, provided daily. **Your own personal Yoshi** **Our Commitment to Equal Opportunity** --------------------------------------- *Cartesia is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.* Compensation Range: $180K \- $250K

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **We believe in the power and joy of learning** ----------------------------------------------- At Cengage, our employees have a direct impact in helping learners around the world discover the power and joy of learning. We are bonded by our shared purpose – driving innovation that helps millions of learners improve their lives and achieve their dreams through education. **AI/ML Engineer – Core AI** ---------------------------- The AI/ML Engineer for Core Systems \- Core AI team is a high\-output, full\-stack engineering role aimed at quickly producing fully functional AI\-powered application prototypes. This is a hands\-on position for a versatile engineer who acts swiftly, codes in multiple languages, and uses AI\-assisted development tools to considerably accelerate delivery. Your role involves turning concepts into functional applications, not simply mock\-ups or wireframes. You will build prototypes that prove business value and technical feasibility. The ideal applicant is proficient in modern programming languages and has strong experience working with AWS services. You adopt AI\-forward development techniques using tools like Open AI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Claude, and other AI coding assistants. You have engineering\-level knowledge of LLMs and core AI/ML concepts and can integrate these technologies into production\-ready software. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ Rapid Prototype Development * Produce fully working AI\-enhanced application prototypes swiftly\-from initial concept to working demonstration in just days * Develop end\-to\-end solutions including backend services, APIs, data pipelines, and frontend interfaces * Transform business requirements and technical concepts into tangible, demonstrable applications * Iterate rapidly based on feedback, adjusting quickly to refine or redirect prototypes * Create reusable code libraries, templates, and scaffolding to accelerate future development * Ensure prototypes are sufficiently robust to support collaborator demos and user testing **AI\-Assisted \& AI\-Forward Development** ------------------------------------------- * Leverage AI coding assistants (Codex, GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor) to improve development speed and quality * Keep up to date with new AI development tools and incorporate them into everyday workflows * Use LLMs for code generation, debugging, refactoring, documentation, and test creation * Develop prompt engineering techniques to optimize AI\-assisted coding output * Contribute to team guidelines for AI\-augmented software development * Assess and suggest new AI development tools and methodologies **Cloud Engineering \& Infrastructure** --------------------------------------- * Develop and deploy applications on AWS cloud platforms * Leverage managed AI/ML services including AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, Agentcore, Stands SDK * Implement serverless architectures (Lambda, Azure Functions) for rapid, scalable deployments * Design and build containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes * Configure cloud infrastructure using IaC tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep) * Optimize for cost, performance, and security in cloud environments **AI/ML Integration \& Engineering** ------------------------------------ * Integrate LLMs and foundation models into applications with deep understanding of their capabilities and limitations * Implement RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) architectures, vector databases, and embedding pipelines * Build prompt engineering solutions, fine\-tuning workflows, and model orchestration patterns * Build agentic AI systems and multi\-step reasoning workflows * Apply core ML principles including model evaluation, inference optimization, and responsible AI practices * Connect AI capabilities to enterprise data sources, APIs, and existing systems **Technical Skills** -------------------- Languages \& Frameworks * Primary: Python (FastAPI, Flask, Django), JavaScript/TypeScript (Node.js, React, Next.js) * Secondary: Go, Rust, Java, or C\# – ability to pick up new languages quickly * AI/ML: PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face Transformers * Data: SQL, pandas, Apache Spark; experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector) **Cloud Platforms** ------------------- * AWS: Lambda, Step Functions, Bedrock, SageMaker, S3, DynamoDB, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, EventBridge * Infrastructure: Terraform, CloudFormation, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) **AI Creation Tools** --------------------- * AI Programming Helpers: Codex, Copilot, Claude, Cursor, Kiro * LLM APIs: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI * Development: VS Code, JetBrains IDEs, Jupyter notebooks, Git version control **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; or equivalent experience * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience building nd infrastructure\-as\-code * Strong problem\-solving skills; ability to work independently and ship fast with minimal direction * Portfolio or examples of rapidly built prototypes or applications **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with fine\-tuning LLMs and custom model training * Experience in developing agentic AI systems and autonomous workflows * AWS and/or Azure certifications (Solutions Architect, Developer, AI/ML Specialty) * Experience with real\-time applications, WebSockets, and streaming architectures * Contributions to open\-source AI/ML projects * Experience in EdTech or learning technology industry * Familiarity with MLOps practices and model deployment pipelines * Full\-stack development experience including modern frontend frameworks **Key Competencies** -------------------- * Velocity – Ships working code fast; optimizes for speed without sacrificing core quality * Polyglot Approach – Comfortable across languages and platforms; picks up new tech quickly * AI\-Native Thinking – Instinctively brings to bear AI tools to amplify productivity and capabilities * Full\-Stack Versatility – Builds complete applications from infrastructure to UI * Pragmatic Engineering – Makes smart tradeoffs; knows when "good enough" enables progress * Self\-Direction – Thrives with autonomy; doesn't wait for detailed specifications **What We Offer** ----------------- * High\-impact Core AI role building the future of AI at a leading learning company * Freedom to work with brand\-new AI technologies and development tools * Fast\-paced, innovation\-focused environment that values speed and experimentation * Direct visibility with AI leadership * Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits * Professional development and continuous learning opportunities * Flexible remote/hybrid work arrangements Cengage is committed to working with broad talent pools to attract and hire strong and most qualified individuals. Our job applicants are considered regardless of any classification protected by applicable federal, state, provincial or local laws. Cengage is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities including during our job application process. If you are an applicant with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in our job application process, please contact us at accommodations.ta@cengage.com. **About Cengage** ----------------- Cengage, a global education technology company serving millions of learners, provides affordable, quality digital products and services that equip students with the skills and competencies needed to be job ready. For more than 100 years, we have enabled the power and joy of learning with trusted, engaging content, and now, integrated digital platforms. We serve the higher education, workforce skills, secondary education, English language teaching and research markets worldwide. Through our scalable technology, including MindTap and Cengage Unlimited, we support all learners who seek to improve their lives and achieve their dreams through education. **Compensation** At Cengage Group, we take great pride in our commitment to providing a comprehensive and rewarding Total Rewards package designed to support and empower our employees. Click here to learn more about our *Total Rewards Philosophy*. The full base pay range has been provided for this position. Individual base pay will vary based on work schedule, qualifications, experience, internal equity, and geographic location. Sales roles often incorporate a significant incentive compensation program beyond this base pay range. In this position, you will be eligible to participate in the company’s discretionary incentive bonus program. This position's bonus target amount, which is not guaranteed and is dependent on individual performance and overall company results among other factors, is provided below. 10% Annual: Individual Target $101,900\.00 \- $132,450\.00 USD

jobs.title: Software Engineer 2, Front End
jobs.description: Chamberlain Group (CG) is a global leader in intelligent access and Blackstone portfolio company. Powered by our myQ technology, we make access simple and secure for millions of homeowners, businesses, and communities worldwide. Our flagship brands, LiftMaster® and Chamberlain® , are found in 51\+ million homes, and 14 million\+ people rely on the myQ® app daily. The Chamberlain Group, LLC seeks a Software Engineer 2, Front End in Oak Brook, IL to: Develop and maintain front\-end iOS, Android, and web applications for the company's IoT (Internet of Things) platform, producing high\-quality, maintainable, and scalable software. Analyze product requirements and collaborate with architects, senior engineers, and cross\-functional teams \- including Engineering, Product Ownership, and Quality Assurance \- to translate business needs into technical specifications and software designs. Collaborate with user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) teams to ensure requirements traceability from definition through implementation. Participate in Agile/Scrum development processes, including peer code reviews, pull requests, and design review forums, to maintain code quality and adherence to coding standards. Present software concepts, designs, and technical solutions in design review and community\-of\-practice forums, contributing to ongoing architectural and engineering discussions. Every agency's network has both common and unique features of geometry, structure, labeling, and management practices. You use AI, customized reasoning and logic, and mathematical models to convert these assets into clean, standardized data that powers our CRASH and ADAPT products. You plan and optimize the full lifecycle of digitalizing different assets to meet accuracy requirements. You build and run data cleaning, ingestion, and extraction pipelines; apply LLMs, computer vision, mathematical models, and reasoning where they accelerate the work; and design, improve, and execute evaluation plans that prove the output is correct. You work directly with agency GIS, IT, and engineering staff, and you can explain data issues clearly to both traffic engineers and software engineers. You are resourceful with mathematics and AI technologies, have strong engineering judgment, care about getting the details right, and want your work to have a direct impact on transforming transportation infrastructure. **Expected Duties:** * Own data accuracy for the digitalization of new and existing state and local government clients, from the initial data request through or inconsistencies. * Build, optimize, improve, and maintain pipelines that collect spatial and temporal data (such as 3D\-registered spherical images) and integrate data from other sensors and client systems, including databases, APIs, Esri/ArcGIS services, open data portals, and file transfers. * Own the accuracy of extracting roadway and infrastructure assets from point clouds, imagery, measurements, and other geospatial sources. * Apply AI\-assisted development, mathematical modeling, logical reasoning, and coding to map each agency's infrastructure data onto Citian's standard data model. * Build automated and rigorous QA/QC checks that validate digitalized results against ground truth, and design methods to collect or estimate ground truth. * Evaluate third\-party AI tools, APIs, and mathematical models for extraction work, and weigh build\-versus\-buy tradeoffs with Engineering. * Document data sources, mappings, and processes for each client so onboarding is repeatable and scalable. * Partner with Customer Success, Account Management, and Product to set data timelines, communicate data issues, and feed client needs back into the product roadmap. **Required Skills \& Experience:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, GIS, or a related field. * 3\+ years of professional experience in data engineering, AI/ML engineering, or a related role. * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience applying AI, machine learning, and advanced mathematical models to real\-world data, ideally in a product environment. * Proficiency in Python and SQL for building data pipelines and transforming data. * Hands\-on experience using LLMs, mathematical models, and reasoning to digitalize physical environments at high accuracy. * Experience with AWS services such as S3, Lambda, and related data tools. * Experience building engineering\-based and computer\-based data validation and quality checks. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work directly with external clients and explain technical issues to non\-technical audiences. jobs.title: AI Lifecycle Engineer
jobs.description: Remote, Miami, United States ### **About the Role** You'll be the engineer responsible for what AI\-MSL delivers into a customer's production system. AI\-MSL, CloudGeometry's AI Managed Software Lifecycle platform, takes a change request written in plain language and carries it through requirements, specs, code, tests, and documentation, delivered as a branch that's ready for production. AI agents do the work, and a senior engineer oversees every step. That's you. You won't write every line yourself. You'll guide agent work on real customer codebases, decide whether the results are correct, and own what happens once they reach production. On a typical day you might turn a vague request into a clear spec, review a 400\-line change you didn't write, spot an issue that looks fine in review but would fail under load, and then add a check so it doesn't happen again. You'll work across several customer systems with unfamiliar code, past decisions you weren't part of, and business rules nobody wrote down. Getting up to speed quickly in new code is a big part of the job. The title is still new in our industry, but the work is clear: someone has to be responsible for AI\-built software that real businesses rely on. ### **What You'll Do** * Turn requests into clear specs. Work out what a customer or product owner is really asking for and write a spec the agents can follow. Most bad output starts with an unclear spec. * Guide agent work and review it. Run changes through each step, step in when something goes off track, and decide at each checkpoint whether the work moves forward or goes back. You approve what ships. * Review a lot of code you didn't write. Read changes, specs, and test results closely enough to catch what looks right but isn't, like a missed edge case, a test that passes for the wrong reason, or a change that works on its own but breaks this codebase. * Learn new systems quickly. Understand each customer's codebase, including its conventions, usage patterns, and unwritten rules, and keep AppGraph (our live model of the system) accurate as things change. * Turn mistakes into safeguards. When something slips through, add a rule, test, or check so the system catches it next time. * Own production results. Handle deployment, monitoring, incident response, and the cost and speed of agent runs. Once you approve a change, it's yours. * Share feedback with the platform team. You'll see where AI\-MSL falls short before anyone else. Report it clearly and help shape what gets built next. * Work directly with customers. Explain decisions and tradeoffs to technical and non\-technical people, and push back when a request needs to change before it can run. * Join a daily standup with the team in Europe and South America (between 07:00 and 11:00 MT) and stay reachable on Slack during your working hours. ### **Must\-Haves** * 5\+ years building and running production software, including fixing things when they break * Strong backend fundamentals. Our stack is TypeScript, NestJS, and PostgreSQL, but fluency in any typed language matters more than knowing ours already * Strong code review skills. You can read unfamiliar code and find what's wrong with it, and this is the most important skill for the role * 1\+ years of daily hands\-on use of an AI coding assistant such as Claude Code, with clear opinions on where it struggles and how you work around it * Good testing instincts. You know the difference between a test that passes and a test that proves something * Experience working in codebases you didn't write, ideally several, and a reliable way of getting up to speed * Experience debugging in production with logs and traces, and handling live incidents * Some cloud experience, ideally AWS * Knowing when to stop and ask. We value people who raise questions early over people who guess * Strong written and spoken English, and comfort working asynchronously across time zones ### **Nice\-to\-Haves** * Built something with agents beyond a simple chat tool, such as a skill, hook, harness, or agent that runs on its own * Testing frameworks or automated checks for generated code * Legacy modernization or large refactoring projects * Consulting, agency, or managed services experience, switching between customers in the same week * On\-call or site reliability experience * TypeScript, Next.js, and React, for work on the review interface * Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, and event\-driven architecture * Writing or open\-source contributions about AI\-assisted development * Spanish, or experience working with teams in Latin America ### **Why CloudGeometry** CloudGeometry is a Silicon Valley engineering company. We're an Anthropic Claude Partner, an AWS Advanced Consulting Partner, and a CNCF Kubernetes Certified Service Provider, and we help companies move from scattered AI chat tools to a reliable, well\-governed way of building software. Most engineers using AI today do it on their own, inside processes that weren't built for it. Here you'll work in one that was, on real production systems, with the tools and authority to do it well. * Competitive pay and benefits * Access to Claude Code and the latest AI models * Training budget for courses and certifications * Fully remote, with flexible hours outside one daily standup (07:00 to 11:00 MT) * Experience across many codebases and architectures, which helps your career grow faster Submit Resume Send us an application to jobs@cloudgeometry.com, and we’ll contact you in shortly.

jobs.title: AI Product Engineer
jobs.description: Relocation Assistance Offered Within Country Job Number \#177436 \- Piscataway, New Jersey, United States **Who We Are** Colgate\-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name! Join Colgate\-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all. **Role Summary:** As an AI Product Engineer reporting to the Director of Global Supply Chain Advanced Analytics and AI, you will develop Minimum Viable AI Products (MVPs) and lead the transition of AI MVPs into robust, scalable, enterprise\-grade solutions. You will own the end\-to\-end technical lifecycle of assigned products, including solution architecture, feature development, API integrations, release management, and continuous performance optimization. Collaborating closely with cross\-functional supply chain teams, platform architects, and governance partners, you will align AI product delivery with measurable business value and user adoption. This role offers an exciting opportunity to transform cutting\-edge AI innovations into trusted, high\-impact enterprise applications that drive intelligent supply chain operations. **Responsibilities:** * Develop and productize AI MVPs and approved AI use cases into scalable, reliable, maintainable products. * Own technical execution for assigned AI products, including solution design, backlog, releases, integrations, performance, support, and continuous improvement. * Build and maintain AI product features, workflows, user interfaces, APIs, data integrations, automations, and backend services using approved enterprise platforms and standards. * Partner with business owners and AI Transformation Leads to align product delivery with adoption plans, workflow change, user feedback, and measurable value capture. * Partner with AI Platform Engineers to use approved gateways, models, identity, security, compliance, observability, FinOps, and SDLC standards. * Implement testing, monitoring, evaluation, incident response, release management, documentation, and support processes for AI products. * Track product usage, quality, reliability, user feedback, business outcomes, and performance metrics to guide prioritization and improvements. * Work with AI Governance, Legal, Regulatory, Ethics \& Compliance, and Information Security teams to ensure responsible and compliant product operation. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s in Science Degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Product Engineering, Engineering, Mathematics, or related technical field. * Advanced proficiency in at least one modern programming language such as Python and JavaScript, plus working knowledge of SQL. * 4\+ years experience building, testing, deploying, or supporting software products, enterprise applications, data products, or AI\-enabled solutions. * Experience working with product requirements, user feedback, releases, defects, documentation, and production support processes. * Strong software engineering skills with experience building and maintaining reliable product features, APIs, workflows, integrations, and user\-facing applications. * Strong understanding of APIs, Git, testing, CI/CD, cloud platforms, and production software delivery practices. * Understanding of AI product patterns including LLM applications, RAG, tool calling, agents, prompt management, evaluation, monitoring, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Hands\-on experience with LLM applications, RAG, agentic workflows, AI evaluation, model monitoring, or AI\-enabled workflow tools. * Experience with Agile delivery, product management practices, UX collaboration, APIs, cloud platforms, and enterprise system integrations. * Ability to implement product telemetry, AI evaluation, usage tracking, error monitoring, and performance reporting. * Familiarity with enterprise data sources, application integrations, authentication, authorization, security, privacy, and responsible AI requirements. * Ability to write clear product documentation, support guides, release notes, architecture notes, and operational runbooks. * Familiarity with end\-to\-end supply chain concepts, demand and supply planning processes, or advanced analytics (e.g., machine learning, optimization, and simulation). * Proven ability to influence cross\-functional partners without direct authority and translate technical constraints into actionable business outcomes. **Compensation and Benefits** Salary Range $96,800\.00 \- $135,000\.00 USD Pay is determined based on experience, qualifications, and location. The above hiring range represents the University's good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting.* Position Summary Reporting to the Manager of the AI and Emerging Technologies team, the Associate AI Solutions Engineer performs defined technical work under general supervision to support the development, testing, implementation, and operation of AI\-enabled solutions across Columbia University. Working from approved requirements, documented designs, established standards, and assigned plans, the role builds and configures prototypes, integrations, automations, data workflows, and other components using programming languages, APIs, large language models, and enterprise AI platforms. The Manager and designated senior staff provide direction and retain responsibility for architecture, scope, platform or vendor selection, security and governance decisions, and production approval. The ideal candidate will have the following skillset: * **Hands\-on technical contributor.** Completes assigned development and configuration tasks for prototypes, scripts, integrations, automations, prompts, and data workflows. * **Emerging AI engineer.** Has working knowledge of large language models and AI application patterns and is motivated to deepen that expertise. * **Collaborative problem solver.** Participates in stakeholder discussions, documents needs, investigates defined problems, and communicates findings to the project lead. * **Standards\-aware contributor.** Follows established security, privacy, data governance, accessibility, reliability, documentation, and supportability requirements. * **Continuous learner.** Builds new skills as AI platforms, models, development tools, and responsible AI practices evolve. Responsibilities The Associate AI Solutions Engineer performs assigned technical work within approved project scope, collaborates across CUIT and the University, and escalates issues requiring architectural, security, governance, or production decisions. **Perform Assigned Solution Development and Testing** ----------------------------------------------------- * **Assigned solution development.** Implement assigned components from approved requirements, technical designs, and implementation plans under general supervision. * **Prototype and pilot support.** Build, configure, test, and demonstrate assigned portions of prototypes, pilots, automations, integrations, and proofs of concept using approved tools and platforms. * **Prompt and workflow configuration.** Configure, test, and update prompts, retrieval workflows, tool integrations, and model settings using established patterns and acceptance criteria. * **Data and integration work.** Develop and maintain assigned data flows, API integrations, connectors, scripts, and automations according to documented specifications. * **Testing and evaluation support.** Execute defined test plans and evaluation criteria, record results and limitations, troubleshoot defects, and escalate unexpected outcomes. * **Technical research and documentation.** Conduct assigned research using defined criteria and summarize capabilities and constraints for review. The Manager or designated senior staff make platform, vendor, and build\-versus\-buy recommendations. **Collaborate and Follow University Standards** ----------------------------------------------- * **Responsible AI and governance.** Follow established University requirements for security, privacy, accessibility, data governance, and responsible AI. Prepare documentation, support reviews led by the appropriate owners, and escalate exceptions. * **Stakeholder collaboration.** Participate in working sessions to gather information, demonstrate work within approved scope, document feedback, and complete follow\-up assignments directed by the project lead. * **Documentation and handoff.** Create and update technical documentation, standard operating procedures, configuration records, and support materials using established templates and review processes. **Support Operations and Continuous Improvement** ------------------------------------------------- * **Production support.** Perform assigned deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, maintenance, and improvement activities using established procedures; escalate work beyond approved scope. * **Reusable components.** Create or update scripts, templates, evaluation materials, integrations, and technical patterns for review and reuse. * **Professional development.** Stay current with evolving AI platforms, model capabilities, software development practices, and responsible AI considerations. * **Other duties.** Perform other related duties as assigned. Minimum Qualifications * Bachelor's degree and/or its equivalent required. * Minimum 2\-4 years of related experience. * Experience carrying out defined technical assignments in applied AI, solutions engineering, automation, systems integration, software development, or a related area. * Hands\-on experience with at least one scripting or programming language, such as Python, JavaScript, or a comparable language. * Experience building or supporting applications, APIs, automations, data workflows, integrations, or cloud\-based services. * Working knowledge of large language models, prompt/context engineering, machine learning concepts, or AI application patterns. * Familiarity with security, privacy, and data governance considerations for AI tools in a complex or regulated environment. * Experience with software development practices, including testing, debugging, and technical documentation. * Ability to implement defined requirements and documented technical designs in working prototypes or technical components. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, organizational, and communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts and limitations to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Ability to organize and complete multiple assigned tasks in a fast\-paced environment. * Ability to perform defined technical work under general supervision and independently, when necessary, follow established standards, and escalate issues outside approved scope. * Demonstrated attention to detail and ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues from different technical and functional backgrounds. * Ability to work occasional evenings or off\-hours to support major pilots, launches, or critical service milestones. Preferred Qualifications * Experience contributing to applications or prototypes using large language models, AI APIs, retrieval\-augmented generation, vector databases, workflow automation, or agentic patterns. * Experience with Python or JavaScript. * Experience with cloud platforms, monitoring, or secure software development. * Experience integrating AI capabilities into websites, enterprise applications, collaboration platforms, or business process workflows. * Familiarity with identity management, authorization, privacy, security, accessibility, data governance, and risk considerations for AI\-enabled systems. * Experience in higher education, research, healthcare, government, or another complex or regulated environment. * Experience participating in technical pilots, vendor evaluations, user testing, or implementation activities. * Demonstrated technical work through professional assignments, research, open\-source contributions, or a project portfolio. * Experience communicating technical findings or supporting AI adoption, training, or user enablement for non\-technical audiences. Equal Opportunity Employer / Disability / Veteran Columbia University is committed to the hiring of qualified local residents.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (AI Solution Owner)
jobs.description: CompassX is a boutique business and technology consulting firm. We help Fortune 500 and high\-growth clients deliver their most strategic initiatives, from enterprise transformations to digital and data\-driven projects. With over 15 years of proven results, we’ve expanded across industries including financial services, pharmaceuticals, aerospace, consumer products, and quick service restaurants. We are honored to be recognized as a three\-time winner of Consulting Magazine’s Best Boutique Firms to Work For, and previously recognized as a “Best Place to Work” in Southern California and one of INC.’s 5000 fastest\-growing private companies in the U.S. We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to work inside our clients' businesses and build the AI\-powered applications they need. You'll sit with the people who do the work, understand how the process runs today, and build a working version quickly with AI coding tools. Our teams are small and move fast, so you'll own your application from the first conversation to the last user. Much of our current work is with large, fast\-growing industrial and manufacturing clients whose teams still rely on spreadsheets, email approvals, and disconnected systems. We've been building custom internal tools that replace those, working alongside the platforms the client already uses, such as ERP, CRM, and data and BI systems. The majority of our team are based local to Southern California (LA/OC), and we have some others based across the USA. Occasional travel to client sites is expected. ### **What You'll Do** * You'll work with business users and stakeholders to understand how work really gets done, decide what's worth building, and agree a first release. * You'll build a working prototype yourself using AI coding tools and use it to get early feedback and sign\-off. * You'll take the application to production: connecting it to the client's data and systems, defining the logic and data it needs, testing it, and bringing in our architects and engineers for the parts that need deeper expertise. * You'll make sure people use it, through training, feedback and fixes after launch. * You'll also present progress and results to senior stakeholders, and travel to client sites now and then for workshops and rollouts. ### **What You'll Bring** * Real experience building and shipping applications with AI coding tools (such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or Emergent), and the judgment to review and fix what they produce * Working knowledge of how applications are built and deployed: front\-end frameworks such as React, Python, SQL, APIs, authentication, and testing * Experience taking something from prototype to production in an enterprise environment, including security, integration, and client sign\-off * Strong product instincts: discovery with business users, scoping a first release, and prioritizing * Clear, concise communication with executives and business teams * 8\+ years of experience across consulting, product, solution architecture and/or engineering, ideally with time at a small or mid\-size consulting firm * Bachelor's degree or higher (Computer Science, Engineering, Business) or equivalent demonstrable experience * A plus: experience with ERP, manufacturing, supply chain or enterprise data (for example Oracle) You don't need to train models or do machine learning research. The work is building and deploying applications. $140,000 \- $180,000 a year The posted compensation range reflects the anticipated compensation for this opportunity. Depending on the role, client requirements, and business needs, compensation may be structured as a salaried position with bonus eligibility or as an hourly contract engagement (including 1099 independent contractor arrangements). Final compensation and engagement type will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, market conditions, and the nature of the role. Our consultants say CompassX is a place where they can truly find their own path. As part of a smaller firm, they see the impact of their work, have an identity, and know their voice matters. They value the freedom to take the reins of their careers, shape their client work, and maintain a direct line to leadership. With CompassX’s focus on serving local Southern California clients, consultants not only build lasting relationships but also see the results of their work in the communities where they live. jobs.title: Lead Engineer, AI Security
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Position Summary** As the Lead Engineer, AI Security, you will secure the digital fabric enabling our company’s rapid AI transformation. You will focus entirely on discovering, managing, and securing machine identities, service accounts, API keys, and automated tokens. A primary objective in this role is mapping and restricting data access rights for non\-human actors—both independent automated systems and AI agents operating on behalf of human users. You will act as the critical bridge between core identity security operations and our AI enablement initiatives, ensuring that tools like Microsoft Copilot and emerging LLM technologies operate under strict least\-privilege principles. **Core Responsibilities** * NHI Governance \& Lifecycle: Discover, inventory, and classify all non\-human identities, including Azure/Entra Enterprise Applications, AWS IAM Roles, service accounts, and API keys. * Data Rights \& Privilege Mapping: Analyze, map, and audit the data rights/permissions held by NHIs to understand what sensitive data they can access, either independently or through inheritance from their human owners. * AI \& Copilot Guardrails: Partner with the AI Enablement team to define and enforce access controls for Microsoft Copilot and future AI models, ensuring AI agents cannot access or expose restricted corporate data. * Least\-Privilege Enforcement: Design and implement automated policies to remediate over\-privileged service accounts and eliminate "privilege creep" within AWS and Microsoft environments. * Blast Radius Reduction: Formulate strategies to untangle complex human\-to\-machine permission chains, ensuring a compromised human account does not inadvertently grant an AI or machine identity elevated data rights. Monitoring \& Incident Response: Establish continuous monitoring for anomalous NHI behavior and integrate machine identity alerts that facilitate the AI Observability and Runtime monitoring requirements of the security operations pipeline. * **Required Technical Experience** * Cloud Identity Infrastructure: Deep, hands\-on experience managing identity frameworks in AWS IAM and Azure AD / Entra ID (specifically Workload Identities, App Registrations, and Managed Identities). * Data Security \& Governance: Proven experience auditing data access paths, file\-share permissions, or cloud data store policies (S3, Azure Blob, SharePoint/OneDrive permission structures) and utilizing tools such as Microsoft Purview or Cyera (or equivalent DSPM platforms). * AI Security Context: Familiarity with the security implications of AI deployment, data ingestion pipelines, and how tools like Microsoft Copilot inherit user\-level permissions. This position is responsible for consolidating data from CPI’s operational and financial systems into a centralized lakehouse and for developing operational applications on Palantir Foundry that support plant, field, equipment, and financial decision\-making across the organization. The role spans the full lifecycle of that work: integrating source systems, modeling and governing data, and delivering production applications, including solutions that replace or extend third\-party software and provide real\-time visibility into plants, jobs, trucking, and equipment. The ideal candidate combines strong data engineering fundamentals with sound software development practices and the ability to translate business requirements into reliable technical solutions. This engineer will work alongside CPI’s existing Foundry team and external consulting partners and will serve as the internal owner of the platform’s design and institutional knowledge. Prior Foundry experience is preferred. **Duties and Responsibilities** * Build and maintain ingestion pipelines that bring data from ERP and accounting, estimating, field production, plant operations, equipment, and telematics systems into Databricks, connecting through relational databases, REST APIs, and SFTP or flat\-file feeds. * Develop batch and incremental pipelines in Python, PySpark, and SQL using a layered lakehouse approach that cleans, standardizes, and combines data into documented, reusable datasets. * Help define a common data model across operating companies, including how jobs, equipment, plants, employees, vendors, and customers are keyed and matched when each company and system names them differently. * Build reconciliation checks so that platform figures tie out to jobs.title: Sr FW Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature\-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best\-in\-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category\-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next\-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead. Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today! **Key Responsibilities** * **Firmware Design \& Implementation:** Architect, write, and maintain clean, highly optimized embedded code (C/C\+\+) for resource\-constrained microcontrollers, SoCs, and RTOS or bare\-metal environments. * **Board Bring\-Up \& Validation:** Partner with electrical and hardware engineering teams to bring up new prototypes, configure I/O peripherals, validate schematics, and troubleshoot complex board\-level issues using lab equipment. * **Connectivity \& Protocols:** Implement and optimize wireless and wired communication stacks (e.g., Wi\-Fi, BLE, Cellular/LTE\-M, MQTT, TCP/IP, SPI, I2C, UART). * **Security \& Lifecycle Management:** Build and maintain secure bootloaders, Over\-The\-Air (OTA) firmware update mechanisms, and robust cryptographic routines (encryption, secure key storage, certificate management). * **Power Optimization:** Profile and minimize power consumption for battery\-operated IoT edge devices to maximize field life. * **Technical Leadership:** Serve as a mentor to junior and mid\-level engineers, drive rigorous code and design reviews, and establish architectural best practices across the engineering organization. **Qualifications \& Requirements** * **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. * **Experience:** 5\+ years of professional experience in embedded systems and firmware development, specifically targeting connected/IoT devices. * **Programming Languages:** Expert\-level proficiency in Embedded C and C\+\+; familiarity with Python or scripting languages for test automation and tooling. * **OS \& Architecture:** Substantial hands\-on experience with Real\-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) like FreeRTOS or Zephyr, as well as bare\-metal development. * **Hardware \& Tooling:** Deep familiarity with common microcontroller architectures (e.g., ARM Cortex\-M, ESP32, nRF5x, STM32\) and proficient use of lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and debuggers (JTAG/SWD). * **IoT \& Cloud Integration:** Demonstrated experience connecting edge devices to cloud platforms (e.g., AWS IoT, Azure IoT) using lightweight messaging protocols like MQTT or HTTP. * **Soft Skills:** Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills, technical writing abilities for design documentation, and a proactive approach to troubleshooting ambiguous problems. * **Copeland Experience:** Prior experience supporting Copeland products is strongly preferred. Authorization to work in the United States without sponsorship \- sponsorship will not be provided for this role. * **Our Commitment to Our People** Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial. Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal \- to make the world a better place. We invest in the end\-to\-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally. Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs: medical insurance plans, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) and more. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave, vacation and holiday leave. Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team! **Our Commitment to Inclusion \& Belonging** At Copeland, we cultivate a strong sense of inclusion and belonging where individuals of all backgrounds, and with diverse perspectives, are embraced and treated fairly to enable a stronger workforce. Our employee resource groups play an important role in culture and community building at Copeland. **Work Authorization** Copeland will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F\-1 with OPT or CPT, H\-1, H\-2, L\-1, B, J or TN, or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire. **Equal Opportunity Employer** Copeland is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, political affiliation, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. We are committed to providing a workplace free of any discrimination or harassment. If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, please contact: copeland.careers@copeland.com

jobs.description: **Description** **About CoreSite:** CoreSite is a leading colocation data center company providing the space, power, cooling and connectivity that businesses rely on to operate and grow. Our data centers bring dozens of organizations together under one roof, supporting the technology and services that keep our world connected. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, bringing the expertise, ideas and commitment that power our business and help our customers succeed. With a culture built on collaboration, ownership, and operational excellence, CoreSite is a place to make an impact. **Integration Engineer:** We're seeking an Integration Engineer to lead the design, development, and delivery of scalable integrations and APIs across a hybrid environment, spanning on‑premises systems and cloud platforms. The ideal candidate is hands\-on with MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, fluent in API\-led connectivity, and comfortable guiding cross\-functional teams through full lifecycle delivery, from discovery to production operations. **Duties:** * Design, develop, and test integration solutions for diverse business systems. * Develop RAML/OAS contracts; implement robust API gateways, rate limiting, throttling, and JWT/OAuth 2\.0 flows. * Apply security standards (TLS/mTLS, OAuth, OpenID Connect, secrets management) and apply API policies via Anypoint API Manager. * Implement logging, tracing, and alerting using Anypoint Monitoring/Visualizer, Splunk, and others per CoreSite guidelines. * Validate, test, and deploy new products, features, and application releases. * Collaborate with Availability during business hours and off\-hours for deployments/ maintenance/ support. * Communicate effectively and frequently, verbally and in writing, with others. * Manage tasks independently and take ownership of responsibilities. * Provide support to ensure reliable interface execution. * Promote and demonstrate behaviors consistent with CoreSite's culture and core values. **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:** * Deep hands\-on experience with MuleSoft Anypoint Platform (Design Center, Exchange, API Manager, Runtime Manager, CloudHub). * Strong DataWeave expertise (transformations, streaming, performance tuning, error handling). * Proficiency with connectors and integrations (REST/SOAP, JDBC, JMS, Kafka, Files/SFTP, Salesforce, etc.). * Solid understanding of API\-led connectivity, microservices, event\-driven architecture, and messaging patterns. * Applied knowledge of security standards (OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, mTLS/TLS, key/secret management, policy whitelisting/configuration. * Strong problem\-solving, analytical thinking, and adaptability in dynamic environments. * Excellent communication skills for technical and non\-technical audiences. * development methodologies, including Scrum, Kanban, Waterfall, and Iterative frameworks. **Education/Experience:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field strongly preferred. * 5\-8\+ years in enterprise integration development, with 3\-5\+ years of focused MuleSoft experience. * Proven delivery of complex integrations/APIs across hybrid environments understanding of network\-based products. * JDE Development experience is a plus **Physical Demands:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle, or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. **Compensation:** Compensation for this role includes a base salary between $120,000\.00 and $130,000\.00\. This role is also eligible for an annual bonus and equity, based upon individual and company performance. **Remote Work Eligibility:** This position may be performed remotely from the following approved locations only: Alabama, Arizona, California, Colorado, District of Columbia, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Iowa, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia and Wisconsin. **Job Post Timeline:** This position is expected to be open for applications for 30 days. **Benefits:** Not only does CoreSite have a fun, team\-focused work environment, but we also offer great benefits to all employees regularly scheduled to work more than 20 hours a week! * Medical coverage starting day one, plus dental, vision, telemedicine, HSA/FSA options. * 401(k) with a 5% company match, plus bonus and equity opportunities. * Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP). * Starting 16 days of PTO, 11 paid company holidays, floating holidays and additional paid time for volunteering, family care, parental leave and other life events. * Free parking or public transportation support. **Additional Perks:** * Up to $800 annually in wellness reimbursements and up to $450 in wellness incentives. * $100 monthly technology stipend. * Up to $5,250 annually in educational reimbursement plus LinkedIn Learning. * Up to $5,000 annually in charitable donation matching. * Financial coaching and student loan support. * Family planning, mental health, and caregiving support. * Pet insurance, employee discounts and cash back offers. **General Statements:** * Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. jobs.title: Project Engineer
jobs.description: Requisition Number: 80053 **The company built on breakthroughs.** **Join us.** Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible. How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward. At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at\-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more. Come break through with us. Corning’s businesses are ever\-evolving to best serve our customers, industries, and consumers. Today, we accelerate and transform life sciences, mobile consumer electronics, optical communications, display, automotive, and solar markets. We are changing the world with: * Trusted products that accelerate drug discovery, development, and delivery to save lives * Damage\-resistant cover glass to enhance the devices that keep us connected * Optical fiber, wireless technologies, and connectivity solutions to carry information and ideas at the speed of light * Precision glass for advanced displays to deliver richer experiences * Auto glass and ceramics to drive cleaner, safer, and smarter transportation * Solar polysilicon, wafers, and innovative photovoltaic modules, enabling low\-cost solar energy solutions **Role Purpose:** ================= The Project Engineer supports execution of key Plant Engineering initiatives across cost reduction, Engineering Excellence, production ramp and transfer activities, and capital projects. The position works cross\-functionally with Engineering, Operations, Quality, Finance, EHS, Procurement, Division Engineering, suppliers, and other partners to translate plant priorities into structured projects with clear actions, schedules, ownership, and measurable results. The role provides technical and project\-management support for both existing and new manufacturing programs. The Project Engineer uses engineering judgment, data analysis, structured problem solving, and project\-management practices to move assigned work from definition through implementation and sustainment. **Key Responsibilities:** ========================= **Cost Reduction and Continuous Improvement:** ---------------------------------------------- * Support the identification, development, execution, and tracking of cost\-reduction and continuous\-improvement projects across labor, material, yield, scrap, cycle time, equipment utilization, and manufacturing processes. * Develop project scope, baseline performance, expected benefits, schedules, and action plans; coordinate with Finance and functional owners to validate and reconcile results. * Apply structured problem\-solving and Performance Excellence methods to address root causes, implement sustainable improvements, and support portfolio reviews and reporting. **Engineering Excellence and Capability Development:** ------------------------------------------------------ * Support implementation of Manufacturing Engineering Excellence (MEE) and related Engineering Excellence priorities, including assessments, development plans, technical problem\-solving activities, and follow\-up actions. * Coordinate engineering training, learning communities, mentoring, knowledge transfer, and documentation of best practices to strengthen plant technical capability. * Promote effective use of appropriate engineering tools and methods, including process control, measurement\-system analysis, design for manufacturability, root\-cause analysis, and standardized work. **Production Ramp and Program Support:** ---------------------------------------- * Support planning and execution of production ramps, manufacturing transfers, and changes to existing or new programs, including cross\-functional readiness for equipment, tooling, process, staffing, training, material, quality, and capacity. * Develop and maintain ramp plans, identify risks and constraints, coordinate mitigation actions, and communicate readiness and performance to stakeholders. * Monitor relevant measures such as throughput, yield, cycle time, scrap/rework, capacity, and schedule attainment, and help transition ramp activities into sustainable production processes. **Capital Project Support:** ---------------------------- * Manage assigned small\- to medium\-sized capital projects and support larger projects from scope development and authorization through procurement, installation, startup, capitalization, and closeout. * Coordinate internal functions, suppliers, and contractors while maintaining schedules, action lists, spending forecasts, risks, and key project documentation in Planview and other applicable systems. * Support equipment selection, financial justification, installation readiness ams, drive actions through closure, and communicate status, decisions, and significant risks to Plant Engineering leadership and stakeholders. * Analyze technical, manufacturing, and business data to support decisions; document project outcomes and ensure changes are incorporated into appropriate systems, procedures, and standard work. **Required Qualifications:** ============================ * Bachelor's degree in Engineering from an accredited institution. * Demonstrated engineering problem\-solving, analytical, and project\-management capability. * Ability to analyze technical, manufacturing, and financial information and manage multiple concurrent priorities. * Ability to work effectively across functions and independently drive actions while maintaining appropriate leadership alignment. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and proficiency with Microsoft Office and common enterprise systems. **Desired Qualifications:** =========================== * Two or more years of engineering experience in a manufacturing environment. * Experience with production ramps, new\-product introduction, manufacturing transfers, cost reduction, continuous improvement, or capital equipment projects. * Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, DMAIC, KT, MSA, SPC, DFM, MEE, or comparable structured engineering methods; Green Belt or similar certification is beneficial. * Experience with ERP/MES platforms, Planview, and project\-management systems. * Experience in precision manufacturing, optics, machining, coating, assembly/test, automation, or other equipment\-intensive operations. **This position does not support immigration sponsorship.** The range for this position is $81,750\.00 \- $112,406\.00 assuming full time status. Starting pay for the successful applicant is dependent on a variety of job\-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, market demands, experience, training, and education. **A job that shapes a life.** **Corning offers you the total package.** Your well\-being is our priority. Our compensation and benefits package supports your health and wellness, financial aspirations, and career from day one. * Company\-wide bonuses and long\-term incentives align with key business results and ensure you are rewarded when the company performs well. When Corning wins, we all win. * As part of our commitment to your financial well\-being, we provide a 100% company\-paid pension benefit with fixed contributions that grow throughout your career. Combined with matching contributions to your 401(k) savings plan, Corning’s total contributions to your retirement accounts can reach between 7% and 12% of your pay, depending on your age and years of service. * Our health and well\-being benefits include medical, dental, vision, paid parental leave, family building support, fitness, company\-paid life insurance, disability, disease management programs, paid time off, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) to support you and your family. * Getting paid for our work is important, but feeling appreciated and recognized for those contributions motivates us much more. That’s why Corning offers a recognition program to celebrate successes and reward colleagues who make exceptional contributions. We prohibit discrimination on the basis of race, color, gender, age, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected status. Corning is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and considers requests for reasonable accommodations in accordance with applicable laws. Individuals with disabilities or sincerely held religious beliefs may request reasonable accommodations to participate in the application or interview process, perform essential job functions, or access other benefits and privileges of employment. To submit a request for reasonable accommodation related to disability or religion, please contact us at accommodations@corning.com.

jobs.title: Senior Controls Engineer
jobs.description: Requisition Number: 80049 **The company built on breakthroughs.** **Join us.** Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible. How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward. At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at\-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more. Come break through with us. Our Optical Communications segment has recently evolved from being a manufacturer of optical fiber and cable, hardware and equipment to being a comprehensive provider of industry\-leading optical solutions across the broader communications industry.This segment is classified into two main product groupings – carrier network and enterprise network. The carrier network product group consists primarily of products and solutions for optical\-based communications infrastructure for services such as video, data and voice communications. The enterprise network product group consists primarily of optical\-based communication networks sold to businesses, governments and individuals for their own use. **Purpose:** Controls Engineers are responsible for the design, development, integration, commissioning, troubleshooting, and lifecycle support of industrial control and automation systems within manufacturing environments. The role leverages electrical and controls engineering principles to optimize machine performance, process capability, equipment reliability, safety, quality, productivity, and cost. Controls Engineers collaborate with cross\-functional engineering teams, manufacturing operations, maintenance, IT, and equipment suppliers to implement robust, standardized, maintainable, and sustainable controls solutions. **Responsibilities:** * Independently design and implement PLC, HMI, motion\-control, instrumentation, and safety solutions. * Define I/O requirements, control sequences, fail\-safe states, alarms, interlocks, and recovery sequences. * Select and specify field devices that meet functional and site\-standard requirements. * Lead troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis for moderately complex and complex control\-system issues. * Own controls scope projects or defined portions of larger projects. * Support process projects and data system projects by interfacing with operators and production team leaders to monitor and correct process fluctuations and equipment issues * Develop functional specifications, control architecture, test plans, and system documentation. * Coordinate work with machine builders, system integrators, vendors, maintenance, IT, and process engineers. * Lead factory acceptance testing, installation, commissioning, and production startup. * Estimate effort, manage assigned schedules, and communicate project status and risks. * Train manufacturing and maintenance personnel. * Recommend sustainable solutions to recurring equipment\-performance problems. * Provide informal coaching to A and B band engineers and technical personnel. * Willingness to travel and provide occasional off\-hours support for a 24/7 manufacturing operation. **Travel Requirements:** Up to 25% travel is expected based on project and business requirements; some international travel may be required. **Hours of Work/Work Schedule/Flex\-Time:** Typical schedule is Monday through Friday, with occasional off\-hours support based on manufacturing or project needs.
