jobs.title: Senior Director, Organizational Engineering
jobs.description: At Credit Acceptance, we are building on the foundation of a successful business while investing in the future through technology, data, AI, and continuous improvement. As we continue to evolve, our Team Members play an active role in improving experiences, driving meaningful change, and shaping the future of our business. We foster an environment where people are empowered to contribute ideas, develop their careers, make an impact, and help lead our continued transformation. Our Enterprise teams provide the expertise, insights, and partnership that help our business and people succeed. Team Members collaborate across the organization to solve challenges, support informed decision\-making, and enable the strategies and initiatives that move our business forward. We value curiosity, continuous learning, and diverse perspectives from people who are passionate about making a meaningful impact on our customers, Team Members, and business. What AI makes possible has changed dramatically in the past 18 months. How most organizations develop and lead people has changed far less. We are looking for a technical product leader to help close that gap. Organizational Engineering is a greenfield opportunity to reinvent how we develop and lead people, so that leaders, teams, and the enterprise work together as one healthy, high\-performing organization. The team will apply first principles to talent management practices: ask why each exists and what it is meant to achieve, then reimagine how to achieve it. There is no established playbook for this role. We are looking for an innovator who understands what has come before and uses every tool and resource available to find what works. Some answers will feel familiar. Others will make us ask why we never thought of them. The goal is an environment where the path to great leadership is easier. Leaders spend their time on what builds high\-performing, highly motivated teams, and every employee can do their best work. As the founding leader, reporting to the CHRO, you will build and lead a multidisciplinary team of six, carry a senior leadership mandate, and work directly with the executive leadership team, HR leadership, and leaders across the organization to imagine what is possible. **Outcomes and Activities** **Build the team and the operating model** * Recruit and develop a multidisciplinary team within an approved investment envelope, validating the capabilities and sequence of hires as the work informs needs. * Establish how the team works, including its delivery approach and standards for evidence, and own the budget, vendors, and technology partnerships. Create an environment where scientists, engineers, product leaders, and talent practitioners do their best work together. * **Define problems from first principles** * Begin with durable enterprise needs rather than inherited processes. Examine the underlying problems and constraints, and determine what practices, information, technology, and human judgment best achieves them. * Translate ambiguous organizational challenges into clear problem statements and hypotheses. Lead the inaugural challenge: design a talent feedback system that gives managers and employees the information they need, when they need it. Start with discovery across employee populations and recommend where experimentation will create the greatest learning and business value. * **Design, build, and deploy the talent cycle** * Serve as the architect of the talent cycle, in partnership with HR and business leaders: paint the product vision and roadmap for how we develop and lead people, spanning feedback loops such as reviews, succession planning and bench strength identification, and talent\-to\-strategy planning. * Deploy in minimally lovable increments and at speed: ship the smallest version leaders and employees would value, keep sprinting, and iterate as we learn. Build with AI\-enabled tools, data, and measurement systems within enterprise\-approved technology, standards, and governance, in partnership with Engineering, including enterprise architecture and AI platform teams, and measure what ships: deployment frequency, adoption by leaders and employees, and impact on decisions and outcomes against baselines set in advance. * **Test, learn, and improve** * Establish baselines, hypotheses, and success measures, including potential unintended effects, before each deployment. * Apply scientifically rigorous analysis and experimentation, using phased rollouts or comparison groups where practical, with safeguards appropriate to work that affects people. Report results against the measures defined at the start, adapt what works, and discontinue what does not, bringing evidence\-based findings, including those that challenge established practices, to senior leaders while accountability for people decisions stays with managers and their leaders. * **Competencies** **Thinks from First Principles:** Questions why existing standards, policies, and process duct, engineering, data or applied science, and economics, including hiring, developing, and setting direction. * Ownership of AI\-enabled products in production (such as LLM\-based or agentic systems, machine learning, or intelligent automation), with accountability for data governance and evaluation. * Experience designing and running experiments in production, using baselines, comparison groups or phased rollouts, and statistical or causal analysis. * Demonstrated ownership of a roadmap, budget, and vendor or technology partnerships, including build\-versus\-buy decisions. Evidence of influence without authority across organizational boundaries, including work that changed direction at the executive level, and the ability to communicate complex information clearly to C\-level leaders. * Preferred Qualifications * Advanced degree in a quantitative, behavioral, or organizational science (for example economics, industrial\-organizational psychology, data science, or human\-computer interaction). * Experience building a new team or capability from the ground up, including founding\-team or early\-stage experience. * Experience applying data science, behavioral science, or experimentation to how people and organizations perform, such as people analytics, talent management, organizational design, or consumer behavior. * Experience designing or delivering solutions involving sensitive or regulated data, with accountability for privacy, security, or data governance, or working closely with security, audit, and compliance functions. * Experience in financial services, consumer lending, credit operations, or other regulated, complex operating environments. Experience scaling new products, technologies, or organizational capabilities across large organizations. * **Targeted Compensation:** $288,800 \- $336,900 base salary \+ annual bonus plan **Benefits** Excellent benefits package that includes 401(K) match, adoption assistance, parental leave, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive medical/ dental/vision and many nonstandard benefits that make us a Great Place to Work * **Our Company Values:** To be successful in this role, Team Members need to be: * Positive by maintaining resiliency and focusing on solutions * Respectful by collaborating and actively listening * Insightful by cultivating innovation, accumulating business and role specific knowledge, demonstrating self\-awareness and making quality decisions * Direct by effectively communicating and conveying courage Earnest by taking accountability, applying feedback and effectively planning and priority setting * **Expectations:** * Remain compliant with our policies processes and legal guidelines * All other duties as assigned Attendance as required by department * **Advice** ! We understand that your career search may look different than others. Our hiring team wants to make sure that this would be a fit not just for us, but for you long term. If you are actively looking or starting to explore new opportunities, send us your application! **P.S** . We have great details around our stats, success, history and more. We’re proud of our culture and are happy to share why – let’s talk! Required degrees must have been earned at institutions of Higher Education which are accredited by the Council for Higher Education Accreditation or equivalent. Credit Acceptance is dedicated to providing an inclusive environment for all. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and value a culturally diverse workforce. We believe in ensuring all team members demonstrate mutual respect for one another. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to protected characteristics like age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Search Core
jobs.description: Join the company that's building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world's biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what's next. We're one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we're remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd. **Why You'll Love This Role** Cribl Search powers high\-speed investigations for security and IT teams at some of the world's largest enterprises. Whether data lives in Lakehouse Engines or is spread across Federated sources, Search unifies ingest, storage, and analysis into a single experience — no tool\-hopping, no complex orchestration. Teams collect once, search anywhere, and investigate with no blind spots. Now add agentic AI to the picture. AI\-driven workloads are exploding, autonomous agents are firing queries alongside human analysts, and the volume and complexity of concurrent searches is growing fast. The query engine at the heart of Cribl Search needs to be faster, more concurrent, and more resilient than ever — and that's where you come in. Cribl is looking for a backend\-focused Staff Software Engineer to join a remote\-first, diverse, inclusive, cross\-functional team of software developers focused on making search stupid fast. You will play a central role in evolving the query engine at the heart of Cribl Search – breaking through concurrency ceilings, optimizing query dispatching and execution, and tuning performance for workloads ranging from interactive analyst investigations to AI agents firing thousands of concurrent queries. This is an ideal role for anyone who is passionate about making Search blazing fast at a massive scale. On top of it all, you will have fun! Cribl strives to be a great place to work for everyone. **As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will …** * Contribute to technical direction, bringing strong, loosely held, opinions to shape how Cribl Search evolves as a platform for multiple products * Own high\-impact changes to large\-scale systems, increasing performance and concurrency for both human and AI\-driven agentic workloads * Build and support a strong foundation for Cribl Search as a whole, collaborating across various teams and divisions * Champion improvements to performance, reliability, and operability * Drive clarity across multiple stakeholders and ambiguous requirements, communicating tradeoffs and risks of competing priorities * Partner with leadership to translate organizational needs from across the business into actionable plans on our roadmap * Lead projects end\-to\-end – from ideation, scoping and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support * Mentor and coach engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and pairing * Write clean, maintainable, and testable code with an eye toward observability and resilience * Share on\-call responsibilities as part of a team that embraces service ownership * Help define and refine the software development practices that make our team effective – everybody's feedback helps shape our process * We are a remote\-first company and work happens across many time\-zones – this position will require stand\-by, on\-call, or off\-hours duties **If You've Got \- We Want It** * Strong experience designing and operating multiple\-petabyte\-scale data systems, including object and distributed storage * Experience building search, query, and/or analytic systems working with structured and unstructured data * Deep understanding of how search tools work – indexing, inverted indices, query parsing, and execution (think Lucene/Solr, Elasticsearch) * Experience working on high\-performance, data\-intensive applications where concurrency, throughput, and latency matter * Familiarity with compilers, ASTs, and query language internals * Polyglot engineer – C\+\+ experience is highly desirable * Ability to problem\-solve from first principles and maintain focus on overarching objectives * Demonstrated ability to lead projects through ambiguity, driving technical decisions across team boundaries * Experience working in a fast paced, dynamic environment where priorities shift quickly * Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written – able to explain complex technical topics to stakeholders in remote, distributed environments * Experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar on a team * Experience with C\+\+, Typescript/JavaScript, NodeJS, and SQL \#LI\-JB1 \#LI\-Remote **Bring Your Whole Self** Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We're building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying. Interested in joining the Cribl herd? Learn more about the smartest, funniest, most passionate goats you'll ever meet at cribl.io/about\-us.

jobs.title: IntelligentOps - Lead Architect_Products & Platforms
jobs.description: **The Team** **Innovation \& Delivery Transformation (I\&DT) Team** The I\&DT team exists to build what Deloitte's next decade demands. We don't optimize the past. We place deliberate bets on the technologies and markets that will define the future of industry, and we build the platforms, products, and commercial engines to win there. IntelligentOps is one of those bets: a decision intelligence product purpose\-built for the complexity of large\-scale operations, and a cornerstone of how Deloitte delivers durable, scaled value to operations\-intensive clients. The core focus of this role is IntelligentOps, Deloitte's decision intelligence and execution product for supply chain and manufacturing operations. IntelligentOps connects data, existing enterprise systems (ERP, MES, PLM, OT), and AI agents on a unified common core, enabling operations leaders to move faster, act with greater precision, and scale operational outcomes without adding systems or complexity. Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026\. **Work you'll do** The Lead Architect owns the technical vision for IntelligentOps solutions and is accountable for architectures that scale across clients, solutions, and industries. IntelligentOps solutions are made up of modules, which call on engines, the pre\-built agentic actions that do the underlying work. All of it connects to client systems and builds on shared foundations. You will guide how these pieces fit together and how they are built, reused, and delivered to clients, with a focus on moving forward the solutions we sell and deliver. **Technical Direction** * Set the technical direction and multi\-year architecture roadmap for IntelligentOps solutions, modules, and engines, and for how they build on shared foundations. * Translate product and client requirements into a scalable technical architecture that holds up across multiple solutions, modules, and client environments. * Make and document key architecture decisions, including technology selection, build versus buy, and integration approach, and communicate tradeoffs clearly to leadership. **Patterns, Standards, and Guardrails** * Define reusable architectural patterns, reference architectures, and engineering guardrails that help teams build new modules and engines faster and more consistently. * Set standards for scalability, performance, security and access control, data modeling, reliability, operability, and observability, including how IntelligentOps integrates with client ERP, MES, PLM, QMS, and OT/IoT systems and with AI agents. * Work with Product, Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), and leadership to make sure implementations adhere to the architecture, and resolve exceptions and gaps. * Design engines as reusable, standardized capabilities that modules can call on, so a capability is built once and reused across modules, solutions, and clients. * Define the architecture for AI agent orchestration and agent\-to\-agent interoperability, including model validation, governance, and human oversight controls. * Set the approach for automated deployment and release of solutions, modules, and engines into client environments across cloud providers. * Build resiliency, high availability, and scalability patterns, such as failover and graceful degradation, into reference architectures so reliability is designed in rather than added after incidents. **Innovation and Proofs of Concept** * Identify, scope, execute, and document proofs of concept that test new technologies and approaches, building reference implementations hands\-on. * Decide which proofs of concept graduate into the product, and partner with Engineering to turn them into production\-ready patterns. **Team Leadership** * Lead, coach, and develop a team of architects and engineers, raising the bar on technical quality and on how efficiently the team builds and ships. * Capture implementation lessons from FDEs and client engagements and feed them back into the architecture and the product roadmap. The successful candidate possesses these skills: * Ability to set technical direction and bring engineers, product leaders, and executives along with it, including when you do not have formal authority. * Pragmatic judgment with a bias toward simple designs that scale. * Clear communication that explains complex technical tradeoffs to both engineering and executive audiences. * Ability to build credibility with engineers by building and coding, not only by designing. **Qualifications** Required: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience defined as an additional 4\+ years of relevant work experience in lieu of a degree. * 10\+ years of experience designing and building enterprise software at scale and serving as an architect or technical lead long enough to have lived with the consequences of your own decisions. * 3\+ years of experience leading, mentoring, or managing other architects and engineers, and raising the bar for the whole team. * 5\+ years of experience architecting cloud\-native systems on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, including containerized deployment (Kubernetes), infrastructure as code, and CI/CD automation. * 2\+ years of experience using or evaluating agentic systems in production, including harness design, tool\-use interfaces, sandboxed execution, and evaluation approaches that test against real execution. * 2\+ years of experience using agentic coding tools daily on real production work; having a considered view of where they help, where they fail, and how to verify what they produce. * Hands\-on proficiency writing code, building proofs of concept or reference implementations, and earning credibility with engineer by showing the work. * Demonstrated experience defining when to standardize and when to leave room for speed, and being able to explain that tradeoff to both engineers and executives. * Experience establishing set patterns or standards that multiple teams adopt without being forced to, including security, access control, and integration with enterprise systems. * Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. Preferred: * Experience with agent interoperability standards, such as Agent2Agent (A2A), Model Context Protocol (MCP), and with event\-driven architecture patterns. * Experience designing ontologies, knowledge graphs, or semantic data models for enterprise or operational data. * Experience integrating with ERP (SAP, Oracle), MES, PLM, or OT/IoT systems in manufacturing or supply chain environments. * Cloud architect certification, such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Google Professional Cloud Architect. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $141,200\-$278,300\. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Product Engineering Delivery Manager, Applied AI
jobs.description: Product Engineering Organization **Overview** As a Delivery Manager, you hold program\-level execution accountable on a day\-to\-day basis within Deloitte's Product Engineering organization, one or more product teams operating against a shared set of intents. Delivery in this organization operates inside an intent\-driven development model with three concurrent layers \- governance, execution, and learning \- that run simultaneously. Execution advances in evidence\-gated dashes, not sprints. The activities that used to define this role \- status compilation, schedule maintenance, risk\-log upkeep, and ceremony documentation \- are increasingly AI\-assisted. What remains, and grows, is the judgment work: cross\-team coordination on initiatives larger than a single product team can self\-coordinate, stakeholder alignment, dependency management, and the operational discipline that keeps evidence\-gated delivery. **Work you'll do:** * Program\-level coordination for one significant initiative or a set of related programs. Ensure dashes start when slices are ready and end when deployed evidence confirms the intended behavior shifted. * Day\-to\-day stakeholder orchestration with internal Deloitte stakeholders at the program level, including reconciliation of AI\-drafted artifacts when stakeholders arrive with their own briefs. * Drive cost\-efficient adoption of LLM, agentic AI, and cloud platforms through effective governance, FinOps practices, and consumption optimization. * Operational integrity of the evidence\-gated cycle in your scope: proof signals being read, harm watches honored and exit gates respected before slices expand. **Core Responsibilities** * **Outcome\-Driven Leadership:** Deliver the right customer and business outcomes by engaging product teams on structure, skills, leverage models, and measurement. Scope dashes against ready slices and observable evidence, so work advances when deployed evidence confirms the behavior shifted \- not at a sprint boundary. * **Delivery Leadership and Advocacy:** Champion fit\-for\-context delivery methodologies and work with Product Managers to drive priorities and execution. Form skilled teams, remove roadblocks, and set cadence to the rhythm the program needs. Surface coordination friction before it becomes a blocker, escalating to the Delivery Leader when it exceeds your authority. * **Craft Mastery:** Foster delivery excellence through quality processes, program value delivery, and team growth \- coaching junior professionals via pairing, observation, and feedback. Experiment with new tools like GenAI and support the AI Workflow Orchestrator on your program, knowing which workflows are AI\-driven and how exceptions route. Spread knowledge through community sessions. * **Communication:** Inspire and influence stakeholders, serving as the contact for value achievement across product engineering teams. Communicate status accurately on the cadence the program needs. Hold the room when stakeholders disagree: surface trade\-offs, recommend a path, drive to decision. Facilitate co\-creation workshops. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Work as a connected member of the program alongside the triad ensemble (Product, Engineering and Experience) and cross functional groups. Maintain a live picture of dependencies across the product teams and platform services you touch. Manage conflict, foster collaboration, and enable cross\-skilling. * **Discovery \& Delivery Proficiency:** Apply deep SDLC expertise with continuous planning and refinement. Watch for drift between intent and execution and raise it early. Hold evidence\-gate discipline \- proof signals read, harm watches honored, exits and expansions respected. Identify risks, adapt scope, and embed continuous improvement. * **Customer\-Centric Delivery:** Drive lean solutions through rapid experimentation, engaging customers before, during, and after delivery to land the right solution effectively. * **Operational Excellence:** Build inclusive, engaged teams; remove obstacles and coach; improve satisfaction and reduce attrition. Govern the intake of AI\-drafted artifacts so they become productive inputs, not noise. Report on financials, innovation, and engagement, and drive efficiency and productivity. * **Engagement and Collaborative Co\-Creation:** Engage stakeholders at all levels and foster a culture of co\-creation. Hold the relationship with program sponsors and affected stakeholders, informing them in proportion to their stake, and reconcile conflicting AI\-generated artifacts on the same initiative. Align diverse perspectives to deliver quality solutions. * **Domain Expertise:** Rapidly acquire domain\-specific knowledge and navigate enterprise functions to drive product value and organizational alignment. **The Team** US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost\-effective model that focuses on value and outcomes. It leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure across a four\-capability matrix: Product, Experience, Engineering, and Delivery. As Deloitte's primary product development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom\-line results. We develop and deploy cutting\-edge go\-to\-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. **Qualifications** **Required Experience** * 10\+ years of delivery management with direct experience leading a cross\-functional program or set of programs with meaningful dependencies and multiple stakeholders. * Experience operating inside an Agile or Lean model and demonstrated readiness to operate inside intent\-driven, evidence\-gated delivery patterns. * Experience working in a product\-staffed model where durable product teams stay with their products across build, deploy, operate, and evolve. * Strong expertise in AI/Cloud FinOps, budget management, financial forecasting, vendor management, cost optimization, and data\-driven delivery governance. * Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. * Limited immigration sponsorship may be available. * Candidates must be located within a commutable distance to one of the select locations available for this role * Ability to work in your local office at a minimum of 3 days per week **Required Skills** * Coordination at scale: Track record of managing dependencies, surfacing risks, and driving alignment across teams that do not naturally talk to each other. * Engineering fluency: Able to follow technical conversations, ask useful questions, and challenge feasibility claims constructively. More than passive listening. * Evidence orientation: Comfortable measuring delivery by outcome validation rather than velocity proxies. Able to hold the line on evidence gates. * AI\-augmented working practice: Fluent with current GenAI assistants and agentic delivery tooling. Able to direct AI output for status, risk, and coordination tasks rather than only consume or produce it manually. * Specification literacy: Able to read and reason about charter, persona, intent, constitution, and blueprint artifacts and understand how a program is governed through them. * Communication: Writes clearly. Presents to senior stakeholders without over formatting. Tells the truth about status, including bad news, without varnish. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $107,700 to $221,200\. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance. jobs.description: **United States, Georgia, Atlanta** **Information Technology** **18\-Nov\-2026** **Ref \#: 35201** ### **How you'll help us Keep Climbing (overview \& key responsibilities)** At Delta, we connect people and cultures, power extraordinary experiences, and shape the future of travel. Here, you'll work on complex challenges on a global scale, using augmented intelligence to build emerging technologies, amplify human potential and continuously grow the skills that keep you at the forefront of what's next. We are seeking a forward\-looking Senior Software Development Engineer to design, build, and scale next\-generation applications leveraging cloud\-native architectures, AI/ML capabilities, and modern engineering practices. As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you will lead the design, development, and optimization of complex software applications. You will mentor junior engineers and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to architect and implement scalable cloud\-based solutions on AWS. This role offers an excellent opportunity for seasoned professionals to leverage their extensive experience, drive innovation, and make significant contributions to high\-impact projects in a fast\-paced and cutting\-edge environment. * Design, develop, and maintain scalable cloud\-based applications using AWS services. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features * Implement best practices for cloud architecture, security, and performance * Automate deployment, monitoring, and management of cloud applications * Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code and contribute to both front\-end and back\-end development as a full\-stack engineer * Build and integrate AI/ML\-powered features and agents into applications using AWS AI services. * Apply AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate software delivery, automate repetitive tasks, and improve code quality. * Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to cloud infrastructure and applications * Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous improvement * Stay up\-to\-date with the latest AWS technologies and industry trends. ### **Benefits and Perks to Help You Keep Climbing** Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience and Servant Leadership – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees. Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way: * Competitive salary, industry\-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives * 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9% * New hires are eligible for up to 2\-weeks of vacation. This is earned for use in the following vacation year (April 1 – March 31\) * In addition to vacation, new hires are eligible for up to 56 hours of paid personal time within a 12\-month period * + 10 paid holidays per calendar year * Birthing parents are eligible for 12\-weeks of paid maternity/parental leave * Non\-birthing parents are eligible for 2\-weeks of paid parental leave * Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life insurance beneﬁts * Family care assistance through fertility support, surrogacy and adoption assistance, lactation support, subsidized back\-up care, and programs that help with loved ones in all stages * Holistic Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health * Domestic and International space\-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members * Career development programs to achieve your long\-term career goals * World\-wide partnerships to engage in community service and innovative goals created to focus on sustainability and reducing our carbon footprint * Business Resource Groups created to connect employees with common interests to promote inclusion, provide perspective and help implement strategies * Recognition rewards and awards through the platform Unstoppable Together * Access to over 500 discounts, specialty savings and voluntary benefits through Deltaperks such as car and hotel rentals and auto, home, and pet insurance, legal services, and childcare ### **What you need to succeed (minimum qualifications)** * Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States. * Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency. * Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles. * Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data. * Execute with a Sense of Urgency * Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail. * 5\+ years of experience in cloud engineering with a focus on AWS. * Proficiency in AWS services such as EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, and CloudFormation * Strong programming skills in languages such as Python, Java, or Node.js. * Experienced in deploying and managing applications using Red Hat OpenShift Service on AWS (ROSA), leveraging its robust platform for scalable and efficient cloud solutions. * Experience with containerization This individual will run AI pilots day to day, measure results, report progress to leadership, and scale knowledge sharing so what works on one account reaches the next. We are looking for someone who is genuinely excited by AI tooling and builds with it, not just talks about it. jobs.title: Lead Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Title: Lead Engineer** **Your role** We are hiring a Lead Engineer, the role will give you the opportunity to expand your skills and experience working on mission critical infrastructure facilities operations for the largest wholesale data center provider in the world. We offer a clean, stable environment where there is a lot of variety and always something to do, and where you’ll work at least 40 hours per week. If you are looking for an exciting job with great benefits in a company that will provide you with a lot of opportunity to learn, grow, and expand your skillset for a high\-demand role, then this could be the right place for you. **What you’ll do** As a Lead Engineer, you’ll work with your peers to ensure coverage 365 days per year, 7 days per week, 24 hours per day. You’ll spend most of your days on a variety of interesting activities, including walking the facility and inspecting infrastructure systems, performing routine maintenance, supervising the facility, assessing needs, monitoring construction projects, and completing repairs as needed. You will also help to gather information and take readings to fill in the parameters on daily spreadsheets. The service you provide will be to the underlying support systems (power, cooling, etc) for customers’ computers, so you will not be expected to do any computer maintenance—the customers do that for themselves. Some of your specific responsibilities will include: * Monitoring building infrastructure systems. * Troubleshooting and repairing building infrastructure systems, HVAC system, electrical systems, and more. * Performing preventive maintenance on all building equipment. * Assembling and commissioning Data Center equipment. * Preparing Change Management Forms and Methods of Procedure (MOPs). * Scheduling maintenance procedures with vendors. * Ensuring compliance with all safety procedures and use of protective equipment. * Responding quickly to emergency situations (fire, evacuation, equipment failure etc.) and customer concerns as needed. **What you’ll need** To be a good fit for this opportunity you will have: * An Associate's degree (AA/AS) or an equivalent combination of education and experience; data center experience is strongly preferred. * A trade license or certification acquired through technical education/training. * A facilities maintenance certification. * Experience working with mission critical data equipment, and the willingness to work in a fast\-paced, mission critical environment. * Strong HVAC, mechanical, and electrical skills and experience. * An understanding of computer systems, and skill with Microsoft Office products. * Strong verbal and written communication skills. * The ability to follow instructions and processes precisely and carefully. * The willingness to work 2nd or 3rd shift, at least one weekend day each week, and unscheduled overtime as needed to complete projects or break\-fixes. * The ability to walk around a good deal of the time to perform inspections, to do some work outdoors in the weather if needed, and to lift heavy objects. **A bit about us** Digital Realty brings companies and data together by delivering the full spectrum of data center, colocation and interconnection solutions. PlatformDIGITAL®, the company’s global data center platform, provides customers with a secure data meeting place and a proven Pervasive Datacenter Architecture (PDx®) solution methodology for powering innovation and efficiently managing Data Gravity challenges. Digital Realty gives its customers access to the connected data communities that matter to them with a global data center footprint of 300\+ facilities in 50\+ metros across 25\+ countries on six continents. **Operations** Our Operations team keeps our customers’ infrastructure running safely and securely. We get plenty of opportunities to take on a variety of tasks and develop our technical skills. From overseeing electrical power to cooling and fire suppression systems, our team plays a vital role in making sure everything in our data centers operates as it should. **What we can offer you** Our rapidly evolving business sector offers the opportunity to be part of a courageous and passionate team who work together to understand and meet the changing needs of our global customers. Join us and you’ll be part of a supportive and inclusive environment where you can bring your whole self to work. As part of our team, you’ll get to work with people from different business areas, challenge the way we do things and put your ideas into action. We’ll also give you plenty of development opportunities so you can build a rewarding and successful career with us. Apply today, take charge of your career and grow your talents with us. **Training and Development** Join our Data Center Operations team and gain the support to succeed from day one. Our onboarding program prepares you to contribute meaningfully right away, with clear career pathways and continuous training to fuel your long\-term growth. From onboarding to specialized development, we equip you with the skills and opportunities to make a lasting impact in operations. **Health and Safety** Safety isn't just a priority here at Digital; it's critical to everything we do. Safeguarding lives, protecting assets, and securing data aren't just ideals \- they're essential pillars of our commitment to excellence for our people, our partners and our customers. We have a culture of care where every member of Team Digital embraces a relentless pursuit of working safely across Digital Realty. Together we are Safely Powering Progress. **Our Compensation Philosophy** Digital Realty offers its employees a highly competitive compensation package, excellent benefits, and an environment that recognizes and rewards your contributions. Central to our compensation philosophy is rewarding our employees for achieving the values and objectives aligned to the company's overall goals and values.

jobs.title: Azure AI Platform Engineer III/Senior
jobs.description: **At EQT, you won't just do a job, you'll help shape our future. Through Transparent Leadership, you'll work alongside leaders who value collaboration and ensure every voice is heard. Through Connected Impact, you'll see how your work influences critical business decisions and drives value across our operations. Through Supported Growth, you'll have opportunities to expand your skills through cross\-functional collaboration, development opportunities, and career advancement.** **Join our Qrew!** EQT runs AI agents in production on Microsoft Foundry, working inside Salesforce and the enterprise systems our people use every day. Demand is compounding as domain experts across the business bring new agent ideas forward, and the platform underneath has to scale with it. We need an Azure AI Platform Engineer III/Senior to own that platform: secure, observable, affordable, and easy to build on. **The Role:** You own the foundation every agent runs on. Our AI Engineers build agents and the tools they use; you build and operate the layer beneath them: the Azure environment, the AI gateway, the tool registry, and the observability, evaluation, and guardrail systems that keep the fleet healthy. This is a senior, hands\-on engineering role. You write the infrastructure as code, own the AI platform in production, and partner with Infrastructure to align to standards and deploy. You won't spend most of your time building agents, but you'll understand them well enough to make the platform fast and safe to build on. **Who Thrives Here:** * **You treat the platform as a product.** Your customers are engineers and business builders, and the best paved road is the one they choose to take. * **You automate the toil.** If you did it twice by hand, it's in code the third time. * **You think in least privilege.** Identity, secrets, and network boundaries are design inputs, not cleanup. * **You know what it costs.** You can say where the tokens and dollars go, and you tune before anyone asks. * **You're excited about where AI is going.** You want to build the platform that lets an organization run many agents well, not just one. **The Azure AI Platform Engineer III/Senior responsibilities include but are not limited to:** * Own our Azure infrastructure as code: author, review, and deploy modular templates across dev and production. * Operate Microsoft Foundry environments, model deployments, and our private Azure subscription as production infrastructure, including onboarding, upgrading, and retiring models. * Own the AI gateway on Azure API Management: routing and transformation policies, per\-consumer keys, rate limits, and onboarding new models and consumers. * Run the centralized tool registry: identity and authentication patterns, versioning, and reuse standards, so a tool built once serves every agent. * Build fleet\-wide observability: logging, compliance log collection, monitoring, alerting, and usage telemetry attributed by agent and user. * Build and operate the evaluation infrastructure that gates releases and continuously scores agents in production. * Own identity and access: Entra ID group\-based, least\-privilege RBAC, managed identities, just\-in\-time elevation, and drift detection against the code. * Own cost and performance: budgets and alerts, tagging, recurring cost reviews, and latency and token tuning across the fleet. * Set the guardrails and paved roads (spend limits, standard build patterns, templates) that let builders move fast without breaking things, and bring manually deployed services under code. * Own platform production support, partnering closely with Cyber, Infrastructure, Network, Salesforce, and data teams, and keep runbooks and documentation current. **Required Experience and Skills:** * Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline (computer science, engineering, information systems, or similar), or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * 6\+ years in cloud platform, infrastructure, DevOps, or site reliability engineering, including 3\+ years running production workloads on Microsoft Azure. * Production infrastructure as code on Azure with Bicep, ARM, or Terraform: modular templates, parameterization, and multi\-scope deployments. * Azure identity and governance: Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities, Key Vault, and least\-privilege design. * Azure networking and security fundamentals: VNets, private endpoints, TLS, and locking down public endpoints. * CI/CD and software fundamentals: git, code review, deployment pipelines (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps), and scripting in Bash, PowerShell, or Python. * Observability on Azure: Log Analytics, Application Insights, and writing KQL. * Working knowledge of how LLM applications and agents work (model endpoints, tool calling, tokens, evaluation), enough to design a platform for them. * Clear communicator who documents well and can explain infrastructure tradeoffs to engineers and business leaders. **Preferred Experience and Skills:** * Microsoft Foundry (Azure AI Foundry) or Azure OpenAI in production: model deployments, agents, evaluations, and the control plane. * Azure API Management policy authoring, including request and response transformation between model APIs. * Azure Container Apps and Container Registry, including hosting Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or similar services. * Agent evaluation and monitoring tooling, and responsible AI guardrails such as PII handling, content filtering, and human\-in\-the\-loop review. * Governance at scale with Azure Policy, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and FinOps practices. * Integrating Azure services with Salesforce or Databricks Remote work is being considered for this role excluding the following states: California, Connecticut, Delaware, Illinois, Indiana, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Michigan, New Jersey, New York, and Tennessee unless willing to relocate. Selected incumbent will be placed into the position that best suits their abilities and experience level. EQT Corporation and its subsidiaries is an Equal Opportunity Employer \- Disabilities/Veterans.
