jobs.description: Location: Chicago Other locations: Primary Location Only Salary: Competitive Date: Nov 18, 2026 **Job description** ------------------- Requisition ID: 1761867 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world. **The opportunity** In EY’s Office of the CTO, the Advanced Forward Engineering (AFE) team deploys small cells of Forward Deployed Engineers who embed with strategic clients in highly regulated industries such as tax, finance, and risk, making AI\-native systems work in production under real client constraints. We are seeking a relationship\-driven Pre\-Sales Lead to build and grow the client relationships that create these engagements. You will be the front door to AFE: opening conversations with client executives, understanding their business priorities, positioning the AFE model and EY’s Agentic AI platform as the right answer, and building a qualified pipeline of opportunities that our delivery cells can win and execute. This is a business development and relationship role, not an engineering one. You will not be expected to design architectures or build solutions yourself; instead you will partner closely with AFE Cell Leads, Builders, and the Distinguished AFE, who lead technical discovery, demos, and proofs of concept, while you own the client relationship, the opportunity, and the story. The role is ideal for a seasoned technology or consulting seller who is fluent in the language of AI, earns trust quickly with senior stakeholders, and knows how to orchestrate expert teams around a client’s needs. **Your key responsibilities** * Build and nurture trusted relationships with client executives and decision\-makers (e.g., CIOs, CTOs, CFOs, Heads of Tax, Risk, and Transformation), becoming their go\-to contact for AI\-native delivery through AFE. * Originate, qualify, and grow a pipeline of AFE opportunities, maintaining account plans and an accurate, evidence\-based view of opportunity status, stakeholders, and next steps. * Lead client conversations that uncover business problems and desired outcomes, then bring in the right AFE engineers to shape the technical solution, run discovery, and deliver demos and proofs of concept. * Craft and tell a compelling value story, articulating how the AFE model and EY’s Agentic AI platform deliver measurable business outcomes in regulated environments. * Own proposal and response content for AFE opportunities, coordinating input from engineering, delivery, and service line teams, and working with partners who approve pricing and commercial terms. * Partner with EY service line teams (e.g., Tax, Assurance, Consulting) to identify and pursue opportunities where AFE adds value, and represent AFE in joint client pursuits. * Work with alliance partners (e.g., hyperscalers and technology providers) on joint go\-to\-market activity, co\-selling, and client introductions. * Curate and maintain a library of reusable pre\-sales assets, including demo narratives, case studies, client\-ready collateral, and reference stories, working with AFE engineers to keep them current. * Ensure a smooth transition from sale to delivery, handing over to the AFE Cell Lead and remaining involved through mobilisation and the early weeks of the engagement to protect client trust and expectations. * Capture and share market and client demand signals, including recurring needs, objections, and capability gaps, with the Distinguished AFE and Product Engineering to inform platform priorities. **Skills and attributes for success** * Exceptional relationship builder: able to earn trust and access with senior executives quickly, and to sustain those relationships over time. * Consultative selling approach: leads with curiosity about the client’s business rather than with the product, and connects their problems to tangible outcomes. * Commercially astute: understands how enterprise buying decisions are made, who influences them, and how to move an opportunity forward. * AI\-literate storyteller: confident explaining what agentic AI and forward\-deployed engineering can do for a business, without needing to be the technical expert in the room. * Strong orchestrator: knows when and how to bring in engineers, partners, and service line colleagues, and makes them effective in front of the client. * Excellent written and verbal communication, from executive conversations to clear, persuasive proposal content. * Honest about fit: qualifies opportunities rigorously and sets realistic client expectations, recognising that every engagement sold must be deliverable. * Resilient, self\-directed, and comfortable working across a matrixed organisation with multiple stakeholders. **To qualify you must have** * 7\+ years in client\-facing business development, technology sales, account management, or consulting sales roles, with  ngside partners on pursuits. * Experience co\-selling with hyperscalers or technology alliance partners (e.g., Microsoft, AWS, Google, NVIDIA). * Familiarity with forward\-deployed engineering or outcome\-based delivery models. * Awareness of AI governance, security, and responsible AI considerations that matter to regulated buyers. **What we offer you** At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers. * We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is: * + New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $150,700 to $251,200 + Bay Area California offices – $157,100 to $261,600 + All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $125,500 to $230,200 * Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options. * Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being. **Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.** * To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six\-month period. * EY accepts applications for this position on an on\-going basis. * For those living in California, please click here for additional information. * At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment. **EY \| Building a better working world** EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets. Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow. EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories. All in to shape the future with confidence. EY provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, genetic information, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected basis, including arrest and conviction records, in accordance with applicable law. EY is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities including veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and either need assistance applying online or need to request an accommodation during any part of the application process, please call 1\-800\-EY\-HELP3, select Option 2 for candidate related inquiries, then select Option 1 for candidate queries and finally select Option 2 for candidates with an inquiry which will route you to EY’s Talent Shared Services Team (TSS) or email the TSS at ssc.customersupport@ey.com.

jobs.title: Sr. Lead Data Scientist
jobs.description: At Early Warning, we’ve powered and protected the U.S. financial system for over thirty years with cutting\-edge solutions like Zelle®, Paze®, and so much more. As a trusted name in payments, we partner with thousands of institutions to increase access to financial services and protect transactions for hundreds of millions of consumers and small businesses. Early Warning follows a hybrid work model to allow for a more collaborative working environment. Candidates responding to this posting must independently possess the eligibility to work in the United States, for any employer, at the date of hire. This position is ineligible for employment Visa sponsorship. The Sr. Lead Data Scientist is a senior individual contributor and technical leader within the data science organization, responsible for designing, developing, and delivering advanced machine learning and statistical solutions in a complex, high\-volume, high\-throughput data environment. This role plays a critical leadership function by owning end\-to\-end modeling initiatives, guiding analytical direction for major business problems, and mentoring data scientists across multiple projects. This position is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, influence modeling standards and best practices, and partner closely with engineering, product, and business leaders to translate strategic objectives into scalable, production\-ready analytics solutions. ### **Essential Functions** **Advanced Modeling \& Technical Leadership** * Leads the design, experimentation, and implementation of advanced machine learning, statistical, and optimization models to solve complex, high\-impact business problems. * Serves as the technical owner for large\-scale, business\-critical models, including model selection, feature engineering, training strategy, validation, and performance monitoring. * Drives development of complex consumer or entity profiles used for both offline model training and real\-time scoring. * Assesses and ensures long\-term performance, stability, scalability, and interpretability of analytically derived models in production environments. * Establishes modeling standards, evaluation frameworks, and best practices adopted across the data science team. **Project \& Cross\-Functional Leadership** * Takes a lead role in the development and delivery of product\-prototype and production models, coordinating across multiple data science and engineering contributors. * Partners with software engineers and MLOps teams to define statistical components, data requirements, unit testing, acceptance testing, and deployment strategies. * Translates ambiguous, high\-level business goals into clearly defined analytical problems, roadmaps, and measurable success criteria. * Identifies and recommends new modeling, analytics, and data opportunities aligned with business strategy. **Mentorship \& Knowledge Sharing** * Acts as a senior mentor and subject matter expert, coaching junior and mid\-level data scientists on modeling techniques, analytical thinking, and technical execution. * Reviews analytical work, model designs, and code for quality, rigor, and alignment with best practices. * Shares knowledge of emerging technologies, tools, and methodologies through documentation, presentations, and informal leadership. **Communication \& Documentation** * Clearly documents model design, assumptions, workflows, and performance results for both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Presents analytical findings, model outcomes, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership with clarity and confidence. **Data Stewardship \& Compliance** * Supports the company’s commitment to protecting the integrity, confidentiality, and appropriate use of systems and data. * Ensures models and analytical solutions adhere to governance, regulatory, and ethical standards. ### **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related field. * Typically 10\+ years of professional experience in predictive modeling, machine learning, statistical analysis, or equivalent advanced education and experience. * Extensive hands\-on experience working with large, complex datasets in high\-volume environments. * Advanced proficiency in data science and machine learning tools and technologies such as Python, R, SQL, Spark, Hadoop, Hive, Java, or equivalent. * Deep experience with a broad range of machine learning methods, including classification, regression, tree\-based models, SVMs, ensemble methods, and optimization techniques. * Proven ability to translate business requirements into robust analytical designs and production\-ready models. * Strong communication skills with demonstrated ability to influence technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Demonstrated experience leading or coordinating data scientists on complex projects. * Successful completion of background and drug screening. ### **Preferred Qualifications** g and maintaining data science pipelines and workflows in Python, R, or similar languages. * Experience working with financial or regulated data environments. * Demonstrated ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast\-paced environments while balancing multiple priorities. * Track record of discovering non\-obvious insights and patterns in complex datasets. ### **Physical Requirements** Working conditions consist of a normal office environment. Work is primarily sedentary and requires extensive use of a computer and involves sitting for periods of approximately four hours. Work may require occasional standing, walking, kneeling, and reaching. Must be able to lift 10 pounds occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently. Requires visual acuity and dexterity to view, prepare, and manipulate documents and office equipment including personal computers. Requires the ability to communicate with internal and/or external customers. The base pay scale for this position in: Phoenix, AZ/ Chicago, IL in USD per year is: $150,000 \- $200,000\. New York, NY/ San Francisco, CA in USD per year is: $210,000 \- $270,000\. Additionally, candidates are eligible for a discretionary incentive plan and benefits. This pay scale is subject to change and is not necessarily reflective of actual compensation that may be earned, nor a promise of any specific pay for any specific candidate, which is always dependent on legitimate factors considered at the time of job offer. Early Warning Services takes into consideration a variety of factors when determining a competitive salary offer, including, but not limited to, the job scope, market rates and geographic location of a position, candidate’s education, experience, training, and specialized skills or certification(s) in relation to the job requirements and compared with internal equity (peers). The business actively supports and reviews wage equity to ensure that pay decisions are not based on gender, race, national origin, or any other protected classes. Some of the Ways We Prioritize Your Health and Happiness * Healthcare Coverage – Competitive medical (PPO/HDHP), dental, and vision plans as well as company contributions to your Health Savings Account (HSA) or pre\-tax savings through flexible spending accounts (FSA) for commuting, health \& dependent care expenses. * 401(k) Retirement Plan – Featuring a 100% Company Safe Harbor Match on your first 6% deferral immediately upon eligibility. * Paid Time Off – Flexible Time Off for Exempt (salaried) employees, as well as generous PTO for Non\-Exempt (hourly) employees, plus 11 paid company holidays and a paid volunteer day. * 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave * Maven Family Planning – provides support through your Parenting journey including egg freezing, fertility, adoption, surrogacy, pregnancy, postpartum, early pediatrics, and returning to work. And SO much more! We continue to enhance our program, so be sure to check our Benefits page here for the latest. Our team can share more during the interview process! Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. ***Early Warning Services, LLC (“Early Warning”) considers for employment, hires, retains and promotes qualified candidates on the basis of ability, potential, and valid qualifications without regard to race, religious creed, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, genetic information, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, protected veteran or disability status or any factor prohibited by law, and as such affirms in policy and practice to support and promote equal employment opportunity and affirmative action, in accordance with all applicable federal, state, and municipal laws. The company also prohibits discrimination on other bases such as medical condition, marital status or any other factor that is irrelevant to the performance of our employees.***

jobs.title: Process Quality Engineer
jobs.description: **Join EarthOptics as a Process Quality Engineer!** At EarthOptics, we are combining cutting\-edge genomic analysis, data science, microbiology, and remote sensing to revolutionize agriculture. We are creating a future where traditional sampling methods are obsolete. Our mission is to be the leading soil information company, delivering maps that growers, farmers, ranchers, and other stakeholders use to cost\-effectively increase yields, improve soil health and the climate and feed the growing world through all things soil. We are a growing company with a passion for soil health, innovative technologies, and supporting all within the food value chain. We currently have \~100 individuals spread across 20 states and 2 countries, and they come from all walks of life, industries, and experiences. We are deeply focused on building the future of AgTech and sustainability and helping the world see soil differently. Our Process Quality Engineer will join our Data Science \& Data Engineering team as an individual contributor reporting to the Chief Technology Officer. You will own quality controls across the journey from field sample collection and laboratory processing through data pipelines and customer delivery. You will investigate problems, build reliable checks, and work across disciplines to make quality part of everyday operations. **The digs:** * **Job Type:** Full\-time, salaried, exempt (not eligible for overtime) * **Work Location:** This is a remote position open to candidates who are authorized to work in the US and reside in the contiguous 48 states. * **Travel:** Up to 25% of the time, including visits to our Emeryville and Raleigh laboratories and field operations. * **Compensation:** $100,000\-$125,000 annual base salary, plus eligibility for our bonus program and an equity option grant (see below). * *This range covers all US locations where this remote role can be performed. The low end reflects our geographic pay adjustment for lower\-cost labor markets (75% of the market rate), and the high end reflects our highest\-cost markets, such as the San Francisco Bay Area and New York City (100% of the market rate). Your offer will reflect the pay zone for your location and your job\-related skills and experience, assessed consistently for every candidate. We do not ask about current or past pay.* **What you’ll cultivate as a Process Quality Engineer:** * **Own quality controls across the sample lifecycle.** Identify gaps in field soil sampling, hardware, sample shipping and intake, laboratory processing, data pipelines, and customer delivery. Maintain an inventory of QC checks and their coverage across products and workflows. While this is not a software role, the candidate is expected to be code\-competent. * **Build quality controls that work consistently.** Translate gaps into clear requirements and tickets for the software engineering team, such as automated ingest gates, acceptance thresholds, chain\-of\-custody and completeness checks, and delivery holds when checks fail. Use AI tools, along with working knowledge of Python and SQL, to analyze data, prototype checks, and document them so they’re reproducible, logged, and auditable. * **Investigate failures and prevent recurrence.** Trace field and laboratory QC flags and customer\-reported issues to their causes, then implement process changes, SOP updates, or tooling. Review gate performance monthly, documenting false positives, missed issues, and problems that reached customers. * **Partner across disciplines.** Work directly with field crews, laboratory operations, software engineering, and data science. Contribute to sampling protocols, SOPs, and field tool and hardware selection; translate observations into concrete requirements; and track the quality initiatives you own through completion. * **Support traceability and accreditation readiness.** Contribute to the data\-integrity workstream supporting the ISO 17025 accreditation effort, led by laboratory and Technology leadership, including audit trails, chain of custody, and traceability. Report quality metrics to the CTO. **Within your first 90 days, you can expect to:** * Visit at least one laboratory and one field sampling operation, document the highest quality risks by customer impact, and take ownership of the existing QC inventory, including automatic, manual, and missing checks. * Ship or strengthen at least two automated pipeline QC gates with logging and a delivery hold on failure. * Lead the first monthly QC gate review and manage the quality issue queue using the AI program manager. * Identify the data\-integrity gaps most relevant to ISO 17025 and share them with laboratory leadership. **Are you our soil\-mate? You’ll bloom in this role if you have experience in:** * A quantitative or applied science discipline through a bachelor’s or master’s degree \- or equivalent experience \- in engineering, soil or environmental science, chemistry, statistics, data science, or a related fie  role requires willingness to travel up to 25% of the time and participate directly in field and laboratory observations. **We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor or transfer visas at this time.** **Although not required, we’d love to see roots in:** * Agricultural, soil, or environmental testing. * ISO 17025 or similar accreditation efforts. * Cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery and pipeline orchestration. * AI\-assisted program management or issue\-tracking systems. * Running cross\-functional programs without direct reports. * A fast\-paced, start\-up environment. **Aside from “the green”, we can offer you:** * Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance \- 90% funded by EarthOptics for benefit\-eligible employees and 55% for dependents * Company\-paid LTD, STD, and Life Insurance * Meaningful equity option grants * 401k Plan \+ Employer Match up to 4% * 17 days of paid time off, plus 11 additional company holidays * Dependent Care FSA * Paid Parental Leave * Professional Development Stipend * Employee Referral Bonus Program * Above and Beyond Bonus Program * Flexible Schedule * Regular opportunities to give feedback on our benefits offerings **How we stay grounded:** Although we have teammates working in the field, in\-office, and at home, we aim to create a cohesive, diverse, and enriching environment for all of our employees. We embrace different tools to enhance our workflows and communicate intentionally, both live and asynchronously. A few quick facts you should know: * We rely on Slack to communicate. Although there are a variety of team\-specific systems to facilitate your work, this is our primary! * We love both food and emojis at EarthOptics. If hired, you’ll come to love (and use many) taco and donut emojis. * Our core business hours are Monday through Friday, 11am–4pm ET. We have teammates in every time zone, and some teams operate outside of that timeframe. As a remote employee, you are asked to honor those hours to ensure enough time to overlap with key cross\-functional teams. * In order to maximize our remote culture, we host company\-wide opportunities to connect (virtually and in\-person) and create space for focus work. For example, we have a weekly all\-hands stand\-up meeting on Monday and reserve Fridays as a regular “No Meeting” day. * Instead of values, we believe in actionable “cultural concepts”. Collectively, we hold one another to act and give feedback with these concepts in mind. Ours are *autonomy, accountability, collaboration, customer centricity, grit and grace*. **Equal Opportunity and Inclusion at EarthOptics:** EarthOptics is an equal opportunity employer, and we stand against any form of discrimination or harassment. We base all hiring and promotion decisions on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, marital or family status,physical or mental disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We are deeply committed to welcoming and including every qualified individual. As part of this commitment, we provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities, for pregnancy, childbirth, and related conditions, and for sincerely held religious beliefs. If you require assistance during the job application or interview process, need support to perform essential job functions, or seek other benefits and privileges of employment, please reach out to us at accommodations@earthoptics.com. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records for employment in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state, and local fair chance laws.

jobs.title: NPD Engineering Manager
jobs.description: Eaton’s ES AMER ARS PDCAD division is currently seeking a NPD Engineering Manager. The position will be based at our facility in Greenwood, SC. We are offering relocation assistance for candidates who reside within the U.S. The expected annual salary range for this role is $130000 \- $190000 a year. This position is also eligible for a variable incentive program. Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations. **What you’ll do:** ------------------- As a member of the leadership team, the New Product Development (NPD) Engineering Manager provides strategic leadership for the electrical, mechanical, and systems engineering functions supporting the Medium Voltage Assemblies (MVA) product lines that includes all air\-insulated and gas\-insulated switchgear products. This role drives engineering performance by leading development activities, guiding and developing engineering resources, and managing product development budgets. Also, you’ll participate in establishing strategic product development priorities and technology roadmaps, provide technical leadership for standards, application, and compliance requirements. You’ll be responsible for all aspects of project execution of new product development programs that support business growth, customer needs, operational excellence, and long\-term product strategy. Overall, the Engineering Manager owns talent development, continuous improvement, design standardization, automation, and technology adoption while supporting safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and delivering solutions that align with customer expectations and business objectives. This role will report directly to the NPD Engineering Leader of the Eaton PDCA division. **Job Responsibilities:** * Drive strategic product development programs and directly supervise the activities of a team of Mechanical, Electrical and Systems Engineering, Laboratory/Test Engineers, Engineering Technicians, and external engineering resources. The team includes Engineers located in Greenwood, Pune, India and remote. * Develop and maintain detailed project schedules incorporating resource planning, milestone deliverables, risk management, and administration of the ProLaunch process for all new product development activities. * Provide technical leadership and application support to field sales, customers, consultants, utilities, and channel partners. * Lead resolution of complex engineering, manufacturing, reliability, and quality issues through structured problem\-solving methodologies and root cause analysis. * Develop and maintain 3–5\-year strategic product roadmaps aligned with market needs, business objectives, emerging technologies, and competitive positioning. * Collaborate with internal and external customers to establish product specifications, performance requirements, and development priorities for the Medium Voltage Switchgear portfolio. * Represent the organization's strategic interests on industry technical committees, standards organizations, and professional societies related to power distribution and medium voltage equipment. * Develop, maintain, and manage departmental operating budgets, capital expenditures, laboratory expenditures, and product development program budgets. * Lead talent development activities including performance management, succession planning, technical mentoring, coaching, and career development planning for direct reports. * Drive innovation initiatives and technology development projects supporting future product platforms, digital solutions, sustainability initiatives, and advanced power distribution technologies. * Provide leadership for design verification, validation testing, certification activities, and compliance with applicable industry standards including ANSI, IEEE, IEC, UL, NEMA, and customer\-specific requirements. * Support manufacturing operations and productivity initiatives by ensuring product designs are optimized for manufacturability, serviceability, reliability, and cost competitiveness. * Lead global and cross\-functional engineering teams while serving as the North American engineering representative for strategic product platforms and technology initiatives. **Qualifications:** ------------------- **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering from an accredited institution * Minimum seven (7\) years of engineering experience in power distribution equipment, switchgear, electrical systems, or industrial equipment. * Minimum three (3\) years of engineering leadership, supervisory, or project leadership experience. * Eaton will not consider applicants for employment, immigration sponsorship, or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F\-1 to H\-1B, H\-1B cap registration, O\-1, E\-3, TN status, I\-485 job portability, etc. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Master’s degree in Engineering or Business Administration from an accredited institution * Experience in the design and development of Medium Voltage Switchgear products. * Professional Engineer (PE) license. * Project Management Professional (PMP) certification. * Experience leading global product development teams. * Experience with digital power management, protection and control systems, or intelligent switchgear technologies. * Patent filings or demonstrated innovation contributions. * Prior people management experience leading engineering organizations. **Skills:** ----------- **Position Criteria:** * Strong expertise in product development, stage\-gate processes, project management * Proven ability to drive innovation, influence stakeholders, and execute strategic initiatives. * Deep knowledge of electrical design principles and applicable ANSI, IEEE, UL, IEC, NEMA, and NEC standards. * Proficient in risk management tool and methods including FMEA, design reviews, testing, root\-cause analysis, and corrective actions. * Experience managing engineering budgets, schedules, resources, and applying Design for Manufacturing (DFM), Reliability (DFR), and Cost (DFC) principles. * Strong leadership, analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to support global operations through domestic and international travel. **Travel:** * Anticipated travel is 15%; which may vary depending on business needs All positions may require participation in video and in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job\-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws. We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job\-related reasons regardless of an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, marital status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law. Eaton believes in second chance employment. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction history will be considered regardless of their arrest or conviction history, consistent with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act and other local laws. You do not need to disclose your conviction history or participate in a background check until a conditional job offer is made to you. After making a conditional offer and running a background check, if Eaton is concerned about conviction that is directly related to the job, you will be given the chance to explain the circumstances surrounding the conviction, provide mitigating evidence, or challenge the accuracy of the background report. To request a disability\-related reasonable accommodation to assist you in your job search, application, or interview process, please call us at 1\-800\-836\-6345 to discuss your specific need. Only accommodation requests will be accepted by this phone number. We know that good benefit programs are important to employees and their families. Eaton provides various Health and Welfare benefits as well as Retirement benefits, and several programs that provide for paid and unpaid time away from work. Click here for more detail: Eaton Benefits Overview. Please note that specific programs and options available to an employee may depend on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

jobs.title: GTM Engineer
jobs.description: *GTM Engineer (GTME) at Echelon: Job Description* *About Echelon* Echelon is an AI platform that helps finance leaders reduce costs, improve workforce productivity, and get more from their existing teams and technology. We connect the dots across people, spend, operations, and AI so CFOs can make better resource decisions and measure the impact. We are a team of about 20, currently in stealth and launching publicly in early 2027\. Our buyer is the CFO of mid\-market and enterprise companies, with a focus today on established software businesses with 1,000\+ employees. We already work with well\-known software companies and are building the outbound engine that takes us from founder\-led and referral deals to a repeatable pipeline. *The role* You will be Echelon's first GTM Engineer, and outbound is the company's top go\-to\-market priority. Today our outbound runs on Apollo, HubSpot, and AI\-assisted research and writing, operated by a lean team of two AEs plus GTM leadership. It works account by account, but it does not scale. Your job is to turn that into a system: find the right CFOs at the right moment, enrich them with real signal, and get relevant, trigger\-based messages in front of them at volume without losing the quality that enterprise finance buyers expect. You will own the data, the workflows, and the experiments, and you will sit close enough to the deals to know what actually converts. * *Title:* GTM Engineer * *Reports to:* Head of GTM * *Location:* TBD * *Compensation:* TBD *What you'll own: first 90 days* * Stand up Clay as the core of our outbound data layer: account and contact sourcing, waterfall enrichment, and CFO\-level verification for our target list. * Build trigger detection that surfaces when a CFO is likely to care: leadership changes, M\&A and ownership changes (including PE activity), restructuring, layoffs, and cost programs. Map each trigger to the Echelon value story the team already uses. * Connect the pipe end to end: HubSpot target accounts in, Clay research and enrichment, personalized messaging, Apollo sequences out, with results written back to HubSpot. * Audit our current outbound and closed\-won deals to sharpen the ICP, then rebuild the target list from it. *What you'll own: beyond 90 days* * Run a disciplined testing program on segments, triggers, angles, and channels (email, LinkedIn, events), and kill what doesn't work fast. * Expand from the CFO to the broader buying group (FP\&A, procurement, people, transformation) with role\-specific messaging. * Build signal\-based plays for inbound, events, and target\-account campaigns ahead of our public launch. * Own outbound reporting: deliverability, reply rate, meetings booked, and pipeline sourced, visible to the CEO and GTM team every week. * Document everything so the system runs without you in the room. *Must\-haves* * *2\+ years of hands\-on Clay experience.* You have built production tables yourself: waterfall enrichment, AI research columns, custom HTTP/API calls, and pushes into a CRM and sequencer. You can show us something you built. * *Has sold to CFOs at Fortune 2000 companies.* You have carried a quota or run outbound into finance leadership at large enterprises, and you know how a CFO evaluates a vendor, who else is in the room, and why most cold emails to them get ignored. * Comfortable owning a system end to end at an early\-stage company, with no playbook to inherit. * Working knowledge of HubSpot (or Salesforce) and a sequencer such as Apollo or Outreach. * Strong writing. You can turn a 10\-K line, an earnings call, or a leadership change into a short, credible message a CFO would answer. *Nice\-to\-haves* * Experience selling into PE\-backed software companies or their portfolio finance teams. * Background in finance, FP\&A, or a finance\-adjacent product (spend, planning, HR and headcount, procurement). * Comfort with scripting (Python or JavaScript), webhooks, and tools like n8n, Make, or Zapier. * Experience using LLMs (Claude, GPT) in production GTM workflows, including prompt design for research and personalization. * Email deliverability know\-how: domain setup, warmup, inbox rotation. * Prior experience as the first GTM Engineer or first growth hire at a startup. *How we'll measure success* * *30 days:* Clay workspace live; ICP and target list rebuilt from closed\-won; outbound baseline documented * *90 days:* Trigger\-based outbound running end to end (HubSpot to Clay to Apollo to HubSpot); first meetings booked from the new system * *6 months:* Outbound is a consistent, measurable source of CFO meetings and qualified pipeline each month; weekly reporting in place * *12 months:* Outbound and signal\-based plays are a primary pipeline source post\-launch, running without founder involvement *Team, stack, and why now* You will work daily with our AEs and GTM leadership, and directly with our CEO, for whom outbound is the top priority. * *Stack:* Clay (you'll lead the rollout), HubSpot, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Claude, Slack * *Why join now:* you get to build the outbound engine before our public launch in early 2027, with a product that speaks to every CFO's current agenda: doing more with existing teams and proving the return on AI. What you build becomes the foundation of how Echelon goes to market.

assignment, remediation tracking, exception handling, validation, and reporting. * Designs and implements security controls within CI/CD pipelines and developer workflows, including SAST, SCA, secrets consistency and scale. * Partners with application development, DevOps, platform engineering, cloud, infrastructure, and cybersecurity teams to integrate security requirements into software development and deployment processes. * Identifies opportunities to automate security controls, remediation workflows, policy enforcement, and security guardrails. * Develops solutions to correlate vulnerability data with application ownership, asset criticality, exploitability, threat intelligence, and business risk. * Leads technical integration and optimization of enterprise Application Security and Vulnerability Management platforms. * Provides technical leadership and serves as an escalation point for complex automation, integration, and security engineering issues. * Develops dashboards, metrics, and reporting to provide visibility into vulnerability posture, remediation performance, security control coverage, and program effectiveness. * Establishes and maintains technical standards, design patterns, and documentation for security automation and DevSecOps capabilities. * Evaluates emerging technologies and recommends improvements to enterprise security tooling, automation, and vulnerability management processes. * Acts as a subject matter expert among peers, management, application teams, and engineering stakeholders. **Minimum Requirements:** Requires BS/BA in information Technology or related field of study and a minimum of 8 years experience in systems administration and security aspects of information systems, access management and network security technologies, network communications, computer networking, telecommunications, systems development and management, hardware, software, data, and people; experience with multiple technical and business disciplines required; or any combination of education and experience, which would provide an equivalent background. **Preferred Skills, Experiences and Competencies:** * Hands on automation scripting and API development experience. * Experience with application security technologies, vulnerability management platforms, CI/CD pipelines, source code management platforms, and enterprise workflow systems is strongly preferred. * Hands\-on experience with Python, PowerShell, JavaScript, REST APIs, GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, ServiceNow, Jira, or comparable technologies is preferred. * Experience with SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning, container security, cloud security, and software supply chain security is also preferred. * Security certifications such as CISSP, CSSLP, cloud security, DevSecOps, or equivalent advanced technical security certifications are strongly preferred. * Experience designing and implementing highly complex, enterprise\-scale security automation solutions is strongly preferred. jobs.title: Global Process Automation Advisor - BMS/Utilities
jobs.description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. The specific platform, discipline, or program focus varies by assignment. **Responsibilities:** Lead the automation discipline through solution assessment, replication, and development, managing tools, engineering standards, and best practices for the assigned platform or discipline. * Provide project teams with subject matter expertise for the Builting Management System (BMS) and Utility Management System (UMS) platforms (e.g., instrumentation specifications, platform stewardship, or process control strategies), collaborating with GFD and A\&E firms on automation scope across major capital projects * Lead design and delivery of projects with a focus on Builting Management System (BMS) and Utilities, supporting the Design Delivery Gate Review process and providing technical coaching and mentoring to other Lilly engineers * Expertly apply automation and process control solutions to continuously improve manufacturing processes, assisting sites globally with technical planning, technology assessments, and troubleshooting * Monitor and influence external codes and standards on Lilly's behalf, network with the external automation community, and champion health and safety, ethics, and compliance in all activities * Champion safe, compliant, and effective operations by supporting departmental activities, maintaining HSE compliance, mentoring others, fostering cross\-functional collaboration, and promoting continuous improvement across diverse work environments. **Basic Qualifications:** * Education Level: BS degree in Engineering or related science field * Experience: Minimum 5 years of experience in automation projects, operations, maintenance, or process development support with significant experience in one or more of measurements, process control, automation systems, instrumentation, or platform stewardship. * Certifications: (preferred) Certified Automation Professional (CAP) * Licenses: (preferred) Professional Engineer (PE) * Language Requirements: English * Required Skills Testing: N/A **Additional Skills/Preferences:** * Technical knowledge in pharmaceutical Drug Substance (API/Biotech) and/or Drug Product (Parenteral) manufacturing, including automated batch process control, recipe management, ISA S88 batch execution, ISA\-95 principles, and IT/OT integration * Experience leading automation project workstreams on major capital projects, managing project delivery metrics and communicating program status to stakeholders and leadership * Experience working with validated DCS/PLC/UMS/BMS platforms (Rockwell Automation, Emerson DeltaV, JCI Metasys, Siemens), including CSV activities (URS/FRS, IQ/OQ/PQ) * Experience in automation system project delivery and major capital projects, collaborating with A\&E firms, GFD, OEMs, and site teams across the full project lifecycle * Technical knowledge in additional automation platforms (Rockwell Automation, Siemens, or similar), including machine control, data historians, and reporting systems for API/Biotech manufacturing * Demonstrated ability to influence without authority, clarify complex issues, and build trust with peers and leaders across diverse, cross\-functional global teams and cultures **Additional Information:** * Position Location: US: Indianapolis IN Tech Center South * Travel Percentage (%): 10–25% on average, depending on assigned platform, discipline, or program; domestic and international travel required to support design reviews, FATs, site startup, and other project\-related activities; higher or extended travel may be required during active capital project delivery phases, with potential for longer\-term site assignments depending on the assignment. * Shift Information: Standard 8\-hour day, Monday through Friday, with some allowance for flex time; overtime and some weekend or holiday work may be required to support global site engagement across time zones and business needs​ Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace\-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response. Lilly is proud to be an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. Our employee resource groups (ERGs) offer strong support networks for their members and are open to all employees. Our current groups include: Africa, Middle East, Central Asia (AMECA), Black Employees at Lilly (BE@Lilly), Chinese Culture Network (CCN), EnAble, Evolve, Lilly Indian Network (LIN), Organization of Latinx at Lilly (OLA), Pride (LGBTQ\+ Allies), Veterans Leadership Network (VLN) and Women’s Initiative for Leading at Lilly (WILL). Actual compensation will depend on a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. The anticipated wage for this position is $130,500 \- $211,200 Full\-time equivalent employees also will be eligible for a company bonus (depending, in part, on company and individual performance). In addition, Lilly offers a comprehensive benefit program to eligible employees, including eligibility to participate in a company\-sponsored 401(k); pension; vacation benefits; eligibility for medical, dental, vision and prescription drug benefits; flexible benefits (e.g., healthcare and/or dependent day care flexible spending accounts); life insurance and death benefits; certain time off and leave of absence benefits; and well\-being benefits (e.g., employee assistance program, fitness benefits, and employee clubs and activities).Lilly reserves the right to amend, modify, or terminate its compensation and benefit programs in its sole discretion and Lilly’s compensation practices and guidelines will apply regarding the details of any promotion or transfer of Lilly employees. \#WeAreLilly

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Product
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ We are a well\-funded, early\-stage AI research and product lab focused on building the next generation of frontier multimodal AI models. Founded by former DeepMind researchers—including Andrew Dai, previously an engineering leader on Gemini—our mission is to push the frontier of visual and multimodal intelligence. Our first model, Glimpse, launched publicly in October 2026\. Our team currently consists of 25 world\-class scientists and engineers. We raised a $55M seed round led by Altimeter Capital, Menlo Ventures, Striker VC, and NVIDIA. We are tackling foundational problems in artificial intelligence and translating cutting\-edge multimodal research into scalable, real\-world systems. **About the role** ------------------ We are seeking a Software Engineer to lead the client\-facing product for Glimpse. In this role, you will design and build the integration layer, including but not limited to API, web interfaces, and platform tools that external developers will use to interact with our multimodal models. You will also collaborate directly with research, infrastructure, and GTM teams to ensure smooth delivery of future model releases. **What you will do** -------------------- * **Craft the Front Door to AI:** Build, scale, and polish the Glimpse developer console, interactive model playgrounds, real\-time analytics, and seamless onboarding flows. * **Architect End\-to\-End Solutions:** Lead front\-end development while bridging backend services with a focus on multimodal data handling, streamed responses, visual outputs, and other platform features such as API key management, budget page, and docs. * **Drive Product \& Visual Design:** You’re the designer — spearhead the UX design for interaction with multimodal input, creating sleek wireframes and high\-craft UI that redefine how developers experience frontier AI. * **Revolutionize Developer Workflows:** Engage directly with our developer community to invent frictionless experiences that make integrating Glimpse effortless. * **Keep the Product Experience Healthy:** Build dashboards and tools to monitor product health and the endpoints it depends on. Be part of the first response when something customers rely on breaks. **What we are looking for** --------------------------- * **Front\-End Expertise \& Full\-Stack Versatility:** Exceptional skills in modern web tech stack (e.g. React, TypeScript, Go gateway, Python services) and user experience design, combined with full\-stack fluency to build supporting API endpoints. * **Performance \& Security Sense:** You know how to keep a web app fast and safe. You’ve tracked down slow page loads or laggy interactions, and you handle sign\-in, API keys, and user uploads with care. * **Passionate Product Craftsman:** Proven track record of building developer\-facing tools, dashboards, or self\-serve platform experiences with strong taste and attention to interaction detail. * **Core Foundations \& Front\-End Reliability:** Solid grounding in API contracts, product lifecycle, failure modes, billing correctness, observability, and reliability, alongside experience keeping web interfaces reliable through monitoring and rapid debugging. * **Product and Design Ownership:** Comfortable owning a product surface end to end and making design decisions yourself, with good judgment about usability. * **High Agency:** Comfortable with ambiguity in a small team, able to balance speed against quality. **Nice to have** ---------------- * **Aesthetic Sense:** A strong eye for visual design, interaction detail, and craft. A portfolio or shipped product we can click through is optional but highly recommended. * **Backend Reliability, Scaling \& Distributed Systems:** Hands\-on experience with distributed systems, backend reliability, scaling, and connecting internal systems to external products smoothly. * **AI Product Experience:** Experience building products on top of AI or ML models.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description: If you are a **Senior Software Engineering Manager** professional looking for an opportunity to grow your career, Emerson has an exciting opportunity for you. Based in Austin, Texas, you will lead a talented team of software engineers focused on advancing DevSecOps and cybersecurity capabilities across the software development lifecycle. In this role, you will help drive innovation by developing tools, automation, and secure engineering practices that enable teams to integrate security into development, testing, deployment, and operations. You will collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to deliver high\-quality solutions that strengthen product security, accelerate delivery, and support customer success. This position follows a hybrid work schedule of four days on\-site and one day remote. **In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:** * Lead, coach, and support a team of approximately 5\-10 software engineers across a range of experience levels. * Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high\-performing team environment focused on continuous learning and innovation. * Drive delivery of new features, security capabilities, and engineering improvements aligned with business and customer needs. * Define and help execute the strategic direction for DevSecOps, software security, and engineering initiatives. * Guide project planning, execution, and prioritization to ensure successful outcomes. * Oversee continuous integration, continuous delivery, and release management processes. * Partner with product managers, technical leaders, and engineering teams to align software and hardware strategies. * Facilitate agile development practices and promote continuous improvement across teams. * Monitor product health, manage prioritization of issues, and support effective resolution of escalations. * Ensure high\-quality, end\-to\-end delivery of software releases while maintaining security and reliability standards. * Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels to provide transparency, alignment, and progress updates. Champion secure software development practices and help teams identify and address risks early in the development lifecycle. * **Who You Are:** You build strong partnerships and work collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives. jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** We’re looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to own and carry out a layered monitoring and alerting strategy for containerized applications on AWS Fargate. Your goal is to catch real problems that affect users, while keeping alert noise near zero. Every alert must lead to action. **Responsibilities*** Set up and maintain monitoring across synthetic tests, real\-user monitoring (RUM), application performance monitoring (APM) and tracing, error tracking, and service\-level objectives (SLOs). * Set up and maintain CloudWatch metrics, alarms, and dashboards for ECS/Fargate, RDS, OpenSearch, and Application Load Balancers (ALB). * Enforce a consistent tagging scheme across AWS resources, monitors, and SLOs, and keep data collection limited to what’s needed. * Deploy and configure monitoring agents (including sidecar containers) in Fargate task definitions. This includes health checks for RDS (PostgreSQL/MySQL), OpenSearch, and self\-managed databases on EC2/ECS. * Connect AWS accounts to monitoring tools using least\-privilege, read\-only IAM roles. * Write and maintain the infrastructure code for this work in AWS CloudFormation/CDK. * Keep alerting clean. Tune, demote, or remove any alert that doesn’t lead to action, and use persistence and multi\-location thresholds to prevent false alarms. * Build application dashboards and create standard alert message templates. * Work with application teams to add tracing to their services and to define SLOs. * Take part in incident response and post\-incident reviews during business hours, using metrics, traces, and logs to find root causes. **Required qualifications*** 5\+ years in SRE, DevOps, or cloud infrastructure engineering. * At least 2 years building production monitoring with a full observability platform, such as Datadog, New Relic, Dynatrace, Grafana, or Elastic Observability. * Hands\-on experience with AWS ECS/Fargate, RDS, OpenSearch, ALB, and IAM. * Hands\-on experience with CloudWatch metrics, alarms, and dashboards. * Skilled with AWS CloudFormation and/or CDK. * Practical experience with SLOs, error budgets, and designing alerts based on user\-facing symptoms rather than underlying causes. * Working knowledge of PostgreSQL and/or MySQL, plus OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, from an operations standpoint. * Scripting skills in Python or a similar language. * Able to obtain and keep a Public Trust determination. * Possession of a bachelor’s degree from an accredited college/university according to the Council for Higher Education Accreditation (CHEA) in related field. **Preferred qualifications*** Experience with Datadog (synthetic tests, RUM, APM, monitors, SLOs). * Experience with Sumo Logic: writing queries, building dashboards, and setting up alerts. * Experience with CloudWatch Logs, including Logs Insights queries and metric filters. * Experience with OpenTelemetry or adding tracing to services in more than one language (Node, Python, Java, .NET, Go). * Experience in federal or other regulated environments. * AWS certification (SysOps Administrator, DevOps Engineer, or Solutions Architect). **Salary:** $120,000\-$160,000 based on experience. **Work Location:** Hybrid (1 day in office, 4 days remote per week) in Rockville, MD 20850**Equal Opportunity Employer** ESI is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, including equitable hiring and promotion practices, and ongoing learning that supports belonging for every team member. *Work Authorization Notice* Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire.
