jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Exodigo is the leading underground mapping solution for non\-intrusive discovery. Our platforms combine multi\-sensor fusion, 3D imaging, and AI technologies to create complete, accurate underground maps that enable confident decision\-making for customers across the built world. We transform the project lifecycle for our customers, who include key community stakeholders in the utilities, transportation and government sectors. **We are experiencing sky\-rocketing growth and closed a historically large $96M Series B round in July of 2025**. Requirements: * Degree in Civil Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 4\+ years combining software development with BIM, CAD, or digital delivery work, ideally on infrastructure or civil projects. * Strong coding skills in Python, plus experience with C\#/.NET or TypeScript. * Hands\-on experience automating BIM workflows using tools such as Dynamo, pyRevit, the Civil 3D or Revit APIs, or Autodesk Platform Services. * Practical experience building with large language models: prompt and workflow design, tool or function calling, retrieval over documents, and evaluating model output. * A working understanding of civil design deliverables: alignments and profiles, corridors, grading, drainage and utility networks, sheet production, and model coordination. * Comfort working directly with end users: you listen first, explain clearly to non\-technical audiences, and build trust by shipping. * Ownership and a bias for action. You are happy working in ambiguity, scoping your own work, and seeing it through to adoption. **Nice to Have** * Experience building agent integrations, for example using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar tool frameworks. * Familiarity with openBIM and infrastructure data standards such as IFC 4\.3, LandXML, and ISO 19650\. * Experience with Bentley OpenRoads, OpenFlows, or iTwin; Navisworks; or GIS platforms such as ArcGIS. * Experience with document AI on drawings, specifications, and reports, including PDF and OCR pipelines. * Background as a practicing civil engineer or BIM coordinator before moving into software. * Experience delivering training or leading change\-management programs in an engineering organization. Job description: Exodigo engineers the underground without digging. Our platform combines multi\-sensor fusion and AI to produce complete, accurate 3D maps of buried utilities, foundations, and geotechnical conditions, which utilities, transportation agencies, and engineering firms use to plan, design, and build with confidence. Behind every map is a team of civil engineers, BIM modelers, and mapping specialists who turn raw subsurface data into engineering\-grade deliverables. We are looking for an AI BIM Engineer to help that team move faster, stay consistent, and scale with our growth. You will work alongside our Mapping, Delivery, and Engineering Services teams, learn how a project moves from field scan through interpretation to Civil 3D and OpenRoads models and client\-ready utility maps, and find where AI can take on the repetitive work so our engineers can focus on engineering judgment. This is a hands\-on, builder role. You will scope the problem, build the solution, ship it into live projects, and stay with it until it becomes part of how the team works. You will be the bridge between engineers who know the underground deeply and the AI agents that can amplify them: you can discuss utility quality levels, model QA/QC, and client CAD standards in the morning, and write a new integration for an AI agent in the afternoon. What you learn on our projects will shape the AI capabilities we give every team. **What You'll Do** Embed with engineering teams * Work side by side with highway, structures, water, and site development teams to understand their design processes, tools, standards, and pain points. * Lead discovery sessions with engineers and project leads, and translate what you hear into clearly scoped, prioritized opportunities for AI and automation. * Own delivery end to end: from first conversation and rapid prototype through to a stable tool in daily production use. * Coach engineers on using AI effectively and safely in their work, through hands\-on sessions, office hours, and one\-on\-one support. Turn expertise into repeatable workflows * Partner with senior engineers to capture their know\-how (checking procedures, design criteria, QA/QC steps, naming and modeling standards) as reusable AI workflows, prompts, and playbooks. * Design workflows that are repeatable and reviewable: clear inputs, clear outputs, and an engineer in the loop wherever professional judgment or sign\-off is required. * Build evaluation sets from real project data so we can measure whether a workflow is accurate and reliable before it scales. * Document what you build and help teams own and extend their workflows themselves. Extend what our AI agents can do * Design and build integrations that let AI agents read, query, and act on civil engineering data: BIM models, alignments, surfaces, pipe networks, drawings, specifications, and project records. * Develop tools and connectors on top of platforms such as Autodesk Civil 3D, Revit, and Autodesk Platform Services / ACC, Bentley OpenRoads and iTwin, and open formats such as IFC and LandXML. * Build automations with Dynamo, pyRevit, Python, and C\#/.NET where a deterministic script is the right answer and expose them as capabilities an AI agent can call. * Make sound trade\-offs between speed, scope, and quality, and keep everything you ship secure, version\-controlled, and maintainable. Close the loop * Spot patterns across teams and turn one\-off solutions into shared, reusable capabilities. * Feed field insights back to our digital, IT, and data teams to shape platform priorities and roadmap. * Contribute to our AI governance, data\-handling, and BIM standards so adoption stays responsible as it grows. Learn more: **What Success Looks Like** In your first year, you will have: * Embedded with several project teams and built a clear map of where AI can save the most time and reduce the most risk. * Shipped AI workflows that engineers use every week, with measurable time savings and quality improvements. * Added new civil\-specific capabilities to our AI agents, so they can work directly with the models and data our teams produce. * Built a library of documented, evaluated workflows that other teams can pick up and adapt. * Become the go\-to person engineers call when they think, "There has to be a better way to do this." **Why Join Us** * Real impact: your work goes straight into the maps that help infrastructure owners avoid utility strikes, delays, and safety risks on major projects. * An AI\-native company: AI already sits at the core of how we read the subsurface. You will extend it to how we engineer and deliver. * A rare mix of disciplines: geophysics, civil engineering, BIM, and modern AI in one role, with a global team spanning the US, Israel, and beyond. * Room to shape, from the ground up, how a fast\-growing company scales its engineering delivery with AI. * Close collaboration with field, mapping, and engineering experts who care about getting the underground right. Our mission is to power the next era of underground exploration – saving time, money, lives, and the planet. We are focused, intentional, confident, and hard working. We solve big problems, but we are approachable, open\-minded, and love hard questions. You can learn more about us on our website or check out this short video. Apply on our careers page, via Linkedin or send your resume to cara.partovich@exodigo.ai

jobs.title: Program Manager III
jobs.description: At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. **Program Manager III** ======================= Our Technology Team partners with teams across Expedia Group to create innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high\-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction. Product Security, part of Expedia Group's Information Security organization, partners with product, engineering, and platform teams to build security and privacy into Expedia Group products across the whole lifecycle, from design through runtime. We give developers the infrastructure to build and ship secure products efficiently, and enable our business partners to build resilient, future\-ready solutions that advance Expedia Group's security posture and operational velocity. Our teams cover security architecture and design review, application and code security, vulnerability management, and offensive security, using AI\-assisted platforms and automation to scale that work across a development community of thousands. You will join Product Security as a program manager, working across our teams and initiatives as priorities evolve, and partnering with security architects, engineers and partner teams to run programs, vendor coordination and the reporting that keeps leadership informed. **In this role, you will** * Own end\-to\-end delivery of security programs and initiatives that span multiple Product Security teams and partner organizations, for example onboarding business units onto AI\-assisted security review, rolling out new security tooling, or driving remediation programs with engineering teams, setting scope, milestones, dependencies and success measures, and moving to new areas as business priorities evolve. * Support Product Security's rhythm of the business, including annual and quarterly planning, investment planning, monthly and quarterly business reviews, and all\-hands and leadership updates, keeping inputs, timelines and narratives on track across teams. * Coordinate delivery with Product Security vendors and partner teams: track vendor commitments and timelines, follow issues through to resolution, and run the recurring vendor and partner forums and escalation paths. * Design the mechanisms programs run on: intake and queue health, operating cadence (sprints, retrospectives), and executive\-ready status, metrics and dashboards for business reviews, automating repetitive reporting wherever possible. * Use AI tools to build and maintain program artifacts, including executive presentations, web\-based status pages, dashboards and demo materials, as versioned, reviewable work, and compile recurring status and metrics from team inputs, verifying every figure before it reaches leadership. * Establish governance, decision frameworks and escalation paths with compliance, privacy, platform engineering and business\-unit partners, and identify risks early with mitigation and contingency plans. * Keep a documented source of truth for each program, including plan, decision log, risks and status, so partners and leaders can see where things stand without another meeting. * Lead rollout and change management, including communications, documentation and enablement, so that developers adopt new security workflows, and measure that adoption. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, business or related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience. * 5\+ years of program management experience delivering cross\-functional initiatives in technology or security organizations. * Experience owning a multi\-team program end to end, including planning, critical path, dependency and risk management, with external vendors or third\-party platforms as delivery dependencies. * Experience supporting rhythm\-of\-the\-business activities for a multi\-team organization, such as planning cycles, business reviews and executive reporting. * Working knowledge of the software development lifecycle and application security concepts, such as security reviews, threat modeling or vulnerability management, enough to coordinate techni , reports and dashboards, with the judgment to validate AI output for accuracy before it is shared. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience delivering product security or application security programs for large\-scale, distributed or cloud\-based services. * Experience running programs that rolled out third\-party platforms across a large organization, including vendor coordination and onboarding internal teams. * Track record of taking a capability from pilot to scaled adoption, including rollout planning, change management, and measurement of risk\-reduction impact. * Experience building program metrics and dashboards from ticketing and platform data, for example with Jira, spreadsheets or business\-intelligence tools. * Demonstrated ability to influence prioritization across multiple product lines or platforms using data and clear storytelling. * Experience maintaining program artifacts as code, for example in GitHub with pull\-request review, or building reusable AI skills or agents that automate recurring reporting and coordination. * Experience running or coordinating work carried out by AI agents, such as automated triage, reporting or remediation workflows, including defining human review points and measuring agent output quality. * Track record of moving between programs or portfolios as priorities shift, ramping quickly on new domains and stakeholders. The total cash range for this position in Austin is $146,000\.00 to $204,500\.00\. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $233,500\.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.\&\#xa; Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future. **Benefits and perks** Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life . **Accommodation requests** Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation . **About Expedia Group** Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease. **Important notice** Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ . **Equal Opportunity** Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. This employer participates in E\-Verify. The employer will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee's I\-9 to confirm work authorization.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - .NET
jobs.description: **Company Description** Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries. **Job Description** The Software Engineer (.NET/Azure) is a hands\-on, mid\-level contributor responsible for designing, building, and modernizing high\-volume, high\-transaction applications across the Experian Employer Services (EES) organization. You will write production code, participate in code reviews, evaluate SAST findings, and work closely with product, quality engineering, security, and operations partners to deliver secure, reliable software to our clients and partners. AI and automation are the main focus of our team. EES is adopting an AI\-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI DLC) and spec\-driven agentic development, in which teams define intent, constraints, acceptance criteria, and validation before AI agents build approved work. As an engineer in this model you will work from versioned specifications, direct AI coding agents to implement approved work, and oversee the review, testing, and security validation of what they produce. You will have already worked this way hands\-on; this is a requirement of the role, not a learning goal. Humans remain accountable for technical decisions, data protection, and production outcomes. At Experian, we believe great work happens when people come together. We're focused on attracting talent in and around our designated hub locations who are open to collaborating with colleagues in person. Aligning employees to these talent markets helps foster collaboration, strengthen team connections, and support long\-term career growth within Experian. This hybrid role reports to the Engineering Manager, Application Engineering, and reside in or near one of our collaboration hubs: Costa Mesa, CA; San Jose, CA; Allen, TX; Austin, TX; Franklin, TN; New York, NY; Schaumberg, IL; Washington, D.C.; Atlanta, GA; Boston, MA; Seattle, WA Responsibilities: * Analyze new feature requirements with attention to design, software development best practices, testing strategy, database design, security, and cloud architecture, and turn them into clear, versioned specifications with explicit acceptance criteria that engineers and AI agents can verify. * Use AI coding assistants and agents (for example GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) to implement approved work, and own the review, testing, and security validation of AI\-generated code before it is merged. Decide when a change needs additional human review based on its risk. * Build new and modernize existing .NET applications, APIs, and partner integrations, including responsive, accessible web UIs that work across devices. * Write high\-quality, well\-tested code: unit tests, integration tests, and contract tests, with observability built in. * Automate repetitive engineering and operational work (pipelines, environment setup, test data, deployments) rather than performing it by hand. * Maintain the team's reusable agent instructions, skills, and coding standards for the codebase, and help teammates use agentic tools well. * Participate in code reviews and provide meaningful feedback on human\-written and AI\-generated code alike. * Follow Experian's Secure SDLC. Evaluate and resolve SAST findings, handle sensitive and personal data safely, and never expose such data to AI tools or non\-production environments without approved controls. * Resolve defects identified by quality engineering and demonstrate completed functionality to the Product team for approval. * Promote a DevOps culture, work with IT and operations, and participate in the on\-call rotation for platform emergencies. * Work within Agile and Scrum delivery while adapting planning and reporting as specifications and system\-generated evidence replace ceremony\-driven tracking. **Qualifications** * Hands\-on experience with spec\-driven agentic development (mandatory). At least one year of personally using AI coding assistants or agents on production code: working from specifications, constraining the agent's scope, testing and reviewing its output, and deciding what requires human approval. * Experience working within an AI\-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI DLC) or a comparable spec\-driven model with explicit specifications, automated validation, and human oversight. * 6\+ years of professional .NET development experience with C\#, .NET 8\+ (and .NET Framework for maintenance of existing systems), and ASP.NET Core. * 2\+ years building and operating solutions on Azure, including services such as App Service, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Service Bus, Key Vault, Application Insights, and Azure Monitor. * Experience with MS SQL Server, T\-SQL, relational database design, and Entity Framework Core or a comparable ORM. * Experience designing, building, and integrating REST APIs and partner integrations, including authentication, versioning, and error handling. * Solid front\-end experience with HTML, CSS, TypeScript, and one modern SPA framework (Angular or React). * Experience with service oriented or microservice architecture, messaging, and common cloud\-native patterns. * Experience with Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, Git branching workflows, and automated testing in the pipeline. * Working knowledge of secure coding practices, SAST remediation, and handling of sensitive and personal data. * Experience with Agile and Scrum delivery. * Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Experience building GenAI\-enabled features with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Semantic Kernel, or similar, including retrieval\-augmented generation, prompt engineering, and output evaluation. * Familiarity with Agent Skills or similar standards for reusable agent instructions and workflows. * Experience with Playwright or similar end\-to\-end testing frameworks. * Experience modernizing legacy .NET Framework applications and integrating acquired technologies into an existing product ecosystem. * Azure certifications such as AZ\-204 or AZ\-400\. General Requirements: * Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience * 6\+ years of professional .NET development experience * 2\+ years of Azure cloud experience * 1\+ year of hands\-on spec\-driven agentic development within AI DLC or a comparable model (mandatory) **Additional Information** Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award\-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25\), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site to understand why. Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets. The base pay range for this position is listed above. Within this range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors such as job\-related skills, experience, and education. You will be also eligible for a variable pay opportunity. Experian is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer for all groups protected under applicable federal, state and local law, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity. **Benefits/Perks:** * Great compensation package and bonus plan. * Core benefits including medical, dental, vision, and matching 401K. * Flexible work environment, ability to work remote, hybrid or in\-office. * Flexible time off including volunteer time off, vacation, sick and 12\-paid holidays. * Explore all our exciting benefits here: https://myexperianbenefits.com/. **Recruitment Fraud Awareness** \- Experian's recruitment process is conducted only through authorised channels. Recruitment communications will only be sent from an @experian.com email address. **Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment** as part of an application, interview, assessment, onboarding, or recruitment process. To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit **experian.com/careers**. \#LI\-Hybrid This is a Hybrid position.

jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer
jobs.description: ExpressPoint has a full\-time opportunity for a Senior Network Engineer in our East El Paso facility. This position is responsible for designing, implementing, maintaining, securing, and optimizing the organizations network infrastructure. This position ensures reliable and secure connectivity across corporate offices, data centers, cloud environments, remote users, and business\-critical systems. The role serves as a senior technical resource for complex network issues, infrastructure projects, cybersecurity initiatives, capacity planning, disaster recovery, and technology modernization. The Senior Network Engineer also establishes network standards, documentation, monitoring, and operational best practices. **COMPANY PROFILE** Built on over 20 years of experience, ExpressPoint provides high quality multi\-vendor depot repair and supply chain services at the lowest total cost. Serving large OEMs, field service providers, and 3PLs that support distributed IT and data center customers, we deliver 1\.6 million global shipments annually at a 98%\+ fill rate from ISO 9001:2015 certified facilities in the United States and Mexico. Our customers experience improved asset utilization and field force effectiveness, lower total cost and complete satisfaction. We also provide a fun, yet professional working environment. Our relaxed business casual dress code allows us to wear jeans daily! **JOB RESPONSIBILITIES** Network Architecture and Engineering * Design, configure, implement, and maintain LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPN, internet, and cloud networking environments. * Develop network architecture that supports scalability, redundancy, security, and business continuity. * Configure and manage enterprise routers, switches, wireless infrastructure, firewalls, and related network appliances. * Manage VLANs, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, NAT, QoS, SD\-WAN, and site\-to\-site connectivity. * Evaluate networking technologies and recommend infrastructure improvements. * Develop network capacity plans based on business growth and application requirements. Network Security * Design and maintain firewalls, VPNs, network segmentation, access control lists, and secure remote access. * Partner with information security personnel to identify and remediate network vulnerabilities. * Review firewall rules and network access regularly to maintain least\-privilege access. * Support ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, and applicable customer or contractual security requirements. * Assist with security incidents by analyzing network traffic, logs, suspicious connections, and potential compromises. * Maintain secure configurations and appropriate firmware and software patch levels. Monitoring, Performance, and Reliability * Monitor availability, bandwidth utilization, latency, packet loss, device health, and other performance indicators. * Proactively identify bottlenecks, capacity issues, recurring incidents, and single points of failure. * Establish alerting and escalation procedures for outages and performance degradation. * Perform root\-cause analysis for significant incidents and implement corrective actions. * Maintain network availability appropriate for business\-critical operations. Troubleshooting and Technical Support * Serve as the escalation point for complex network and connectivity problems. * Troubleshoot routing, switching, wireless, VPN, DNS, DHCP, firewall, ISP circuit, and application connectivity issues. * Coordinate with telecommunications carriers, technology vendors, managed service providers, and security providers. * Provide Tier 3 technical support to infrastructure and service desk teams. * Lead the technical response during major network outages. Microsoft and Cloud Networking * Support networking for Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 environments. Configure and maintain Azure virtual networks, subnets, VPN gateways, network security groups, routing, and hybrid connectivity where applicable. * Support Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, and cloud applications from a connectivity and network\-security perspective. * Work with systems engineers to maintain secure communication between cloud and on\-premises infrastructure. Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery * Design network redundancy and failover capabilities for critical facilities and systems. * Maintain network\-related disaster recovery procedures and participate in continuity testing. * Verify backup configurations for routers, switches, firewalls, and other critical network devices. * Develop recovery procedures for major network outages. Documentation and Configuration Management * Maintain network diagrams, IP addressing documentation, circuit inventories, firewall documentation, and equipment inventories. * Establish network configuration and naming standards and maintain current configuration backups. * Document major changes, troubleshooting procedures, and recovery processes. * Develop network standard operating procedures and technical work instructions. Project, Vendor, and Technical Leadership * Lead network infrastructure projects, including implementation plans, testing, migrations, and rollback procedures. * Coordinate carriers, ISPs, hardware vendors, managed service providers, and security providers. * Review vendor solutions and proposals and assist with network hardware and telecommunications budgeting. * Function as the network subject\-matter expert and mentor junior network, systems, and support personnel. * Establish engineering standards, lead complex root\-cause analysis, and recommend improvements to IT leadership. * Identify technical risks early and translate network risks and requirements into understandable business terms. **Required Qualifications** * Typically 7\+ years of progressively responsible network engineering experience. * Advanced knowledge of TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, NAT, VPNs, routing, switching, wireless networking, and network security. * Strong understanding of routing protocols such as OSPF and BGP. * Hands\-on experience managing enterprise firewalls, switches, routers, and wireless infrastructure. * Experience troubleshooting complex, multi\-site network environments and using network monitoring and diagnostic tools. * Strong documentation, change\-management, communication, and project leadership skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Bachelors degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience. * Cisco CCNP Enterprise or equivalent experience. * Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, or comparable firewall and security certification appropriate to the environment. * Microsoft Azure networking and hybrid cloud experience. * Experience supporting ISO 27001, NIST, SOC 2, or similar security and compliance frameworks. * Experience with SD\-WAN, network automation, and cloud\-connected enterprise networks. At ExpressPoint, we offer a great benefits package. Our health, dental, vision and life insurance coverage begin on your first day of employment! We also offer paid vacations, holidays, 401K, short term and long term disability, and tuition reimbursement.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description: **The Team You'll Join** ======================== First American Trust helps individuals and businesses protect, manage, and grow what matters most through banking, wealth management, and trust solutions backed by more than ﬁve decades of experience. As an OCC\-regulated federal savings bank with more than $9 billion in assets, First American Trust is comprised of two distinct divisions: banking services, and wealth management services. We provide commercial deposit services tailored to the real estate and title industries. Our wealth management division has provided personalized investment management, fiduciary trust services, and wealth planning for over six decades. You'll work alongside experienced professionals who build lasting relationships, provide thoughtful financial guidance, and help clients achieve their long\-term financial goals with confidence. Along the way, you'll have the freedom and support to innovate, collaborate, and grow professionally alongside people who genuinely care about your success. **The Impact You'll Make** ========================== As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for hands on coding as well as supporting and contributing to the architecture, design of cloud\-native applications \& mentoring junior software engineers. We're interested in talking to you if you're passionate about new opportunities and you have a demonstrated track record of success in delivering new features and products. You love coding and find yourself keeping up with the latest technology trends. You tinker, explore and regularly read to stay in touch with the development community and are passionate about discovering ways to improve quality, reusability, extensibility, and consistency. You are multi\-faceted with a great mix of technical and interpersonal skills, which enables you to succeed in highly collaborative and agile work environments. **What You'll Do:** * Contribute to design, development, coding, testing, debugging, and deploying of software in an Azure cloud environment * Modify and enhance existing applications as well as assist the team on product delivery by writing code and reviewing pull requests * Independently define, prioritize goals and tasks in a fast\-paced agile product environment with small, focused teams * Communicate effectively with a variety of stakeholders to ensure project success * On call by rotation and after\-hours support driven by business needs * Derive optimal solutions and implement best coding practices * Work with Solution Architect and strategize design plans * Propose solutions to tough problems, build consensus among team \& mentor junior developers **What You'll Bring:** * 5\+ years of experience in cloud\-native applications (Azure strongly preferred, AWS is also ok) using Python * Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent combination of education and experience * Thorough understanding of Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) design and practices * Strong RDBMS experience (PostgreSQL, MS SQL etc.) designing tables \& writing queries * SQL experience is a strong plus * Proven ability to identify, explain, and implement common design patterns * Demonstrated experience and design of systems or pipelines from scratch * Ability to assess and clearly articulate design trade\-offs, scalability options, and performance implications * Conduct code reviews to ensure best coding practices are utilized * Strong knowledge of professional software engineering best practices for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, CI/CD, and DevOps * Fluency with multi\-platform software utilizing various programming environments and tools * Excellent communication and written skills * Eager to learn new languages and technologies * Knowledge of Python, Ruby, Azure, React, JavaScript/TypeScript, REST API, Relational Databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL etc.), NoSQL Databases (MongoDB etc.) preferred * Experience with Docker, Linux, Windows, Azure, GIT, NPM Package Management preferred **Pay, Benefits, and Support** ============================== Pay Range: $129,300\.00 \- $172,300\.00 Annually This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on a number of factors which may include job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, business requirements and geographic location. Based on eligibility, First American offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401k, PTO/paid sick leave and other great benefits like an employee stock purchase plan. Our people first culture is built on creating a workplace where different perspectives are welcomed, respected, and valued. We believe teams are stronger when employees feel supported, included, and encouraged to contribute as themselves. Here, you’ll be part of a culture built on collaboration, respect, accountability, and continuous improvement — so you can do meaningful work, grow your career, and help move our customers, communities, and company forward. **About First American** ======================== First American Financial Corporation (NYSE: FAF) is a premier provider of title, settlement, and risk solutions for real estate transactions. Backed by financial strength and stability built over more than 135 years, the company is leading the digital transformation of the industry through continued investment in proprietary technologies, unmatched data assets, and scalable solutions designed for what’s next. First American’s commitment to putting its people first has resulted in numerous accolades, including being named one of the 100 Best Companies to Work For by Great Place to Work® and Fortune Magazine for more than ten consecutive years. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **TITLE:** Senior Software Engineer **REPORTING TO**: CTO **LOCATION**: Marina del Rey, CA – OR – Williamsburg, NY (onsite M \- F) **Who Is Flip?** Flip builds AI voice agents that handle millions of real customer conversations for some of the biggest brands, healthcare providers, and transportation companies in the world. When you call a company and the AI actually solves your problem — tracks the order, processes the return, refills the prescription — that's us. We're a low\-ego team. We don't need the limelight or the stardom — we care about solving really hard problems, fast. And here's the part worth stopping on: outside the frontier labs, almost nobody is running AI in production at this scale. We are — millions and millions of live phone calls, at a ratio of roughly one engineer for every million calls. We deploy to production three times a day. Very few teams our size serve this volume, and the reason is simple: we hold a very high bar for development. **How we think** ---------------- **From day one, we've operated on first principles, and the first principle is the customer.** If you have strong conviction that something delivers real business value for your customer, it shouldn't die in red tape or committee. You ship it — fast and often — because the customer is what actually matters. That's why there's a direct line from your keyboard to production here. We didn't remove the committee to move fast for its own sake; we removed it because conviction plus customer obsession doesn't need a permission slip. **We reward big swings.** Our founders are very forward about this: you'll test in production, and you'll always be encouraged to take a swing — whether it lands or not. Missing on a big swing is fine. Not swinging is what gets called out. Agentic development has changed the way we work — we're not shy about that. What it hasn't changed is the necessity of experience, especially at the production level. You can ship faster than ever now; that doesn't negate experience. Speed without judgment is how you break things millions of people depend on. That's why we hire senior engineers: builders whose experience makes the new speed safe. **Our view is simple: let builders build.** We care a lot less about stack experience or corporate pedigree than most companies — and a lot more about whether you've looked past the noise and want to build product you're genuinely proud of. Tools change monthly now. The instinct to build doesn't. We keep the team lean on purpose — a high bar, real support, real resources — because that's where builders truly express themselves. The most common thing we hear from engineers after joining Flip is some version of *"I could never have done this at my last company"*. Deep industry expertise matched with ruthless execution creates wonderful work. That's the whole formula. **What you'll build** --------------------- We're serving an orchestrated system of agents answering millions of contacts daily and now also expanding into other modalities like chat. Pulling that off requires elite engineering paired with incredible DevOps — voice is unforgiving: it's real\-time, there are no retries or page refreshes, and the customer is literally on the line. The work breaks into three lanes: * **Vertical engineering** — building the agents themselves: complex multi\-step customer workflows and deep integrations into the contact center and the industries we serve — order systems, healthcare workflows, logistics. This is where "mostly works" isn't shippable. * **Platform engineering** — the orchestration layer every agent runs on: routing, state, tool use, and the primitives that let vertical teams ship fast without reinventing the engine. * **Inference \& DevOps** — we host our own models; low\-latency serving at production scale is a core competency here, not a vendor line item. Plus the telephony, observability, and deployment infrastructure that keeps millions of live calls healthy. And the range here is real. Our engineers do everything from sitting face\-to\-face with customers to going deep on complex backend systems — you really get to pick where you fit. We don't slot you into one of these on day one. There's probably a place for you — we'll find it together, and it'll probably change as we grow. **What we look for** -------------------- This is a senior role, and the bar is the same one we hold for staff: we are always raising the bar on each other. Builders love to build — and how they build varies. Some want the flexibility of working alone and joining forces when it counts; some do their best work in a small pod. We don't prescribe it. You'll own real systems from day one, work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with our staff engineers, and have a clear path to staff as your scope grows. * **Real production experience.** You've built and owned systems where failure had consequences. You have 6\+ years of professional engineering experience building and running production systems. Beyond the years, we look at what you've shipped and what you learned shipping it. * **Judgment that survives contact with production.** Agentic development is how we work — but what we're actually hiring is your experience: knowing what to ship, what to slow down on, and what never to ship at all. * **Low ego, high execution.** You own outcomes, not tickets. You'd rather ship the thing than present the plan for the thing. * **A bias for big swings.** You'd rather take a shot and miss than play it safe — and you learn fast from both. * **Customer obsession.** You want to be close to the problem — sometimes literally in the room — and you measure yourself by what the customer got. **More About Us** * We're international, spanning the US, UK, and Canada. * We've raised \+$30M to date including our recent $20M Series A \- backed by Ridge, Next Coast, ScOp, Bullpen Capital, Data Point and Forum Ventures, as well as founders \& executives from Amazon Alexa, Ada, Attentive and Simon Data. * Our tech stack includes Python, MongoDB, AWS, Twilio, Datadog, Snowflake, and Omni. * Comprehensive healthcare and unlimited vacation, including a mandatory half week for everyone over July 4, and a full week off at the end of the year. * In the office 5 days/week, we collaborate in real time on the desk. Our customers span the globe, and so do our offices. Flip is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all employees, applicants, and covered individuals regardless of protected characteristics. We want our company to be as diverse and inclusive as our customers.

jobs.description: **Who We Are:** Our story began in 2011 when a group of office workers at a major logistics company in Chicago had a lunch problem. Nearby options were limited, and the team was spending too much time and money traveling to their favorite restaurants. They had an idea: bring Chicago’s local restaurant culture inside the office to sell food. It was an immediate hit. When they discovered people from other companies sneaking into their office, they knew they were on to something. Fooda pioneered the concept of rotating popup restaurants inside offices. Today, we operate in 60 cities with over 100 million meals served and continue to grow rapidly. Powered by technology and a network of 1500\+ restaurants, we feed hungry people at work through a platform of unique food programs located within companies, office buildings, hospitals, schools, distribution centers, and more. At Fooda, we believe a workplace food program should be something employees love and look forward to every day. **Requirements** **Who You Are:** The Principal Software Engineer is a hands\-on senior technical leader who owns the architecture and technical direction of Fooda’s platform. They lead complex, cross\-team initiatives, raise the bar for engineering excellence, and align technical decisions with the company’s long\-term goals. They lead by example in the daily use of AI tools and coding agents, and help the team use them safely and effectively. **What You Will Be Doing:** * 8\+ years of experience designing, building, and running production\-grade distributed applications across the stack (front\-end, back\-end, and cloud infrastructure) * Expert in Ruby on Rails, React, and PostgreSQL; hands\-on experience with RESTful and GraphQL APIs, RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch, and Redis (.NET experience is a plus) * Deep experience with cloud technologies (e.g., AWS S3, CloudFront, Lambda, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform) * Proven experience building and optimizing CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, CircleCI, Jenkins, AWS tools) * Drives software architecture evolution, ensuring scalability, reliability, and extensibility * Designs and implements the most complex features end\-to\-end — from technical design and implementation to release * Identifies and resolves performance bottlenecks, and refactors critical components for maintainability * Solves ambiguous, high\-impact problems with innovative thinking * Enforces high software quality through comprehensive testing * Leads large\-scale technical discussions and delivery plans, and influences architectural decisions across teams * Mentors engineers, conducts rigorous code reviews, and provides insightful feedback to uphold engineering excellence * Drives best practices with a strong focus on collaboration and innovation * Partners closely with product managers and QA to align solutions with user and business goals * Excellent oral and written communication * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience **AI Tools and Coding Agents:** * Proven experience designing, building, and running autonomous AI\-powered pipelines in the software development lifecycle * Strong hands\-on experience with AI coding agents for design, implementation, refactoring, and code review * Understands the security risks of AI tools and agents (e.g., exposure of source code, customer data, or credentials to outside services) and sets safe practices for the team * Builds and improves jobs.title: Robotics Field Service Engineer - Road Warrior

As labor constraints rise, costs increase, and global competition intensifies, automation is no longer optional for manufacturers that want to stay competitive. We deliver automation through a Robotics\-as\-a\-Service model that combines industrial robotics, proprietary software, and full\-service support into a single, integrated solution. By removing the traditional barriers of cost, complexity, and risk, we enable manufacturers to deploy automation quickly and realize measurable gains in throughput, safety, and operational efficiency without large upfront capital investment. Backed by leading investors including Lux Capital, Initialized Capital, Blackhorn Ventures, and Mitsubishi HC Capital North America, Formic is scaling rapidly and building the foundation for a new era of high\-performance, Made in America production. **Ready to take your robotics career on the road? As Formic's customer base and robot fleet continue to grow, so does our need for skilled Robotics Field Service Engineers who are ready to go where the action is! Our engineers travel across the U.S., working hands\-on with cutting\-edge robotic systems, troubleshooting challenges, and keeping automation running. If you're passionate about robotics, love solving problems, and are open to travel up to 100%, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and be part of the future of industrial automation!** **About the team:** The Fleet Operations Team drives uptime and operational performance across Formic's growing fleet of deployed robotic systems. Working inside live manufacturing environments, the team diagnoses issues, restores production, and continuously improves system reliability at scale. Fleet Operations operates at the intersection of robotics, controls, and real\-world factory execution, ensuring Formic's automation delivers consistent, measurable performance across diverse industrial applications. **About the role:** As a Robotics Field Service Engineer, you are the front line of technical ownership across Formic's deployed robotic cells. You will diagnose failures, restore systems to production, perform preventative and corrective maintenance, and represent Formic directly within customer facilities. This is a hands\-on, high\-accountability role in uptime\-critical environments. Success requires strong troubleshooting discipline, calm execution during production interruptions, and structured documentation. Your work directly impacts fleet performance, customer satisfaction, and long\-term system reliability. **In this role, you will:** * Perform preventative, corrective, and predictive maintenance on robotic manufacturing cells * Respond to remote and on\-site escalations, diagnose root causes, and restore systems quickly * Provide hands\-on technical support to customer operators and maintenance teams * Log service activity, asset updates, and spare part requirements in CMMS * Coordinate field scheduling and support with customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders * Monitor system performance remotely using Formic dashboards and fleet tools * Document service work, root cause analysis, and follow\-up actions with clarity and precision * Identify recurring failure patterns and escalate systemic risks for broader improvement * Build professional, trusted relationships with plant managers and site personnel * Operate with strict adherence to safety standards, including LOTO and industrial compliance * Participate in RCA sessions, audits, and continuous improvement initiatives * Continuously expand technical depth across robotics, controls, networking, and industrial mechanical, PLC, or robotic control systems * Ability to read electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and pneumatic drawings * Experience using CMMS platforms to track and report maintenance activity * Comfortable with travel up to 100% * Clear written and verbal communicator capable of producing structured service documentation * Demonstrated commitment to safety and disciplined field execution **Bonus points if you have:** * Experience with 6\-axis robot brands such as FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, ABB, or Universal Robots * Familiarity with palletizing, case packing, pick\-and\-place, or conveyor systems * Experience in food, beverage, packaging, CPG, or other high\-speed manufacturing environments * Prior customer\-facing field experience * Spanish language proficiency **What we look for:** We're building this company from the ground up, and every person we hire has an outsized impact on our culture, performance, and trajectory. While each team member brings unique strengths and perspectives, we look for people who align with our Operating Principles and embody them in action. If this sounds like you, Formic may be the right place for you! * **Fearless Optimism:** You make bold bets and default optimistic. You believe in the mission, aren't paralyzed by risk, and fear inaction more than failure. You see ambiguity as opportunity and bring energy to building what doesn't yet exist. * **Create the Magic:** You absorb complexity so customers don't have to. Whether your customer is external or internal, you focus on delivering experiences that are clear, fast, value\-added, and outcome\-driven. You don't say "not my job." You make things work. * **Today, Not Tomorrow:** You have a bias to action. You close the loop. You take extreme ownership. jobs.title: AI Development Engineer
jobs.description: **Introduction** Welcome to Gallagher \- a global community of people who bring bold ideas, deep expertise, and a shared commitment to doing what’s right. We help clients navigate complexity with confidence by empowering businesses, communities, and individuals to thrive. At Gallagher, you’ll find more than a job; you’ll find a culture built on trust, driven by collaboration, and sustained by the belief that we’re better together. Whether you join us in a client\-facing role or as part of our brokerage division, our benefits and HR consulting division, or our corporate team, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, make an impact, and be part of something bigger. Experience a workplace where you’re encouraged to be yourself, supported to succeed, and inspired to keep learning. That’s what it means to live The Gallagher Way. **Overview** The Senior AI Engineering Developer owns the technical delivery of enterprise AI solutions at AJ Gallagher. Reporting to the Director of AI, you will lead the design, build, and deployment of production AI systems \- RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, and Copilot integrations \- on our Azure and .NET/Python stack. You will set engineering standards for a growing AI team, mentor developers, and partner directly with business units to turn ambiguous problems into shipped, governed, production\-grade AI products in a regulated insurance environment. **How you'll make an impact** * **Translate Business Problems into Technical Solutions:** Work side\-by\-side with business leaders and subject\-matter experts to unpack ambiguous, unstructured challenges and shape them into well\-scoped, buildable AI solutions with a clear delivery path. * **Own AI Solution Architecture:** Design and defend end\-to\-end architectures for GenAI and agentic systems on Microsoft Foundry \- spanning Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Foundry Tools, and Copilot Studio \- that meet enterprise security, scalability, and data\-residency requirements. * **Lead Hands\-On Delivery:** Write and review production code (C\#/.NET and Python) for RAG pipelines, AI agent orchestration, and API integrations; raise the technical bar across the team. * **Ship to Enterprise Surfaces:** Deliver AI capabilities into internal applications, Microsoft Teams, and M365 Copilot, integrating through Foundry agents, Service Bus, Azure Functions, and other cloud\-native services. * **Build Governance In:** Implement responsible\-AI controls \- Entra ID/RBAC, IaC Policy, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, audit logging \- aligned to Gallagher compliance expectations from day one, not as an afterthought. * **Drive Evaluation and Reliability:** Define measurable quality bars (groundedness, accuracy, latency, cost) and build the evaluation harnesses to enforce them before and after release. * **Communicate Up and Across:** Translate technical trade\-offs into clear recommendations for the Director of AI and business stakeholders; manage delivery risks and dependencies proactively. **About You** **Required** ============ * **Experience:** 7 or more years in software engineering, including experience in building LLM/GenAI systems in production and 2\+ years leading engineers or owning technical direction. * **Azure Depth:** Hands\-on production experience with Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, and Azure compute (Functions, Container Apps, or App Service). * **Languages:** Strong .NET/C\# plus working proficiency in Python; able to review and contribute in both. * **GenAI Engineering:** Proven delivery of RAG architectures, agent orchestration (Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, or LangChain), and prompt/evaluation pipelines. * **API and Integration Skills:** Designing secure REST APIs and event\-driven integrations (Azure API Management, Service Bus) within an enterprise identity model (Entra ID, RBAC). * **Delivery Discipline:** Agile experience with Azure DevOps (or equivalent) \- backlogs, CI/CD, automated testing, and release management. * **Leadership:** Track record of mentoring engineers, running design reviews, and owning technical decisions across multiple concurrent initiatives. **Preferred Differentiators** ============================= * **Regulated Industry Experience:** Prior AI/ML delivery in insurance, financial services, or healthcare, with familiarity with model risk management or responsible AI guidance. * **Familiarity with AI\-enabled and spec\-driven development:** Using AI\-assisted tooling and agent workflows across the SDLC to quickly deliver production\-grade systems. * **Experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code:** Building applications tightly aligned to Terraform\-deployed, optimized infrastructure. * **Evaluation and MLOps Maturity:** Built LLMOps tooling \- automated evals, red\-teaming, drift/cost monitoring \- at enterprise scale. * **Architecture Credentials:** Azure certifications (AZ\-305, AI\-103\) or equivalent demonstrated architecture ownership. **Professional Qualities** ========================== * **Bias for Shipped Outcomes:** Measures success by working software in users' hands, not demos or decks; cuts scope intelligently to ship. * **Calm Technical Authority:** Makes and defends decisions under ambiguity, and changes course quickly when evidence demands it. * **Force Multiplier:** Gets more from the team than from their own keyboard \- through mentoring, standards, and unblocking others. * **Governance as a Feature:** Treats compliance, security, and auditability as design inputs that build trust, not friction to route around. * **Clear Communicator:** Explains complex systems simply to executives and precisely to engineers; writes things down. * **Pragmatic Curiosity:** Tracks the fast\-moving AI landscape but adopts new tools only when they solve a real AJ Gallagher problem. **Compensation and benefits** At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.* Competitive compensation * Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well\-being * Career development opportunities and ongoing learning * A collaborative, people\-first culture with accessible leadership * The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact **At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace.** If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. jobs.title: Cost Engineer – Business Intelligence & Data Analytics
jobs.description: **Job Description** The Product Program Cost Optimization (PPCO) team at General Motors is seeking a highly motivated individual for the role of Cost Engineer – Data Analytics. This individual will be technically skilled in data analytics, data engineering, machine learning, and AI implementation, with the ability to lead initiatives that enable product and program level cost optimization through robust data engineering, exploratory data analysis (EDA), advanced predictive modeling, and rapid prototype application development. This role sits within the PPCO Systems and Data Analytics teams and focuses on building and maintaining the data and foundations for advanced analytics solutions and applied AI that power cost analytics initiatives across GM Finance. You will work with data from across the GM ecosystem, identifying interconnections between multiple enterprise applications from different functional areas (e.g., engineering, purchasing, finance, program management) and designing scalable data structures, pipelines, and intelligent models that turn disparate and unstructured data into trusted, analysis\-ready, and actionable assets. The ideal candidate combines strong data engineering fundamentals (ETL/ELT, database and table management, EDA) with hands\-on depth in machine learning and applied AI — including classical predictive modeling, modern ML techniques, and increasingly, generative AI / LLM\-based approaches — and can rapidly translate ideas into working prototype applications that stakeholders can interact with. You will use current data to understand behaviors and to predict product attributes such as manufacturing parameters, product cost, program development cost creep, and economic factors based on parameters and features extracted from existing data, and you will build quick, functional prototype tools that put these insights directly into the hands of business users. You will partner closely with Data Analysts, AI Analysts, IT, and cross\-functional business stakeholders to design and implement data architectures, curate high\-quality datasets, develop predictive models, and ship rapid prototype applications that deliver meaningful, actionable insights to improve vehicle profitability and program performance. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design and maintain data models and curated datasets (relational schemas, dimensional models, and feature characterizations) that support PPCO analytics and efficient downstream consumption for reporting in engineer derived features (characterizations, aggregations, encodings), and understand data distributions, identify anomalies, and uncover data quality risks and insight to address by the business team. * Develop, validate, and deploy machine learning models — spanning classical methods (regression, clustering, decision trees, random forests, gradient boosting, time\-series/panel models) and more advanced techniques (deep learning, NLP, embeddings, and generative AI/LLM\-based approaches where applicable) — to predict product attributes (geometries, cost, economic indicators) and surface insights from known input parameters and historical patterns. * Rapidly prototype and ship lightweight, functional applications (e.g., Python\-based web apps/APIs using frameworks such as Streamlit, underground/buried OSP fiber design and construction. * Demonstrated experience managing third\-party engineering firms or telecommunications contractors. * Strong understanding of fiber network architecture, permitting, utility infrastructure, construction methods, and design standards. * Experience reviewing detailed engineering drawings, construction prints, BOMs, and splice documentation. teams, market leadership, and executives. * Ability to travel throughout the assigned region as required. * Demonstrated ability to use AI\-assisted tools and technology to improve productivity, analysis, reporting, and operational efficiency. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience managing engineering for large\-scale FTTx/FTTH, middle\-mile, metro fiber, or broadband infrastructure deployments. * Experience with IQGeo or comparable GIS/network inventory platforms. * Familiarity with project\- and construction\-management platforms used to manage engineering through project closeout. * Experience managing engineering and permitting performance through measurable KPIs. * Familiarity with NESC requirements, utility joint\-use processes, pole attachment engineering, and underground utility coordination. * Professional Engineer (PE), PMP, RCDD, or related telecommunications/design credentials. **Key Competencies** **Fiber Engineering Expertise:** Applies deep knowledge of aerial and underground OSP design, fiber architecture, and construction practices to deliver constructible designs. **People Leadership:** Coaches and develops Fiber Engineers with clear ownership and accountability for deliverables. **Engineering Vendor Management:** Sets clear expectations for engineering firms and holds them accountable for quality, schedule, and cost. **Permitting jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer, Quantum Control, Quantum AI
jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 2 years of experience designing embedded software, firmware, or device drivers. * Experience developing kernel drivers for hardware devices (e.g., NICs, PCIe devices, or hardware accelerators). * Experience reading and interpreting hardware schematics, datasheets, and register maps. * Experience with C, Linux kernel internals (memory management, scheduling, interrupts, synchronization primitives), DMA engines, and cache coherency. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience with embedded real\-time CPUs, real\-time Linux patches (PREEMPT\_RT), or bare\-metal development. * Experience with PCIe device drivers, enumeration, and bus controllers. * Experience with Yocto or Buildroot for creating custom Linux distributions. * Experience with hardware description languages (Verilog or VHDL) and FPGA constraints. * Experience with userspace I/O frameworks (e.g., DPDK, SPDK, or VFIO) for high\-performance applications. * Experience writing Linux subsystem drivers (e.g., V4L2, ALSA, or IIO). **About the job** ----------------- As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will develop low\-level software for electronics that control and readout our future quantum computers. You will collaborate with electrical engineers and FPGA/ASIC designers to bring custom hardware to life, ensuring drivers exploit full performance capabilities for scaled quantum processors. In this role, you will develop firmware and drivers delivered with Quantum's control and readout electronics. You will contribute to hardware\-software co\-verification, collaborating with architects and digital designers to understand functional requirements, design verification plans, and drive their execution. Additionally, you will participate in system architecture discussions and contribute to software system requirements. Google Quantum AI is building quantum computing for otherwise unsolvable problems. The full potential of quantum computing will be unlocked with a large\-scale computer capable of complex, error\-corrected computations. Our roadmap is focused on advancing the capabilities of quantum computing and enabling meaningful applications. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $147000 \- $210000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Partner with the hardware team during pre\-silicon and post\-silicon phases to perform board bring\-up, verify register maps, and validate hardware behavior against specifications. * Integrate drivers into the broader software stack, including RTOS (if applicable), userspace libraries, and HALs. * Diagnose complex system\-level issues using JTAG, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and kernel debugging tools (ftrace, kgdb, crash). * Provide feedback to hardware designers on register interfaces and interrupt mechanisms to improve software programmability in future hardware revisions. Benefits for this role include: * Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance * Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match * Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6\.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment * Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance * Maternity Leave (Short\-Term Disability \+ Baby Bonding): 28\-30 weeks * Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks * Holidays: 13 paid days per year Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; Kirkland, WA, USA; San Jose, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience in software development. * 5 years of research experience in software engineering, formal methods, software verification, artificial intelligence, or machine learning research. * Experience in formal methods, software verification, or interactive theorem proving. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * PhD degree in formal methods, software verification, or interactive theorem proving, or equivalent practical research experience. * 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms. * 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction. * Experience prototyping and engineering to conduct experiments and translate research prototypes to production environments. * First\-author publications in conferences in software engineering (ICSE, FSE, ASE), programming languages (PLDI, POPL), or machine learning/NLP (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP). **About the job** ----------------- Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward. The Developer AI (DevAI) Research team within Developer Transformation explores the frontiers of AI\-assisted and AI\-initiated development within Google. We combine research expertise in software engineering, formal methods, and machine learning with practical engineering to carry ambitious research projects from idea to deployment. As part of DevAI Research’s verification engineering team, you will apply your knowledge of programming languages and logics, formal methods, static and dynamic analysis, and interactive theorem proving across Google’s codebase. We apply formal methods, software verification, and interactive theorem proving to discover bugs and ensure code correctness at Google scale. Our team builds and deploys AI\-assisted development tools. We are committed to advancing the field, actively publishing our production\-proven research in conferences like ICSE, FSE, and CHI. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $207000 \- $300000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Lead the development and application of formal methods and software verification techniques to provide strong assurances within the codebase. * Define a long\-term goal and roadmap for progress in AI\-assisted development. * Collaborate within the team and across the organization to support shared goals around AI\-enhanced development. * Publicize novel results and share findings with the broader research community. * Provide technical leadership on high\-impact projects. Manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager II, Machine Learning, Google Cloud
jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 2 years of experience in program management. * Experience driving Machine Learning programs and building applications. * Experience in systems engineering or software engineering management, shipping distributed systems or data platforms. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * 2 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects. * Experience driving complex system integrations and proven ability to manage multi\-quarter technical initiatives from concept to deployment across multiple highly matrixed engineering organizations. * Deep understanding of data center physical operations, supply chain logistics, capacity planning, or hardware systems. **About the job** ----------------- A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers. As a Technical Program Manager for Execution Signals and Foundations, you will help us build the next strategic chapter out our flagship product, helping it transition from a post\-execution, batch\-processed productivity tool into a real\-time, proactive execution oversight platform. You will be the bridge between physical operations, real\-time system telemetry, and high\-scale capacity planning. You will own the technical strategy to expand our coverage into complex new domains while ensuring our data pipelines feed cleanly into downstream forecasting, machine\-learning, and simulation models. This is a highly visible, strategic role requiring a rare combination of deep systems engineering thinking, product vision, and the ability to influence senior cross\-functional stakeholders without direct authority. Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $138000 \- $197000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Act as the primary technical program advocate across the broader organizations. Negotiate boundaries, secure technical dependencies, and build deep alignment with engineering partners. * Work with functional stakeholders to define, document and implement solutions based on data. * Work cross\-functionally with global geographically dispersed program managers, data engineers and data scientists to understand, implement and deploy actionable enterprise data management solutions. * Articulate and advocate a data\-centric culture that embraces process excellence and data\-driven decisions as a means to achieve business objectives. * Promote clarity and focus on delivering incremental value to the organization. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law.
