jobs.title: Intermediate Software Engineer
jobs.description: Welcome to Gordon Food Service! We are excited that you are thinking about opportunities with us, and we have an amazing story to share. See below for a quick glance of who we are and the impact you could have on the food service industry. There's a seat at our table for you... **Position Summary:** The **Intermediate Software Engineer** develops, creates, and modifies general computer applications software or specialized utility programs. You will analyze user needs, map complex enterprise integrations, and develop robust software solutions. You will design or customize software to optimize operational efficiency, directly supporting our high\-priority fleet, telematics, and delivery initiatives. As a member of our growing **GTS Transportation Systems** team, you will focus on our **Drivers / Delivery vertical** —our most critical, high\-impact demand area. In this role, you will help design and maintain clean architectural boundaries while elevating the technology GFS drivers use every single day. **What you will do:** * **Drive Strategic Integrations:** Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs and microservices to support critical driver\-facing commitments, including telematics platforms (Samsara), mobile navigation systems, and onboard device integrations (PFF). * **Responsible AI Acceleration:** Actively leverage approved AI\-enablement tools as a co\-pilot to design next\-generation features and automate testing. You must possess the strong software engineering fundamentals required to critically audit, debug, and fully own the code generated by these tools—never relying on AI as a black box. * **Deliver Stable \& Secure Solutions:** Ensure operational continuity, drive active defect resolution, and perform system testing in alignment with our **Fortify** program standards for stability and performance. * **Develop \& Implement:** Construct programs, scripts, and software components according to specification and established coding standards. * **Analyze \& Optimize:** Review and test software for accuracy and optimal implementation. Analyze current business systems, determine project scope, and provide precise task estimates. * **Test \& Validate:** Perform integrated testing of systems for accuracy, reliability, and optimal performance to validate completeness and quality. * **Maintain \& Troubleshoot:** Analyze and resolve program, script, or system failures. Perform ongoing software system maintenance, support, and requirement analysis. * **Collaborate Cross\-Functionally:** Assist in designing GUI and software components. Engage in formal code reviews, and help guide or review work for staff augmentation resources. * **Other duties** and responsibilities as assigned. **When you will work:** * Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm * **Hybrid schedule;** 4 days in office in Wyoming, MI or Atlanta, GA with 1 day remote * **Travel:** Minimal but highly valuable. We love to provide our engineers with opportunities to get out into the field, visit division sites, and experience GFS logistics operations firsthand **What you'll bring to the table:** * **Education:** Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field preferred. * **Experience:** Three to five years of previous software development and enterprise integration experience (or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience). * **Tech Stack Familiarity:** Proficient in one or more program languages, operating systems, and databases. Experience with RESTful APIs, microservices, and mobile delivery applications is highly preferred. * **Strong Code Ownership:** A commitment to deep technical understanding. While we encourage AI\-assisted development, you must be able to explain, support, and troubleshoot every line of code you deliver. * **Skills:** Good written and verbal communication skills, organizational capabilities, and strong problem\-solving skills. * **Work Style:** Proven ability to multi\-task, prioritize, work independently, and thrive within a fast\-paced, collaborative team environment. **BE PART OF AN AMAZING CULTURE WHERE WHAT MATTERS TO YOU, MATTERS TO US!** --------------------------------------------------------------------------- Gordon Food Service values our customers and understands that their success is largely dependent upon their workforce. To demonstrate our commitment to our partnership, we will require any candidate who works for a Gordon Food Service customer to provide a letter of support from their management if they are selected for the interview process. Equal Employment Opportunity is a matter of policy at Gordon Food Service, Inc. and we are committed to a work environment in which all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, status as a protected veteran, or status as a qualified individual with disability. If you require reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process due to a disability, please submit your request to talent@gfs.com and use the words “Accommodation Request” in your subject line. All Gordon Food Service locations are tobacco\-free. Gordon Food Service is a drug\-free workplace and conducts pre\-employment drug tests.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Grafana Infrastructure (Remote, USA)
jobs.description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40\+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X. We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open\-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation\-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career\-defining opportunity. *This is a remote position and we're considering candidates in the US or Canada (residents of Québec are not eligible for this position).* **The Opportunity** ------------------- ### **About our platform** Grafana Cloud moves millions of metrics, log lines, and traces per second from our customers' environments into a highly available, low\-latency stack that processes and stores this data, and serves it to dashboards and alerting tools. We aim to grow this to hundreds of millions per second, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and do it efficiently and securely. The Foundations department owns the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP): the Kubernetes clusters, cloud service provider resources (CSP), hardware, identity, delivery, and observability systems that Grafana Labs's application engineers use to build, deploy, and run their workloads. ### **About the Infrastructure group** We're hiring an engineering manager for the Foundations Infrastructure group, which owns the cloud infrastructure Grafana Cloud runs on. The group provisions and operates Kubernetes clusters and CSP resources across GCP, AWS, and Azure; enforces identity, access, and security controls across those environments; and runs the observability and cost\-visibility systems that keep the infrastructure measurable and accountable. You'll lead one of the squads of platform engineers that comprise the group. We're platform engineers, and our application teams are our users. Our job is to give them leverage: self\-service building blocks that take care of the hard parts of infrastructure, so they can focus on what they're building. We treat the platform as a product and value the experience of the people who use it. When a change is well communicated and understood, teams welcome it, and it lands as an improvement that makes the right way the easy way. You'll lead a squad that makes that happen. ### **How we work** Foundations is a global team that works asynchronously. The people who own a component or problem make the decisions about it, once stakeholders have had a chance to weigh in. Application teams build and run their own services; we give them a self\-service platform to do it on. Every engineer is on\-call for the components their squad provides. We plan on\-call, tactical work, and time off into every quarter, so roadmap work is roughly half of an engineer's time rather than all of it. **What You'll Be Doing** ------------------------ * Hire, manage, and develop a squad of platform engineers, with regular feedback and career conversations that support each person's growth. * Own your squad's roadmap and quarterly objectives: help decide what the squad works on, what it defers, and why, across a broad remit where demand always exceeds capacity. * Take platform changes from design to fleet\-wide adoption: staged rollouts, migration paths, and clear communication, so changes land well for the teams who depend on them. * Partner with the other Infrastructure squads on work that spans them, and with the teams across Foundations and the rest of Engineering whose work depends on yours. * Help shape how the group works as a whole, including planning, on\-call, and the ownership model between squads. * Own the squad's intake. Requests, reviews, and support from application teams arrive continuously; keep them triaged and visible so that planned work still moves. * Keep on\-call healthy: ensure a sustainable load and support incident response. * Work across team boundaries, contributing beyond your squad's scope where Foundations needs it. We invest heavil ias toward action and ownership, able to navigate ambiguity in a complex problem space. * Comfort with AI\-assisted tooling. We embrace AI and agentic development, so we expect you to be curious and comfortable using AI\-powered tools, and ideally to have practical experience folding them into a team's workflow. **Bonus Points For** -------------------- * Experience across more than one of the group's areas: cloud infrastructure, infrastructure security, and observability * Hands\-on depth in cloud infrastructure security: cloud IAM, Kubernetes security, secrets, and workload identity on at least one major cloud provider. You can challenge a threat model or an access design on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to. * Building self\-service infrastructure for application teams * Running observability for a production platform at scale * Operating across more than one of GCP, AWS, and Azure * You've worked in or on open source, or other community\-based projects. At Grafana Labs, "OSS is in our DNA" In the USA, the base compensation range for this role is $189,374 \- $227,249\. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. \#LI\-Remote * *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range \& benefits at the beginning of the process.* **Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:** * **100% Remote, Global Culture \-** As a remote\-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. * **Scaling Organization** – Tackle meaningful work in a high\-growth, ever\-evolving environment. * **Transparent Communication** – Expect open decision\-making and regular company\-wide updates. * **Innovation\-Driven** – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. * **Open Source Roots** – Built on community\-driven values that shape how we work. * **Empowered Teams** – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. * **Career Growth Pathways** – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. * **Approachable Leadership** – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. * **Passionate People** – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. * **In\-Person onboarding** \- We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. * **Balance is Key** \- We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *\*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.* **Equal Opportunity Employer:** *Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.* *Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.* \#LI\-Remote *For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our* *privacy policy**.*

jobs.title: Founding Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **About Gravity** ----------------- Gravity is the ad network for AI. We place relevant, sponsored suggestions inside AI platforms, right when someone is deciding what to do or buy. Everyone at Gravity believes three things: * AI should be free for everyone. * Most people will never pay for an AI subscription. * Someone has to pay for the compute, and advertising is the answer. If you believe these too, you'll probably fit right in. We built our ad engine from the ground up for AI interactions. Any AI platform can plug in with one integration, and we're already live on 50\+ of them, reaching millions of conversations every day. You can read more about us at trygravity.com. We've raised $38\.5M from investors like Lightspeed, Committed Capital, Basis Set and Caffeinated Capital. We work in person in San Francisco, 6 days a week. **About the Role** ------------------ We're hiring a founding **Solutions Engineer** to make sure every advertiser and publisher actually works on Gravity. You'll work with our engineering team and our CEO, Zach. * **Tracking.** Get every advertiser to its first tracked conversion fast. * **Integrations.** Support publisher SDK and API integrations with the engineering team. * **Broken accounts.** Fix what breaks, then build the tools that keep it from breaking again. * **Product feedback.** Turn what customers ask for into a ranked list for product, then build what's on it. You'll talk to customers in the morning and ship the fix by the afternoon. **Job Requirements** -------------------- * **Experience.** 3\+ years in a technical, customer\-facing role: solutions, forward\-deployed or support engineering. * **Tracking depth.** You've owned pixel, server\-side or MMP tracking end to end. * **Builder.** You fix things yourself instead of filing tickets. * **AI\-native.** You're ahead of the curve on AI. You build your own workflows and systems with it, and most of your routine work already runs without you. * **Ownership.** You don't need to be told what to do. You take responsibility, you follow through, and you don't drop the ball. * **No bullshit.** You say what you think and you do what you said. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Ad tech or martech experience, or mobile app\-install tracking (iOS, SKAN, MMPs). **Compensation** ---------------- * $160K – $190K base * $62\.5K – $187\.5K equity * Health benefits * Unlimited PTO Compensation Range: $160K \- $190K

jobs.description: Overview: **THE ROLE** At Great Dane, we rely on makers and we’re calling on them to join our expanding team, the time has never been better to Embrace Your Great and work in an environment with the highest safety standards in the industry. The Position: The Principal Software Engineer is responsible for the development automation pipeline of all enterprise Java projects. They understand modern application development methodologies, tools, infrastructures, and work cultures. The Principal Software Engineer provides technical guidance to development teams and oversee the technical aspects of all Java projects. They promote industry standards and best practices which integrate Security and DevOps disciplines to accelerate delivery of secure, elastic and resilient application solutions. Responsibilities: **WHAT YOU’LL DO*** Application and infrastructure design from concept through development and implementation while ensuring scalability, performance and maintainability * Provides training, guidance, mentoring and leadership * Leads daily standup meetings, hold regular training or refresher workshops * Supervising and overseeing all technical aspects of all projects * Provides maintenance support and assist with updates to existing applications * Implements the application deployment strategy, including automation and CI/CD strategies * Oversee, design, and ensure appropriate source code management policies and practices are implemented and maintained. * Provides guidance of DevOps and hosting server infrastructure. * Interfaces with external vendor to coordinate integration of technologies * Take part in continuous training in company policies/procedures and industry regulations. * Bring a passion to stay on top of tech trends, encourage innovation and a culture of collaboration by experimenting with and learning new technologies. * Responsible for recruiting, hiring, performance reviews and career advancement of subordinate developer positions * Other duties as assigned. Qualifications: **YOUR SKILLS AND ABILITIES (REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS)** * *Education:* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field required; Master’s Degree can supplement experience in specific cases and is a plus. * *Experience:* 8\+ years of full stack development experience designing, building, and operating scalable, highly available, mission\-critical systems. + Extensive experience developing and consuming RESTful APIs and designing integration patterns across enterprise platforms. + Hands\-on experience designing and building applications in AWS cloud environments (including compute, networking, storage, and managed database services). + Experience building and supporting event streaming and asynchronous architectures using Apache Kafka. + Experience with cloud\-native relational databases including Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. + Extensive experience and deep technical understanding of the following: - Programming languages: Java, SQL - Front\-end architecture components: JavaScript, JSON, ReactJs, MaterialUI - Event Streaming \& Messaging: Apache Kafka - Cloud Platforms \& Infrastructure: AWS - RDMS: Oracle, MySQL, MariaDB, Aurora PostgreSQL - Enterprise solution applications: ERP, CMS, CRM Server Architectures: Docker, Kubernetes, SpringBoot, Weblogic, Tomcat - * *Skills:* Strong working knowledge of modern web development, distributed systems, event\-driven architectures, cloud\-native application development, and relational databases + Comprehensive knowledge of software, application, systems, and network engineering principles + Ability to serve in an architectural role, designing scalable, resilient solutions for complex business and integration challenges + Ability to apply analytical and problem\-solving skills to resolve complex design, performance, and distributed system challenges + Ability to lead teams through ambiguity while managing multiple concurrent initiatives with varying timelines + Ability to facilitate healthy technical debate and help team members resolve conflict constructively * *Travel*: Up to 10% **PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS:*** Office and plant environment. * Keyboarding, lifting, standing, bending, walking. * Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **ABOUT GREAT DANE** With a history dating back to 1900, Great Dane has established itself as a transportation solutions leader of today – delivering innovative products and exceptional services that help our customers and employees succeed. jobs.title: Systems Administrator
jobs.description: ### **Description** HC Brands specializes in customizing and selling thousands of products that help our customers make connections. We are a fast, profitable, growing ecommerce company that markets ourselves through a wide range of ecommerce channels and marketplaces. We take pride in offering products that are unique and that help each of our customers develop meaningful connections in their personal and professional lives. Our Systems Administrator at HC Brands is responsible for planning, configuring, testing, deploying, securing, troubleshooting, and managing our enterprise servers and applications in our data centers including e\-commerce websites.### **What you'll do:** * Support and troubleshooting of enterprise technologies in a redundant environment. * Utilize experience with assigned systems administration and troubleshooting, automatic scheduling, monitoring, system configuration, tuning \& optimization, performance analysis, backups, and recovery. * Operational focus on data center issues and emergencies. * Implement and maintain assigned monitoring responsibilities for infrastructure to provide relevant statistics to management on performance/utilization of production environment. * Ensure production 24/7/365 availability (with planned maintenance). * Provide technical recommendations for infrastructure. * Assist in the administration of desktop PCs/peripherals when needed. * Assist in the administration of Office365 * Participate and manage to expectations for disaster recovery planning, including failover systems, backup and recovery procedures, and high\-availability configurations. * Review applications, servers, and network configurations and recommend refinements, improvements, and enhancements to ensure that most efficient and widely accepted methods are employed. * Understand how to keep our environments secure. Use log management tools to retain and monitor logs. (SIEM) * Design, implementation, and/or administration of: + Linux and Windows Servers in both Local and multiple Hosted Environments including AWS + LAMP Stack (and similar) Administration + VMWare vSphere/vCenter/ESX clusters + Proxmox + Storage Area Networks (SAN) + Microsoft Active Directory and related Azure tools + Load Balancers \& Firewalls/WAF + Additional hardware and software as assigned ### **To do well in this role you’ll need to have:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or other related field or equivalent work experience preferred. * 3\+ years of experience as an administrator/engineer in the IT field. * Certifications or equivalent proven knowledge for assigned roles. * E\-Commerce experience preferred. * Strong scripting knowledge in scripting languages for developing scripts to automate IT processes and procedures. * Experience with web hosting technologies and troubleshooting such as understanding of DNS, SSL, HTTP, HTML Windows and Linux. * Experienced with automation, deployment, and configuration management. * Familiarity with email authentication protocols (such as SPF, DKIM, and DMARC) and email setup/configuration. * Basic working knowledge of VoIP systems and configuration. * Must be detail oriented and able to multi\-task. * Strong organizational and analytical skills. * Ability to communicate effectively, verbal and written. Above all else though, my advice for anyone looking to work at HC Brands is very simple; you have to *want* to be here. It won't be enough to show up to the interview and be capable. We are a small company with extremely talented people who creatively solve unique problems as they arise. There will be times when we all just have to take a deep breath and dig deep to get the job done. We're looking for talented people with the appetite for that challenge. **Do your homework. Look at our website, our blogs, and our products. Get to understand what we're about, and come to the interview with that insight ready to tell us how you could play a part in that success.** ### **Benefits:** We care deeply about making HC Brands an amazing place to work, and invest a significant amount of time and energy into creating and maintaining a company culture that provides our team with a level of support while inspiring them to do their best work. The specific benefits we offer include:* Health, dental, vision, and life insurance * 8 paid holidays * Paid time off (PTO) * 401(k) plan with a company match on the first 5% contribution * 8 paid hours of community service time off * 50% employee discount on our products Beyond the tangible benefits though:* You will be part of a growing team whose purpose is to create a culture that underscores connections with employees, customers, businesses, and each other. While we’re in the business of personalization, we also exist in a society where individual interactions are harder and harder to come by. In response to this challenge, we’ve made it our mission at HC Brands to prioritize people and relationships—one custom order at a time. It’s not just a clever blurb on our website or a catchy acronym we pass around the office. It’s what we do, and more importantly, it’s who we are. **Equal Employment Opportunity** Equal Employment Opportunity has been, and will continue to be, a fundamental principle at HC Brands. HC Brands provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. HC Brands is committed to creating and maintaining a workplace in which all employees have an opportunity to participate and contribute to the success of the business and are valued for their skills, experience, and unique perspectives. This commitment is embodied in the company policy and the way we do business at HC Brands and is an important principle of sound business management.### **About HC Brands** At HC Brands, our mission is to design and manufacture the highest quality and most innovative personalized products for both home, professional and business use. With our cutting edge web technology, we aim to provide an easy user experience to fully customize any product we offer. We are committed to the customer's total satisfaction and providing exceptional customer service, just like we’ve been doing since 1954\. We also aim to have the fastest turnaround time on personalized products with most shipping the next business day.

jobs.title: AI Engineer Team/Project Lead
jobs.description: We are looking for the right people\- people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry. **The role:** As an AI Engineering Team/Project Lead on our Data \& AI team, you will work on a project team with two other engineers, leading the work of turning real engineering and operations workflows into agents that people across Halliburton rely on every day. You will build on our established agent platform, which spans Databricks and Azure, and extend it as you go. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role with no direct reports. You will write code every day, set the technical direction for your team, and put working agents in people's hands. You lead by building, not by managing tickets or running status meetings. Success is measured by what is live and in use, not by plans and presentations. **What you'll do:** * Lead from the keyboard\- Work on a project team with two other engineers, write production code every day, and take on the hardest technical problems yourself. * Ship workflows that get used\- Lead your team in turning real engineering and operations workflows into production agents on our platform, from first conversation to daily use. * Own requirements and roadmap\- Work with business stakeholders and the people who do the work to define requirements, cut scope and keep a roadmap focused on what delivers the most value. * Set and review architecture\- Define the architecture for your team's agents, review designs and code, and hold a high bar for reliability, security and maintainability. * Connect agents to the business\- Use secure tool and data connectors (including MCP servers) to give agents governed access to Halliburton data and engineering applications. * Prove it works\- Use the platform's evaluation and tracing to show each agent is reliable, then track adoption and time saved in production. * Keep agents on track\- Build optimization routines and monitoring that catch drift, regressions and failures early, so agents keep operating as designed long after launch. * Raise the team's speed\- Make AI\-first development the norm on your team, using coding agents, shared templates and code reviews to help every engineer ship faster. * Own what you ship\- Fix what breaks and keep improving your team's agents based on real use. * Add to the platform\- When you hit a gap, contribute the template, connector or evaluation that closes it, so the next workflow ships faster. **Who you are:** * AI\-first by default\- You reach for an agent before you open a ticket. Your own workflow is already heavily automated, and you can show us how. * A builder with high agency\- You don't wait for a perfect spec. You get the smallest useful version live fast, then harden and expand it. * A leader who builds\- You earn trust through your code and decisions, not status meetings. * Allergic to repeated work\- When you see the same task done twice, you build a tool so nobody has to do it a third time. * Comfortable in the mess\- Legacy systems, messy data and shifting requirements don't slow you down. * Results over demos\- A demo is not the finish line. You measure success by evaluation results, adoption and demonstrated time savings for the business. * Fluent in business and code\- You turn business needs into a roadmap, then build it with your team. **What you'll need:** * Must have 6\+ years building and shipping production software, or equivalent demonstrated work. * Degree in Computer Science, Data Science or a related technical field, or equivalent experience. * Experience leading the technical work of a small engineering team (setting architecture, reviewing code and mentoring) while remaining a hands\-on contributor. * Track record of working directly with business stakeholders to turn ambiguous needs into clear requirements and a delivery roadmap. * Strong Python, and comfort working across the stack (APIs, services, simple internal user interfaces). * Shipped LLM\-powered agents to real users, ideally multi\-agent systems rather than single prompt chains: tool calling, RAG, structured outputs, and prompt and context engineering. * Hands\-on experience with agent frameworks and protocols (for example LangGraph, Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel, OpenAI Agents SDK, Model Context Protocol) — and the judgment to know when not to use one. * Experience testing non\-deterministic systems: building eval sets, automated scoring and regression checks. * Solid engineering fundamentals: Git, automated testing, CI/CD, containers and cloud deployment. * Hands\-on Azure experience, such as Microsoft Foundry (Azure AI Foundry) Agent Service, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure Kubernetes Service or Container Apps, and Entra ID. **Nice to have:** * Databricks\- Mosaic AI Agent Framework / Agent Bricks, MLflow tracing and evaluation, Unity Catalog, Model Serving, Vector Search. * Developer tooling\- You have contributed to SDKs, internal platforms or shared libraries that other engineers use. * Total ownership\- You treat what you build as your own. You take it from idea to production and stay accountable for the outcome, not just your piece of it. * Open source\- Contributions to AI or developer tooling projects. * Energy or industrial exposure\- Helpful, not required. We will teach you the domain; we can't teach you to build. **What success looks like:** * First 30 days\- You know the platform and your team, and have agreed on the team's first workflow, its success measure and an initial roadmap with business stakeholders. * First 90 days\- Your team's first workflow is shipped and in regular use by the people it was built for, with a measured result such as hours saved. You wrote a meaningful share of the code. * First 6 months\- Your team has several workflows live and in daily use, stakeholders trust the roadmap, and the architecture and review standards you set help the team ship faster. **World Class Benefits:** At Halliburton, we're committed to providing you and your family with a comprehensive and affordable benefits package \- which means we offer support for your physical, emotional, financial and parental needs, both now and in the future. When you join our team, you'll have access to a wide range of resources designed to help you thrive at work and at home. By clicking here, you can review a summary of the benefits available once you join. **Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.** **Location** Houston, Onsite **Job Details** **Requisition Number:** 213139 **Experience Level:** **Job Family:** Engineering/Science/Technology **Product Service Line:** Global R\&D **Full Time / Part Time:** Full\-time **Compensation Information** Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience. *Please Note: This posting is intended to collect candidate information for Halliburton’s talent pool, and is not considered an application. By completing the candidate profile, recruiters will have visibility to your information in order to contact you for a future related job opportunity. In addition to providing your information on this posting, we encourage you to create a Job Alert within our career site. The Job Alert allows you to select search criteria for positions that match your interest(s). Once positions are posted that match your search criteria, you will receive an email notification.*

jobs.description: Senior AI Software Engineer About Us Health Data Analytics Institute (HDAI) is a commercial\-stage HealthTech company. HDAI is located in Dedham, MA near the Dedham Corporate Center Commuter Rail station on the Franklin/Foxboro line (25 minutes from Back Bay and South Station, Boston) and I\-95/128\. In this role, you will bridge the gap between Data Science and production software by owning our full AI/ML backend. This includes a high\-throughput predictive inference engine (scoring 580\+ patient risk models in real time) and generative LLM pipelines on Amazon Bedrock (powering clinical summaries and diagnostic discovery). You will work across the entire backend stack as priorities shift, developing deep domain expertise while ensuring complete system coverage. We expect you to use AI tools daily to multiply your output. Responsibilities * **Inference engine.** Own the system that scores patients against hundreds of predictive models in production. Understand the scaling concerns (580\+ models, memory pressure, compute efficiency) and drive architectural improvements. * **ML productization.** Work with Data Science to take model artifacts (coefficient files, scoring logic built in R) and ensure they run correctly in the production Python inference pipeline. Build tooling that automates validation and reduces the manual reimplementation cycle. * **LLM applications.** Build and maintain production LLM integrations on Amazon Bedrock (Claude) for AI summaries, PDD, and conversational interfaces. Manage prompt lifecycle: design, versioning, testing, and evaluation. Handle the specific challenges of LLM applications in production: token management, output validation, evidence citation, structured output parsing, and graceful degradation. * **Production AI engineering.** Build and maintain production Python services on AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, S3\). Work across the existing stack including FastAPI and legacy services during migration to serverless. * **Evaluation and quality.** Build testing and evaluation frameworks for both model inference and LLM outputs. Define what “correct” means for AI\-generated clinical content in collaboration with Clinical and Data Science teams. Write tests for critical paths. Monitor production output quality and catch regressions. * **Cross\-functional collaboration.** Partner with Data Science on model release planning, validation, and new prompt development. Work with Platform Engineering on deployment infrastructure. Collaborate across the full Product Engineering team on features that span frontend and backend. Qualifications **Required:** * 7\+ years of experience as a software engineer, ML engineer, or AI engineer building production systems. * Strong Python proficiency for production service development. * Experience building and operating services on AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, SQS, S3\) or equivalent cloud platforms. * Experience in at least one of these areas, with willingness to grow into the other: ***ML engineering:*** taking model artifacts from data science and deploying them to production. You understand model scoring, feature engineering, and what it takes to validate that a production implementation matches the original model. ***LLM engineering:*** building production LLM applications (not just prototypes). You have worked with model APIs (Bedrock, OpenAI, or similar), designed prompt architectures, and handled the failure modes of generative AI in production. * AI\-native engineering practice. You use AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as a core part of your daily workflow. * Comfort with ambiguity. Requirements evolve as we scale to new health system partners; you make sound decisions with incomplete information. * Clear written and verbal communication. **Preferred:** * Experience across both ML engineering and LLM engineering (see above). * Experience with Amazon Bedrock or similar managed LLM services. * Experience with R or familiarity reading R code (our data science team works in R). * Experience with model serving at scale (hundreds of models, multi\-tenant environments). * Healthcare or regulated industry experience. * Experience building evaluation/testing frameworks for AI system outputs. * Experience with FastAPI, event\-driven architectures (SQS, SNS), or serverless patterns. * Familiarity with Terraform and infrastructure\-as\-code. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. jobs.title: Engineering Cooperative Test Technician
jobs.description: The Nevada Automotive Test Center (NATC) is currently seeking talented candidates for a part\-time on\-call Engineering Cooperative Test Technician (Co\-Op) role at our Silver Springs, NV location. At NATC, our Co\-Ops work directly with a team of engineers and other matrixed personnel dedicated to designing, fabricating, and testing innovative automotive platforms. This role provides irreplaceable hands\-on technical experience allowing students to apply classroom lessons to real world problems to form viable solutions. NATC Co\-Ops have gone on to work with the leading edge of technology for submarines, racecars, and military/commercial vehicles around the word, including staying on as full\-time engineers at NATC after graduating. **NATC OVERVIEW:** Founded in 1957, the Nevada Automotive Test Center (NATC) is a privately owned, independent test, evaluation, design and engineering facility offering development and testing to customers worldwide. We have substantial international experience, which allows us to evaluate products intended for global markets knowledgeably and objectively. NATC has compiled an extensive database of worldwide operational and infrastructure conditions allowing accurate definition of user duty cycles and creation of test programs that are representative of service environments around the world. NATC is a leading innovator in translating real\-world conditions into validated virtual proving ground simulation and virtual prototyping. NATC’s location in the great basin of Nevada allows our team to access terrain that can represent 85% of the world within a 150 mile radius, providing an excellent test bed for off\-road mobility. NATC’s operational area includes 1200 sq. miles of natural terrain, that when coupled with 6,200 acres of privately owned test courses, create an unparalleled testing area available to our engineers to innovate and solve our customer’s problems. **Position Summary****:** Our Engineering Cooperative Test Technicians are specifically tasked with assisting a wide variety of test events including performance and durability testing of ultra\-light up to heavy vehicle platforms., On occasion Co\-Ops may also be given the opportunity to support vehicle development projects requiring the design and build of technology demonstrators aimed at meeting customer provided requirements. The Engineering Cooperative Test Technician is reports directly to the Engineer Resource Manager (ERM), who then sources them out to various program managers (PM) and project supervisors (PS) for direct support tasking. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:** * Assists in the preparation of test plan development, execution, and associated documentation. * Assists engineering and technician personnel in preparing test vehicles, instrumentation, and equipment for test conduct. * Supports in\-field vehicle tests by photographing, filming, or driving support vehicles as needed. * Works with mechanics, technicians, equipment operators and other personnel to support task completion. * Within capability, analyzes technical data and clearly communicates results to supported permanent personnel technical reports, briefings, or other medium. * Conducts research, as directed, in support of project tasking. * Conducts themselves in a professional and personable manner. * Assists in drafting of final reports. * Conducts research related to technical standards, test specifications, automotive suppliers, component sources, etc. * Assists with hardware design, fabrication, and installation on vehicles. This may include CAD drawing preparation, light machine work, and/or mechanical work. * Maintains focus of effort and a positive attitude, despite austere and sometimes challenging conditions. * Other duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Senior / Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us:** Homebound is on a mission to make it possible for anyone, anywhere, to build a home using technology. Created by an experienced team of construction, real estate, design, and technology experts, Homebound is transforming the residential construction industry by improving the costly and inefficient process of building a home. We’ve created an entirely new way to build homes with technology powering every stage from start to finish to provide a seamless experience for our customers. Homeowners across the country can choose where they want to live, select a home plan that’s perfect for them, then personalize and buy it, all online. Homebound has raised $150M in capital from leading venture capitalists like Google, Khosla, Thrive Ventures, and we’re scaling quickly in places like Texas, Colorado and Florida. Come build your future with us. **About The Role:** Homebound is seeking an exceptional Senior/Staff AI Engineer to accelerate our mission of building the leading vertical AI stack for residential construction. Our proprietary platform captures granular data at every stage of the homebuilding process, enabling us to develop novel LLM\-powered applications that improve efficiency and quality across the board. We are a small, fast\-moving team with multiple AI products already in production and a rapidly growing AI platform. In this role, you will lead the research and implementation of cutting\-edge advancements in AI, design and deploy impactful features, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to shape the future of homebuilding. **What You'll Do:** * Shape the vision for how AI, particularly LLMs, integrate into Homebound’s products and operations. Define technical standards for experimentation, deployment, and evaluation. * Design and build scalable AI systems that can handle real\-world production workloads and evolve with the business. * Deliver high\-quality, production\-grade code daily while ensuring observability, maintainability, and reliability. * Raise the bar across engineering by teaching AI best practices, reviewing designs, and guiding engineers through complex technical challenges. * Stay abreast of the rapidly evolving AI landscape, bringing forward cutting\-edge ideas while focusing investment where it creates clear business impact. **What You Have Done In Your Career:** * 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on AI systems. * Shipped LLM\-powered features into production, including hands\-on experience with some or all of the following: + RAG + eval frameworks + agentic loops. + sandboxes for agents + systems to edit memory + managing subagents + Pydantic AI + agent observability * Fluency in Python. Proven ability to design systems that balance rapid experimentation with long\-term reliability and maintainability. * A strong understanding of metrics and data science logic **Who You Are:** * You take ownership and seek autonomy over your work and outcomes. * You’re excited to learn and grow as part of a small, nimble, high\-impact team. * You communicate clearly and proactively \- especially in writing without AI assistance. * You’re humble, good\-natured, and bring a positive energy to your team. **Our Commitment**: We are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. To apply, please submit an application with your resume on the Career’s page. Homebound is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, state, or local law. Homebound considers all qualified applicants in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. **Our Compensation Philosophy**: Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Please note that the salary range displayed on each job posting may vary by state. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter will share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that each job posting includes a general description of any other compensation offered for the position in addition to the salary range displayed on the job posting. You can find information about our benefits here. Compensation Range: $160K \- $220K

jobs.description: The successful candidate will combine engineering expertise with experience deploying advanced digital technologies to accelerate product development, improve engineering productivity, and enhance product performance. The candidate will report to the Sr Director of Engineering for Component Design \& Analysis at the Phoenix, AZ location.

jobs.title: Principal Quality Engineer
jobs.description: **Become a part of our caring community** ========================================= The Principal Quality Engineer carries out procedures to ensure that all information systems products and services meet organization standards and end\-user requirements. The Principal Quality Engineer provides strategic advice and guidance to functional team(s). Highly skilled with broad, advanced technical experience. Humana is committed to helping people achieve their best health by delivering innovative technology solutions that power exceptional member, provider, and associate experiences. The **Principal, Quality Engineering** is a senior individual contributor and hands\-on technical leader responsible for advancing modern, AI\-focused quality engineering practices across Humana’s software delivery ecosystem. This role defines, demonstrates, and scales **what good looks** like for enterprise quality engineering across the SDLC through technical expertise, reference patterns, automation frameworks, quality intelligence, and practical implementation guidance. This role serves as a **deeply technical expert in AI\-enabled quality engineering**, test automation, quality architecture, engineering excellence, and continuous quality practices. The Principal partners closely with the core EQE Platform team, Quality Engineering Segements, Product, Engineering, Architecture, Enterprise Engineering Enablement, Agile teams, DevOps, Cybersecurity, Risk, Compliance, Audit, and Data/AI teams to embed scalable, secure, measurable quality practices into delivery workflows, release processes, engineering platforms, and operational support models. This is a **hands\-on principal role**, not a people management role. The Principal will accelerate Humana’s enterprise quality engineering transformation by building reusable solutions, creating technical standards and exemplars, coaching teams directly, and ensuring responsible use of AI across quality engineering processes. This role is also responsible for defining and operationalizing **what good looks like for EQE** across the SDLC, including test strategies and approaches, release management, incident tracking, production validation, and continuous improvement. **Key Responsibilities** **Enterprise Quality Engineering Strategy, Standards, and Technical Leadership** * Define, refine, and operationalize enterprise quality engineering standards, patterns, reference architectures, and technical guidance across software delivery teams. * Define and continuously evolve **what good looks like** for Enterprise Quality Engineering across the full SDLC, including planning, development, testing, release, deployment, production validation, support, and continuous improvement. * Establish practical, reusable best practices for embedding quality engineering into each SDLC phase, including requirements quality, test planning, test design, automation strategy, validation, release readiness, production verification, and supportability. * Create and maintain reusable frameworks, starter kits, accelerators, example implementations, and practical guidance for quality planning, test automation, regression strategy, API and UI testing, service virtualization, code quality, deployment validation, performance and resilience testing, release readiness, observability\-driven quality, production validation, and AI\-assisted quality engineering. * Define enterprise quality expectations, guardrails, and example patterns that help teams consistently apply EQE best practices within Agile, DevOps, and platform\-based delivery models. * Create technical guidance for quality\-related **Definition of Done** expectations and quality checkpoints across delivery workflows to improve consistency, traceability, and readiness. * Provide deep technical consultation to engineering teams on implementing modern quality engineering practices aligned with enterprise delivery models, DevOps controls, and platform standards. * Partner with engineering enablement and platform teams to ensure quality practices are reflected in enterprise tooling, templates, reusable workflows, and CI/CD pipeline patterns. **Hands\-On AI\-Focused Quality Engineering** * Lead the practical application of **AI\-enabled quality engineering** capabilities across the SDLC through hands\-on experimentation, prototyping, implementation, and refinement. * Design and implement patterns for responsible use of AI in quality engineering, including test case generation, test data analysis, requirements analysis, defect clustering and triage, risk\-based testing, code review support, automation acceleration, quality intelligence, and production issue analysis. * Evaluate and pilot generative AI, machine learning, intelligent automation, and analytics solutions that improve test effectiveness, speed, coverage, defect prevention, and engineering productivity. * Develop guardrails, technical recommendations, and implementation patterns for safe and responsible use of AI\ incident patterns, test reliability, and AI productivity indicators. * Experience implementing or advising on SDLC governance, evidence collection, audit support, control mapping, and responsible AI considerations. * Experience creating reference architectures, proof of concepts, technical playbooks, Communities of Practice content, or engineering enablement materials. * Experience using platform and workflow standards to reduce developer overhead and improve delivery consistency at enterprise scale. **Use your skills to make an impact** ===================================== Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self\-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.**Description of Benefits** Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole\-person well\-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short\-term and long\-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.**About Us** ============ About Humana: Humana Inc. jobs.title: Principal Firmware Engineer - AI System/OpenBMC
jobs.description: **Hyve Company Overview** ------------------------- Hyve Solutions transforms complex engineering challenges into production reality for technology innovators building AI, cloud, and connected infrastructure. As a US\-based manufacturing partner, the company rapidly delivers fast, agile execution through dep technical partnerships and co\-innovation, and supply chain clarity. Hyve’s integrated ODM, CM, and SI capabilities eliminate vendor complexity while accelerating time\-to\-market with single\-partner accountability from design through scale. The company co\-innovates with deep engineering expertise, treating customer success as its own while building tomorrow's digital infrastructure. Platform management firmware is essential to the reliability, serviceability, and manageability of hyperscale AI servers. This Principal\-level role owns BMC firmware architecture and development—built on OpenBMC—for Hyve's next\-generation AI and compute server platforms, spanning manageability, telemetry, power/thermal control, security, and manufacturing enablement in close partnership with hardware and Hyperscaler customers. **Core Responsibilities** ------------------------- * **BMC firmware architecture.** Define and own the OpenBMC\-based firmware architecture for AI/GPU server platforms, including manageability stack, Redfish interfaces, IPMI, and platform telemetry. * **Platform control and monitoring.** Develop and integrate power, thermal, fan\-control, and sensor monitoring firmware in close collaboration with power delivery and thermal teams. * **Security and reliability.** Implement secure boot, firmware update/recovery, RoT integration, and robust error handling to meet hyperscaler security and reliability requirements. * **Bring\-up and debug.** Lead firmware bring\-up across EVT/DVT/PVT, debug at board and system level, and drive root\-cause analysis and permanent fixes across firmware, hardware, and system\-integration domains. * **Manufacturing and deployment enablement.** Deliver firmware tooling and features for factory provisioning, diagnostics, and fleet deployment, and support field issue resolution at scale. * **Technical leadership.** Set firmware development methodology, review code, and mentor engineers; represent firmware architecture to customers and internal executives. **Required Qualifications \& Skills** ------------------------------------- * **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. * **Experience:** 10\+ years of embedded/firmware development experience, including significant BMC/platform management firmware work and hands\-on OpenBMC development. Proven delivery of server\-class firmware into production; hyperscale experience preferred. * **Technical expertise:** Strong C/C\+\+ and embedded Linux skills; deep knowledge of OpenBMC, Redfish, IPMI, I2C/I3C, PMBus, SPI, and platform management interfaces; experience with secure boot, firmware update, and RoT. * **Systems knowledge:** Solid understanding of server hardware, power/thermal control loops, and the interaction of firmware with BIOS, hardware, and manufacturing flows. * **Communication:** Able to lead cross\-functional debug, drive architecture decisions, and communicate effectively with hardware teams, customers, and executives. Compensation: $214,000 to $290,000 **What’s in it for you** ------------------------ Benefit Insurance * Flexible Spending Account (FSA) * Health Savings Account (HSA) * Mental Health Care * 401K with match * Paid Holidays, Vacation \& Sick Days * Tuition Reimbursement * Perks at Work * LEAP Program * MyFlexPay ***We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*** --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This Principal\-level role owns BMC firmware architecture and development—built on OpenBMC—for Hyve's next\-generation AI and compute server platforms, spanning manageability, telemetry, power/thermal control, security, and manufacturing enablement in close partnership with hardware and Hyperscaler customers. **Core Responsibilities** ------------------------- * **BMC firmware architecture.** Define and own the OpenBMC\-based firmware architecture for AI/GPU server platforms, including manageability stack, Redfish interfaces, IPMI, and platform telemetry. * **Platform control and monitoring.** Develop and integrate power, thermal, fan\-control, and sensor monitoring firmware in close collaboration with power delivery and thermal teams. * **Security and reliability.** Implement secure boot, firmware update/recovery, RoT integration, and robust error handling to meet hyperscaler security and reliability requirements. * **Bring\-up and debug.** Lead firmware bring\-up across EVT/DVT/PVT, debug at board and system level, and drive root\-cause analysis and permanent fixes across firmware, hardware, and system\-integration domains. * **Manufacturing and deployment enablement.** Deliver firmware tooling and features for factory provisioning, diagnostics, and fleet deployment, and support field issue resolution at scale. * **Technical leadership.** Set firmware development methodology, review code, and mentor engineers; represent firmware architecture to customers and internal executives. **Required Qualifications \& Skills** ------------------------------------- * **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. * **Experience:** 10\+ years of embedded/firmware development experience, including significant BMC/platform management firmware work and hands\-on OpenBMC development. Proven delivery of server\-class firmware into production; hyperscale experience preferred. * **Technical expertise:** Strong C/C\+\+ and embedded Linux skills; deep knowledge of OpenBMC, Redfish, IPMI, I2C/I3C, PMBus, SPI, and platform management interfaces; experience with secure boot, firmware update, and RoT. * **Systems knowledge:** Solid understanding of server hardware, power/thermal control loops, and the interaction of firmware with BIOS, hardware, and manufacturing flows. * **Communication:** Able to lead cross\-functional debug, drive architecture decisions, and communicate effectively with hardware teams, customers, and executives. Compensation: $214,000 to $290,000 **What’s in it for you** ------------------------ Benefit Insurance * Flexible Spending Account (FSA) * Health Savings Account (HSA) * Mental Health Care * 401K with match * Paid Holidays, Vacation \& Sick Days * Tuition Reimbursement * Perks at Work * LEAP Program * MyFlexPay ***We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*** --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

for building workflow agents, controlling states, and developing intelligent decision\-making systems. * **Vector Database Integration:** Design, implement, and maintain vector database solutions and accuracy. * **RAG Implementation:** Design and implement RAG workflows to improve accuracy and context in AI applications by combining real\-time retrieval with language model generation. * **MCP Integration:** Work with the Microsoft Cognitive Platform (MCP) for AI and cognitive services, integrating them with LangChain and LangGraph for enhanced capabilities. * **Optimization \& Fine\-Tuning:** Continuously optimize AI models, embeddings, and retrievers for performance and efficiency. * **Collaboration \& Problem\-Solving:** Work closely with product managers, data scientists, and other engineers to understand business needs and deliver AI\-driven solutions. **Required Skills \& Qualifications:****Technical Skills:*** **Model Selection \& Evaluation:** Compares foundation models (such as Anthropic Claude, Amazon Nova, Llama, and Mistral) for latency, accuracy, and cost, using model evaluation and prompt routing. * **RAG \& Knowledge Bases:** Connects foundation models to enterprise data sources and vector stores via Bedrock Knowledge Bases for grounded responses. * **Agent \& Workflow Engineering:** Builds multi\-step workflows and agents using Bedrock Agents, Bedrock AgentCore, and AWS services like Lambda, API Gateway, and Step Functions. * **Safety, Governance \& Optimization:** Configures Bedrock Guardrails, IAM permissions, logging, prompt caching, and model distillation for production reliability and cost control. * **LangChain**: Hands\-on experience with LangChain for developing intelligent workflows, managing chains, and leveraging its powerful capabilities for building GenAI applications. * **LangGraph**: Proficiency in LangGraph for designing advanced workflows and agents with state management, decision\-making, and loops. * **Vector Databases (e.g., Qdrant, Pinecone, FAISS)**: Experience working with vector databases to manage and search embeddings, and optimize large\-scale retrieval tasks. * **Large Language Models (LLMs)**: In\-depth understanding of LLMs, such as GPT, BERT, and other transformer\-based architectures, and how to integrate them into GenAI applications. * **Embedding Creation and Integration**: Expertise in building embeddings using models like sentence\-BERT, OpenAI embeddings, or custom models for a variety of data types (text, images, etc.). * **Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)**: Proven experience in designing and implementing RAG systems that combine real\-time retrieval with language model generation. * **Microsoft Cognitive Platform (MCP)**: Familiarity with integrating Microsoft Cognitive Services, such as Azure Cognitive Search, Azure OpenAI, or other Microsoft AI tools, into GenAI applications. * **Model Context Protocol (MCP) \- Building or GenAI applications on cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud, with an emphasis on cloud\-based AI solutions. * **Machine Learning Frameworks**: Knowledge of popular ML frameworks, such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Hugging Face, and how to use them for model training and inference. * **Data Engineering**: Strong skills in handling large datasets, including data preprocessing, data jobs.title: Engine Performance Engineer
jobs.description: **Engine Performance Engineer** The Performance Engineer supports Ilmor’s high\-performance powertrain development programs through hands\-on engineering, test preparation, data review, component design, documentation, and cross\-functional coordination. Working under the direction of the Program Manager, High Performance Powertrain, and alongside experienced engineers and technicians, this role helps move engine development work from concept through prototype build, dynamometer testing, validation, and implementation. This is an entry\-level development role for an engineer who wants to build practical knowledge of internal combustion engines, testing, data analysis, and product development. The successful candidate will be curious, organized, safety\-minded, and comfortable learning in office, shop, engine test, customer, and trackside environments. **RESPONSIBILITIES** Engine Development \& Testing Support * Support test planning, engine preparation, instrumentation checks, test execution, and post\-test inspections under the guidance of senior engineering staff. * Assist with dynamometer and development testing by preparing test requests, checklists, parts, tooling, sensors, data channels, and supporting documentation. * Monitor test activity, recognize unusual conditions, and promptly communicate concerns to the responsible engineer or test lead. * Collect, organize, and review test data for completeness and accuracy; prepare charts, tables, and concise summaries for engineering review. * Compare results against defined test objectives, baselines, limits, and acceptance criteria, and identify trends or inconsistencies for further investigation. * Participate in engine teardowns, inspections, measurement activities, failure reviews, and root cause investigations. * Help document test results, findings, open issues, engineering decisions, and recommended next steps. Design, Analysis \& Engineering Documentation * Create and revise basic components, assemblies, layouts, and drawings in SolidWorks under appropriate engineering review. * Perform entry\-level engineering calculations and tolerance checks using established methods and assumptions. * Assist with component selection, bill of material updates, engineering releases, change documentation, and revision control. * Review engineering drawings, specifications, build records, inspection reports, and supplier information for completeness and consistency. * Maintain organized development records, test reports, action lists, hardware status, photographs, data files, and lessons learned. * Follow Ilmor design, documentation, configuration control, and product lifecycle management practices. Program \& Cross\-Functional Support * Support the Program Manager and engineering team with schedules, milestone tracking, action\-item follow\-up, parts status, and technical meeting preparation. * Coordinate routine information and hardware needs with Design, Calibration, Testing, Engine Assembly, Manufacturing, Quality, Purchasing, and suppliers. * Prepare clear technical updates and present assigned work during internal design, build, and test reviews. * Assist with prototype hardware tracking, supplier follow\-up, component availability, and test asset readiness. * Communicate technical questions, risks, delays, and resource needs early; seek guidance when requirements or priorities are unclear. * Support customer, supplier, and trackside activities as assigned, with appropriate supervision and preparation. Safety, Quality \& Continuous Improvement * Follow all required safety procedures and use appropriate personal protective equipment in manufacturing, assembly, test, and field environments. * Complete assigned work accurately, document assumptions, and request review before releasing or acting on safety\-critical or performance\-critical information. * Use structured problem\-solving methods to investigate issues and support corrective actions. * Identify practical improvements to test preparation, data organization, engineering documentation, and team workflows. * Protect confidential customer, product, and company information and demonstrate honesty, accountability, and professional judgment. * Perform other related duties and support other performance engine programs as business needs require. QUALIFICATIONS * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering * 0\-2 years of relevant engineering, internship, co\-op, Formula SAE, Baja SAE, motorsports, dynamometer, laboratory, powertrain, or hands\-on mechanical experience. * Academic or practical experience with internal combustion engines, thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, machine design, data analysis, or controls is preferred. * A combination of relevant education and directly related practical experience may be considered. Skills \& Expertise * Foundational understanding of internal combustion engine systems and mechanical engineering principles. * Ability to read basic engineering drawings, specifications, schematics, and technical procedures. * Working knowledge of SolidWorks or similar three\-dimensional computer\-aided design software; ability to create basic parts, assemblies, and drawings. * Ability to organize, graph, and interpret engineering data using Microsoft Excel; exposure to MATLAB, Python, data acquisition, or calibration tools is preferred. * Careful attention to detail, strong recordkeeping, and the ability to follow established test and engineering procedures. * Clear written and verbal communication and the confidence to ask questions, explain observations, and accept constructive feedback. * Ability to manage multiple assignments, meet commitments, and work effectively with engineers, technicians, suppliers, and operational teams. * Demonstrated mechanical curiosity and willingness to work hands\-on with engines, components, test equipment, and development hardware. * High degree of honesty, integrity, accountability, and respect for safety and quality requirements. Additional Qualifications * Formula SAE, Baja SAE, collegiate racing, engine lab, automotive, marine, powersports, or personal vehicle project experience is strongly valued. * Exposure to dynamometer testing, combustion analysis, engine calibration, instrumentation, simulation, failure analysis, or validation is preferred but not required. * Familiarity with design reviews, failure mode and effects analysis, design validation planning, root cause analysis, or engineering change control is helpful. * Ability and willingness to travel to customer sites, suppliers, test facilities, and development events as required. * Ability to work additional hours, including occasional evenings or weekends, when necessary to support critical builds, tests, or development events. * Valid driver license and ability to meet company travel requirements.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Security Operations
jobs.description: Overview: A global biopharmaceutical company on a mission to Solve On, Incyte follows science to find solutions for patients with unmet medical needs. Through the discovery, development, and commercialization of proprietary therapeutics, Incyte has established a portfolio of first\-in\-class medicines for patients and a strong pipeline of products in Hematology, Oncology and Inflammation and Autoimmunity Headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, Incyte has operations in North America, Europe, and Asia. jobs.description: Software Services Engineer I **Industrial Networking Solutions · Software Services Team · Remote** **JOB DESCRIPTION** The Software Services Engineer I is an early\-career developer on the Software Services team.
