jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer (Snowflake & Informatica
jobs.description: Job Description The Data Engineer is responsible for realizing the vision of the Data Architect through the technical implementation of data pipelines using Snowflake and Informatica. Data Engineers are technical coding experts focused on moving data from line\-of\-business, transactional, or partner agency source systems into analytical data platforms, building transformations, managing data cleansing and quality, and presenting structured data for consumption by analysts and scientists. In the context of the Statewide Longitudinal Data System (SLDS / COdata) an OIT Data Engineer is expected to join the project team in January 2027 under a shared delivery model with a 3rd party implementor. The OIT Data Engineer will participate in a structured knowledge\-transfer progression (shadowing, co\-running, and checking), leading specific new source ingestions, and progressively will take over production operations and upkeep of the SLDS data foundation and analytics layer.**Scope of Responsibilities** * Data Ingestion \& Pipeline Engineering: Design, develop, test, and deploy automated ETL/data pipelines in Informatica and Snowflake to ingest data from partner state agencies and third parties into the SLDS common data model. * Transformation \& Analytics Layer Support: Implement transformation logic to convert raw agency feeds into harmonized, linked longitudinal records and analytics layer data models, adhering to core naming and modeling standards established with the Data Architect. * Record Linkage \& Identity Matching: Execute the SLDS internal matching logic to link newly ingested agency records to master longitudinal student and workforce profiles, handling match exceptions and cross\-agency reconciliations. * Production Pipeline Operations \& Incident Response: Maintain operational ownership of scheduled feed runs, monitoring job execution, resolving run failures, reloading late or corrected files, reconciling row counts, and rebuilding downstream objects. * Data Quality \& Governance Compliance: Implement L1 (structural/format), L2 (completeness/de\-duplication), and L3 (referential integrity/logic) validation checks, layout\-change detection, and audit trails; enforce data privacy, suppression rules, and compliance standards (FERPA, COPPA, ADA, and state statutes). * Performance Optimization \& Platform Stewardship: Optimize query execution, warehouse compute, and pipeline performance for cost and latency; identify and tune heavily used models and performance hot spots in Snowflake. * Quality Assurance, Code Review \& Promotion: Adhere to the unified release process across Development, Test, UAT, and Production environments using Azure DevOps and Azure Test Plans; author and execute test cases, conduct peer code reviews, and maintain release change logs. **Activities Performed****A. Ingestion \& Pipeline Development (OIT\-Led Feeds)****CDHE Courses Data Ingestion:** * Ingest and validate annual postsecondary course\-level data files from CDHE per data sharing agreements. * Build ETL mapping processes from CDHE course files into the SLDS common data model based on design specifications provided by 3rd party implementation partner. * Pair with 3 party implementation team during ETL construction, validation, and promotion. **Postsecondary SES \& Disability Data Ingestion (Conditional):** * Ingest and validate demographic, Pell Grant eligibility, and disability classification codes from postsecondary sources. * Apply mandated privacy protections, cell suppression rules, and permissible\-use governance requirements. **PSAT/SAT Assessment Data Ingestion (Conditional):** * Ingest, validate, and map section/composite assessment scores and grade levels from the College Board or CDE. * Execute identity matching to connect assessment records to existing longitudinal student profiles. **B. Knowledge Transfer \& Operational Transition (Jan–April 2027\)****Shadowing \& Co\-running (Jan–Feb 2027\):** * Shadow 3rd party implementation partner engineers on day\-to\-day operations of existing data feeds (e.g., NSC, K\-3, CDEC, and Phase 1 feeds). * Co\-run live feed cycles, handle data loading, execute record matching, and troubleshoot exceptions alongside 3rd party implementation partner. **Readiness Gate Execution (Target: March 2027\):** * Run two consecutive feed cycles completely unaided to achieve formal operational hand\-over sign\-off. **Full Production Operations (March 2027 Onward):** * Execute recurring feed schedules, rebuild downstream objects, reconcile row counts against source files, and triage failed jobs. * Address ad\-hoc data inquiries and export requests from OIT leadership and partner agencies. **C. Data Stabilization \& Analytics Layer Upkeep** * Stabilization Backlog Support: Resolve identified data reliability defects, run variations, and de\-duplication issues transitioned from the Phase 1 stabilization backlog. * Analytics Layer Hardening \& Maintenance (April 2027 Onward): * Apply object mode longitudinal reporting use cases . * De\-Identified Data Extraction Scripts: Data extraction scripts that generate de\-identified, suppressed outcome files for participating IHEs per specification. **Documentation \& Engineering Specifications** * ETL Pipeline Design Documents: Technical architecture and transformation specifications detailing source\-to\-target logic, schemas, and dependencies. * Mapping \& Transformation Specifications: Contribution to enterprise data mapping documents aligning source fields to the SLDS common data model. * Lineage Documentation \& Dependency Maps: As\-built data lineage records and dependency diagrams detailing object\-level upstream and downstream flows. * Operational Runbooks \& Incident Procedures: Standard operating procedures for running feed cycles, handling late or malformed files, performing failover, and reconciling row counts. **Governance, Testing \& Operational Reporting** * Azure Test Plans \& Execution Records: Fully documented test plans, test suites, manual test run results, and defect logs for all pipeline modifications prior to production promotion . * Release Change Logs: Detailed audit entries for all OIT\-led production releases, detailing changes, rationales, linked Azure DevOps work items, test results, and deployment timestamps]. * Feed Operation Run Logs \& Match Summaries: Run completion records, reconciliation totals, exception logs, and data\-quality summaries produced for agency loads. **Required Qualifications \& Technical Experience** * Snowflake ETL/ELT: Minimum 5 years of demonstrated experience building, orchestrating, and optimizing complex ETL/ELT data pipelines and transformation logic natively within the Snowflake platform. * Informatica CDGC: Minimum 1 year of hands\-on experience working with Informatica Cloud Data Governance and Catalog (CDGC) for metadata management, data profiling, cataloging, and automated data quality validation. * Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Minimum 1 year of experience utilizing Terraform to provision, configure, and maintain cloud infrastructure and resources. * CI/CD \& DevOps: Demonstrated proficiency implementing automated build, test, and release deployment pipelines using Azure DevOps. * Version Control: Expert proficiency with Git / version control workflows (branching strategies, pull requests, automated merge checks, code reviews). * Location Constraint: Must currently reside within the State of Colorado for the duration of the engagement. **Preferred Skills \& Experience** * Prior experience working with public sector, longitudinal education, and workforce data systems (e.g., CDE, CDHE, CDLE, CDEC, National Student Clearinghouse). * Experience with record linkage, entity resolution, and deterministic/probabilistic identity matching across disparate public records * Familiarity with federal and state student/workforce privacy regulations, including FERPA, COPPA, and cell suppression standards * Experience authoring and executing structured test plans in Azure Test Plans Required Skills Our Senior Staff Engineers are leading experts in their domains, helping devise practical and reusable solutions to complex problems. With a trusted legacy of more than 150 years of engineering expertise, our products power all the world’s most essential industries. Today, we are bringing the \#EnergyTransition to life with a portfolio that enables our customers to boost energy efficiency, reduce greenhouse gases, and minimize the carbon footprints of plants.**Our Most Powerful Engine: Our People**We are a team of more than 15,000 dedicated experts, doers, and innovators. For us, engineering the future means keeping businesses in motion. As a global player operating with the spirit and speed of a mid\-sized champion, the future holds unlimited opportunities for us. If you share our bold mindset to be best\-in\-class, we want you IN. **Your Future Role** Innomotics is making a strategic investment in the fast\-growing data center market, and our New Kensington, PA (NKN) site is building production capability for high\-power equipment that operates at high DC and AC voltages. As Senior Test Systems Engineer, High Voltage, you will be the technical lead for high\-voltage test at NKN – designing the test systems for our data center products, owning their high\-voltage safety, and carrying them from concept through qualification and production ramp. You will work alongside our test system development engineers, who bring deep expertise in test automation software and platform architecture. R\&R / MSA before release to production. * **Production ramp and sustaining:** Support the test capacity ramp, analyze yield and failure data, lead root\-cause analysis on test failures, and set calibration and preventive maintenance requirements for HV equipment. * **Site infrastructure:** Define facility requirements for HV test capability, such as power, grounding, space and segregation, working with facilities and EHS. * **Documentation:** Maintain test specifications, safety documentation, qualification records and change records in line with our quality system. **Your profile.****Required qualifications:*** Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. * 8\+ years of experience in high\-voltage test engineering, HV test system design, or HV product development and validation, for example power electronics, drives, switchgear, transformers, or power conversion and distribution. * Demonstrated design of high\-voltage test equipment or test setups at 10 kV or above, including source selection, measurement and safety systems. * Deep working knowledge of dielectric testing methods: hipot, insulation resistance, partial discharge, impulse and leakage current. * Proven experience engineering HV safety: interlocks, grounding and discharge systems, guarding, clearances and creepage, and safe work procedures. * Experience qualifying test equipment and measurement systems (IQ/OQ/PQ, Gage R\&R / MSA). * Working proficiency in test automation (LabVIEW and/or Python) and data acquisition, enough to integrate HV hardware with an automated test platform. * Track record as technical lead on complex, multi\-discipline engineering projects. * Clear communicator who works well across R\&D, quality, EHS, production and suppliers. **Preferred qualifications:*** Experience with data center power equipment (UPS, medium\-voltage or DC power conversion and distribution) or medium\-voltage drives. * Familiarity with NFPA 70E, IEEE high\-voltage test practice (e.g. IEEE 4\), IEC 60060 and IEC 61010, and UL / IEC product safety standards. * Experience in an accredited HV lab or a high\-power test facility. * Experience scaling a new product from pilot builds to volume production. * Experience designing custom measurement or control hardware, including PCB design. * Experience deploying and remotely supporting test systems at contract manufacturers or other global sites. * Experience using AI tools, such as coding assistants and AI agents, to augment engineering work in test development, data analysis and documentation, with the judgment to verify their output. jobs.title: Sr. AI Software Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description: The Sr. AI Software Engineer reports to the Sr. Director, AI Center of Excellence, in the Technology Department, and has no direct reports. In this role you embed with business teams across Health \& Benefits, Retirement \& Wealth, operations, contact center, finance, HR, marketing, sales, and engineering. You are a consultant at the edge of our internal teams, helping to identify AI opportunities, define requirements, build prototypes, and ship governed, measurable AI agents into production. The primary duties include finding and scoping AI\-suited business problems; building and shipping production agents and automations on approved enterprise platforms; baselining processes and measuring and reporting ROI before and after deployment; applying AI governance and compliance controls to every build; and converting repeat work into reusable patterns while raising AI fluency across the business teams this role supports. You bring information back to the CoE and deliver value to our business partners. If you love finding new challenges, showing people new was to solve problems, and to build and tinker while delivering critical business value continuously, this role is a perfect fit. **Duties \& Responsibilities:** * Embed within business teams across Health \& Benefits, Retirement \& Wealth, operations, contact center, finance, HR, marketing, sales, and engineering to identify work that is repetitive, automatable, or bottlenecked. * Translate and communicate a business need into a written solution statement, success criteria, data requirements, and a documented recommendation on whether AI is the appropriate solution. * Build working prototypes to validate feasibility before committing to a full build. * Scope each opportunity appropriately, determining whether the right solution is a single\-purpose agent, an automated workflow, a multi\-tier agent system, or an existing approved vendor capability. * Build production agents and automations on approved enterprise platforms, including assistant and agent frameworks, low\-code workflow automation, document intelligence, conversational and agent\-assist capabilities, and natural language analytics. * Design multi\-tier connectors and MCP servers and support the approval process for new connectors when a use case requires one. * Hand off completed builds with documentation, a runbook, a named owner, and a business user able to operate the solution independently. * Baseline process performance prior to each build, capturing cycle time, volume, error and rework rates, handle time, and cost per unit as applicable. * Instrument deployed agents so that value is measured continuously rather than asserted once at launch. * Report outcomes honestly, including builds that did not deliver value and the resulting lessons learned. * Apply an ISO/IEC 42001 governance mindset to every build, including defined purpose, risk classification, data handling, human oversight, and evidence that controls operated as intended. * Define and implement governance, security, and compliance telemetry for each agent, covering tool calls, scope adherence, escalation and override rates, data access, output quality, and cost. * Build monitoring and alerting so drift, boundary violations, and unexpected spend are surfaced to an owner. * Operate within the AI Governance Committee process and the AI Acceptable Use Policy. * Report business team needs, governance friction points, recurring patterns, and tooling gaps back to the AI Center of Excellence. * Convert repeat builds into reusable patterns, templates, and starter kits for use by other consultants and delivery teams. * Run enablement sessions and working labs to raise AI fluency within the business teams this role supports. * Perform other duties as assigned. Requirements: **Education \& Experience:** Minimum required: * Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering or Computer Science * AI Continuous learning certifications are a plus * 3\-6 six years of software engineering experience shipping and supporting production systems. * 2 \+years of hands\-on experience building AI solutions across assistants, agents, workflow automation, retrieval, and document processing. **Skills \& Abilities:** * Demonstrated end\-to\-end ownership, taking a business idea from initial concept through requirements, prototype, and production use. * Ability to define and measure business value, including constructing a baseline, defending a measurement method, and communicating cost and benefit independently. * Working knowledge of at least one AI governance or management framework, such as ISO/IEC 42001 or NIST AI RMF, and the ability to convert it into implemented controls. * Experience instrumenting telemetry as part of the build process rather than after an incident. * Ability to work effectively within unfamiliar business functions, build credibility quickly, and influence stakeholders while building relationships. * Ability to learn and adapt to a changing AI platform and tooling landscape. * Financial services, healthcare, benefits administration, or other regulated industry experience preferred, particularly environments handling PII, PHI, or fiduciary data. * Process improvement experience preferred, such as Lean, Six Sigma, or process mining. * Fluency in low\-code automation platforms alongside code\-first development preferred. * Experience with contact center, claims, or back\-office operations technology preferred. * Experience developing internal enablement materials, documentation, or practitioner communities preferred. **Other Requirements:** * Ability to occasionally work outside normal business hours to meet project deadlines as needed. * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Req Benefits: The compensation for this position will vary depending on factors such as your location, skills and experience. The compensation package may also include incentive and bonus opportunities. Inspira provides industry\-leading benefits including, but not limited to: healthcare, 401K savings plan, company holidays, paid time off, parental leave and an employee assistance program. Compensation: $100,200\-$140,000 per year Additional Details : **Take the next step in your journey at Inspira Financial.** Guided by our mission to enable better health and greater wealth, we help businesses and individuals thrive today, tomorrow, and into retirement by strengthening and simplifying the health and wealth journey. Serving more than 7 million clients and representing over $62 billion in assets, Inspira partners with thousands of employers, plan sponsors, recordkeepers, TPAs, and other institutional partners to help the people they support plan, save, and invest for a brighter future. Through solutions including automatic rollover services, health savings accounts, emergency savings, and custody services, Inspira is focused on delivering better outcomes for all. Learn more at inspirafinancial.com. Our values shape how we show up every day. We **Lead with Heart** by acting with compassion, empathy, and doing what's right; **Cultivate Trust** through integrity, transparency, and accountability; **Aim Higher** by never settling for what's expected and continually raising the standard; and **Win Together** by collaborating inclusively to achieve the best outcomes. Our growth and culture haven't gone unnoticed; we've been recognized on Crain's Fast 50 and Inc. 5000 for remarkable growth, and named to Built In's 2025 Best Places to Work and Gallagher's 2022 Best\-In\-Class Employer for our workplace culture and benefits. Don't meet every single requirement? That's okay. We know growth comes from people who are willing to learn and challenge themselves, not just check every box. jobs.title: Principal Engineer — Money Agent (Money-In & Money-Out Connectivity)

The signature bet is the **Money Agent**: the single AI experience that reasons across a business's entire money picture — everything coming in across Invoicing, Payments, and Capital, and everything going out across Bill Pay and Card — and the connectivity that makes those domains work together as one. architecture for the Money Agent and the connectivity beneath it — the layer that lets money\-in (Invoicing, Payments, Capital) and money\-out (Bill Pay, Card) interoperate as one coherent money experience. * Personally design and hand\-build the Money Agent: an AI\-native experience that reasons across a business's full money picture — what's coming in, what's going out, what it can borrow, what it should pay — and acts across domain boundaries on the customer's behalf. * Build the connectivity that makes every money product agent\-addressable: the tools, contracts, APIs, and primitives that let the agent orchestrate across Money In and Money Out safely. * Design for the hard cross\-domain problems no single team owns: safe action across money, authorization and consent, reconciliation across domains, and trust when the agent acts with real money. * Partner across the Money In and Money Out teams to align their architectures toward shared connectivity — you are the technical glue, not a layer that slows them down. * Find the pattern underneath the first builds and generalize it into a platform standard the whole organization builds against. * Get into the field as needed — sit with SMB owners and accountants to see how they actually think about money in and out, and pressure\-test the agent against real financial lives. **Qualifications** * 12\+ years of software engineering experience at a true Principal / Distinguished bar — a systems thinker and architect who has **doubled down on hands\-on AI building**, not stepped back from the keyboard. * Deep fintech experience **and** deep, hands\-on AI/LLM work are both must\-haves — agents, tool use, orchestration, RAG — and you can go from concept to a working agent prototype in days. * A zero\-to\-one jobs.title: Faculty Search in AI for Scientific Discovery in Mechanical Engineering
jobs.description: The **Department of Mechanical Engineering** at **Johns Hopkins University** seeks applications for tenure\-track/tenured faculty positions focused on data science (DS) and artificial intelligence (AI) for scientific discovery in mechanical engineering. We seek scholars who combine expertise in mechanical engineering with the development of novel AI or machine learning methods, systems, or architectures to advance scientific discovery and engineering innovation. Areas of interest include mechanics of materials, fluid mechanics and thermal processes, biomechanics and mechanical engineering in biology and medicine, robotics and control, energy and the environment, nano/microscale science and engineering, space engineering, and other research areas represented in the department. We particularly welcome research that complements and expands the department's strengths and creates opportunities for collaboration with existing faculty. Johns Hopkins University has made a landmark investment in data science and artificial intelligence by establishing the **Johns Hopkins Data Science and AI Institute** (DSAI Institute). The Whiting School of Engineering at Johns Hopkins University is adding 150 new faculty positions, including 30 Bloomberg Distinguished Professorships. A new half\-million\-square\-foot building is being constructed, and an unparalleled computational infrastructure is now operational. This expansion will establish Johns Hopkins as one of the largest and leading engineering schools with a top AI research program. Outstanding candidates at all academic ranks will be considered. The successful candidate will have a tenure home in the Department of Mechanical Engineering and an affiliation with the DSAI Institute. A joint appointment with another department is also possible. Faculty in the Department of Mechanical Engineering work with colleagues across Johns Hopkins on research in materials, fluids, robotics, energy, health, and space. They also contribute to the **Johns Hopkins Turbulence Databases** (JHTDB), which provide access to detailed flow simulation data, and the **Artificial Intelligence for Materials Design Laboratory** (AIMD\-L), which combines automated experimentation with AI to study and develop materials for extreme environments. The department faculty also collaborate through many university institutes and centers that amplify DS and AI research, including: the **Laboratory for Computational Sensing and Robotics** (LCSR) for learning\-enabled perception, planning, and control; the **Hopkins Extreme Materials Institute** (HEMI) for data\-driven materials discovery and design; the **Institute for Assured Autonomy** (IAA) for trustworthy and verifiable autonomous systems; the **Center for Environmental \& Applied Fluid Mechanics** (CEAFM) for physics\-informed modeling of multiscale flow phenomena; the **Mathematical Institute for Data Science** (MINDS) for foundational theory underlying modern DS and AI methods; the **Ralph O'Connor Sustainable Energy Institute** (ROSEI) addressing clean energy challenges; the **Malone Center for Engineering in Healthcare** for medical innovation; the **Johns Hopkins Institute for Planetary Health** (JHIPH) at the nexus of environmental interventions and human health; and **Space@Hopkins** connecting civilian space research across the university. Faculty also collaborate with the **Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Laboratory** (APL), one of the nation's premier research and development organizations, which tackles grand challenges in national security, space exploration, and critical infrastructure. This interconnected ecosystem enables transformative research, from fundamental science to high\-impact applications in autonomous systems, extreme environments, sustainable energy, healthcare, space, and defense. The expected salary range for this position is: Assistant Professors $160k\-$200k, Associate Professors $180k\-$250k, Full Professors $220k\-$450k, for 12\-month FTE. The referenced salary range is based on Johns Hopkins University's good faith belief at the time of posting. The actual compensation offered to the selected candidate may vary and will be based on factors including, but not limited to, the experience and qualifications of the selected candidate \- e.g., years in rank, training, field, discipline, other work experience, and other similar factors; geographic location; internal equity; external market conditions; and other factors as reasonably determined by the University. * PhD in Mechanical Engineering or a related field by the start date. * A record of research excellence and a clear vision for an independent, collaborative program in DS/AI for Mechanical Engineering. * Commitment to high\-quality teaching, mentoring, and inclusive excellence. **Salary Range** The referenced salary range represents the minimum and maximum salaries for this position and is based on Johns Hopkins University's good faith belief at the time of posting. Not al ill ultimately depend on multiple factors, which may include the successful candidate's geographic location, skills, work experience, internal equity, market conditions, education/training and other factors, as reasonably determined by the University. **Total Rewards** Johns Hopkins offers a total rewards package that supports our employees' health, life, career and retirement. More information can be found here: https://hr.jhu.edu/benefits\-worklife/ . **Equal Opportunity Employer** The Johns Hopkins University is committed to equal opportunity for its faculty, staff, and students. To that end, the university does not discriminate on the basis of sex, gender, marital status, pregnancy, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status or other legally protected characteristics. The University is committed to providing qualified individuals access to all academic and employment programs, benefits and activities on the basis of demonstrated ability, performance and merit without regard to personal factors or demographic characteristics that are irrelevant to the program involved. **Pre\-Employment Information** If you are interested in applying for employment with Johns Hopkins University and require special assistance or accommodation during any part of the pre\-employment process, please contact the HR Business Services Office at jhurecruitment@jhu.edu . For TTY users, call via Maryland Relay or dial 711\. For more information about workplace accommodations at Johns Hopkins University for disabilities, medical conditions (including medical conditions related to pregnancy or childbirth), accessibility, or religious reasons, please visit accessibility.jhu.edu . **Background Checks** After receiving a conditional offer, the successful candidate(s) for this position will be subject to a pre\-employment background check including education verification. When deciding whether a candidateâ€™s conviction history is job\-disqualifying, the University considers the nature and gravity of the offense, the time that has passed since the conviction, and the nature of the job being sought. **EEO is the Law** https://www.eeoc.gov/employees\-job\-applicants **Vaccine Requirements** Johns Hopkins University requires all faculty, staff, and students to receive the seasonal flu vaccine. Exceptions to the flu vaccine requirements may be provided to individuals for religious beliefs or medical reasons. Requests for an exception must be submitted to the JHU vaccination registry. New hires with start dates after the required vaccination deadline and during the designated flu season must be fully vaccinated before their start date to begin working. For positions in clinical areas or laboratories, or for those that involve work with research subjects or community contact, the pre\-employment physical requires a TB screening at least six weeks before your start date. TB screening can be a negative PPD test or an IGRA (T\-spot or Quantiferon blood test). A chest X\-ray may be required if your TB screening is positive. Documentation of immune status against rubella (German measles), rubeola (measles), mumps, varicella (chickenpox), and hepatitis B, and documentation of having received the Tdap (tetanus, diphtheria, and pertussis) vaccination is required. This may include documentation of having two (2\) MMR vaccines, two (2\) varicella vaccines, or antibody status to these diseases from laboratory testing. Blood tests for immunities to these diseases are ordinarily included in the pre\-employment physical exam except for those employees who provide results of blood tests or immunization documentation from their own health care providers. Any vaccinations required for these diseases will be given at no cost in our Occupational Health office. An applicant who chooses to have his or her own practitioner complete the above requirements is responsible for those incurred costs.

processes. **Key Responsibilities** * Support the integration, alignment, testing, and manufacturing readiness of precision optical assemblies and modules. * Develop, improve, and sustain optical alignment, metrology, calibration, and test processes used in manufacturing. * Design, develop, and maintain test fixtures, tooling, and measurement methods that improve repeatability and manufacturing efficiency. * Define and support incoming quality and acceptance processes for precision optical components, including fabricated optics, optical coatings, interferometry, and dimensional/metrology requirements. * Partner with optical, mechanical, systems, software, manufacturing, and supplier engineering teams to troubleshoot complex optical and opto\-mechanical issues. * Perform root\-cause and failure analysis using optical measurements, manufacturing data, and structured problem\-solving methods. * Apply Design for Manufacturing (DfM), tolerance analysis, and statistical process control (SPC) to improve yield, process capability, and product quality. * Analyze manufacturing and MES data to identify trends, define appropriate specifications, and improve process stability. * Create and maintain engineering documentation, work instructions, procedures, and process\-of\-record documentation, support training for technicians and manufacturing personnel. * Interpret optical and mechanical drawings, specifications, tolerances, and GD\&T and perform basic CAD modifications as needed. * Work directly with suppliers and internal manufacturing teams to resolve component and process issues. * Travel up to 25% domestically and internationally to support suppliers, manufacturing operations, and product needs. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Optical Engineering, Physics, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical discipline, with relevant industry experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * Hands\-on experience working with optical or opto\-mechanical assemblies, including alignment, integration, testing, metrology, or manufacturing. * Experience with optical measurement or metrology techniques such as interferometry, wavefront measurement, MTF testing, profilometry, imaging performance, or precision dimensional measurement. * Understanding of optical and jobs.title: Senior Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: **Imagine yourself…** * Doing meaningful work that makes an everyday impact on the world around you. * Growing your expertise and expanding your skillset with every project. * Contributing to a brighter, more sustainable future. It’s possible with a role at Kipp \& Zonen, where you’ll have the chance to shape the future of your career—and the future of our planet. Kipp \& Zonen, a Veralto company, provides class\-leading instruments for measuring solar radiation and atmospheric properties in Meteorology, Climatology, Hydrology, Industry, Renewable Energy, Agriculture and Public Health. Kipp \& Zonen is the specialist in the measurement of solar and sky radiation, from the ultraviolet to the far infrared. We offer a complete range of high\-quality instrumentation and accessories, from reliable cost\-effective products to the best performance available. Our pyranometers, for example, are used in meteorological networks around the world. Furthermore, our expertise and close links with the scientific community have led to high\-end solutions for the measurement of atmospheric properties such as stratospheric Ozone, UV Spectra and evapo\-transpiration. Our mission is to satisfy the fundamental need to monitor atmospheric properties related to climate change, classical meteorology, agriculture, renewable energy and the available water budget. **The opportunity:** Reporting into the Senior Manager, R\&D, you will **lead the firmware engineering aspect of product development and maintenance initiatives** at the Austin site and support a global organization. **This is a full\-time, onsite position (40 hours per week, Monday to Friday) based in Austin, Texas (North Central, near the Domain)**, where our factory and production operations are located. You will have meaningful ownership across the full product lifecycle, from ideas and prototypes to globally deployed products. In this hands\-on role, your design judgment, production partnership, and problem\-solving directly influence customer outcomes in an impactful solar market where our products shape the future of our planet. In this role, you will: * **Lead** the concept and implementation of new features for our solar sensing products. You turn requirements into a firmware architecture, make the key design decisions together with electrical and systems engineers, and implement robust, production\-ready C firmware for MCU\-based sensors and controllers. You own each product’s firmware independently from specification through final design, and set the technical direction and quality bar for the team through code and design reviews. * **Think** beyond the firmware. Weigh electronics, communications, manufacturability, reliability, and cybersecurity in every decision, and choose solutions that work for the whole product, not just the code. * **Champion** hardware bring\-up at system level: analyze schematics, review component selections, validate hardware\-software interfaces, and define integration strategies for sensors, ADCs, communications interfaces, memory, power systems, and peripherals. jobs.title: Software Engineer (Backend, Infrastructure Focus)
jobs.description: As a Software Engineer at Kira, you will build and own backend services that power critical product workflows, and you will grow quickly while doing it. This role is for an engineer who has already seen a system grow fast and wants more ownership: real design decisions, close collaboration with our VP of Engineering, and mentorship from senior engineers. This is a product\-minded backend role with meaningful work in performance, reliability, and infrastructure. You’ll partner with product and design to ship complete features, contribute across the stack when needed, and have opportunities to meet directly with teachers and students to learn how they use Kira and where we can improve. This is a full\-time position that requires flexibility with work hours and availability outside of regular business hours. We have offices in San Francisco, CA and New York City, NY. We ask that employees work from one of the two locations and come into the office in person 4 days a week (Wednesdays WFH). **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Ship impactful, end\-to\-end features that improve student and teacher experiences * Own scoped initiatives from design through rollout, making real design decisions with increasing independence * Build and scale backend services, APIs, and event\-driven systems as our traffic and customer base grow rapidly * Improve engineering foundations, including code quality, observability, testing, and CI/CD * Take part in operational excellence: performance, reliability, security, and incident response * Partner closely with product managers and designers on UX, interaction design, and execution * Use AI coding tools (such as Cursor and Claude Code) as a daily workflow, and review and understand everything they produce * Contribute to design discussions and code reviews, and grow through mentorship from senior engineers **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent technical experience * Roughly 3–6 years of professional software engineering experience. We will consider standout candidates outside this range * Strong backend experience in at least one modern language (for example Kotlin, Python, Go, Rust, Scala, Elixir, or Haskell). Kotlin is a nice\-to\-have, not a requirement, and we expect you to ramp up on Kira's stack (Kotlin, Python) * Hands\-on experience scaling a system through real growth, such as taking users or requests from tens or hundreds of thousands to millions, not only operating mature large\-company services * Experience designing APIs and event\-driven systems (queues, messaging), with a practical approach to scalable architecture * Experience with relational databases (for example MySQL) and operating production systems on cloud infrastructure (ideally AWS) * A track record of owning a multi\-week feature or initiative, including design decisions, and a clear, specific story about its impact * AI\-enabled development as a real daily workflow (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar), with good judgment about when to use AI and when to solve or review code yourself. You can explain, debug, and fix AI\-generated code * Familiarity with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and reliable deployment practices * Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain your thinking to technical and non\-technical colleagues * A mix of larger\-company and startup experience is a plus, along with comfort in a fast\-paced, early\-stage environment with changing priorities * Hunger to grow, a positive can\-do attitude, and impeccable attention to detail **Nice To Have** ---------------- * Experience contributing to frontend codebases (for example React and TypeScript), so you can go full\-stack when a feature needs it * Experience shipping LLM\-backed features, including handling latency, cost, model failures, and fallbacks. * Experience building or maintaining AI evaluations, including representative datasets, task\-specific quality checks, and regression tests for prompt or model changes. * Experience building workflows where models call tools or coordinate multiple steps, including managing state, retries, timeouts, and human review. * Experience at a company that grew quickly during your tenure **What We Offer** ----------------- * Competitive compensation and equity. For applicants in the US, the salary range for this role is $165,000 \- $195,000, depending on relevant considerations like professional experience and related skill sets * Medical, dental, vision and life insurance, including a medical insurance plan with 100% coverage of employee premiums * Flexible PTO policy and company holidays * DoorDash credit for lunch daily * Wellhub Membership: 100% company\-paid access to premium gym networks (Orangetheory, SoulCycle), 60\+ wellness apps (Headspace, MyFitnessPal, Apple Fitness\+), and 1:1 coaching sessions spanning fitness, mental health, nutrition, and sleep * 401(k) matching * Dog friendly office ***Equal Employment Opportunity Employer*** *At Kira, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information (including characteristics and testing), military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Kira believes that diversity and inclusion among our employees are critical to our success as a company, and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool. jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Your Job** As a Platform Engineer on the Cloud \& Integrations capability, you will help build and operate the cloud and integration platforms that Koch businesses rely on every day. You will work alongside architects, product owners, and fellow engineers to make our platforms easier to consume and harder to misuse by automating provisioning, strengthening guardrails, expanding self\-service capabilities, and improving reliability and cost efficiency as adoption grows. This is a hands\-on engineering role where you will contribute across the full engineering lifecycle. You will work with business partners and teammates to understand problems, design solutions, implement and roll them out, and support them in production. You will have opportunities to expand your technical capabilities while contributing to areas such as private connectivity, agent and Model Context Protocol (MCP) patterns, and platform foundations for artificial intelligence (AI) workloads. You will be successful in this role if you take ownership of your work, automate wherever practical, consider security and identity as part of good engineering, and think about the experience of the engineers consuming the platform. You will also be expected to share knowledge, document what you build, and consider reliability, security, maintainability, and cost when making technical decisions. **Our Team** The Koch Technology Cloud \& Applications team delivers cloud and application platforms and enabling solutions that empower our Koch businesses to design, build, and deploy the technology necessary for transforming their businesses. We manage several enterprise platforms including public/private cloud, integrations, developer enablement, contact centers, data visualization, and enterprise knowledge. Our applications team also provides technical consulting, develops custom applications, and provides support for leveraged enterprise applications. **Location: This role is located in Wichita, KS and requires an in\-office presence with flexibility.** **This role is not eligible for VISA sponsorship.** **What You Will Do** * Build and maintain automation that provisions, configures, and governs cloud accounts, networks, identity, and shared services across our public and private cloud environments. * Develop and improve platform guardrails and controls that allow teams to move quickly within well\-understood security, identity, and operational boundaries. * Extend self\-service and developer\-enablement tooling, including the Integration Foundry and internal cloud portal, to reduce friction for teams consuming the platform. * Implement private connectivity and integration patterns between cloud platforms, Software as a Service (SaaS) providers, and on\-premises systems. * Work with engineers and business partners across Koch businesses to understand platform needs, evaluate technical options, and help implement effective solutions. * Improve platform reliability and observability through telemetry, alerting, health reporting, troubleshooting, and operational runbooks. * Identify opportunities to improve cloud utilization and cost efficiency and help teams understand the resource impact of their solutions. * Contribute to emerging platform capabilities, including agent and Model Context Protocol (MCP) patterns and foundations for AI workloads. * Create and maintain technical documentation, implementation guides, and reference examples that help other engineers use the platform effectively. **Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)** * Experience building, deploying, or operating infrastructure and applications on a public cloud platform. Our primary platform is Amazon Web Services (AWS); experience with Microsoft Azure is also valued. * Hands\-on experience with Infrastructure as Code, such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK), or equivalent, along with git\-based continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) workflows. * Working knowledge of cloud networking, including virtual private clouds (VPCs), routing, Domain Name System (DNS), and private connectivity, as well as identity and access management and least\-privilege concepts. * Experience using at least one general\-purpose programming or scripting language, such as Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, or equivalent. * Experience troubleshooting applications or infrastructure across cloud environments and communicating technical decisions clearly with engineers and business partners. **What Will Put You Ahead** * Experience supporting or contributing to a multi\-account cloud environment or landing zone, including cross\-account automation. * Experience with cloud security posture, entitlement management, or policy\-as\-code tooling. * Experience with integration platforms or API management, such as MuleSoft, API gateways, Apache Kafka, or Amazon EventBridge. * Experience with containerized or serverless workloads using technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon Elastic Container Service (ECS), Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), or AWS Lambda. * Exposure to platforms supporting AI or large language model (LLM) workloads, including agent frameworks, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or model hosting. * Experience with software development, infrastructure operations, or site reliability engineering practices. * Relevant cloud, platform, or networking certifications. * Experience contributing to documentation, code reviews, technical knowledge sharing, or helping teammates solve engineering problems. At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy. **Hiring Philosophy** All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here . **Who We Are** Koch creates and innovates a wide spectrum of products and services that make life better. Our work spans a vast number of industries across the world, including engineered technology, refining, chemicals and polymers, pulp and paper, glass, electronics and many more. Headquartered in Wichita, Kansas, Koch employs about 120,000 employees across the globe. At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company. **Our Benefits** Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength \- focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes \- medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter. Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results. **Equal Opportunities** Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. This employer uses E\-Verify. Please click here for additional information. You will engineer and deploy scalable solutions using advanced Machine Learning, GenAI, and Agentic AI workflows. Your mission will be to analyze and solve complex strategic and operational challenges across the L’Oréal Americas market, leveraging data\-driven models to drive innovation and business value across various domains. **Key Responsibilities:** In this role, you will sit at the intersection of innovation and implementation, driving the adoption of cutting\-edge AI across L’Oréal. * Build and ship AI solutions: Develop, evaluate, and deploy machine learning models and LLM\-powered applications that address concrete business needs. * Drive Cross\-Business Impact: Create scalable AI solutions for a diverse range of use cases across multiple L’Oréal brands and business units, addressing needs in marketing, supply chain, retail, operations and much more. * Solve problems across the business. Partner with Data Engineers, UX/UI Designers, Full\-Stack Developers, and DevOps Engineers to integrate AI into usable, maintainable products. * Shape the right use cases. Help business stakeholders assess feasibility, clarify requirements, and weigh trade\-offs between performance, complexity, cost, and value. * Share what you learn. Our 3,500 L'Oréal R\&I experts leverage Science \& Technology to invent safe, trustable, sustainable \& responsible beauty products and experiences that will change people's lives. Today, our Advanced Research division is leading a revolution at the convergence of computational biology, artificial intelligence, and cutting\-edge laboratory science. We are building next\-generation discovery platforms that combine in silico predictive models with high\-throughput wet\-lab assays to decode skin and hair biology, design novel biomimetic actives, and pioneer sustainable, high\-performance beauty solutions. The Mission As a Senior Scientist I in Digital Biology, you will serve as a vital bridge between the digital and biological worlds. In this dual\-threat role, you will navigate complex, multi\-stakeholder programs bridging AI/ML modeling, bioinformatics pipelines, and wet\-lab translational validation. You will design and deploy predictive workflows to generate biological hypotheses, validate them experimentally at the bench alongside multidisciplinary teams, and translate computational insights into tangible active ingredients, proprietary technologies, and consumer\-facing innovations. Key Responsibilities 1\. In Silico Discovery \& Computational Modeling * AI/ML Workflow Co\-Development: Test, execute, and improve computational biology pipelines, machine learning models, and predictive algorithms to identify novel biological targets, biomarkers, and active ingredient mechanisms (e.g., transcriptomics, proteomics, single\-cell analysis, structure\-activity relationships). * Data Integration \& Analysis: Analyze and interpret complex multi\-omics datasets from public and/or internal datasets to build predictive phenotypic and cellular models. * Algorithm Evaluation: Benchmark modern algorithms and generative models against biological benchmarks, establishing clear metrics for model fidelity, generalizability, and biological relevance. 2\. Experimental Validation * Bench\-to\-Algorithm Synergy: Co\-build experimental strategies with internal and external research teams for in vitro, ex vivo, or high\-throughput screening assays to validate in silico predictions. * Collaborative Experimentation: Partner directly with cell biologists, analytical chemists, and other scientific stakeholders to translate computational hypotheses into tangible bench results, actively troubleshooting assays and interpreting data feedback loops. * Product \& Active Translation: Trace the pipeline from target discovery to active screening and prototype formulation, ensuring that digital hits meet safety, efficacy, sustainability (Green Sciences), and regulatory standards. 3\. Project Management * End\-to\-End Responsibility: Assist in leading cross\-functional innovation projects from scoping through proof\-of\-concept, managing timelines, deliverables, resource allocation, and risk mitigation. * Translational Bridge: Act as the translator between data scientists/software engineers and experimental biologists/formulators, establishing shared frameworks and common taxonomies. * Internal Ecosystem Engagement: Interface cross\-functionally with internal partners, tapping into L’Oreal’s multinational R\&I network to work collaboratively on global projects. 4\. Scientific Communication * Insight Delivery: Synthesize complex computational and biological findings into compelling presentations, dashboards, and executive summaries for scientific peers, management, and brand partners. * Scientific Footprint: Co\-author invention disclosures, patent filings, technical documentation, and high\-impact peer\-reviewed publications in collaboration with appropriate teams. **We Are Looking For:** Education \& Experience * Ph.D. in Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Systems Biology, Molecular/Cell Biology (with a he PyTorch/TensorFlow) and/or R/Bioconductor. * Omics \& Bioinformatics: Proven track record analyzing high\-throughput biological data (bulk/single\-cell RNA\-Seq, spatial transcriptomics, proteomics, or metabolomics). * Data Infrastructure: Familiarity with common digital environments (i.e. RStudio, Jupyter) and cloud computing platforms (i.e. AWS, GCP, Azure). Biological \& Wet\-Lab Acumen * Foundational Biology: Mechanistic understanding of skin cell biology, molecular pathways, barrier function, inflammation, or matrix biology (specific experience with skin, hair, or cutaneous models is a plus). * Experimental Execution: Background in cellular assay development (e.g. ELISA, flow cytometry, confocal microscopy, phenotypic screens) and comfortable operating within a biological lab environment (when coordinating with lab teams). Soft Skills * Communication \& Influence: Exceptional ability to distill complex data science concepts for non\-computational colleagues and articulate biological mechanisms to L’Oreal R\&I teams. * Navigating Ambiguity: An entrepreneurial mindset; comfortable with open\-ended exploratory research, pivoting when data dictates, and thriving in a fast\-paced research environment. * Project Orchestration: Proficiency in project leadership, with a track record of contributing to cross\-functional teams and delivering milestones on schedule. * The ability to be onsite, in the office/laboratory at least 3 days a week, as this is an essential function of the position (required). * Authorization to work in the United States is required. No sponsorship is offered for this role. (required). What's In It For You * A place for you to leave your comfort zone and grow beyond your potential (here, you'll be encouraged to try new things and take risks!) * Real responsibility from day 1, there's no sitting on the sidelines at L'Oréal * An environment where people of every ethnicity, social background, age, religion, gender and sexual orientation as well as people with disabilities are accepted, can speak up, will thrive and are celebrated! * A place where you can contribute to something bigger! Many of our brands have societal/environmental causes to make concrete difference * Base Salary Range: $77,400 \- $110,300 (The actual compensation will depend on a variety of job\-related factors which may include geographic location, work experience, education, and skill level) * Competitive Benefits Package (Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K, Pension Plan) * Hybrid Work Policy (Up to 2 days per week work from home for eligible roles, subject to manager approval) * Flexible Time Off (Paid Company Holidays, Paid Vacation, Vacation Buy Program, Volunteer Time, Summer Fridays \& More!) * Access to Company Perks (VIP Access to L'Oréal's Internal Shop for Discounted Products, Monthly Mobile Allowance) * Learning and Development Opportunities (Unlimited Access to E\-learnings, Lunch \& Learn Sessions, Mentorship Programs, \& More!) * Employee Resource Groups (Think Tanks and Innovation Squads) * Access to Mental Health \& Wellness Programs Don’t meet every single requirement? At L'Oréal, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and innovative workplace. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the qualifications listed in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways! You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles! We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and take pride in a diverse environment. We’re committed to guaranteeing inclusive recruitment processes and advocating for hiring and promoting each candidate in an ethical and equitable way. jobs.title: Senior Data & Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: Founded in 1981, Lanter Delivery Systems is a national logistics company and a leader in overnight, unattended delivery of auto, agricultural and industrial parts from their customer's distribution centers to dealer locations. In the 21st century we live in a business culture that demands cost and logistical efficiencies combined with increased productivity. Lanter's strategic, process driven approach has been embraced by the marketplace and is setting new standards in the automotive and agricultural manufacturing marketplace. We see a bright future on the road before us and we are very excited about bringing our solutions to a variety of new industries. The ideal candidate will embody our company's Non\-Negotiables:* **Walk in Humble Confidence** \- We are experts at what we do, but we never assume we know everything * **Be Open, Honest and Respectful** \- We say what has to be said in a tactful, courteous way * **Be Fearless** \- We never fail, we only learn * **We are One Team** \- We achieve more together by collaboration and consensus * **Delivery on Commitments** \- We do what we say we will do * **We have a Passion to Serve** \- We are dedicated, hardworking individuals who provide exceptional service to our customers and to each other * **We put Safety First** \- We prioritize the safety of our team members and customers above all else in our business * **We Strive for Operational Excellence** \- We are dedicated to a culture of continuous improvements, driving quality and productivity **Position Summary:** The Senior Data \& Analytics Engineer supports the continued development and reliability of Lanter’s enterprise data platform. Working within an Azure and Databricks environment, this position builds and enhances data pipelines, integrates new data sources, develops reporting\-ready datasets, and implements automated testing to protect the integrity of production ETL/ELT processes. This hands\-on role works across data engineering, analytics, data modeling, governance, and reporting. The position partners with business and technical stakeholders to translate complex requirements into accurate, scalable, and understandable data solutions. **Essential Duties and Key Deliverables:*** Build and operate ETL/ELT pipelines using Databricks, SQL, Python, Spark/PySpark, and Azure Data Lake. * Develop an integrated enterprise gold\-layer model spanning source systems, customers, and operating companies. * Build dimensional serving\-layer and data\-mart models with deliberate decisions regarding grain, keys, conformed dimensions, historical data, and slowly changing dimensions. * Implement automated regression testing using defined inputs and expected outputs to validate pipelines and transformations. * Own orchestration, observability, performance, failure diagnosis, replay and recovery, root\-cause fixes, and cost management for assigned production solutions. * Partner with stakeholders to reconcile business definitions and establish data requirements, rules, ownership, and governance standards. * Apply disciplined engineering practices, including Git, code review, reusable components, automated testing, controlled deployments, and technical documentation. * Develop analytics and reporting solutions using Sigma, Power BI, or comparable platforms. * Support strategic data initiatives across Lanter’s business units and industry verticals, including AI, operational visibility, and analytics enablement. * Independently own deliverables and provide technical guidance on complex data and analytics needs. **Required Experience and Skills:*** 5\+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, BI engineering, or a related field. * Strong, recent, hands\-on experience developing production pipelines with Python and Spark/PySpark. * Advanced SQL skills and hands\-on experience with Databricks, Azure Data Lake, and Azure DevOps or comparable technologies. * Experience designing integrated enterprise models and dimensional data marts, including grain, keys, conformed dimensions, history, and slowly changing dimensions. * Experience implementing automated testing, regression testing, data\-quality controls, and pipeline validation. * Experience operating production data solutions, including monitoring, optimization, troubleshooting, recovery, and cost management. * Experience with Git, code review, CI/CD, reusable development practices, and technical documentation. * Ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable data and analytics solutions. * Strong communication, collaboration, problem\-solving, and independent ownership skills. **Preferred Experience:*** Experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, or another operationally complex environment. * Experience supporting data governance, AI, or advanced analytics initiatives. **Supervisory Responsibilities:** This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities but is expected to provide technical guidance and serve as a resource for complex data and analytics needs.**Position Type:** ================== This is a full\-time, remote position. Proximity to Lanter’s St. Louis headquarters is preferred but not required, and there is no regular onsite work requirement.**Travel:** =========== Travel may be required periodically for company meetings, training, or other business needs. **Work Environment:** This job is performed in a professional remote or office environment. The role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, and other job\-related technology or systems. The team member may be required to sit for extended periods of time while working at a computer and communicating with internal and external business partners. **Physical Demands:** The team member is regularly required to listen, communicate verbally and in writing, sit for extended periods of time, use a computer and other office equipment, and occasionally lift up to 15 pounds at a time. **Other Duties:** **This job description is not designed to cover a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the team member for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may vary by location based on business needs and may change at any time with or without notice.** ======================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================= **EEO Statement:** ================== Lanter Delivery Systems provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all team members and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Lanter Delivery Systems complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. Lanter Delivery Systems expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. Improper interference with the ability of Lanter Delivery Systems team members to perform their job duties may result in discipline up to and including discharge.

jobs.description: ### **General Information** Req \# WD00108655 Career area: Artificial Intelligence Country/Region: United States of America State: North Carolina City: Morrisville Date: Tuesday, November 17, 2026 Working time: Full\-time **Additional Locations**: * United States of America \- North Carolina \- Morrisville ### **Why Work at Lenovo** We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers. Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked \#153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full\-stack portfolio of AI\-enabled, AI\-ready, and AI\-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world\-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992\) (ADR: LNVGY). This transformation together with Lenovo’s world\-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub. ### **Description and Requirements** The Lenovo AI Technology Center (LATC)—Lenovo’s global AI Center of Excellence—is driving our transformation into an AI\-first organization. We are assembling a world\-class team of researchers, engineers, and innovators to position Lenovo and its customers at the forefront of the generational shift toward AI. Lenovo is one of the world’s leading computing companies, delivering products across the entire technology spectrum, spanning wearables, smartphones (Motorola), laptops (ThinkPad, Yoga), PCs, workstations, servers, and services/solutions. This unmatched breadth gives us a unique canvas for AI innovation, including the ability to rapidly deploy cutting\-edge foundation models and to enable flexible, hybrid\-cloud, and agentic computing across our full product portfolio. To this end, we are building the next wave of AI core technologies and platforms that leverage and evolve with the fast\-moving AI ecosystem, including novel model and agentic orchestration \& collaboration across mobile, edge, and cloud resources. This space is evolving fast and so are we. If you’re ready to shape AI at a truly global scale, with products that touch every corner of life and work, there’s no better time to join us. **The role** We are looking for a first\-line engineering manager to lead our US team. You will be responsible for the people: their growth, their careers and how well they work together. You will also bring enough technical depth to guide the work: review plans and results, help the team choose sound approaches, and keep quality high. The team works closely with colleagues across Lenovo's global organization, so you will be a key link between the US team and partners in other regions. This is a people\-leadership role first. call\-flow debugging and protocol\-level troubleshooting across N1, N2, N3, N4, N6, N10, N11, and N12 interfaces. + Implement and support network slicing, policy control, and service function chaining. + Ensure compliance with relevant 3GPP specifications, security requirements, and interface protocols (e.g. HTTP/2, PFCP, SCTP). + Collaborate with RAN and infrastructure teams to support lab test\-cells, and limited production radio deployments where required. + Integrate, harden, and operate both vendor\-supplied and open\-source 5G core solutions (e.g. Open5GS, free5GC, Magma) in + Execute assigned technical workstreams within contracted wholesale customer projects, including deployment, integration, testing, and handover to operations. + Work under the direction of the Operations Centre (NOC) for live network incidents affecting wholesale and internal services. + Participate in escalation and support on\-call rotations as required. + Conduct root\-cause analysis, document findings, and implement corrective and preventative actions. * Skills Development + Continuously develop technical expertise across core network functions, infrastructure platforms, and emerging 3GPP features relevant to Limitless Mobile?s network roadmap. **Measurement:** * Performance will be assessed based on a combination of delivery effectiveness, operational stability, incident resolution time, change success rate, and successful deployment of wholesale customer solutions. **Desired Expertise \& Experience:** * Bachelor?s or Master?s degree in computer science or engineering. * Minimum of 5\-8 years working in the telecommunications industry designing, integrating and managing mobile core network propositions for e.g. a Network Equipment Provider or carrier / Mobile Network Operator (MNO). * Deep understanding of 5G Core architecture (SA/NSA), 3GPP specs, and control/user plane functions. * Experience with open source 5G cores like Open5GS, free5GC, or Magma. * Experience with Mongo database for opensource 5G solutions is a plus. * Programming in at least one of the C\+\+, Python, Golang, Bash, or equivalent languages. * Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), Git, and CI/CD tools. * Hands\-on experience with Wireshark, PCAP analysis, and log\-level debugging. * Minimum of five years of systems integration, management and/or technical support of 4G / LTE and 5G mobile core network components. * In\-depth knowledge of mobile voice and data core network architecture (including MNO and MVNO / MVNE infrastructure architecture) as well as network topology, including ability to describe the key elements of a mobile network and understand how the components function and interact as well as how mobile calls are made and received and how mobile data sessions work both in VoLTE and VoNR environments. * Understanding of Packet Switched network elements, interfaces and messaging for 4G / LTE networks, including IMS architectures and PCRF. * Understanding of Voice SIP / RTP, ISUP and voice convergence technologies, including IMS (including VoLTE and VoWiFi). * Understanding of RADIUS and Diameter for both signaling and charging scenarios. * Experience of capacity management and dimensioning of mobile core elements. * Familiarity with LI (Lawful Intercept), E911 and CALEA requirements. * Familiarity with IMS and VoNR architecture. * Demonstrated experience implementing and operationalizing technically robust mobile core network solutions aligned with customer, regulatory, and operational requirements. **Desired Personality:** * Entrepreneurial and proactive and accountable self\-starter, comfortable with taking ownership of complex technical problems and hunger to make a difference as
