jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Annotation UI
jobs.description: **About Mercor** ================ Mercor’s mission is to organize human intelligence for the AI economy. We build the infrastructure that enables frontier AI labs and enterprises to train, evaluate, and improve AI on real\-world professional work. More than five million experts have joined our network, and we pay out over $5 million daily for their knowledge and expertise. We built our training and evaluation infrastructure alongside the world’s leading AI labs. Now, we’re bringing those capabilities to enterprises across industries, enabling them to train, evaluate, and improve AI using their own expertise and standards. Our APEX benchmarks measure how AI performs on economically valuable work, while our enterprise evaluations and post\-training capabilities turn those insights into measurable improvements across real\-world workflows. Our work sits at the intersection of frontier AI, human expertise, and real\-world application. We’re solving problems few companies have encountered, with the opportunity to influence what the world’s most advanced AI systems become capable of doing. We’re looking for people who bring different perspectives, take ownership, exercise sound judgment, and hold themselves to an exceptionally high standard. You’ll have the opportunity to do consequential work alongside talented colleagues who challenge one another, collaborate openly, and share a commitment to excellence. Mercor is profitable and recently raised a $750 million Series D at a $20 billion valuation. We work in person five days a week in San Francisco, New York, and London. **About the Role** ------------------ Mercor produces training data for frontier AI labs, and two kinds of workers produce it today: human experts (doctors, lawyers, engineers, analysts) who write tasks, write rubrics, and judge quality, and synthetic pipelines, swarms of AI agents that build environments, generate tasks, and iterate until they pass our quality bar. Today these two sides barely work together. Experts face friction: they write specs, wait on pipelines, and redo work when an agent gets it wrong. Pipelines under\-use the expert, whose judgment is our most valuable signal. And nobody owns the system between the two. This is a role for a senior engineer who ships products people use, understands the infrastructure underneath them, and can reason across product, agent pipelines, research, and the business at the same time. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Define the interaction model between experts and agents: how an expert sees, steers, and corrects agent work, and how agents ask experts for input and use what they get. * Build the surfaces experts use every day inside Studio, our data platform. * Build the infrastructure that lets agents act on expert input in real time. * Own the metrics: expert time per unit of accepted data, share of expert input the pipelines use, and expert satisfaction and retention. * Work across product, synthetic pipelines, research, and go\-to\-market to connect what customers want, what experts need, and what makes data valuable for training models. * Set the bar for engineering quality and technical direction across the collaboration system. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 7\+ years of engineering experience building and shipping production products that people use. * Strong full\-stack product engineering skills, with a high bar for usability and empathy for end users. * Infrastructure experience: you can build both the surface and the pipes, including real\-time, high\-throughput, or pipeline\-based systems. * Ability to think across product, systems, and the business, and to understand where agent pipelines work and where they fail. * High ownership mindset; able to navigate ambiguity and drive projects from design through delivery. * Strong communication skills and ability to articulate technical and product tradeoffs clearly. **Nice\-to\-Haves** ------------------- * Experience building human\-in\-the\-loop AI workflows, or tooling for data labeling, annotation, or evaluation. * Experience building agentic systems or LLM\-powered products. * Familiarity with what makes data valuable for training and evaluating models. * Experience at top\-tier tech companies or fast\-scaling startups. **Why This Role Matters** ------------------------- * Nobody has solved how human experts and AI agents should work together to create data. This is a brand new product problem. * The system you build can become the operating system for expert work, well beyond training data. * Your work directly influences the training and evaluation of frontier AI models. * You'll shape the experience of thousands of experts and operators who use Studio every day. **Benefits:** * Generous equity grant vested over 4 years * Health, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) with company match * Unlimited paid vacation and sick days * Parental leave for birthing and non\-birthing parents * Free mental health services * $200 monthly wellness reimbursement * $1\.5K monthly meal stipend * $200 monthly laundry reimbursement * Free Equinox membership * Up to $15K relocation bonus Mercor is an **Equal Opportunity Employer** and is committed to providing equal opportunity to all employees and applicants. Mercor does not discriminate based on actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, related medical conditions and lactation), gender identity or gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, disability, protected medical condition as defined by California or local law, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, California, or local laws and ordinances. Further, Mercor prohibits discrimination, harassment, and retaliation based on any combination of protected characteristics. This Policy applies to all areas of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, compensation, benefits, discipline, termination, and all other privileges, terms, and conditions of employment. This Policy and the law prohibit employment discrimination against any employee or applicant based on any legally protected status. Compensation Range: $250K \- $400K

jobs.title: GTM Engineer
jobs.description: **About Mia Labs** ------------------ Mia is the AI communication platform for car dealerships. We answer and act on every inbound call, text and web lead so dealers stop losing service appointments and sales to voicemail. Franchise dealers and some of the largest dealer groups in the country run on Mia. **The Role:** ------------- You'll be our first GTM Engineer. You'll build the systems behind our account\-based motion and run the plays yourself, including ABM, gifting and direct mail. This is a hands\-on seat. You'll write the webhook on Monday and pick the gift on Tuesday. We want someone who'd rather ship a working play this week than write a spec about it. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Turn our tiered account list into a living model with actionable next steps and cadences. * Run ABM, gifting and direct mail end to end, from picking vendors and recipients to tracking every send to pipeline. * Build signal pipelines and route each signal to the right play, owning the campaigns and their outcomes * Ship agents, not just automations: account research, first\-touch drafts and inbound routing. * Run technical growth experiments the rest of the team can't build alone. * Own the scoreboard: pipeline from target accounts, meetings booked and manual hours removed. **What you bring** ------------------ * 3\+ years in GTM engineering, growth, ABM or RevOps at a B2B company. * You've personally run ABM, gifting or direct mail programs, not just built the data behind them. * Real Clay depth: waterfalls, AI research, scoring and CRM syncs you built and kept running. * You're technical. Our strength comes from diverse experiences, perspectives, and skills, and we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Passionate about the role but don’t tick every box? We’d still love to hear from you, you might be exactly who we need. Mia is an EVerify employer.

jobs.title: Engineer, Matching Software
jobs.description: Are you interested in joining a purpose\-driven company in the music industry? Do you thrive in a collaborative, hybrid work environment? While our foundation is rooted in music licensing and rights administration, the scale and complexity of the data we process\-billions of usage records from digital service providers\-has positioned The MLC at the intersection of music and technology. As we continue to build and refine the systems that power matching, royalty processing, and rights management, we are increasingly operating like a technology company, developing sophisticated platforms, data infrastructure, and automation to support the future of digital music licensing. **THE ROLE** As a Software Engineer, you will build, enhance, and maintain the workflows and systems that operationalize our machine learning models. You will focus on building data pipelines, orchestration workflows, APIs, and cloud infrastructure that support the matching process at scale. Working with other software engineer, data scientists and QA engineers, you will deliver reliable, well\-tested software and help improve the performance and maintainability of the Matching Platform. The Matching Platform is a critical tool that enables The MLC to drive accurate royalty payments to our Members. **QUALIFICATIONS:** * Minimum three (3\) years' experience as a Software Engineer working on production, data\-intensive applications or platforms. * Experience building and maintaining data pipelines, REST APIs, and background or workflow\-driven services. * Proficiency in Python, Java, or Node.js, with the ability to work effectively in an existing codebase. * Experience with relational databases; familiarity with large datastores or document/non\-relational databases. * Hands\-on AWS experience; exposure to CI/CD and infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Terraform is a plus. * Strong problem\-solving, collaboration, and communication skills, with a commitment to clear documentation and high\-quality delivery. **ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES** **AS A DEVELOPER AT THE MLC, YOU WILL:** * Build, test, and maintain workflows that support machine learning model deployment and operation. * Develop and enhance reliable data pipelines and REST APIs that support the Matching Platform's functionality. * Collaborate with data scientists to integrate models and data\-driven features into production systems. * Write maintainable, well\-tested code and contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment practices. * Troubleshoot production issues and contribute to monitoring, performance, and platform reliability. **AS A MEMBER OF THE TECHNOLOGY TEAM, YOU WILL:** * Advocate for quality throughout the development lifecycle, partnering with engineers to incorporate testing considerations early. * Contribute to the evolution of scalable, automated QA practices across the Technology organization. * Promote consistent standards for reliability, validation, and defect management. * Participate in Agile ceremonies, providing a quality\-focused perspective in planning and retrospectives. * Support continuous improvement of engineering practices as systems grow in complexity. **YOU WILL CHAMPION THE MLC'S CULTURE BY:** * Embracing The MLC's leadership values and applying The MLC's Guiding Principles to your team's work * Being process\-oriented, data\-driven, and tech\-savvy; being collaborative, curious, and open to new ideas * Building a dynamic team; mentoring team members; developing future leaders * Inspiring others with your enthusiasm and humility THE MLC IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER THE MLC DOES NOT MAKE EMPLOYMENT DECISIONS BASED ON RACE, COLOR, RELIGION OR RELIGIOUS BELIEF, ETHNIC OR NATIONAL ORIGIN, SEX, GENDER, GENDER\-IDENTITY, SEXUAL ORIENTATION, MARITAL STATUS, CITIZENSHIP STATUS, DISABILITY, AGE, MILITARY OR VETERAN STATUS, OR ANY OTHER CATEGORY PROTECTED BY LOCAL, STATE, OR FEDERAL LAW. Our network infrastructure teams are responsible for developing, deploying, and operating this complex system, covering the entire network lifecycle from hardware development to operation. FBOSS is a software team in the Network Infrastructure group that powers the network devices Meta runs. FBOSS stands for Facebook Open Switching System \- a software stack running on network switches across Meta's global network. We work on some of the most critical infrastructure challenges at Meta, including the networking switch platforms behind our AI clusters for large language models, recommendation systems, and the metaverse. This role exists to close that gap across platform, operating system, and data plane security. ### **Software Engineer, Embedded Systems Security Responsibilities:** * Own systems design spanning jobs.title: AI Trainer
jobs.description: **About Metis Strategy** Metis Strategy, a management and strategy consulting firm, focused on the intersection of business and technology, continues to grow and is looking for highly motivated individuals to join our San Francisco Bay Area team. We are trusted advisors to Fortune 500 and Global 1000 companies, helping them meet their most critical business objectives through tailored engagements and deep professional relationships. We work across industries on topics related to business \& digital strategy and navigating organizational change. We are an entrepreneurial, fast\-growing firm headquartered in the Washington, D.C. area with offices in the San Francisco Bay Area and Dallas, Texas. The firm’s presence from coast to coast allows us to serve clients throughout the United States and internationally. In our 20\+ year history, we have established a track record of making lasting impacts on organizational performance and helping executives improve business outcomes. In a career with Metis Strategy you will experience high growth as you encounter new challenges with each client engagement; have a high degree of autonomy to craft the direction of your work; and become empowered to work directly with thought\-leaders, C\-level clients, and other decision\-makers. ### **What We Look For** ### **Role summary** You will design and deliver hands\-on AI training for enterprise clients. Sessions are mostly virtual and run in 3–4 hour blocks across global time zones. Audiences range from executives to software engineers. Builder cohorts work in the labs themselves: skills, agents, MCP servers, coding agents, code review. Leader and enabler cohorts work on everyday workflows. You co\-facilitate with other Metis trainers and tailor the content to each client’s industry, tools and security requirements. You own keeping content current. Models, tools and pricing change quarterly, so you update materials before each cohort. ### **Must\-have** ### **Technical depth** * You have shipped LLM or agentic systems to production, not just prototyped them. You can show examples. * You are fluent in how agentic coding harnesses work: context files (CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md), skills, subagents, hooks, MCP and plugins. You have built a custom MCP server and an agent end to end. * You know the main ways to extend a model (prompting, RAG, fine\-tuning, self\-hosting) and can explain when to use each. * You understand agent security: prompt injection, least\-privilege tools, human\-in\-the\-loop and guardrails outside the model. * You can explain Tokenomics and cost control to both engineers and finance audiences. **Ecosystem breadth** * Hands\-on with Anthropic (Claude, Claude Code, Cowork), OpenAI (ChatGPT, Codex, SDKs), Microsoft (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Copilot Cowork, GitHub Copilot) and open\-weight models. * Working familiarity with Google (Gemini, Vertex), AWS (Bedrock), Cursor and the major agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, MS Agent Framework). **Teaching and facilitation** * You have taught live, technical, hands\-on sessions to groups, in person or virtual. * You pace a 4\-hour virtual session well: polls, breakouts, chat, energy management and a clean break structure. * You troubleshoot setup problems in locked\-down enterprise environments (Windows, WSL2, proxies, restricted installs, SSO and licensing) without losing the room. * You can explain complex concepts plainly to different audiences, and you stay calm when a live demo misbehaves. Models are non\-deterministic, so demos will sometimes fail. **People skills (observable)** * You read a remote room and adjust. You can tell who is lost, who is bored and who is already ahead. * You handle skepticism and job\-displacement anxiety directly, without dismissing it. * You are comfortable saying “I don’t know, let’s test it.” **Experience** * 10\+ years in software development, data/ML engineering, architecture or technical product work, with recent, practical experience building with LLMs. ### **Strong plus** * Consulting or client\-facing delivery experience, including working under a partner brand and co\-facilitating. * Governance and compliance fluency: responsible AI, data classification, and regional requirements such as the EU AI Act and data residency. * Evals and observability experience: building test sets, guardrails and monitoring for LLM applications. * Instructional design: building labs, measuring learning with pre/post assessments, and reinforcing it afterward (office hours, 30/60/90\-day follow\-through). * Change management or AI adoption experience, including connecting training to business outcomes and ROI. * Domain experience in a regulated or industrial sector (manufacturing, IT/OT, healthcare, financial services). * Experience authoring skills, plugins or reusable templates that a client team can maintain. ### **Nice to have** * Experience teaching across cultures and non\-native English audiences (for example India, EMEA and North America in the same program). * Public thought leadership: writing, talks or open\-source work. * Self\-hosted inference and fine\-tuning experience (vLLM, Ollama, LoRA/QLoRA). ### **What Metis Strategy Has to Offer** Successful candidates will be motivated by the desire to make a difference by helping our clients achieve and maintain strategic and operational excellence while continuously improving their own skill set and embracing emerging intellectual challenges. This position is also eligible for bonus compensation. Additional benefits include but are not limited to: * comprehensive medical insurance, dental insurance, and vision insurance; * parental leave, and family benefits; * retirement contributions; * stipend for continued learning; * paid time off, and more. Compensation and benefits are competitive and will be commensurate with each candidate’s qualifications and relevant work experience. If you are driven by the desire to help some of the world’s most renowned companies solve complex business problems and excited by the intersection of business strategy and technological innovation, you will enjoy being a part of our team. The pay range for this role is: 140,000 \- 220,000 USD per year (Remote (United States))

MTC provides services to the Association of Bay Area Governments (ABAG). For more information about MTC, visit www.mtc.ca.gov . **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER** The Metropolitan Transportation Commission is an equal\-opportunity, non\-discriminatory employer. MTC provides all employees and applicants with an equal opportunity in every aspect of the employment experience regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, physical handicap, medical condition or marital status. **DEADLINE TO APPLY IS SUNDAY, DECEMBER 13, 2026, AT 11:55 PM****IF YOU ARE INTERESTED, PLEASE APPLY IMMEDIATELY***A resume is required with your application**Be ready to rethink your assumptions about the public sector. Dedicated and motivated colleagues? Beautiful, high amenity building for on\-site work and collaboration? Flexible schedules and hybrid work options? Yes, yes, and yes!* **ABOUT THE ROLE** Under the direction of the Bay Area Toll Authority (BATA) Information Technology Manager, the Systems Administrator provides server, identity, email, and security administration in a primarily Windows Server and Azure environment with a small number of Linux systems. This is a broad role supporting multiple sites, with an emphasis on identity, security, and automation. The position will help build a new configuration standards and automation program and will support facility monitoring technology as new toll facilities come online. This is one of two systems administrator positions on a small IT infrastructure team within the Capital Delivery, Asset Management, and Roadside Tolling (CART) section, alongside network engineers and a technical project manager. Responsibilities are divided between the two administrators and reviewed as the work changes. scalable identity solutions across on\-premises and cloud environments. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, implement, administer, and support enterprise Identity and Access Management technologies and services. * Engineer and maintain authentication solutions utilizing Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, MFA, passwordless authentication, and hardware security keys such as YubiKey. * Support identity lifecycle processes including joiner, mover, and leaver (JML) workflows, account provisioning, deprovisioning, and entitlement management. * Develop and maintain integrations between enterprise applications and identity platforms using technologies such as SAML 2\.0, OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SCIM, LDAP, and REST APIs. * Engineer and support Single Sign\-On (SSO) and federated authentication integrations for SaaS, cloud, and internally hosted applications. * Administer and enhance Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) and passwordless authentication technologies. * processes, including access reviews, access certifications, role management, entitlement governance, and segregation\-of\-duties controls. * Develop automation for identity lifecycle, provisioning, access management, and operational processes using technologies such as PowerShell, APIs, and workflow automation. * Support and troubleshoot Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID authentication, authorization, group membership, service account, and identity\-related issues. * Assist with the development and implementation of Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) and least\-privilege access models. * Identify excessive, inappropriate, stale, or unnecessary access and work with business and technology owners to remediate identified risks. * Support cybersecurity incident investigations involving compromised credentials, suspicious authentication, privilege escalation, account misuse, or other identity\-related activity. * Perform periodic reviews of IAM configurations and processes to identify security weaknesses and opportunities for improvement. * Create and maintain technical documentation, diagrams, standards, procedures, and operational runbooks. * Support internal and external audits by providing IAM evidence, technical documentation, and explanations of identity controls. * Evaluate emerging identity technologies and recommend enhancements to strengthen the organization's identity security posture. * Work collaboratively with cybersecurity and IT teams to integrate identity security controls into new technologies, applications, and cloud services. * Participate in after\-hours support or incident response activities when required. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Required Qualifications** * Strong understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM) principles, architecture, and security practices. * Experience administering or engineering enterprise identity technologies such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Active Directory, or comparable IAM platforms. * Experience with authentication and federation technologies such as SAML, OAuth, OIDC, LDAP, Kerberos, and MFA. * Experience implementing or supporting SSO and application federation. * Understanding of identity lifecycle management, account provisioning/deprovisioning, group management, and access controls. * Working knowledge of Privileged Access Management (PAM) concepts and technologies. * Understanding of cybersecurity principles including least privilege, Zero Trust, RBAC, privileged access, and defense in depth. * Experience troubleshooting complex authentication and authorization issues. * Ability to automate administrative or identity processes using PowerShell, scripting, REST APIs, or similar technologies. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to work effectively with cybersecurity, infrastructure, application, cloud, and business teams. * Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently with minimal supervision. **Experience** * **4\+ years** of experience in Information Technology, systems administration, identity, or a related technical field. * **2\+ years** of experience supporting Identity and Access Management, cybersecurity, or identity\-related technologies. **Preferred Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. * Experience with Okta Workforce Identity administration and application integrations. * Experience with Microsoft Entra ID / Microsoft 365 identity security. * Experience with CyberArk or another enterprise PAM platform. * Experience implementing passwordless authentication, FIDO2 security keys, or YubiKey. * Experience with Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) platforms and access certification processes. * Experience in integrating applications with IAM platforms using SAML, OIDC, OAuth, and SCIM. * Experience working within a regulated environment such as banking or financial services. * Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks and regulatory requirements such as NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST SP 800\-63, FFIEC guidance, and Zero Trust architecture. * Relevant certifications such as: * + Okta Certified Professional / and engineering efficiency. * Take ownership of features and projects throughout the software development lifecycle, demonstrating accountability, initiative, and a results\-oriented mindset. * jobs.title: AWS/Databricks Cloud Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About Moser** =============== For more than 25 years we have formed partnerships and grown through open and honest collaboration with our clients, partners, and employees. We are best known for taking great care of our clients, our dedication to creating a work environment where employees do their best work, and our deep commitment to continuous improvement. Our consultants work in a collaborative and fast\-paced environment, are self\-motivated, and are passionate about evolving technology. It is no accident that we are recognized as one of the Best Places to Work in Indiana for 10 consecutive years. Internally, we believe in building strong teams from the top down with a focus on values in our Model\-Coach\-Care philosophy. Our leadership are encouraged and trained to model good practices, mentor other employees and each other, and show empathy and caring in all interactions. This is the base of our core values: Accountability, Balance, Collaboration, Focus, Integrity, Social Responsibility, Support and Transparency. Moser Consulting believes in equal opportunity for all people and is committed to enabling a diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture. We foster a spirit of unity that respects the remarkable individuality of everyone's culture, history, and service. **Description** =============== We are seeking a Senior Cloud Data Engineer to join our consulting team. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and acquisition workflows across cloud and on\-premises environments, contributing to the full spectrum of data engineering – from ingestion through transformation and delivery. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to translate business requirements into robust data solutions, while upholding best practices in architecture, cloud infrastructure, documentation, and continuous improvement. This position sits within our genomics organization, providing senior\-level, strategic technical leadership alongside two existing engineers to build out AWS\-based data pipelines that support genomic data science models — hands\-on, production AWS pipeline\-building experience is the top priority for this role. **Role Responsibilities** ========================= * Participate in team stand\-ups and other agile ceremonies to support project delivery * Assist in building and maintaining data acquisition pipelines from diverse sources including databases, flat\-files, and REST APIs * Leverage development design patterns and best practices across workloads. * Support data modeling efforts including dimensional models and semantic layers for analytics under senior guidance * Proactively troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures, query performance issues, data quality concerns, notebook timeouts, data model inconsistencies, semantic model refresh errors, and capacity throttling using monitoring tools and query optimization techniques * Participate in requirement gathering meetings and translate business needs into technical specifications * Engage in ongoing learning through online trainings, certifications, and mentorship opportunities * Create and maintain technical documentation, operational documentation, data flow diagrams, and data mapping documents * Collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams and communicate progress to technical and non\-technical stakeholders * Build and maintain AWS\-native pipelines (Lambda, ECS, EKS, S3\) that ingest and store genomic data retrieved via API calls * Generate and manage sequencing and post\-sequencing data processing workflows in support of genomics data science models **Requirements** ================ * Top priority: proven, hands\-on experience designing and building AWS\-based data pipelines end\-to\-end (API ingestion through storage and delivery) * Must\-have: hands\-on experience working with High Performance Computing (HPC) clusters * Experience with dimensional modeling, SCDs, and medallion architecture * Previous cloud experience required; AWS preferred with hands\-on exposure to Lambda, S3, and Docker * Experience implementing and managing role\-based access control (RBAC), including group/permissions management for secure system access * Strong Python experience across pipeline development, ETL, and data engineering tasks, with exposure to complex datasets from disparate batch and streaming sources and an emphasis on low latency, high throughput, and cost\-efficiency; pandas experience a plus * Leveraging SQL and python data tooling develop scalable, optimized ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, and load large, complex datasets from disparate sources (batch and streaming). Streamlining for low latency, high throughput and cost\-efficiency. * Experience with API development in both consumer and producer capacities (REST APIs) * CI/CD experience with modern DevOps tooling and deployment pipelines * Experience with API\-based access patterns for retrieving and integrating data from external systems * Lambda functions must be developed and deployed via code/infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g., CloudFormation, Terraform, CDK, SAM) — GUI/console\-based Lambda creation is not acceptable * Hands\-on experience with Amazon ECS and/or EKS for container orchestration * Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies quickly and apply them to solve problems * Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing high\-quality work * Excellent oral and written communication skills * Professionalism and ethics including trust, positive attitude, commitment, honesty, collaboration, and approachability * Proven ability to adapt in a fast\-paced consulting environment, including managing time effectively and handling multiple tasks simultaneously **Preferred Skills** ==================== * Experience with version control systems (Git) and agile development frameworks * Design and document end\-to\-end testing plans for Python\-based applications * PySpark experience for large\-scale distributed data processing * Experience with Datadog or similar observability and monitoring platforms * Familiarity with Dagster or other modern data orchestration frameworks * Terraform or infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) experience for cloud resource provisioning * Database experience with databases such as AWS RDS, MySQL, or PostgreSQL * Familiarity with D3\.js for building custom data visualizations **Where You'll Work** ===================== Moser Consulting has 2 local, Indianapolis, IN offices. on\-call easier. * Help manage technical debt by consolidating approaches and making pragmatic decisions about what to improve and when. * Write clear design documents, provide thoughtful code reviews, and keep documentation current for the systems you own. * Collaborate effectively with teammates across time zones. ### **What We're Looking For:** * 4\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including building and operating backend or distributed services in production. * Proficiency with AI tools and automation, including AI\-assisted coding. * Strong coding skills in Go or a similar language (such as Java, Python, or Rust) and a willingness to work in Go. * Experience building and operating services on AWS, including serverless services such as Lambda and infrastructure as code such as Terraform. * Understanding of networking and security fundamentals, including TLS, certificates, and authentication between services and devices. * Experience with monitoring, logging, and alerting, and a habit of instrumenting the systems you build. * Ability to debug issues across system boundaries and explain findings in plain language. * Clear written communication skills, including the ability to write design documents that teammates in other time zones can act on. * Preferred: Experience with Ruby. * Preferred: Working knowledge of messaging and streaming systems such as MQTT and Kafka. * Preferred: Experience with connected devices, IoT platforms, or firmware delivery. * Preferred: Experience with Kubernetes, stream processing frameworks such as Flink, or factory provisioning flows for hardware products. *Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of Motive's core values. jobs.title: Sr Cyber Event Analyst (Shift: 8:45 AM EST to 5 PM EST)
jobs.description: **Company Description** NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world\-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad\-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry\-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations \& Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information. Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world. **Job Description** NBCUniversal’s Cyber Defense Operations team provides cyber threat intelligence, security event analysis, incident response, threat hunting, and detection and response capabilities across the enterprise. As a member of the Cyber Response team, the **Senior Cyber Event Analyst** will serve as a senior technical investigator responsible for identifying, analyzing, scoping, and responding to cybersecurity events. This role requires an analyst who can **go beyond the alert**. The successful candidate will dive into underlying security telemetry, correlate activity across multiple data sources, develop and test investigative hypotheses, and determine the actual risk and potential impact of security events. The analyst will also help engineer and improve SOAR playbooks, investigation workflows, and response processes. This is a shift\-based role supporting NBCUniversal’s 24x7 Cyber Defense operation and includes participation in an on\-call rotation; including the need to cover Company holidays. **Key Responsibilities** * Manage and prioritize the queue including the Cyber hotline * Perform advanced triage, investigation, scoping, and disposition of security events across **endpoint, identity, network, cloud, application, and email environments**. * Go beyond surfaced alerts by querying and analyzing **underlying logs and telemetry** to validate detections, reconstruct activity, determine scope, and identify potential impact. * Correlate evidence across **SIEM, EDR/XDR, identity, DNS, proxy, firewall, WAF, cloud, email, application, and threat intelligence data sources**. * Conduct **hypothesis\-driven investigations**, identifying the additional evidence required to confirm or disprove malicious activity. * Assess security risk based on technical evidence, including **affected identities and assets, privileges, persistence, lateral movement, data access, exposure, and business context**. * Develop clear, evidence\-backed dispositions documenting investigative findings, scope, confidence, risk, and recommended response actions. * Maps observed attacker behaviors and techniques to **MITRE ATT\&CK** and other applicable security frameworks. * Collect and preserve endpoints, identity, network, cloud, and application artifacts to support investigations. * **Design, build, test, troubleshoot, and maintain SOAR playbooks and investigation workflows** for enrichment, evidence collection, containment, and response. * Translate manual investigation procedures into scalable automation using **APIs, Python, PowerShell, JSON, or similar technologies**. * Identify gaps/tuning opportunities in detection logic, telemetry, logging, and response processes and partner with Detection Engineering to implement improvements. * Perform technical peer reviews and mentor analysts on investigative methodology, query development and telemetry analysis. * Maintain detailed investigation records, technical runbooks, and shift handoffs to ensure continuity and analytical rigor. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, relevant certifications, **or equivalent professional experience**. * **4\+ years of hands\-on cybersecurity experience** in SOC, Incident Response, Threat Hunting, Detection Engineering, or Cyber Defense. * Demonstrated ability to independently investigate complex security events **beyond the information provided in the initial alert**. * Hands\-on experience querying and analyzing security telemetry using **SIEM, security data lake, and/or log analytics platforms**. * Experience correlating data across endpoints, identity, network, cloud, email, and application security technologies. * Strong understanding of **Windows/Linux, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, identity and authentication, enterprise networking, APIs, and cloud infrastructure**. * Experience investigating threats such as **credential compromise, malware, phishing/BEC, endpoint or network intrusion, suspicious cloud activity, and unauthorized data access**. * Working knowledge of **MITRE ATT\&CK and incident response methodologies**. * Experience developing, modifying, or troubleshooting **SOAR playbooks and security automation workflows**. * Experience with **Python, PowerShell, APIs, or similar scripting and automation technologies**. * Ability to clearly distinguish and communicate **confirmed evidence, analytical conclusions, risk, assumptions, and investigative gaps**. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical findings to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to support shift\-based operations and participate in on\-call rotation. * Ability to cover Company holidays to ensure 24x7 all year\-round coverage. **Desired Characteristics** * Experience with query languages such as **KQL, SPL, SQL, or equivalent**. * Experience analyzing **Windows Event Logs, Sysmon, EDR telemetry, authentication logs, DNS, network telemetry, cloud audit logs, and application logs**. * Experience with endpoint/network forensics, packet analysis, or attack\-path reconstruction. * Advanced experience developing **SOAR automation, API integrations, or analyst enrichment tools**. * Experience supporting Cyber Defense or Incident Response within a **large, globally distributed enterprise or Media and Entertainment organization**. * Relevant technical certifications such as **GCIH, GCFA, GIAC, or equivalent**. **Additional Requirements** **Fully Remote**: This position has been designated as fully remote, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non\-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence. This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $90,000 \- $120,000 We are accepting applications for this position on an ongoing basis. **Additional Information** As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in\-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access nbcunicareers.com as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by emailing AccessibilitySupport@nbcuni.com. For LA County and City Residents Only: NBCUniversal will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories, or arrest or conviction records, in a manner consistent with relevant legal requirements, including the City of Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative For Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, where applicable.

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, Edge
jobs.description: **About NCR VOYIX** **NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform\-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end\-to\-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.** ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, Edge** ========================================== **Atlanta, Georgia • Professional Services • Customer\-facing technical leadership** ==================================================================================== **Help shape the future of technology in retail.** Work with leading retailers to design and deliver Edge Kubernetes\-based containerized solutions across complex, distributed store environments. **About NCR Voyix Edge** At NCR Voyix, we're changing how retailers deploy and manage technology across their stores. NCR Voyix Edge is our Kubernetes\-based platform designed for retail environments. It enables retailers to centrally manage and operate containerized applications deployed across hundreds or thousands of locations, while simplifying the infrastructure required within each store. **The Opportunity** We're looking for an **Edge** **Kubernetes Solution Architect** to join our Professional Services team and help customers successfully adopt this technology. This is a hands\-on, customer\-facing architecture role. You'll understand customer environments, design the right end\-to\-end solution and lead implementation from discovery through pilot and production rollout. We're not looking for someone who already knows every technology we use. We're looking for strong technical foundations, experience with modern infrastructure or application platforms, confidence working with customers, and the curiosity and ability to learn. **What You'll Do** **Lead customer engagements** * Own the technical solution across customer Edge engagements, from discovery and architecture through deployment and transition to operations. * Act as a trusted advisor, guiding customers through architecture choices, dependencies, risks and deployment strategy. * Work directly with customer infrastructure, application, networking and security teams. * Coordinate technical delivery across Professional Services, Solution Architecture, Product and Engineering. * Create practical solution designs, implementation plans, runbooks and technical documentation. * Communicate recommendations clearly to engineers, architects, programmer stakeholders and executives. **Design and guide implementation** * Design end\-to\-end Kubernetes\-based solutions for geographically distributed retail environments. * Help customers onboard, migrate and operate containerized applications on NCR Voyix Edge. * Implement repeatable deployment patterns, automation workflows and operational practices. * Guide decisions covering infrastructure, networking, storage, security and observability. * Lead technical troubleshooting across applications, platforms and infrastructure. * Support pilots and proof\-of\-concepts that demonstrate the solution in the customer's environment. **Improve the platform and delivery approach** * Build lab and proof\-of\-concept environments to solve real customer challenges. * Translate deployment experience and customer feedback into actionable input for Product Management and Engineering. * Capture lessons learned and turn them into reusable standards, tools and implementation practices. * Share knowledge and mentor colleagues across the Professional Services organization. * Stay current with Kubernetes, cloud\-native technologies, Edge computing and retail technology. **What We're Looking For** We're primarily looking for someone who is technically strong, comfortable leading customer conversations and motivated by solving difficult problems. * Experience designing, delivering or supporting complex enterprise technology solutions in a customer\-facing role. * The ability to explain technical subjects clearly to technical and business audiences. * Practical knowledge of Kubernetes and/or container technologies such as Docker. * Strong foundations in Linux, infrastructure, virtualization, cloud or cloud\-native platforms. * A good understanding of enterprise networking fundamentals, including IP networking, DNS, DHCP, routing and firewalls. * Experience troubleshooting issues that span multiple systems and technology domains. * Some experience with automation, scripting or infrastructure tooling. * Confidence influencing stakeholders and bringing multiple technical teams together. * A willingness to learn and become a subject matter expert in NCR Voyix Edge. **You don't need to tick every box.** If you have strong experience in Kubernetes, **Technologies You May Work With** Kubernetes • Linux • Containers • Docker • Helm • Git • GitOps • Bash • Python • Cloud platforms • Virtualization • Networking • Observability Experience with all of these is not expected. Experience with one or more is valuable, and we will help you develop knowledge in areas that are new to you. **Nice to Have, but Not Essential** * Knowledge of distributed infrastructure or Edge computing architectures. * Experience operating Kubernetes in a production environment. * Familiarity with Helm, Flux or other Kubernetes deployment tooling. * Public cloud experience with Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure or AWS. * Experience with observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic or OpenTelemetry. * Experience in retail, hospitality or another large multi\-site environment. * Experience helping enterprise customers through infrastructure or application modernization. **What Success Looks Like** Success in this role is not about knowing every technology on day one. It is about becoming someone customers trust when undertaking significant technology change. You'll be able to understand a complex environment, define a practical solution, bring together the right people and technologies, and lead the implementation through to a successful production outcome. Over time, you'll become an expert in NCR Voyix Edge and play an important role in helping retailers deploy the next generation of applications across their stores. Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job **EEO Statement** Integrated into our shared values is NCR Voyix’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, military service, genetic information, or any other characteristic or conduct protected by law. We believe in understanding and respecting differences among all people. Every individual at NCR Voyix has an ongoing responsibility to respect and support a globally diverse environment. **Statement to Third Party Agencies** To ALL recruitment agencies: NCR Voyix only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. NCR Voyix is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes *“When applying for a job, please make sure to only open emails that you will receive during your application process that come from a @ncrvoyix.com email domain.”*

jobs.title: AI Forward Engineer
jobs.description: **Role Overview** As an **AI Forward Engineer**, you will operate at the intersection of deep software engineering, customer operations, and product strategy. Unlike standard back\-office ML engineers who build foundational algorithms, you will be embedded on the front lines to solve real\-world, high\-impact business challenges. You will work directly with enterprise stakeholders to identify operational bottlenecks, design custom AI solutions leveraging LLM tool\-calling and RAG architectures, and integrate these systems into complex legacy infrastructure and Navan's API suite. **What You'll Do:** * **Bridge Pilot\-to\-Production:** Build, test, and ship production\-ready AI agents and autonomous workflows that streamline travel booking, expense policy auditing, and financial reconciliation. * **Translate Business to Code:** Engage directly with internal operational teams and external enterprise clients to audit complex manual workflows and codify "tribal knowledge" into custom software solutions. * **Architect \& Integrate:** Integrate advanced LLM pipelines, vector databases, and agentic frameworks into Navan's core backend platforms, enterprise data lakes, and third\-party ERP/HRIS systems (e.g., SAP, NetSuite, Workday). * **Rapid Prototyping \& Feedback Loops:** Develop proof\-of\-concepts (POCs) on\-site or in close collaboration with end\-users, gather real\-time usage data, and iterate rapidly to maximize user adoption and business impact. * **Governance \& Security:** Ensure all custom AI solutions comply with strict enterprise data privacy standards, SOC 2 compliance, and financial auditing frameworks. * **Collaborate with Core Product Teams:** Act as a critical feedback loop to Navan's core Product and AI Engineering teams, bringing real\-world edge cases and customer requirements into the core platform roadmap. **What We're Looking For:** * 4\+ years of experience in software engineering, technical consulting, forward deployed engineering, or solutions architecture. * Experience in corporate travel, fintech, expense management, or enterprise SaaS domains are a plus. * Familiarity with enterprise compliance, audit logs, and security protocols surrounding generative AI. * Strong proficiency in **Python**, **TypeScript/JavaScript**, or **Go**, along with solid experience with REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, and asynchronous architecture. * Hands\-on experience building with modern AI stacks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI/Anthropic APIs), agentic architectures (tool\-calling, multi\-agent frameworks), and RAG pipelines (vector databases like Pinecone, Weaviate, or Qdrant). * Proficiency in SQL, data pipeline integration, containerization (**Docker**, **Kubernetes**), and cloud deployment platforms (**AWS**, **GCP**, or **Azure**). * Ability to design scalable, secure, and fault\-tolerant enterprise software integrations. Navan uses AI\-assisted Automated Employment Decision Tool (Metaview) to assist with evaluating resumes against job qualifications for this role. jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description: **Join NELLSON and Become Part of a Winning Team of Professionals!** We currently have an immediate opportunity for an **Network Engineer** to join at our team. Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to: **POSITION SUMMARY:** The Network Engineer is a technical contributor responsible for designing, implementing, securing, optimizing, and supporting Nellson LLC’s enterprise network across manufacturing sites, offices, data centers, remote locations, and cloud environments. This role ensures resilient, high\-performing connectivity for business\-critical applications, users, facilities, and operational technology. The successful candidate brings advanced, hands\-on expertise in Cisco enterprise switching, Palo Alto Networks next\-generation firewalls, Aruba wireless, and cloud networking concepts. The engineer applies zero\-trust principles, network segmentation, NIST and CIS guidance, and vendor best practices to reduce risk while meeting availability, performance, and service\-level objectives. The Network Engineer owns solutions spanning LAN, WAN, wireless, internet connectivity, remote access, DNS/DHCP/IPAM, network access control, firewalls, and hybrid\-cloud connectivity. The role partners with infrastructure, security, cloud, applications, service desk, business, plant, and vendor teams; provide Level 3 escalation support; and drives automation, observability, documentation, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement. **KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Design and implement scalable, highly available campus, datacenter, branch, manufacturing, and cloud network architectures. * Configure, optimize, and troubleshoot advanced Cisco switching environments, including VLANs, trunks, spanning tree, link aggregation, routing adjacencies, redundancy, quality of service, and network segmentation. * Engineer and administer Palo Alto Networks firewalls, including security and NAT policies, zones, routing, Global Protect, high availability, logging, threat\-prevention capabilities, and secure change control. * Design, deploy, and optimize Aruba wireless solutions, including controllers or gateways, access points, RF performance, secure authentication, roaming, guest access, and centralized management. * Design and support hybrid\-cloud networking, including virtual networks, subnets, route tables, network security controls, private endpoints, load balancing, DNS, site\-to\-site VPN, and dedicated connectivity concepts. * Operate and improve WAN, internet, remote\-access, DNS, DHCP, IP address management, and network access control services. * Lead complex incident response and root\-cause analysis for availability, latency, packet loss, routing, wireless, firewall, and application\-connectivity issues. * Build monitoring, alerting, capacity, configuration\-backup, and performance\-management practices that improve network reliability and reduce time to resolution. * Use scripting, APIs, templates, and infrastructure\-as\-code or automation tools to standardize deployments, validate configurations, and reduce manual effort. * Maintain accurate diagrams, standards, inventories, configurations, support procedures, recovery documentation, and audit evidence. * Follow IT service\-management and security processes for change, incident, problem, vulnerability, lifecycle, and configuration management. * Evaluate technology, licensing, support agreements, vendors, and implementation proposals; provide recommendations based on risk, cost, scalability, and business value. * Partner with technical and business stakeholders, mentor network administrators, and provide clear technical leadership during projects and service disruptions. * Participate in an after\-hours support rotation and planned maintenance windows, and travel to remote sites as needed, up to 10%. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * Five or more years of progressive enterprise network engineering experience supporting multi\-site, business\-critical environments. * **Advanced\-level, hands\-on Cisco switching expertise**, including Layer 2 and Layer 3 design, VLANs, 802\.1Q, spanning tree, link aggregation, routing protocols, quality of service, access control lists, and resilient campus or data\-center designs. * **Advanced\-level, hands\-on Palo Alto Networks firewall expertise**, including policy design, NAT, routing, App\-ID, User\-ID, Global Protect, high availability, Panorama or centralized management, logging, and troubleshooting. * **Advanced\-level, hands\-on Aruba wireless expertise**, including enterprise WLAN design, RF fundamentals, controllers or gateways, access points, secure authentication, roaming, guest access, performance analysis, and Aruba Central or comparable management platforms. * **Advanced understanding of cloud networking concepts** in Azure, AWS, or a comparable platform, including virtual networks, subnets, route tables, network security controls, private connectivity, VPNs, load balancing, DNS, and hybrid\-cloud routing. * Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, IPv4, DNS, DHCP, IP address management, BGP, OSPF, VPN technologies, network access control, packet analysis, and network monitoring. * Working knowledge of security frameworks and practices, including network segmentation, least privilege, zero trust, vulnerability remediation, NIST, and CIS guidance. * Experience with automation or scripting using tools such as PowerShell, Python, APIs, configuration templates, Git, or infrastructure as code. * Ability to create clear network diagrams, standards, procedures, implementation plans, test plans, and executive or operational communications. * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * Experience supporting networks in manufacturing, distribution, or other operationally critical environments. * Experience with Cisco Catalyst, Aruba Central, Palo Alto Panorama, and enterprise monitoring or configuration\-management tools. * Cloud networking experience in Microsoft Azure and familiarity with cloud security, connectivity, and landing\-zone design principles. * Relevant current certifications such as Cisco CCNP Enterprise, Palo Alto Networks PCNSE, Aruba ACMP or equivalent, or an Azure or AWS networking certification. * Experience with disaster recovery, network lifecycle planning, carrier management, and vendor or managed\-service oversight. **Why Join Nellson?** At Nellson, we invest in talented individuals and provide opportunities for continuous learning, professional growth, and career advancement. Our state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facilities and collaborative culture create an environment where employees can thrive and make a meaningful impact. **We Offer:** * Competitive Pay * Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance * Generous Paid Time Off * 401(k) with Company Match * Professional Development Opportunities * Tuition Reimbursement * Employee Recognition Programs * Career Growth Opportunities * And Much More! Learn more about Nellson and our culture at **www.nellsonllc.com.** **Apply Today!** Take the next step in your career and join a team dedicated to quality, innovation, and operational excellence. Apply today and discover how you can make an impact at Nellson. **EEO \& Compliance Statement** **EEO \& Compliance Statement** The Company complies with all California and federal employment laws and is an Equal Opportunity Employer. **Employment Disclaimer** This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications and does not alter the at\-will employment relationship where applicable.

jobs.title: Software Engineer 5, AI Observability
jobs.description: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode \- pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting\-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next. **The Opportunity** ------------------- The AI Observability team makes AI, ML, and Agentic systems transparent, reliable, and production\-ready at scale. We build end\-to\-end observability for ML and GenAI workloads, capturing model inputs, features, predictions, outcomes, and behavior across online and batch systems. Our platform enables teams to monitor model performance, data quality, drift, latency, and failures, turning the ML system from a black box into an explainable, debuggable system. We provide developer\-friendly libraries, dashboards, and alerts so teams can debug issues, respond to incidents, and ship AI\-powered products with confidence. We're looking for a hands\-on senior engineer to build the frameworks behind Netflix's AI Observability platform, model performance, evaluation, and vendor integration surfaces. You will design reusable infrastructure that enables ML/AI practitioners across domains to monitor model quality in production, evaluate LLM and agentic systems, and adopt vendor tooling through a consistent, self\-serve platform. AIP owns the generic, reusable infrastructure; domain teams own their domain\-specific evals and remediation. You will partner closely with engineering, product, machine learning, and data teams to turn their needs into reusable platform capabilities. To succeed, you will bring a strong background in AI or ML infrastructure and a passion for building scalable, robust systems. **In this role, you will:** --------------------------- * Build the observability framework and platform capabilities that give ML and GenAI systems metrics, logs, and distributed traces across online inference, batch scoring, feature pipelines, and agent orchestration, so teams can instrument their systems consistently. * Build the primitives that let teams monitor model performance (accuracy, calibration, error rates), data quality, drift, and degradation on their own systems, rather than monitoring individual models yourself. * Build and extend evaluation frameworks for LLM and agentic systems that support response quality, grounding and hallucination, task success, tool\-use and trajectory correctness, and LLM\-as\-a\-judge and human\-in\-the\-loop scoring, giving teams reusable building blocks to define and run their own evals. * Lead build\-vs\-buy evaluations for observability and eval tooling, and own the SDKs, connectors, and APIs that integrate vendor platforms into a consistent, well\-supported interface, so ML and product teams can onboard models and agents with minimal friction. * Build reusable libraries, SDKs, and templates that make observability and evaluation the default for new systems ("observability\-by\-default"), lowering the barrier for teams to instrument and evaluate their work. * Provide the dashboarding, alerting, and SLO/SLI building blocks (plus sensible out\-of\-the\-box templates) that teams use to track model performance, latency, cost, and reliability. **To succeed in this role, you will need:** ------------------------------------------- * Experience in software, AI/ML, or platform engineering, with hands\-on time in production observability, monitoring, or ML/LLM evaluation * Proven track record of designing standards, libraries, SDKs, or frameworks that other teams build on and adopt, reflecting a platform and enablement mindset rather than shipping features for a single use case. * Strong coding skills in Python and at least one of Java, Go, or Scala, with experience building production services * Practical experience operating ML models in production (online serving and/or batch), including drift, model performance, and data quality. * Hands\-on experience with modern observability stacks (e.g., Prometheus/Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, ELK/OpenSearch, Jaeger/Tempo, or similar). * Solid understanding of distributed systems, microservices, and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure). * Ability to work cross\-functionally with ML, data, infra, and product teams, and to communicate clearly about system behavior, quality, and risk. * Experience with vendor integration and VPC deployment. * An AI\-Native Engineering Mindset who uses AI tools as a core part of their own workflow to accelerate design, development, testing, and code review. **Nice to have:** ----------------- * Hands\-on experience with ML/LLM observability and evaluation tools (e.g., Arize, Braintrust, LangFuse, Weights \& Biases, Galileo, Vertex AI Model Monitoring, SageMaker Model Monitor). * Experience building or shipping LLM/GenAI applications and evaluating them: prompt/result logging, evaluation metrics, LLM\-as\-a\-judge, and human\-in\-the\-loop review. * Experience evaluating agentic systems: tool use, multi\-step reasoning, and trajectory/task\-success measurement. To learn more about our AI Platform, you can review the relevant talks/blog posts on the Netflix AI Platform Research website . Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $500,000\.00 \- $860,000\.00\. This compensation range will vary based on location. Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family\-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full\-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full\-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here . Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here . Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner. We are an equal\-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service. Job is open for no less than 7 days and will be removed when the position is filled.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: Netic is the AI revenue engine for essential services who are the backbone of the American economy. **With $43M in funding from Founders Fund, Greylock, Hanabi, and Dylan Field who led our Series B, we helped our customers book hundreds of thousands of jobs across services industries in North America.** There are now companies operating entirely AI\-first on Netic. You’ll join our team with relentless builders from Scale, Databricks, HRT, Meta, MIT, Stanford, and Harvard in bringing frontier AI to the physical economy, where the problems are hard, the data is complex, and the impact is immediate and tangible. As an Applied AI Engineer, you’ll dive deep into cutting\-edge research, understand the business functions we put on autopilot inside\-out, and execute targeted ML projects that deliver pure magic. **What You'll Do:** * **Study the frontier:** Track frontier work in traditional ML, LLMs, multimodal models, retrieval, and agentic systems—then distill it into ideas we can ship. * **Identify high‑ROI projects:** Partner with GTM and ops teams to spot bottlenecks in products;
