jobs.title: Applications Programmer
jobs.description: Become an integral member of a dedicated team focused on improving the quality of life among citizens in southeastern and south\-central West Virginia. New River Community Technical College provides comprehensive, quality higher education, workforce training and community education programs and services. We aspire to make a difference in the communities in which we serve! We are seeking an enthusiastic professional Applications Programmer. **This is an on\-site position**. Because of our commitment to community, employment preference is given to residents who live in WV and the New River Community Technical College service area of Braxton, Fayette, Greenbrier, Mercer, Nicholas, Pocahontas, Raleigh, and Summers, West Virginia counties. The individual in this position may have the flexibility to choose anyone of our campus locations (Raleigh County Campus, Greenbrier County Campus, Nicholas County Campus or Mercer County Campus) as their primary work location. This position reports directly to the Director, Information Security. The position will work collaboratively with management, faculty and staff within the department and college to serve the best interests of the students. This role is full\-time exempt, position and serves at the will and pleasure of the College President. We offer a competitive benefit and compensation package as well as 401 K employer contributions and a robust vacation and sick leave accrual plan. New River Community and Technical College provides a work environment dedicated to helping our students achieve academic and career goals. If you are interested in making a difference in students' lives, we want to hear from you to discuss this opportunity! **Job Summary** This position will add capacity to handle increasing demands and surges in technical issues related to student\-facing systems like Handbrake (career readiness), Brainfuse (tutoring), DropGuard (retention), Udemy (self\-paced learning) and DegreeWorks (academic planning). By managing these evolving student resources (e.g., authentication issues, account privilege information, new AI features, and guiding users through the specific procedural steps required to complete tasks), this position will provide essential support for the newest technology services and initiatives focused on supporting student learning and success. This position will also provide programming support needed to import and extract information from multiple enterprise systems. Using industry standard coding languages, this work includes creating, debugging, and updating scripts that function to import or export data among enterprise systems that may include: Ellucian Banner, Brightspace D2L, Active Directory, Element451, DropGuard, Apache, SQL, Microsoft 365, myPhoto, Udemy, Filemaker Pro, and others. **Scope of Work and Responsibilities** The Applications Programmer will be an instrumental staff member expected to participate in self\-study and on\-the\-job training to improve skills related to systems programming. This position will rely on clearly defined program specifications and instructions to perform assigned tasks while documenting solutions and progress. Some remote work opportunities may be possible, based on supervisor’s judgement and organizational needs. This position provides software support for enterprise systems that are relied upon by a large portion of the New River educational community. Errors in judgment could negatively impact data security, privacy, and availability with severe ramifications and may require a prioritized and rapid response to resolve. Responsibilities: * Reviewing program specifications and clearly defined instructions, to create the necessary program coding to meet those requirements. * Debugging programs by reviewing any diagnostic errors identified from testing the programs. * Resolving issues with integrated systems using programming and system configuration familiarity and expertise. * Documenting procedures and configurations to create artifacts that streamline decision\-making for self and others using effective technical writing techniques. * Providing solutions for users while ensuring that information privacy and security procedures are followed and improved upon as needed. * Increasing technical expertise by exploring new techniques, methodologies, and a continuing review of technical literature to become familiar with advancements and alternatives in a changing environment. * Seeking out and attending product demonstrations and freely available webinars to evaluate awareness of and expertise with the products and solutions relevant to services used or planned for use at New River. * Performing routine duties such as managing access privileges for users, assisting users with access to services, manually running scripts, creating data\-driven reports, and providing the required data as needed (through data extracts or customized reports). * Ensuring that the elevated access privileges granted to them are used only to perform assigned tasks and that confidentiality for personal information is secured and protected. *To* *perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.* Skills/Abilities * Proficiency with three or more industry standard programming languages (SQL, Java, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Python, Ruby, Swift, etc.). * An understanding of data processing procedures, information security, personal privacy, and data governance principles. * Proven skills with the design, implementation, and management of software applications, databases, patches, and solutions for service delivery and operation. * The ability and desire to learn programming languages, new applications, and software solutions as needed. * The ability to logically solve data processing problems while documenting issues and resolutions. * The ability to read, understand, reference, and create technical sources of information. * The ability to evaluate technical issues, communicate effectively, and collaborate with others to identify and implement technical solutions. **Education Requirements** Associates Degree; Computer Science or related field is Required. Bachelors Degree, Computer Science or related field is Preferred. In addition to education, the following related work experience is required. An equivalent combination of education and recent, related experience may be acceptable. **Experience** 2 years, IT support or programming is required **License or Certification/Preferred** CompTIA A\+ Google IT Support Professional Certificate Microsoft 365 or Microsoft Certified **Expectations** Employees are expected to adhere to the Mission, Values and Vision of the College. Each employee’s position has attributes that contribute to the achievement of these goals. **Mission** New River Community and Technical College provides accessible, affordable, quality education and workforce programs to meet the needs of the region it serves. **Values** Shared values guide New River Community and Technical College in fulfilling its mission. These values influence thoughts, guide decisions, mold policies, and determine courses of action. Our employees are expected to support and enact these values in our daily work. **Respect** § Promote a culture of belonging. § Recognize and celebrate the unique contributions and perspectives of all individuals. § Involve a diverse range of voices and perspectives in decision\-making. § Ensure everyone feels they are an integral part of the College. **Honesty** § Communicate openly and truthfully. § Take responsibility for one’s actions. § Provide accurate and transparent reporting of data. § Make decisions based on ethical principles. **Education** § Encourage and support a culture of continuous learning. § Facilitate the sharing of information. § Offer access to a diverse range of educational resources. § Encourage curiosity. § Regularly assess educational programs and supporting services. § Cultivate a workforce of knowledgeable, competent, and skilled leaders. **Community** § Actively engage with the local community. § Partner with local businesses, organizations, and non\-profits. § Meet the educational needs and interests of the local community. § Encourage and facilitate civic engagement among students, staff, faculty, and administration. **Vision** New River Community and Technical College will improve students’ lives and will enrich communities as an increasingly integral part of the educational and economic landscape of southern West Virginia.

jobs.title: Staff Security Engineer
jobs.description: Staff Security Engineer Location: Austin, TX, United States Category: Technology Job ID: 3430 Apply Now Description Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions. Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance. About the Role: Our apps and websites run on APIs. A public API gateway and a federated GraphQL platform carry billions of requests a month, covering listings, search, sign\-in, saved homes, and the leads we send to agents. As the founding Staff engineer for API security on our new Edge and API Security team, you'll set the technical direction for how we protect them. You'll decide how every API is authenticated, which operations are allowed, how abuse is detected and stopped, and how new APIs ship secure by default. You'll work hands\-on and lead through influence across platform, product, identity and security teams, with leadership backing and a clear mandate. Top Reasons to Apply: * A Key technical role on a high impact team. You'll shape its architecture, standards and hiring from day one. * Real scale: billions of API and GraphQL requests a month, and abuse that ranges from scraping to account takeover. * Direct business impact: your work protects consumer accounts, the quality of leads sent to agents, and the data that powers our business. * A modern stack, all managed as code: an API gateway, Apollo GraphQL Federation, Kubernetes and policy\-as\-code. * Room to apply automation and AI to detection and response. * Leadership that wants guardrails built into the platform, not more tickets. What You'll Do: * Own the API security architecture across the API gateway and the GraphQL platform, and set the multi\-quarter roadmap. * Define and enforce an authentication standard for every public API, and lead the migration of existing unauthenticated APIs to it, working with the owning teams. * Secure GraphQL end to end: approved\-operation lists and persisted queries, depth and cost limits, field\-level authorization, and safe schema change. * Protect high\-value flows such as sign\-in, registration, account and lead submission against credential stuffing, account takeover, scraping and fake submissions. * Make "secure by default" real, using admission policies, CI checks and gateway policies that stop an unprotected API from reaching production. * Build detection and alerting on API abuse, so attacks surface in minutes, not in downstream business reports. * Lead response to API attacks and abuse, and turn every incident into a lasting fix. * Mentor engineers, set API security review standards, and help hire the rest of the team. What You'll Bring: * 8\+ years in security, platform or backend engineering, with 5\+ years focused on API or application security at large scale. Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. * Deep knowledge of API security: OAuth 2\.0/OIDC, JWT, API keys and client identity, mTLS, and the OWASP API Security Top 10\. * Hands\-on GraphQL security experience: federation, persisted queries and safelists, query cost analysis, introspection controls, and authorization patterns. * Experience operating an API gateway (such as Tyk, Kong or AWS API Gateway), including policy design, rate limiting and key management. * Kubernetes and policy\-as\-code experience (ValidatingAdmissionPolicy, OPA or Kyverno), plus infrastructure as code and CI/CD. * Strong programming skills in at least one language such as Go, TypeScript or Python, and comfort reading and changing service code. * Experience with abuse and fraud patterns: credential stuffing, account takeover, scraping and bot\-driven form abuse, and how to detect them with logs and SQL. * A record of leading multi\-team technical initiatives, and of explaining risk to executives in business terms. Nice to Have: * Experience with Apollo GraphQL Federation and its router, or with Auth0 or similar identity platforms. * Experience with mobile app attestation (App Attest, Play Integrity) or API bot protection. * Experience building a security function or team from scratch. How We Reward You: Realtor.com is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our benefits programs include, but are not limited to: * Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage * Family forming benefits * 13 Paid Holidays * Flexible Time Off * 8 hours of paid Volunteer Time off * Immediate eligibility into Company 401(k) plan with 3\.5% company match * Tuition Reimbursement program for degreed and non\-degreed programs * 1:1 personalized Financial Planning Sessions * Student Debt Retirement Savings Match program * Free snacks and refreshments in each office location * Do the best work of your life at Realtor.com Here, you’ll partner with a diverse team of experts as you use leading\-edge tech to empower everyone to meet a crucial goal: finding their way home. And you’ll find your way home too. At Realtor.com®, you’ll bring your full self to work as you innovate with speed, serve our consumers, and champion your teammates. In return, we’ll provide you with a warm, welcoming, and inclusive culture; intellectual challenges; and the development opportunities you need to grow. Diversity is important to us, therefore, Realtor.com® is an Equal Opportunity Employer regardless of age, color, national origin, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, status as a disabled veteran and/or veteran of the Vietnam Era or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, Realtor.com® will provide reasonable accommodations for otherwise qualified disabled individuals. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Apply Now

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloud Engineering
jobs.description: #### **\#TeamNextdoor** Nextdoor is the essential neighborhood network. Neighbors, public agencies, and businesses use Nextdoor to connect around local information that matters in more than 350,000 neighborhoods across 11 countries. Nextdoor builds innovative technology to foster local community, share important news, and create neighborhood connections at scale. Download the app and join the neighborhood at **nextdoor.com**. #### **Meet Your Future Neighbors** At Nextdoor, Cloud Engineers are responsible for building, deploying, managing, and securing the underlying cloud\-based architecture that powers communities on the Nextdoor platform worldwide. These engineers have designed, built and implemented a globally scalable container and "serverless" based infrastructure that serves billions of requests a day, millions of active users, and hundreds of developers. We build infrastructure and tooling that is iterable, scalable, and secure. We write everything in code from network infrastructure to server management, database provisioning, and data pipelines. Recently we have focused on scaling up our Kubernetes infrastructure. We created a dedicated management cluster to run ArgoCD, Loki, Prometheus, and Grafana. Additionally, we have created a second Kubernetes cluster for Nextdoor applications to ensure we can scale beyond the limitations of a single cluster. This will ensure Nextdoor's infrastructure is able to scale for many years to come. Additionally our team has focused efforts to modernize our Infrastructure as Code (IaC) by leveraging CDK to manage our AWS resources and Pulumi to manage our other core infrastructure systems such as PagerDuty, Datadog, and Sentry. At Nextdoor, we operate in an AI\-first environment and expect every team member to actively use AI tools as part of their workflow. We aren't looking for prompt engineers; we're looking for people who use tools like Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, and Glean to challenge their own thinking and take full ownership of AI\-assisted outputs. We also offer a warm and inclusive work environment that embraces a hybrid employment model, blending an in office presence and work from home experience for our valued employees. The hiring team will go over these expectations with you if you are being considered for a role near one of our offices in San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago, Dallas, New York, and London. #### **The Impact You'll Make** You will be responsible for building an efficient and scalable container and serverless computing environment for our product developers. In this team you will work in the ways of reliability engineering, design scalable systems from the ground up, and generally build systems that never page you. You serve all of our engineering teams by providing them with reliable and scalable infrastructure. Here are just some of our team's most recent deliverables: * Operationalizing a second Kubernetes cluster to ensure Nextdoor can continue to scale beyond the limits of a single Kubernetes cluster * Building automation for our developer's workflows including applying 3rd party dependency updates automatically as well as distributing Helm chart updates * Modernizing our Infrastructure as Code (IaC) by leveraging CDK and Pulumi * Optimizing our Kubernetes resource management by leveraging Spot Ocean and Karpenter * Providing self\-service infrastructure\-as\-code systems to developers that automate the full lifecycle of managing, deploying and operating cloud services including blob/block storage, relational databases, key\-value databases, caches and document search services * Developing tooling for horizontally and vertically autoscaling our developers compute workloads * Providing upstream open source patches to well known community projects like AWS Bottlerocket, the Istio Service Mesh, Keiko IAM Manager, Kyverno, Strimzi.io's Kafka Operator and more! #### **What You'll Bring to The Team** * 7\+ years experience in a DevOps or Cloud role * Solid understanding of Kubernetes (k8s) * Experience using TypeScript * Experience with infrastructure as code (CDK, Pulumi, CloudFormation, Puppet, Salt, Ansible, Terraform, Packer) * Thorough understanding of Linux and networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, HTTP/S, eBPF) * Strong debugging and performance tuning skills using software like gdb, perf, strace, ltrace, tcpdump, Wireshark, etc. * Experience with performance, automation, monitoring, and capacity planning * Experience automating configuration and bootstrapping of Linux systems * Eagerness to explore and apply AI and emerging technologies to reimagine how work gets done * Participate in in\-person Nextdoor events such as trainings, off\-sites, volunteer days, and team building exercises * Build in\-person relationships with team members and contribute to Nextdoor's company culture #### **Bonus Points** * Experience using Docker or other containerization software * Linux certifications such as Linux\+, Network\+, RHCSA/RHCE/RHCA or similar * Experience in a large scale compute environment with hundreds or thousands of servers #### **Rewards** Compensation, benefits, perks, and recognition programs at Nextdoor come together to create our total rewards package. Compensation will vary depending on your relevant skills, experience, and qualifications. The starting salary for this role is expected to range from $187,000 to $238,000 on an annualized basis, or potentially greater in the event that your 'level' of proficiency exceeds the level expected for the role. The salary range will be determined by the candidate's geographic location. We expect to award a meaningful equity grant for this role. With quarterly vesting, your first vest date will take place within 3 months of your start date. When it comes to benefits, we have you covered! Nextdoor employees can choose between a variety of health plans, including a 100% covered employee only plan option, and we also provide a OneMedical membership for concierge care. At Nextdoor, we empower our employees to build stronger local communities. To create a platform where all feel welcome, we want our workforce to reflect the diversity of the neighbors we serve. We encourage everyone interested in our mission to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation, age, or any other trait that unfairly targets a group of people. In accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we always consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. For information about our collection and use of applicants' personal information, please see Nextdoor's Personnel Privacy Notice, found here.

jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Redefine the future of customer experiences. One conversation at a time.** At Nextiva, we’re reimagining how businesses connect, bringing together customer experience and team collaboration on a single, conversation centric platform. Powered by AI, driven by human innovation. Our culture is forward thinking, customer obsessed and built on the belief that meaningful connections drive better business outcomes. Whether it’s through our signature Amazing Service®, the technology we create, or the experiences we cultivate, connection is at the core of who we are. If you’re ready to collaborate with incredible people, make an impact, and help businesses everywhere deliver truly amazing experiences, this is where you belong. **Location:** While this role is open to remote candidates across the United States, team members located within 40 miles of our Scottsdale headquarters (9451 E. Via de Ventura, Scottsdale, AZ 85256\) are expected to work onsite four days per week to support collaboration, speed, and execution. Specific scheduling and flexibility will be guided by your leader to support both team collaboration and individual productivity. We are seeking a Staff AI Engineer to help accelerate new AI initiatives and support Nextiva’s mission of delivering exceptional customer experiences through a unified, modern platform powered by AI and automation. The Staff AI Engineer is a hands\-on individual contributor role for an experienced engineer with deep technical expertise in Python, distributed systems, and system design. This role will help design, build, and launch new AI\-focused initiatives while working across Nextiva engineering teams and with external technology partners. As a Staff Engineer, you will operate at the intersection of hands\-on engineering, system design, and early\-stage solutioning. You will take ownership of new capabilities from initial technical discussions through design, development, and launch. This is not an architecture\-only position; we are looking for someone who remains close to the code and is comfortable building alongside the team. You will work on initiatives involving NextIQ capabilities, including collaboration with the Google Gemini team to bring capabilities built within Nextiva into partner environments. You will also work closely with global Nextiva product and engineering teams, including teams working on NextOS, to extend NextIQ capabilities across the Nextiva ecosystem. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, building new capabilities from the ground up, and taking end\-to\-end technical ownership while contributing as a deeply hands\-on individual contributor. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and launch new AI\-focused engineering capabilities and modules. * Own engineering initiatives end to end, from early\-stage solutioning and architecture through implementation and launch. * Remain deeply hands\-on with software development and contribute production code. * Build solutions using Python and apply strong distributed\-systems engineering principles. * Participate in system design, architecture, and solutioning discussions with engineering teams. * Work closely with the Google Gemini team on initiatives designed to bring NextIQ capabilities into Gemini. * Collaborate with other external technology partners to extend Nextiva capabilities into their environments. * Partner with U.S.\-based Nextiva product and engineering teams on new initiatives. * Work with teams supporting NextOS to help bring NextIQ capabilities into other areas of the Nextiva ecosystem. * Navigate ambiguous, early\-stage technical problems and translate them into practical engineering solutions. * Take accountability for designing, building, and successfully launching the capabilities you own. **Requirements** **Basic Qualifications** * 7–10\+ years of relevant software engineering experience, with strong hands\-on experience building and delivering production software. * Very strong hands\-on Python engineering skills. * Strong system design capabilities. * Experience designing and building distributed systems. * Demonstrated experience owning and launching software modules or capabilities end to end. * Experience taking technical initiatives from solutioning and design through development and launch. * Ability and willingness to remain hands\-on with coding at Staff Engineer level. * Experience contributing to architecture and technical solutioning discussions. * Ability to work effectively on new initiatives where requirements and technical approaches may still be evolving. * Ability to collaborate effectively with internal engineering teams and external technology partners. * Ability to work remotely within a time zone reasonably aligned with the Arizona\-based team. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience operating as a Staff Engineer or at a comparable level in a similarly sized or slightly larger organization. * Experience building new produ practices and apply them where they improve engineering effectiveness. * Contribute directly to AI\-related initiatives involving NextIQ and partner environments such as Google Gemini. **Additional Qualities** * Strong sense of ownership and accountability. * Comfortable working through ambiguity and early\-stage technical challenges. * Able to move effectively between system design and hands\-on implementation. * Strong problem\-solving and technical decision\-making skills. * Collaborative approach to working across engineering teams and external partners. * Ability to take ownership of a capability through design, build, and launch. * Self\-directed and comfortable operating as a senior individual contributor. Nextiva DNA (Core Competencies) Nextiva’s most successful team members share common traits and behaviors: * Drives Results: Action\-oriented problem solvers who quickly bring clarity and simplicity to ambiguity, challenge the status quo, and lead meaningful change; celebrating wins to fuel momentum. They act swiftly and pragmatically, learning and improving as they go. * Critical Thinker: Data\-driven, forward\-thinking individuals who identify key drivers, anticipate risks, and deliver clear recommendations. They confidently leverage AI and automation to reduce friction, improve decision\-making, and focus on higher\-value work. * Right Attitude: Collaborative, competitive, and resilient team players who jump in to solve tough problems, learn from setbacks, and foster a culture of service, respect, and care for customers and teammates. #### **Total Rewards** Our Total Rewards offerings are designed to allow Nexties to take care of themselves and their families so they can be their best, in and out of the office. Our compensation packages are tailored to each role and candidate's qualifications. We consider a wide range of factors, including skills, experience, training, and certifications, when determining compensation. We aim to offer competitive salaries or wages that reflect the value you bring to our team. Depending on the position, compensation may include base salary and/or hourly wages, incentives, or bonuses. The expected hiring range is $115,000 \- $200,000\. A different level in the job hierarchy may apply to a specific candidate, resulting in a different hiring range. * Health: Multiple health plan options to suit your needs, including medical, dental, vision, and telemedicine coverage * Insurance: Life, disability, and supplemental indemnity plans * + ️ Work\-Life Balance: Flexible Time Off for salaried employees, PTO for hourly employees, Paid Sick Time, Paid Parental Bonding Leave, and holiday pay * Financial Security: 401(k) with company match, Health Savings Accounts with company contributions, Dependent Care FSA * ‍ Wellness: Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and comprehensive wellness initiatives * Growth: Access to ongoing learning and development opportunities and career advancement At Nextiva, we're committed to supporting our employees' health, well\-being, and professional growth. jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (Python + TypeScript)
jobs.description: ### **About Northbeam** Northbeam is building the world's most advanced marketing intelligence platform, providing top eCommerce brands a unified view of their business data through powerful attribution modeling and customizable dashboards. Our technology helps customers accurately track ad spend, understand the full customer journey, and drive profitable growth. Machine learning has been at the heart of Northbeam since day one: our full suite of measurement, spanning multi\-touch attribution, MMM\+, and incrementality, is built on it, along with laser\-accurate first\-party data. Now we're taking that foundation further, using AI to help brands operationalize their data and turn Northbeam insights into automated decisions. We're experiencing rapid growth, have strong product\-market fit, and are looking for the right people to help us scale. This is a rare chance to make a meaningful impact at a fast\-moving, high\-growth company. At Northbeam, you'll join a team of driven, collaborative, and talented individuals who value personal growth and excellence. We'd love for you to be part of our journey. We're a remote\-friendly company with physical offices in San Francisco and Los Angeles. **About the role** ------------------ We're hiring a **Senior Fullstack Engineer** to build Northbeam's mobile attribution product and the data collection layer underneath it. You'll own our client\-side SDKs (JavaScript today, iOS next) and the high\-throughput APIs that ingest the events they send. This is a **fullstack role** with a **strong backend and scaling bent.** Our microservices run in both **TypeScript and Python**, so you'll move between the two daily, and ship React UI when a feature needs it. You'll also partner with our Conversions API (CAPI) team on event ingestion. The ideal person has built web analytics or event tracking at real volume and cares as much about a reliable SDK as about the systems that catch its data. **Your Impact** --------------- * Build Northbeam's mobile attribution solution end to end: SDK, ingestion APIs, data model, and the dashboard views customers use to act on it. * Design and own our client\-side SDKs in JavaScript/TypeScript, and help shape our iOS SDK, so they capture events accurately with minimal impact on customer site and app performance. * Build and scale high\-throughput APIs and microservices in TypeScript and Python that ingest, validate, and route event data from our customers' sites and apps. * Partner with the CAPI team to ingest server\-side conversion events and deliver them reliably to ad platforms. * Own the reliability of these ingestion paths: load testing, monitoring, alerting, and performance tuning. * Ship frontend features in React and TypeScript when a product experience needs them. * Scope projects with product managers, data scientists, and customer success, and help set technical direction for how Northbeam collects data. **What You Bring** ------------------ * 5\+ years building production software, with deep fullstack experience in TypeScript/JavaScript across frontend and backend. * Professional experience building services or APIs in Python, and comfort working across TypeScript and Python microservices in the same system. * A track record designing and scaling high\-throughput APIs: you've handled request volume, latency, queuing, retries, and idempotency in production. * Hands\-on experience with web analytics or event tracking: building tracking SDKs, pixels, or tag libraries, designing event schemas, and working within browser constraints like cookie restrictions and ad blockers. * Proficiency in SQL; experience with BigQuery or a similar cloud data warehouse. * Startup instincts: you turn ambiguous product needs into sound architecture and ship production\-ready code with minimal guidance. * Interest in mentoring other engineers and raising the bar for what the team ships. **Bonus Skills \& Experience** ------------------------------ * iOS SDK development in Swift, or building SDKs that third\-party developers install and depend on. * Familiarity with mobile attribution: mobile measurement partners (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch), SKAdNetwork or AdAttributionKit, and Apple's App Tracking Transparency. * Experience with server\-side conversion APIs such as Meta CAPI, Google Enhanced Conversions, or the TikTok Events API. * Streaming or event pipeline experience (Pub/Sub, Kafka, or similar) on GCP or another major cloud. * Experience in marketing, e\-commerce, or ad\-tech. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location. In addition to your base salary, we offer an equity package, comprehensive healthcare benefits (medical, dental, and vision), and a 401(k) plan. Our team enjoys a flexible PTO policy, 12 company\-paid holidays, and 12 weeks of paid parental leave. We also provide a $500 work\-from\-home stipend to support your remote setup. **Interview Process** The interview process varies by role but typically begins with a 30\-minute interview with a Northbeam recruiter, followed by a video interview with the hiring manager. Next, candidates complete a role\-specific video interview followed by video or onsite interviews with several team members. The final step is a video interview with our CEO/Co\-founder. The entire interview process is usually 5\-7 interviews total and requires around 5\-8 hours of your time. We accept applications on an ongoing basis.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer - Kernel
jobs.description: **Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.** **The Opportunity** Are you a skilled developer with a passion for open source technologies and a deep understanding of kernel level systems? AHV is an enterprise\-grade hypervisor designed for Nutanix’s software solution, offering reliability, performance, and scalability ideal for demanding enterprise and private cloud workloads. There are no travel requirements for this position at Nutanix, ensuring you can focus on your responsibilities and contribute effectively within the team dynamic. **Your Role*** Contribute to the development of Nutanix's Acropolis Hypervisor (AHV), design and develop new AHV security features * Maintain and fix issues in AHV security, push for improved reliability, performance, and security of AHV * Interact with open source communities, lead the development of features from concept to market * Collaborate with kernel developers, platform engineers, and the ProdSec team to drive strategic security initiatives. **What You Will Bring*** Have extensive knowledge of OS internals, particularly UNIX/Linux kernel, and low\-level software development experience * Strong knowledge of Linux security models, including discretionary and mandatory access control, capabilities, namespaces, and privilege separation. * Experience with vulnerability analysis, exploit mitigation, security auditing, and security compliance certifications. * Strong proficiency in Python and at least one of C/Golang/Rust, with experience debugging complex system\-level issues. **Preferred qualifications** * Contributions to Linux kernel security, upstream open\-source projects, or security\-related patches. * Familiarity with vulnerability management and security standards such as CVE, CWE, CVSS, and relevant industry security frameworks * Knowledge of virtualization security, hypervisor isolation, and cloud infrastructure protection. * Understanding of cryptography, secure boot, trusted execution environments, and hardware\-assisted security. **Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.** The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between USD $ 160,000 and USD $ 320,000per year. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description: **About Orb:** We're a team that cares deeply about the work, the people we do it with, and the customers we do it for. Everyone at Orb has real ownership over their work, direct access to customers, and a voice in how the company grows. We're building the revenue design platform that helps teams automate billing, evolve pricing, and grow revenue with confidence. Looking ahead, joining forces with Adyen expands what we can build and raises the ceiling on the problems we get to solve for customers. The challenges are uniquely interesting, and you'll be surrounded by thoughtful, ambitious people who move fast and hold a high bar. For San Francisco Bay Area residents, we've built a hybrid work culture where we are in office 3 days/week. Our values, *customer centricity, minutes matter, run with it, attention to detail, and go further together* are at the core of everything we do. **About the role:** As a member of the infrastructure team, you'll play a key role in maintaining a high bar for reliability. Our customers depend on our systems being operational, as downtime can directly lead to lost revenue. You'll be responsible for the infrastructure powering the entire product, from event ingestion, API services, alerting, invoicing, and everything in between. **In this role, you will:** * Lead infrastructure resiliency efforts \- recovery mechanisms, tenant isolation, load spike handling, etc * Improve observability and operability of our systems * Build performance\-critical, user\-facing infrastructure (e.g. real\-time event processing) * Plan scaling initiatives to handle large customer growth * Partner with other engineering teams to ensure we build reliable product features * Learn from a talented peer group, and share your expertise **About you:** * You have 8\+ years of experience in software engineering, and you've worked in in the infrastructure domain for 2\+ years * You think deeply about edge cases, failure modes, bottlenecks, etc * You have a knack for investigating and debugging tricky errors and performance issues * You enjoy building scalable infrastructure for a high\-growth product * You can effectively mentor fellow engineers on best practices (observability, rollout strategies, risk mitigation, etc) ### **Orb's Tech Stack :** At Orb, we believe great engineers can learn any stack, so you do not need experience with these specific tools, and we encourage you to apply regardless. * **Frontend:** Typescript \+ React * **Backend:** Python * **Datastores:** PostgreSQL \+ Clickhouse * **Cloud Platform:** AWS **Why Adyen x Orb?** This is an exceptional opportunity to join a solid, established company with a startup mindset, characterized by small teams, direct communication, and work on important challenges. You'll have direct access to massive global datasets (e.g., payments, identity data) and the ability to see your team's work have an immediate impact at scale. While this is a San Francisco\-based role, we recognize that global mobility matters—especially for candidates navigating complex situations. Adyen has deep roots in Europe and a strong global presence, and we're open to future relocation conversations to our offices if better supports your personal or professional goals in the future. Our aim is to build a lasting foundation for you at Adyen x Orb—starting in San Francisco, but with the flexibility to adapt as life evolves. *The annual base salary range for this role is* *$235,000\- $317,000* *plus RSUs; to learn more about our compensation philosophy, please click* *here**. This position is based out of the San Francisco office.*

jobs.title: Engineer, Performance and Operations (Reefer/Power Systems)
jobs.description: **Company Description** At \#ONE, we are one of the world's largest liner shipping companies. Operating more than 280 vessels, we offer an expeditious and reliable international network of over 165 services to 120 countries and beyond. We have a fleet size of approximately 2\.2 million TEU. \#ONENA **Job Description** We are seeking an analytical and hands\-on **Performance \& Operations Engineer** with a strong background in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering to oversee the operational efficiency, reliability, and functional performance of our **Diesel Generator Sets (Gensets)** and **Refrigerated Containers (Reefers)**. In this role, you will bridge hardware engineering, thermal/electrical performance evaluation, and telemetry data analytics. You will be responsible for optimizing equipment uptime, diagnosing complex mechanical and electrical anomalies, evaluating energy/fuel efficiency, and driving data\-driven continuous improvement across our refrigerated transport fleet. **Additional Responsibilities** **1\. Diesel Genset Operations \& Power Reliability** * Oversee the operational performance, maintenance standards, and lifecycle management of clip\-on and undermount diesel generator sets. * Evaluate diesel engine mechanics, fuel delivery systems, cooling loops, and electrical power generation components (alternators, AVRs, transfer logic). * Analyze fuel consumption profiles, power output stability, load\-sharing dynamics, and start/stop reliability under variable environmental conditions. * Lead root\-cause investigations into generator failure modes, engine wear, and electrical output irregularities. **2\. Refrigerated Container (Reefer) Functional Performance** * Monitor and optimize the thermodynamic performance of container refrigeration units (compressors, evaporators, condensers, expansion valves, and controllers). * Assess thermal load profiles, airflow dynamics, pull\-down rates, setpoint stability, and defrost cycles to ensure temperature\-sensitive cargo safety. * Evaluate insulation performance, air leakage rates, and refrigerant system efficiency across diverse climatic zones. * Develop standard operating procedures (SOPs) for reefer pre\-trip inspections (PTIs), maintenance, and emergency response. **3\. Data Analytics \& Telemetry Insights** * Leverage IoT telemetry data and sensor networks to monitor real\-time equipment status, temperature curves, power quality, and fault codes. * Apply statistical methodologies and analytical tools (e.g., Python, MATLAB, SQL, Excel, or BI platforms) to perform failure probability modeling, degradation tracking, and predictive maintenance scheduling. * Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) for equipment utilization, mean time between failures (MTBF), mean time to repair (MTTR), and total cost of ownership (TCO). * Translate complex diagnostic and performance datasets into actionable technical recommendations for operational leadership. **4\. Technical Governance \& Continuous Improvement** * Collaborate with equipment vendors, OEMs, and field service technicians to implement design retrofits, firmware updates, and component upgrades. * Ensure operational compliance with safety, environmental, and international transport regulations (e.g., EPA tier standards, ISO container codes, ASHRAE, and refrigerant handling guidelines). * Conduct Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) to identify systemic vulnerabilities in power delivery or refrigeration equipment. **Qualifications** **Core Required Skills and Competencies** * *Mechanical Focus:* Deep understanding of thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, heat transfer, internal combustion engines, and vapor compression refrigeration cycles. * *Electrical Focus:* Deep understanding of power electronics, alternators, voltage control, control circuitry, wiring diagrams, PLC/microcontroller logic, and sensor integration. **High\-Level Analytical Skills:** Demonstrated proficiency in quantitative problem\-solving, statistical data analysis, telemetry data interpretation, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA). **Function Specific Skills** * Proficiency with programming/data analysis languages (Python, R, SQL, MATLAB) or data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau). * Knowledge of smart reefer telemetry platforms (e.g., Carrier, Thermo King, Daikin, Star Cool). * Familiarity with environmental regulations regarding refrigerants (e.g., EPA Section 608, Low\-GWP refrigerants) and diesel emissions standards. * Experience with intermodal logistics, container shipping, or cold chain fleet operations. **Required Minimum Years Experience** * 3\+ years of engineering experience with power generation (diesel/generators) and/ thermal/refridgeration systems (HVAC, Chiller Units, or Intermodal Reefer Containers) **Required Minimum Education** Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field preferred. **Additional Information** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Ocean Network Express provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. At Ocean Network Express, we strive toward high\-level results for all our employees and pride ourselves on identifying opportunities for internal movement and advancement of proven talent. If you’re interested in a career in the global transportation industry and are looking for growth and advancement opportunities, we encourage you to apply. We enjoy meeting candidates who are persistent in their own professional development. ONE NA follows a hybrid work schedule requiring employees to work 3 days in the office (i.e. Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday) and 2 days remote each week. What we offer: Opportunities available with hybrid working arrangements Total rewards package including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability, 401K plan About Ocean Network Express (ONE) Ocean Network Express (ONE) was incepted on July 7, 2017, following the liner service integrations of Kawasaki Kisen Kaisha (“K” LINE), Mitsui O.S.K. Lines (MOL) and Nippon Yusen Kaisha (NYK). The new entity functions from its global headquarters in Singapore, supported by regional headquarters in Hong Kong, Singapore, the United Kingdom, the United States, and Brazil. ONE is the world’s sixth\-largest container carrier with a fleet size of approximately 1\.91 million TEU. Operating more than 240 vessels, it offers an expeditious and reliable international network of over 130 services to 120 countries and beyond. ONE is a member of the Premier Alliance, a global ocean carrier consortium. For more information, please visit www.one\-line.com \#JIL \#ZR

A satisfactory combination of education and experience equivalent to "1", "2" or "3" above. However, all candidates must have at least a four\-year high school diploma or its educational equivalent and must possess at least three (3\) years of experience as described in "1" above, including the eighteen (18\) months of administrative, managerial, executive or supervisory experience as described in "1" above. In the absence of a baccalaureate degree, undergraduate credits may be substituted for a maximum of two (2\) years of the required experience in IT on the basis of 30 semester credits for six (6\) months of the required experience. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
jobs.description: Olive Systems partners with fast\-growing AI and technology companies across the United States to help them build and scale their engineering teams. We’re looking for experienced **Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs)** who can bridge the gap between complex customer challenges and real\-world technical solutions. Rather than hiring for a single position, we’re building a network of strong engineers interested in working with innovative startups and technology companies. Based on your technical background, experience, and career preferences, we’ll connect you with relevant opportunities across our partner companies. **This is not an internal engineering position at Olive Systems.** **What You’ll Do** As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll work closely with customers and engineering teams to solve complex technical challenges, often without predefined requirements. Your responsibilities may include: * Working directly with customers to understand business challenges and translate them into technical solutions. * Designing, developing, and deploying production\-ready applications and systems. * Building prototypes and turning successful concepts into scalable products. * Working across backend, frontend, APIs, cloud infrastructure, data, and AI technologies. * Making architectural and technical decisions independently. * Collaborating with founders, product managers, and engineering teams. * Identifying opportunities to turn custom solutions into reusable product capabilities. * Taking full ownership of technical solutions, from initial discovery through production deployment. **Who We’re Looking For** We’re interested in engineers who combine strong technical expertise with product thinking, problem\-solving skills, and the ability to work independently. You might currently be a: * Forward Deployed Engineer * Senior / Staff Full\-Stack Engineer * Founding Engineer or Technical Founder * AI / Applied AI Engineer * Solutions Architect with hands\-on development experience * Senior Software Engineer with end\-to\-end product ownership **What matters most:** * Strong hands\-on software engineering experience. * Proven track record of building and shipping production systems. * Ability to take ownership of complex technical challenges from start to finish. * Experience designing software architecture and making technical trade\-offs. * Confidence working with ambiguous or evolving requirements. * Strong communication skills and experience collaborating with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to move quickly from problem discovery to implementation. **Nice to Have:** * Experience building AI\-powered applications using LLMs, RAG, or AI agents. * Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. * Background in early\-stage startups or fast\-paced product environments. * Previous experience working directly with enterprise customers. * Experience developing MVPs, prototypes, or custom integrations. **Our Hiring Process** **1\. Initial Technical Evaluation** We’ll invite you to a short AI\-powered interview focused on your real engineering experience. We’ll explore systems you’ve built, architectural decisions, technical challenges, and how you approach solving complex problems. No algorithm puzzles or generic coding questions. **2\. Conversation with Olive Systems** We’ll discuss your professional background, career goals, compensation expectations, preferred working environment, and availability. **3\. Introduction to Relevant Opportunities** When we identify a suitable opportunity, we’ll introduce you to the company and coordinate the next steps. Depending on the company, additional technical interviews or assessments may be required. **Location \& Work Setup** We work with technology companies hiring across the **United States**. Opportunities may be fully remote, hybrid, or onsite, depending on the company. Specific location, compensation, employment arrangements, and work authorization or sponsorship requirements vary by opportunity. **Why Join Our Network?** Instead of applying to multiple companies individually, you can complete our initial evaluation once and be considered for relevant opportunities as they become available. Our goal is to connect experienced engineers with companies where their technical expertise, problem\-solving abilities, and career ambitions are a strong match. **Interested?** Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile. If your experience aligns with what our partner companies are looking for, we’ll contact you with the next steps. Pay: $160,000\.00 \- $220,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Flexible schedule * Paid time off Work Location: Hybrid remote in Boston, MA 02110

We’re looking for an engineering manager to lead the team that owns this platform. You will own the technical direction, delivery, and operation of the Console Shell, with responsibility for its reliability, performance, security, and the developer experience it provides to service teams across OCI. This role combines people leadership with technical judgment. You will hire and develop engineers, set priorities, guide architecture decisions, and partner with service teams to solve shared problems. Your team’s work directly shapes how customers experience OCI and how effectively engineers across the company deliver new capabilities. **About the Role** * **Lead and develop the team.** Hire, coach, and grow engineers. Set clear expectations, provide regular feedback, and support career development and performance. * **Own the Console Shell roadmap.** Set priorities and deliver the shared platform OCI service teams depend on to build, deliver, and operate their user interfaces. Balance new capabilities with reliability, security, and ongoing maintenance. * **Guide technical direction.** Lead architecture and design reviews, challenge assumptions, and help engineers make sound decisions about performance, scalability, and maintainability. * **Deliver quality software.** Establish clear expectations for code review, automated testing, accessibility, and documentation. Stay close enough to the implementation to guide decisions and help resolve difficult problems. * **Own production operations.** Ensure the team has effective monitoring, actionable alerts, service objectives, and operating procedures. Lead incident response and follow through on improvements that prevent repeat failures. * **Manage platform changes safely.** Maintain compatibility across service integrations. Plan versioning, migrations, and releases so teams can adopt changes without disrupting customers. * **Improve the developer experience.** Work directly with OCI service teams to understand integration challenges, remove recurring friction, and make the platform easier to use and support. * **Build security into delivery.** Ensure secure design and development practices, timely vulnerability remediation, and adherence to OCI security and compliance requirements. * **Drive execution.** Turn priorities into achievable plans, assign clear ownership, manage dependencies, and address delivery risks early. Communicate progress and trade\-offs clearly. * **Partner across OCI.** Align with engineering, product, and design teams on shared requirements and priorities. Resolve cross\-team issues and represent both customer needs and the needs of teams building on the platform. * **Improve how the team works.** Use production data, customer feedback, and engineering experience to strengthen tools, automation, and development practices. Give engineers room to learn, share knowledge, and improve the platform. **Key Responsibilities** **Platform Software Development:** * Operate a platform team roadmap that enforces compatibility, versioning, and safe rollout policies for shared services and SDKs. * Drive team\-level observability baselines (SLOs, error budgets) and resilience patterns; ensure adherence during releases. * Coordinate cross\-team incident response for platform issues, ensuring downstream consumer safety and clear remediation paths. **Software Development and Coding \- Design, Testing, and Optimization:** and guide new software features and enhancements following design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and to develop documents to clarify software design and code. * Leads code reviews to drive improvements. * Leads and reviews team to conduct debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix software issues within a single component or functional area. * Ensures team implements software testing (e.g., functional and non\-functional), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging. * Leverages prior experience and analysis to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding. * Guides team in troubleshooting and resolving issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. * Manages team to implement API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. **Software Architecture \- Software System Structural Design:** * Manages team to design and develop software, systems, and services. * Provides technical leadership and technical guidance and domain expertise in software architecture decisions and best practices. * Guides team and conducts periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural framework(s) and internal development practices and standards. * Collaborates with stakeholders within own group to align and build software architecture with business and/or customer goals and priorities * Implements performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. * Impacts immediate team to conduct regular technology research and evaluation for architectural enhancements. **Issue/Defect Collaboration \- Software Products Support:** * May collaborate and communicate with stakeholders to understand customer issues and align solutions. * Manages team to provide technical guidance and appropriately prioritize support to customers regarding reported issues. * Enables direct reports to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. * Communicates regularly with stakeholders to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. * Provides jobs.title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: We're looking for hands\-on engineers with expertise and passion in solving difficult problems in distributed systems, virtualized infrastructure, and highly available services. If this is you, at Oracle you can design and build innovative new systems from the ground up. These are exciting times in our space \- we are growing fast, still at an early stage, and working on ambitious new initiatives. An engineer at any level can have a significant technical and business impact. As a member of the software engineering division, you will take an active role in defining and evolving standard practices and procedures. You will be responsible for defining and developing software for tasks associated with the developing, designing, and debugging software applications or operating systems. At Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), we build the future of the cloud for Enterprises as a diverse team of fellow creators and inventors. We act with the speed and attitude of a start\-up, with the scale and customer focus of the leading enterprise software company in the world. Values are OCI's foundation and how we deliver excellence. We strive for equity, inclusion, and respect for all. We are committed to the greater good in our products and our actions. We are constantly learning and taking opportunities to grow our careers and ourselves. We challenge each other to stretch beyond our past to build our future. You are the builder here. You will be part of a team of really smart, motivated, and diverse people and given the autonomy and support to do your best work. It is a dynamic and flexible workplace where you'll belong and be encouraged. If you want to build large\-scale distributed infrastructure for the cloud, this is your team! Oracle is aggressively investing in the Oracle Cloud to provide the industry's broadest, most comprehensive cloud. Oracle offers a complete suite of integrated services that include applications as a service, platform as a service, and infrastructure as a service eliminating the data and business process fragmentation that come with cloud silos. A critical part of these silos is the Infrastructure Services, including Compute, Storage, and Messaging service. This is your chance to be part of this exciting Compute team that offers elastic compute capabilities to run any workload in the cloud! As a Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer, you will own the software design and development for major components of Oracle's Cloud Infrastructure. You should be both a rock\-solid coder and a distributed systems generalist, able to dive deep into any part of the stack and low\-level systems and design broad distributed system interactions. You should value simplicity and scale, work comfortably in a collaborative, agile environment, and be excited to learn. **Minimum Qualifications** : * 8\+ years of software development experience with distributed systems within large\-scale environments. * Proficient in Java, C, or C\+\+ and experience with scripting languages like Python, Perl, etc. * Experience working on large\-scale, highly distributed services infrastructure. * Experience working in an operational environment with mission\-critical tier\-one livesite servicing. * Systematic problem\-solving approach, strong communication skills, a sense of ownership, and drive. * Experience designing architectures that demonstrate deep technical depth in one area, or span many products, to enable high availability, scalability, market\-leading features and flexibility to meet future business demands. Able to effectively communicate technical ideas verbally and in writing (technical proposals, design specs, architecture diagrams and presentations). * **Preferred Qualifications** : * Demonstrable knowledge of data structures, algorithms, operating systems, distributed systems fundamentals, and cloud\-native development. * Working familiarity with operating systems internals, networking protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP) and standard network architectures. * Strong troubleshooting and performance tuning skills. * Experience building multi\-tenant, virtualized infrastructure, a strong plus.

jobs.title: Patent Engineer / Scientist - Physics/Applied Math - Japanese Language Fluency Required
jobs.description: Osha Bergman Watanabe \& Burton LLP is currently seeking candidates with a physics or applied math background for the team responsible for preparing and prosecuting patent applications. Business level Japanese language fluency is required. Individuals who are hired will be placed in our unique Patent Agent Program, a forward\-thinking, highly effective method for training and developing technically and legally savvy individuals. No IP experience is necessary. This is a great position to combine your technical skills with writing, client interaction, and legal concepts. An university degree in physics or applied math is required. The Basics of the Patent Agent Program: The Patent Agent Program serves as an apprenticeship in patent law. During the first year of employment, participants undergo a regular training schedule with a combination of in\-house lectures and mentorship. During their studies, they also maintain technical expertise through daily application of technical knowledge by prosecuting patents. Upon completion of the one\-year program, participants are expected to sit for and pass the Patent Agent Exam conducted by the United States Patent and Trademark Office. After passing this exam, they become patent agents. Patent Agents are given the opportunity to attend part\-time law school while continuing their education within the Firm. Core Responsibilities: Patent engineers are problem solvers. When writing a patent application, they are required to study the technology and learn about the invention. During patent prosecution, they may need to determine how the invention differs from others in the marketplace. They can expect to spend half the day reading and studying the technical analysis of complex scientific topics within a particular patent application. The remainder of the day may be spent writing and scheduling future projects. Some days may be focused on technology in one field, while other days may require work in more than one technical area. Patent engineers, in collaboration with patent agents and attorneys, continuously work together to solve problems on behalf of clients. Qualifications: Applicants must be U.S. citizens, permanent legal residents, or otherwise authorized to work in the U.S. Individuals who have earned, or will soon earn, a physics or applied math degree from an accredited U.S. University with an extremely strong academic record (top 25%) are encouraged to apply. Industry experience is a plus. Business level Japanese language fluency is required. Candidates should enjoy drafting narrative and persuasive documents while critically analyzing and solving problems. Time management skills are also critical. ***About Osha Bergman Watanabe \& Burton LLP*** OBWB is an IP boutique law firm. Founded in 1997, OBWB is headquartered in Houston, Texas and has offices in Austin, Colorado, Dubai, France, China, and Japan. Our goal is to assist clients in protecting and enforcing their intellectual property interests worldwide. Recently ranked as one of the seven most loved IP boutique firms by in\-house counsel and 45th in the list of Top Patent Firms according to IP Today, OBWB is one of the most technically and legally proficient IP firms in the world. OBWB also takes great pride in its diversity and its cooperative, positive work environment. Last year, OBWB was ranked \#1 in the nation for the percentage of female attorneys handling PTAB actions https://oshaliang.com/news/osha\-liang\-ranked\-top\-law\-firm\-in\-ptab\-litigation\-diversity/ and as one of the top 100 firms for minority attorneys https://oshaliang.com/news/osha\-liang\-ranked\-among\-top\-100\-firms\-for\-minority\-attorneys/. OBWB's members collectively speak more than 20 languages. jobs.description: Life changing therapies. Global impact. Global Network Engineering \& Connectivity** -------------------------------------------------- * Own the architecture, engineering and lifecycle management of PCI's global WAN, SD\-WAN, LAN, wireless, internet, remote\-access and telecommunications environment. * Ensure highly available connectivity across geographically distributed business locations and facility connections supporting operations in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Ireland, Spain, Germany and Australia. * Establish engineering standards for site connectivity, network segmentation, redundancy, observability, capacity, performance and resilient communications. * Develop and maintain network reference architectures and standardized approaches for new facilities, manufacturing expansions and acquired locations. * Partner with Cybersecurity and Operational Technology teams to appropriately segment and protect enterprise, manufacturing and OT environments. * Establish appropriate resiliency for business\-critical facilities, including carrier diversity, failover strategies and tested recovery procedures. **3\. warehouses and validated computerized systems. * Experience integrating acquired businesses or newly constructed manufacturing facilities into an enterprise infrastructure environment. * Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Azure, Cisco networking, ITIL, TOGAF, PMP or equivalent technical and leadership credentials. **Leadership Profile** ====================== The successful Executive jobs.title: UI/UX Design Lead
jobs.description: **We are PMG** PMG, a global independent platform company engineered for impact, integrates business strategy, media, creative, and data within a single operating model powered by our proprietary operating system, Alli. With more than 1,000 employees, PMG partners with brands including Apple, Nike, Dropbox, Experian, Sephora, and Whole Foods. Our work has earned top industry honors, including Cannes Lions and Adweek's Media Plan of the Year, and PMG has won 40\+ workplace culture awards, including being the only company to rank among Ad Age's Best Places to Work for 11 consecutive years. **Who You Will Be Working With** At PMG, our UI/UX team is focused on creating experiences that are as thoughtful and intuitive as they are beautiful. Central to this effort is our design system, the backbone of consistent, scalable, and accessible digital experiences across our enterprise SaaS platform. We believe robust design systems are critical infrastructure that enables teams to deliver exceptional user experiences efficiently and at scale. You will lead strategic design initiatives, strengthen our design systems practice, and help define how artificial intelligence transforms modern marketing experiences. This is a senior level design leadership role for someone who thrives at the intersection of systems thinking, emerging technology, and human centered design. You will collaborate with product, engineering, data science, and AI experts to create intelligent, scalable experiences that push the boundaries of what marketing technology can be. We are looking for a design leader with deep expertise in design systems, strong executional craft, and demonstrated fluency in AI driven workflows including Figma Make, large language models, and modern AI powered design tools. You'll collaborate primarily with front\-end engineers, product teams, and fellow designers as the technical bridge between design intent and production reality. As our UI/UX Design Lead, if you're passionate about systematic design, technical collaboration, and building the infrastructure that enables great experiences at scale, this is where you'll make your most significant impact. **What You Will Do** Strategic Design Leadership * Lead the design of complex product experiences across the full lifecycle, from discovery and research through delivery and iteration. * Translate ambiguous ideas into structured workflows, interaction models, and detailed interface specifications. * Guide cross\-functional teams toward user\-centered solutions that balance business goals, technical feasibility, and user needs. * Clearly articulate design rationale and influence stakeholders across product, engineering, and executive leadership. AI\-Driven Experience Innovation * Explore and apply AI/LLM capabilities to enhance product experiences within marketing technology. * Leverage Figma Make and AI\-powered design workflows to accelerate ideation, prototyping, and production. * Design intelligent, adaptive interfaces that thoughtfully incorporate automation, predictive insights, and generative capabilities. * Collaborate with data and AI teams to shape user\-facing experiences that responsibly leverage machine learning. * Continuously evaluate emerging AI tools and methodologies to improve both the user experience and the design practice. User Research \& Validation * Conduct and guide research efforts including user interviews, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations. * Translate qualitative and quantitative insights into actionable design improvements. * Utilize analytics and experimentation frameworks (A/B testing, behavioral analysis) to optimize experience effectiveness. * Ensure accessibility and inclusive design principles are embedded throughout the product. Team \& Practice Leadership * Mentor and elevate junior designers through critique, collaboration, and design reviews. * Contribute to the evolution of PMG's UX design standards and processes. * Foster a culture of continuous learning, experimentation, and thoughtful risk\-taking. * Present work confidently to internal teams and senior stakeholders, championing design excellence. **What You Will Bring** * 5\+ years of product design experience, with demonstrated impact leading complex, multi\-surface initiatives across web and platform experiences. * Proven ability to drive consistency and quality at scale by partnering with Design Systems and Engineering teams to evolve shared patterns, contribute reusable components, and ensure adoption across product areas. * Experience leading cross\-functional collaboration with Product and Engineering to shape end\-to\-end experiences, aligning interaction patterns and UI decisions to both user needs and platform standards. * Advanced proficiency in Figma, including deep experience with libraries, variants, auto\-layout, and prototyping. * Solid understanding of front\-end technology fundamentals (HTML, CSS, and JavaScript) and experience with build tools, package management, and version control (Git). * Ability to read and review code, contribute to technical discussions, and understand the implications of design decisions on performance and maintainability. * Deep knowledge of accessibility standards (ADA/WCAG) and practical experience applying them to component design. * Demonstrated systems thinking, with the ability to connect individual feature work to broader ecosystem implications, platform constraints, and long\-term maintainability. * Strong judgment in balancing craft, speed, and scalability, knowing when to leverage existing patterns versus advocating for new approaches in service of user experience and product clarity. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to articulate design rationale to cross\-functional teams and stakeholders. **What We Offer** **Performance\-Based Rewards:** Your impact should be part of your reward. This role is eligible for PMG's annual bonus program—a standout part of our total compensation offering and an opportunity to share in our success. Bonus awards are informed by individual impact and performance, as well as team and company results, and are subject to applicable program terms. **Professional Development:** Keep growing through learning and development programs, mentorship opportunities, and support for career advancement. **Generous Time Off:** Take the time you need to recharge, connect with loved ones, and enjoy life outside work. **Parental Leave:** Receive paid parental leave during life's important family moments. **Retirement Benefits:** Build for your future with competitive retirement benefits, including employer contributions or matching where applicable. **Fertility and Family Support:** Access fertility and family\-building benefits for eligible employees and their spouses or partners. **Healthcare:** Choose from medical, dental, and vision coverage designed to support you and your family. **Pet Insurance:** Access optional coverage for the four\-legged members of your family. **Lifestyle Spending Account:** Receive company\-funded support for eligible health and well\-being expenses. **Commuter Benefits:** Access support for your commute where available. **Volunteering Opportunities:** Receive eight paid hours each year to give back to your community. **AI Tools and Training:** Access enterprise AI tools and ongoing training that helps PMGers use AI effectively, creatively, and responsibly. *Our benefits and compensation programs may vary by location and eligibility and are subject to applicable plan terms. We'll share full details during the hiring process.* **What Sets Us Apart** Being part of PMG means joining a company culture that's unmatched in digital. We're dedicated to working hard to serve our employees and clients, delivering value, results, and innovation—which often requires true grit and agility. We believe in taking care of ourselves and each other to continuously improve in every way. In alignment with our core values to be inclusive and always change for the better, PMG is committed to creating a more diverse and inclusive culture, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe that we only change for the better by bringing diverse perspectives to our company. PMG recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.
