jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role.** PURE Insurance is actively investing in our data, analytics, data science, machine learning (ML), and artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities. We are building IDEAS (Innovation in Data Engineering, Analytics \& Science), a centralized Data \& AI department that brings together specialists across data architecture, engineering, analytics, governance, and advanced modeling. This structure creates opportunities for collaboration and impact across every function of the insurance ecosystem, including Claims, Underwriting, Actuarial, Product, Distribution, and Finance. We are seeking a Senior AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI solutions that leverage unstructured and semi\-structured data to improve business processes and member outcomes. From claim notes and inspection reports to property photos, policy documents, call recordings, and correspondence, this role will focus on transforming complex information into actionable business value. As an early member of PURE's AI Engineering function, you will play a key role in building production\-ready AI solutions, establishing engineering best practices, and helping shape the team's future capabilities. **What You'll Do.** * Design and build end\-to\-end AI solutions, from initial scoping with business partners through development, evaluation, and production deployment. * Identify and apply the most effective AI or machine learning techniques for each business problem, including large language models (LLMs) and other approaches as appropriate. * Make key technical design decisions related to document parsing, information extraction, retrieval, and context engineering. * Partner with the AVP of AI Engineering to identify common patterns across solutions and develop reusable components for PURE's AI platform. * Collaborate with business stakeholders to define success criteria and develop evaluation and validation strategies that measure real\-world performance. * Monitor AI solutions in production, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve performance as business needs evolve. * Help establish engineering standards, development practices, and technical processes as PURE's AI Engineering function grows. Mentor junior AI engineers through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and technical guidance as the team expands. * **What We're Looking For.** * 3–5\+ years of experience developing Python\-based AI or machine learning solutions. * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience building solutions that leverage large language models (LLMs). * Demonstrated experience designing, deploying, and evaluating AI solutions in production environments. * Experience extracting and processing information from documents, images, and other unstructured data sources. * Strong understanding of LLM\-based applications, including retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), tool calling, and context engineering. * Experience developing evaluation frameworks and using performance metrics to guide AI solution development. * Strong engineering fundamentals, including Git, testing, CI/CD pipelines, and code reviews. * Working knowledge of major cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). * Ability to communicate technical concepts, design decisions, and trade\-offs effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. Strong problem\-solving skills and a business\-focused mindset, with an emphasis on delivering measurable results. * **What Will Make You Stand Out.** * Experience working in insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry. * Experience developing computer vision solutions. * Previous experience mentoring engineers or data scientists. * Experience building APIs or endpoints using FastAPI or Flask. * Familiarity with LLM observability and evaluation tools such as Arize or MLflow. ‌ **What We Do** We're a member\-owned property and casualty insurer designed exclusively for financially successful families and driven by a purpose of doing what is right for our members. We provide exceptional service, hospitality and care, we partner with our members to help prevent losses and we create smart insurance solutions at fair prices. We aim for our members to *love their insurance* . It is our mission is to create a membership experience so compelling that our members never want to leave. **Who We Are** We want to be transparent about what we expect from each other. jobs.title: Ocean Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Company** We are a renewable energy and ocean technology company committed to rapidly developing and deploying technologies that will ensure a sustainable future for Earth by unlocking the vast energy potential of its oceans. Our focus is on capturing civilizational levels of ultra\-low\-cost renewable energy for applications including computing and affordable renewable fuels delivered to shore. The company is a public benefit corporation headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and backed by leading venture capitalists, philanthropic investors, university endowments, and private investment offices. We operate as an idea meritocracy in which the best ideas change the company's direction on a regular basis. Our staff have worked at organizations such as SpaceX, Blue Origin, Boeing, Tesla, Apple, Virgin Orbit, Astra, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, New Relic, Bridgewater, Raytheon, Disney Imagineering, and the US Army and Air Force, as well as research universities, startups, and small companies across a range of industries. ### **About the Job** Our core technology is the node, a device that produces energy in the ocean's harshest conditions for years at a time without human maintenance or intervention. As an Ocean Engineer, you will drive design and operational engineering decisions through analysis of marine systems. You will work with our Principal Naval Architect and collaborate closely with various teams including computational fluid dynamics (CFD), node structures, mechanical engineering, marine operations, and systems engineering. This role focuses on reduced\-order and mid\-fidelity marine hydrodynamics tools. Candidates should have applied and theoretical knowledge of time and frequency domain marine dynamics modeling approaches. Working familiarity with DNV standards and metocean analysis is required. Programming skills are highly valued for this position. The ability to contribute to core naval architecture work including hydrostatics, stability and structures is also highly valued. Candidates should have strong interpersonal skills and be able to thrive in a creative, scrappy, and collaborative environment in which the best ideas change the company's direction on a regular basis. You will own your designs cradle\-to\-grave, from first concept through fabrication and deployment at sea. If you are an excellent engineer, regardless of your background, we want you to apply. We strive to be the best engineering team on the planet and we compensate our team accordingly. ### **Responsibilities** * Perform Orcaflex analysis and own engineering decisions relating to marine dynamic analysis for autonomous and conventional marine systems including the node and supporting vessels. * Guide project decisions by applying industry knowledge and experience from past offshore projects. * Guide analysis approaches and provide engineering quality assurance by leveraging strong physics intuition, theory, and knowledge of existing analogous designs and practices. * Work with metocean reanalysis data, measured ocean data, sea\-state statistics, wave spectra, wind statistics, and other environmental inputs. * Develop Python or MATLAB based workflows to drive analysis. Use git workflow. * Process, visualize, and interpret simulation results to evaluate power, propulsion, structural loading, motion, operability, survivability, and other performance metrics. * Compare mid\-fidelity models against CFD, experimental data, and sea\-trial data. * Collaborate within the CFD team to understand where high\-fidelity results can improve reduced\-order models and where reduced\-order tools can guide CFD validation priorities. * Develop new analysis methods and identify additional uses for fast\-running simulation tools across the company. * Write clear documentation, technical notes, plots, and presentations that communicate methods, assumptions, results, limitations, and recommendations. * Use modern software and AI\-assisted development tools effectively to accelerate coding, debugging, analysis, and documentation while maintaining strong engineering judgment and code review discipline. ### **Required Qualifications** * Legal authorization to work in the United States. * Bachelor's degree in Ocean Engineering, Naval Architecture, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, Applied Mathematics, or a similar field. * Strong foundation in fluid mechanics, marine hydrodynamics, ocean wave mechanics, rigid body dynamics, meteorology and physical oceanography (metocean) statistics, and physics\-based modeling. * Demonstrated theoretical and applied knowledge in mid\-fidelity time\-domain codes such as Orcaflex, ProteusDS, AQWA, MOSES, aNySIM/QSHIP, Flexcom, SIMA and BEM codes such as WAMIT, OrcaWave, Wadam, Nemoh, Capytaine. * Strong proficiency in Python or MATLAB for scientific computing, engineering analysis, data processing, and tool development. * Understanding of boundary element method concepts and their applicat ent. * Ability to collaborate with CFD, controls, mechanical, software, metocean, and test teams to resolve modeling and simulation issues. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Strong first\-principles engineering judgment and the ability to understand model assumptions, limitations, and appropriate use cases. ### **Desired Qualifications** * Master's or PhD in Ocean Engineering, Naval Architecture, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, Applied Mathematics, or a similar field. * At least several years of industry experience with offshore engineering on real world (constructed) projects. * Experience with DNV rules and standards especially for Marine Warranty review. * Experience in hydrostatics and stability, particularly with the GHS stability software, offshore towing, and barge loadouts. * Experience in structural design including vessel longitudinal strength and deck strength, foundations, basic beam theory, fatigue. * Experience with frequency\-domain and/or time\-domain BEM methods. * Experience with RANS theory and software, especially openFOAM or Star\-CCM\+. * Experience working with cloud or on\-prem HPC resources. * Experience with Python, MATLAB, C\+\+, Fortran, Julia, and git * Experience with classical control theory (PID, cascade PID), and/or modern control theory * Experience implementing co\-simulation workflows. * Experience with scale model testing, towing tanks, and/or wind tunnels * Experience with metocean reanalysis datasets, measured ocean data, wave spectra, environmental contours, or fleet deployment simulations. * Experience validating reduced\-order models against CFD, wave basin data, tow tank data, sea\-trial data, or field measurements. * Working knowledge of Linux environments * Experience with software engineering practices for scientific code, including testing, documentation, version control, packaging, and code review. * Experience with marine energy systems, offshore structures, floating bodies, propulsion, mooring systems, or autonomous marine systems. * Experience in startup environments or fast\-paced R\&D teams; comfortable with ambiguity, proactive in shaping work, and adaptable to change. The above qualifications are desired, not required. We encourage you to apply if you are a strong candidate with only some of the desired skills and experience listed. ### **Additional Requirements** * Occasional extended hours or weekend work to support key milestones, sea trials, fleet operations, or urgent design decisions. * Travel to vendors and test sites as needed * Intermittently able to work longer hours and weekends to support critical needs. While we expect a lot of each other, we also offer a high degree of autonomy and work\-life balance, including flexible PTO and flexible working hours. ### **Compensation and Benefits** If hired for this full\-time role, you will receive: * Cash compensation of $175,000 – $235,000\. * Equity in the company. We're all owners and if we're successful, this equity should be far and away the most valuable component of your compensation. * A benefits package that helps you take care of yourself and your family, including: + Flexible paid time off + Health insurance (the company pays 100% of gold\-level PPO plan for full\-time employees, their partners, and dependents) + Dental insurance (the company pays 100% for full\-time employees, their partners, and dependents) + Vision insurance (the company pays 100% for full\-time employees, their partners, and dependents) + Disability insurance (the company pays 100% for a policy to provide long\-term financial support if you become disabled) + Ability to contribute to tax\-advantaged accounts, including 401(k), health FSA, and dependent care FSA * Relocation assistance to facilitate your move to Portland (if needed). ### **Location** Strong preference for candidates based in Portland, Oregon. Exceptional remote candidates will be considered, with regular travel to Portland expected.

jobs.title: Lead ML Engineer
jobs.description: 46807 Los Angeles, CA, US, 90038 Technology Los Angeles Full\-Time On\-Site **Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.** Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator\-first, audience\-focused, tech\-forward, globally scaled. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next\-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO! **Job Title**: Lead ML Engineer **Team**: Technology \- Enterprise Solutions **Location**: Los Angeles (Burbank) **Overview** Paramount’s Platforms \& Intelligent Automation team (Enterprise Solutions \& Technology) is building a knowledge layer for the company. This layer helps AI agents and decision\-makers access important information. It includes titles and content, rights and contracts, talent and participants, and other business data that connects them. As our Lead Machine Learning Engineer for Enterprise Knowledge Graph \& Ontology, you will design Paramount’s enterprise ontology and knowledge graphs. You will build machine learning systems to ensure these graphs are precise. This includes tasks like entity resolution, LLM\-based information extraction, and graph learning. You will also deploy models and graph services. This will help create knowledge\-grounded AI agents. They will have a consistent and semantically linked view of the business. You will set the technical direction for this program. This includes data modeling, MLOps, and production operations. You will work autonomously, with minimal oversight. Close collaboration with data owners, enterprise architects, and agent developers across Enterprise Solutions \& Technology and the business units will be key. **Key Responsibilities** * Enterprise ontology and semantic modeling (25%). Design and manage Paramount’s enterprise ontology and domain models. This includes content and title hierarchies. It also covers rights and obligations, talent and participants, organizations, deals, and financial and operational entities. Ensure that all of these align with industry standards. You make the modeling decisions; enterprise\-wide changes are ratified with data owners and architecture review. * Knowledge graph construction and entity resolution (25%). Build scalable pipelines that control both structured and unstructured systems. This includes structured data from rights management, ERP, contract and talent systems, and metadata catalogs. It also includes unstructured sources like contracts, scripts, and documents. The goal is to create knowledge graphs using platforms like Spanner Graph, Neo4j, or Amazon Neptune. Use machine learning for entity resolution and record linkage, along with LLM\-based information extraction and data quality scoring. Manage the master\-identity process to align entities across these systems. * Advanced machine learning on graphs (20%). Develop, evaluate, and deploy graph\-based learning techniques. These techniques include node and link prediction, graph neural networks, and graph embeddings. Work on predictive and semantic search as well. This includes GraphRAG retrieval, which supports knowledge\-grounded agents. Additionally, set the evaluation methodology. Establish the quality standards for the program. * MLOps and production knowledge services (15%). Use Vertex AI Pipelines and MLflow to productionize models and graph services. Implement versioning and use feature stores. Set up automated evaluation, monitoring, and drift detection. Share knowledge through well\-governed APIs and MCP tools. Make sure agent applications can use these tools while meeting security, privacy, and audit requirements. * Stakeholder partnership and program management (10%). Partner with Rights, Finance, Content Operations, and Talent business leads. Work with engineers in enterprise data governance and AI platforms. Define key questions and service levels. Create a plan. Translate requirements for offshore and vendor data engineers, and review their work. * Standards, reuse and mentorship (5%). Establish modeling standards, reusable graph and ML components and documentation; mentor engineers and data scientists in knowledge engineering and graph machine learning. * Ad hoc. Perform various ad hoc projects as needed, including executive proofs\-of\-concept and evaluation of emerging graph, retrieval and model capabilities. **Required Qualifications** * 8\+ years of experience in machine learning, data, or softwar rience with classical predictive modeling is also needed. Involving thorough offline and online evaluation. * Experience deploying ML on a major cloud (Google Cloud preferred; AWS or Azure acceptable) with MLOps practices such as CI/CD pipelines, model registry, and monitoring. * Proficient communication skills: able to gather requirements from business experts, document models clearly, and present trade\-offs to senior stakeholders. Experience working with distributed or offshore teams is a plus. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Science or a related field, or equivalent applicable experience. **Preferred Qualifications** * Media and entertainment experience (e.g., rights and royalties, content metadata, distribution and avails) or experience with rights\-management platforms. * Experience with GraphRAG, including hybrid retrieval (vector search plus graph traversal) and connecting knowledge to agent frameworks (e.g., Google ADK, LangGraph) via MCP. * Experience with master data management and data governance tools (e.g., Collibra, Informatica, Google Dataplex), and with data\-product or data\-mesh delivery. * Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning or Information Science; publications, patents or open\-source contributions in knowledge graphs, NLP or graph ML. * Experience with Wikidata / Wikibase, Palantir Foundry Ontology as enterprise context layers for AI agents. \#LI\-JC1 **About Skydance** Skydance is a next\-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct\-to\-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount\+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION Hiring Salary Range: $156,800\.00 \- 235,200\.00\. In compliance with local law, we are disclosing compensation, or a range thereof, for roles where legally required. Actual salaries will vary based on a variety of job\-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, external market data, internal equity, skill set, experience, training, education, and/or performance. Base pay is just one component of our total compensation package. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, short\- and long\-term incentives, and program\-specific awards. This position is bonus eligible. **What We Offer**: * Attractive compensation and comprehensive benefits packages. Check out our full list of benefits here. * Generous paid time off. * Complimentary subscriptions to HBO Max, Paramount\+, and other Skydance streaming services and digital news products. * Robust employee engagement opportunities, including access to exclusive screenings and events, speaker series, volunteer activities and more. Skydance is an equal opportunity employer (EOE) We embrace the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit. In line with the laws of the country or region in which the role is based, this includes consideration without regard to race, color, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship status, religion or belief, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, physical or mental disability, genetic information, military or protected veteran status, union status or any other category protected by applicable law. If you are a qualified individual with a disability, you may request a reasonable accommodation during the job application and/or recruitment process. You can request reasonable accommodations by calling 212\.846\.5500 or by sending an email to paramountaccommodations@paramount.com. Only messages left for this purpose will be returned.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer, Sustaining
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Senior Electrical Engineer, Sustaining **Department:** Hardware Engineering **Employment Type:** Full\-Time **FLSA Status:** Exempt **Location:** Houston, TX (on\-site) **Travel:** 10% **Who We Are** Persona is building humanoid robots for the most demanding environments in heavy industry — shipyards, steel mills, fabrication facilities, and offshore platforms — performing welding, grinding, maintenance, inspection, and material\-handling work that is dangerous, physically demanding, and increasingly difficult to staff. We are backed by leading strategic and financial investors and engaged with global industrial leaders across Korea, Japan, the United States, and Singapore. Korea is the center of gravity for our early commercial strategy, anchored by relationships with the world’s leading shipbuilders and steelmakers. Our work spans both the robot platform itself and the systems, partners, and playbooks required to deploy it at scale. **Why Join Persona?** * We offer competitive compensation, a performance\-based bonus, 100% employer covered medical benefits for most healthcare plans, early\-stage equity, competitive PTO, and company\-wide paid winter break between December 24th and January 2nd. * You’ll shape technology that’s redefining the possibilities of robotics and human interaction. * Work alongside passionate teammates who value creativity, and continuous learning. **About the Role** We’re looking for a Senior Sustaining Electrical Engineer to own the electronics we already have deployed on our robots. As we scale production, this role ensures our deployed and in\-production designs stay healthy, easy to build, and flexible enough to meet new customer needs. You will sit between our product\-focused design engineers and our manufacturing and field operations teams. When a board fails on the line, a robot misbehaves in the field, or a customer application needs something added or done differently, you are the person who troubleshoots it, finds the root cause, and drives the fix — whether that’s a rework, a component change, a design modification, or a documentation update. This is not a forward\-looking design role. It’s a role for an experienced, hands\-on engineer who thrives on variety, can juggle many inputs at once, and has the people skills to work across manufacturing, field ops, firmware, and design teams. Expect broad scope and lots of different problems: you’ll often be the filter and the bridge that closes the gap between manufacturing and operations. If you’ve supported products through their lifecycle and enjoy making shipped hardware work better at scale, we’d love to hear from you. **What You Will Be Doing** * Own deployed electrical designs across the robot — PCBAs, harnesses, and rigid\-flex assemblies for actuators, sensors, perception, compute, and power — keeping them reliable, manufacturable, and supportable through their lifecycle. * Serve as the primary electrical interface to manufacturing and field operations: triage incoming issues, prioritize across many inputs, and act as the filter between production, ops, and the product design team. * Troubleshoot and root\-cause failures on the production line and in the field, from board\-level faults to full\-robot system issues, using schematics, firmware knowledge, and lab tools (scope, logic analyzer, DMM). * Develop and implement fixes: reworks, component substitutions, ECOs, and targeted design modifications to existing boards. * Adapt existing designs for new or varied customer applications when something needs to be added or done differently. * Support the battery and battery management system (BMS) in the field and in production, including diagnostics and corrective actions. * Partner with manufacturing and EMS partners on yield, DFM/DFA/DFT improvements, test coverage, and production ramp. * Design and improve test fixtures and test procedures for production and failure analysis, including test software where needed. * Own documentation for sustained designs: failure analysis reports, ECOs, troubleshooting guides, work instructions, and revision control of schematics and BOMs. * Work across sustaining and product design teams to feed field and manufacturing learnings back into future designs. * Collaborate with firmware and software teams to diagnose issues that span hardware and code. **What We Are Looking For:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering. * 8\+ years of industry experience supporting production electronics, with project or program\-level ownership later in your career. * Very hands\-on: strong lab fluency with scope, logic analyzer, and DMM; you trust your measurements and can debug at both the board and system level. * Proven track record troubleshooting, root\-causing, and fixing issues in deployed or in\-production hardware. * Experience working directly with manufacturing, EMS partners, and field operations teams. * Ability to read and modify schematics and layouts in a modern ECAD tool (KiCAD, Altium, Cadence Allegro). * Solid fundamentals across mixed\-signal systems: power conversion, analog sensing, and embedded digital communication (CAN\-FD, EtherCAT, SPI, I2C, USB, Ethernet, RS485\). * A juggler: comfortable managing many simultaneous issues from many stakeholders and prioritizing what matters most. * Strong communication and people skills; you can translate between design engineers, technicians, and operations staff. * Disciplined documentation habits: ECOs, failure analysis reports, and revision control. **Bonus Skills:** * Prior experience in a sustaining engineering role. * Product lifecycle experience: supporting designs from launch through end\-of\-life, including obsolescence and component substitutions. * Test engineering experience, including designing test fixtures and writing test software. * Software development experience (Python, embedded C) for diagnostics, test automation, or firmware support. * Experience with battery systems and battery management (BMS). * Robotics, automation, or motor drive experience (BLDC/PMSM, gate drive, current sensing). * Experience supporting NPI and production ramp with overseas EMS partners. * Familiarity with IPC Class 2/3 standards and compliance requirements (FCC, CE, UL). * Experience using GitLab for revision control and reviews. ***Persona is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*** ***All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.***

We are continuing to grow at a faster pace and we want to continue to provide best\-in\-class experiences for pets and pet parents. Our **Technology team**has 6 different departments: Information Security, Service Delivery, Business Enabling Systems, eCommerce \& Marketing Technology, Data and Stores, Services \& Supply Chain. Whether it’s online or in our stores, the work that the IT team does is instrumental in PetSmart’s success. In a standard work week, associates may work up to one remote “flex day” (with leader approval). Our hybrid approach is designed to foster strong collaboration while also supporting flexibility and individual success. **About the Job** **This role works in our Phoenix Home Office \- visa sponsorship is not available for this role** ================================================================================================= **Position Overview** ===================== As a Data Engineer, you will design, build, and support data solutions that help PetSmart teams make informed decisions and operate effectively. This mid\-level role focuses on delivering moderately complex pipelines, data models, integrations, or reporting components within a core data platform or domain. You will own defined work from design through production support, apply engineering standards, and partner with business and technology teams to deliver reliable, usable data products. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * Design, develop, test, and maintain moderately complex data pipelines, models, integrations, or reporting solutions using established architecture and engineering standards. * Work proficiently in at least one core data platform or domain, such as Databricks or Snowflake * Implement data quality checks, security and governance controls, documentation, lineage, metadata, and data contracts as appropriate. * Build and maintain automated tests, observability, and CI/CD practices that support reliable, repeatable delivery. * Own assigned data work from requirements and design through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing support. * Troubleshoot production issues, improve run stability, and contribute to root\-cause analysis and prevention of recurring problems. * Partner with stakeholders to clarify requirements, understand intended use, and recommend practical solutions to data needs. * Identify opportunities to improve data product quality, transparency, adoption, and engineering efficiency. * Participate in code and design reviews; share reusable practices and mentor Associate Data Engineers. * Collaborate across data, technology, product, and business teams to resolve blockers and deliver outcomes. **Qualifications \& Experience** ================================ * Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. * 2–5 years of experience in data engineering or software development * Proficiency in SQL and experience with at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python. * Experience working with cloud based data platforms and services such as GCP, AWS, or Azure. * Demonstrated experience building and supporting data pipelines, data models, integrations, or data products in a production environment. * Experience with a core data platform such as Databricks, Snowflake, or a comparable technology. * Working knowledge of data testing, quality, observability, version control, CI/CD, and deployment practices. * Familiarity with APIs, file\-based and message\-based integrations, and common data formats such as JSON, XML, and Parquet. * Understanding of data security, governance, documentation, and the importance of producing trusted, usable data. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to manage defined work independently and raise risks early. * Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and nontechnical partners. **What Will Set You Apart** =========================== * You connect technical choices to the business problem and recommend solutions that improve data usability and value. * You take ownership from design through production support, communicate risks early, and follow issues through to resolution. * You look beyond the immediate task to improve data quality, reliability, performance, cost, and maintainability. * You make complex data easier for others to understand through clear documentation, lineage, and collaboration. * You seek feedback, share what you learn, and help Associate Data Engineers and teammates grow. * You build strong partnerships across data, technology, product, and business teams to deliver outcomes together. **Additional Job Considerations** * This role requires collaboration, teamwork, and face\-to\-face interaction with colleagues, leaders, and/or clients. * Being in the office ensures access to leaders, cross\-functional partners, and resources necessary to make timely decisions and drive results. * On\-site presence in accordance with our FlexSmart policy supports our culture of innovation, mentorship, and engagement, which is integral to our success in developing the best team. * *This is not intended to be an all\-inclusive, exhaustive list of all essential job functions for this position. PetSmart retains the right to change or assign other required job duties to this position.* **About the Culture** Our associates are the heart of Team PetSmart. Together, we’re building the best team in retail through our values\-based culture, connection, and teamwork. Our goal is to create a culture where associates learn and grow together, thrive as effective teams and challenge each other to be the best they can be. Our home office offers outstanding amenities in a fun and rewarding workplace including: * **Pet\-friendly environment** , bring your pets to work and enjoy the on\-site dog park! * **On\-Site Events \& Adoptions** , enjoy community\-building opportunities, including pet adoption days, seasonal celebrations, family events, art events, \& holiday festivals * **“Top Dog” gym**with equipment, fitness classes, massage therapists, personal trainers, and wellness spaces * **“Sit \& Stay” Café** serving fresh breakfast and lunch options, snacks, \& more * “ **Lil Paws” NAEYC\-accredited onsite childcare** facility providing high\-quality early education * **Paid Volunteer Opportunities**to spend time doing good for causes close to heart * **Print Center and Business Services** , Dry Cleaning, Mother's Rooms, Sustainable Infrastructure \& more PetSmart provides an equal opportunity for all associates and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Workflow Automation Specialist
jobs.description: **About PHIL** -------------- Getting a prescription filled shouldn't be the hardest part of starting treatment. Yet for many patients, it is. PHIL is a Series D health\-tech company building the platform that connects patients, prescribers, pharmacies, and pharmaceutical manufacturers so patients can get their medication quickly and affordably. Our digital hub and pharmacy platform handles everything from enrollment and benefits verification to prior authorization, copay support, and home delivery. For manufacturers, that means more patients start therapy and stay on it, plus the commercial insight to keep improving access. We're a diverse team of people from a wide range of backgrounds, united by a focus on the patient experience. **The role** ------------ We're hiring a Workflow Automation Specialist to remove manual work from our pharmacy network and patient fulfillment operations through practical automation and AI workflows. This is an individual contributor, hands\-on operations role, not a custom\-engineering or research role. Faster, cleaner operations let us serve more patients as we grow. You'll report to the VP of Operations and work closely with our frontline pharmacy intake, customer care, and fulfillment teams, and with Engineering. You'll lead the discovery and build the solutions alongside operations, while Engineering supports on security, compliance, and handoffs. **What you'll own** ------------------- * **Workflow discovery:** Shadow pharmacy intake, customer care, and fulfillment teams, then map current processes and leaner future\-state versions. * **Automations and AI workflows:** Build with Make, Zapier, n8n, or Power Automate plus LLM APIs for document triage, data validation, status updates, and ticket resolution, favoring simple, maintainable fixes and flagging what to redesign or eliminate instead. * **Engineering partnership:** Work with Engineering on secure API access, data integrity, and compliance, and hand off automations that become core product infrastructure. * **Measurement and guardrails:** Set KPIs upfront (cycle time, touchpoints per order, error rate, hours saved), monitor error logs and AI output accuracy, and keep platform costs in check. * **Adoption and reuse:** Write documentation, train operations staff, gather feedback, and package proven automations and prompt templates for other teams. **What success looks like in your first year** ---------------------------------------------- * **By 90 days:** You've shadowed the pharmacy intake, customer care, and fulfillment teams, mapped their current workflows, and shipped a first automation with agreed KPIs. * **By 6 months:** Several of your automations are live and in daily use, with documentation, trained users, and tracked results on cycle time, error rate, and hours saved. * **By 12 months:** Operations teams beyond your first partners use your reusable automation patterns and prompt templates, and your KPIs show a measurable drop in manual touchpoints and errors. **What you'll bring** --------------------- Our strongest candidates have worked alongside operations teams and built live automations, so they understand how frontline work gets done and what makes a tool stick. They come from process automation, business systems analysis, or operations engineering, and they enjoy listening to non\-technical teammates describe their daily pain points. * 3\-6 years of experience in business process automation, operational excellence, business systems analysis, or operations engineering * Hands\-on experience building and maintaining live automations in a workflow platform (Make, Zapier, n8n, Workato, or Power Automate), using REST APIs and webhooks * Practical experience using AI in production workflows, such as LLM prompt engineering, agents, structured document extraction, or automated classification and summarization * Experience running process discovery with operational stakeholders and producing clear process maps and SOPs * Clear communication with frontline support staff, clinical coordinators, and software engineers alike * You default to action: you prototype quickly, handle edge cases, and ship working solutions over perfect ones **Nice to have** ---------------- * Light scripting in Python or JavaScript/Node.js for custom API payloads or data transformations when low\-code tools hit their limits * Experience with data hygiene, prompt evaluation, and monitoring for autonomous agent loops * Background in healthcare operations, pharmacy fulfillment, or patient\-support services, and familiarity with HIPAA **Why PHIL** ------------ At PHIL, we're tackling one of healthcare's most persistent challenges: helping patients access the medications they need without unnecessary delays, complexity, or financial barriers. As a growing Series D healthcare technology company, we're building solutions that connect patients, prescribers, pharmacies, and pharmaceutical manufacturers to improve the prescription experience. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact at a pivotal stage of our growth, helping shape solutions that improve patient access and support PHIL's continued expansion. **Benefits at a glance** ------------------------ * Fully remote working environment available in the following states: AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IA, ID, IL, IN, MA, MI, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WV * Full benefits (medical, dental, vision) * 401(k) contribution opportunity * Paid Parental Leave * Fertility Benefit *PHIL is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.* Compensation Range: $120K \- $150K

is required Tuesday through Thursday. **Job Description:** **Key Areas of Accountability** **Digital Engineering \& Technology Leadership** * Lead and develop multidisciplinary technology teams responsible for digital applications, software engineering, platform integration, and technical delivery. * Own technical execution across the digital portfolio, including architecture, engineering standards, solution design, development, integration, deployment, and production support. * Establish modern software engineering practices, including Agile delivery, DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, and application performance management. * Make informed technology decisions involving custom development, vendor platforms, cloud services, and enterprise integration. * Ensure solutions meet standards for scalability, reliability, security, maintainability, and performance. **Digital Platforms \& Enterprise Integration** * Lead technology delivery for digital patient and member experiences, including portals, mobile applications, digital front door, scheduling, access, virtual care, and omnichannel communication. * Provide technical oversight of API\-driven architectures, middleware, identity management, CRM integrations, and interoperability. * Oversee the integration of digital solutions with Epic, health plan technology platforms, and other enterprise systems. * Collaborate with enterprise architecture, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and data teams to ensure sound technology decisions and alignment with enterprise standards. * Manage technology partners and vendors, with accountability for architecture, implementation quality, integration, and operational performance. **AI\-Enabled Digital Solutions** * Lead the technical evaluation, integration, implementation, and scaling of AI\-enabled capabilities within patient\- and member\-facing digital platforms. * Oversee solutions involving conversational AI, virtual assistants, intelligent self\-service, personalization, and workflow automation. * Evaluate AI technology architectures, including vendor solutions, APIs, model integration approaches, security requirements, and operational readiness. * Ensure AI\-enabled applications align with enterprise AI governance, data privacy, security, and responsible AI standards. * Translate emerging AI capabilities into practical, supportable technology solutions that deliver measurable business value. *This position is accountable for AI within digital applications, not the overall enterprise AI strategy.* **Technology Strategy, Execution \& Operational Accountability** * Develop and execute a multiyear digital technology roadmap aligned with organizational and business priorities. * Lead technology planning, engineering capacity management, portfolio prioritization, budgeting, and vendor performance. * Establish measurable accountability for delivery quality, platform reliability, adoption, technical debt, and business outcomes. * Balance innovation with operational stability, cybersecurity, cost management, and long\-term platform sustainability. * Serve as a senior technology leader and trusted partner to clinical, health plan, operational, and executive stakeholders. **Additional Job Description:** **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a closely related technical discipline, or equivalent demonstrated technical experience. * 15\+ years of progressive experience in enterprise technology, software engineering, application development, or digital platform delivery, includ logy platform teams in a complex enterprise environment. * Strong working knowledge of modern application architectures, APIs, cloud platforms, systems integration, software development lifecycle practices, and enterprise technology delivery. * Proven accountability for delivering and operating complex, business\-critical technology platforms. * Demonstrated ability to evaluate technical architectures, challenge engineering decisions constructively, and communicate technical tradeoffs effectively. * Experience managing technology leaders, engineering organizations, budgets, external vendors, and complex delivery portfolios. * Strong executive communication skills and the ability to translate business objectives into executable technology strategies. **Candidates must demonstrate substantial technology and engineering leadership experience. Clinical, operational, product, or digital transformation leadership experience alone, without direct accountability for technical teams and technology delivery, does not meet the requirements of this position.** **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience leading technology platforms in healthcare, health insurance, or other complex, highly regulated industries. * Experience with Epic integration, FHIR/HL7 interoperability, health plan platforms, or CRM technologies. * Experience delivering consumer\-facing applications at enterprise scale. * Experience deploying AI\-enabled applications, conversational AI, or intelligent automation in production environments. * Experience with cloud\-native architectures, API management, modern DevOps practices, and enterprise identity solutions. * Experience operating in an integrated payer\-provider environment. **Benefits** Benefits are effective day\-one (for .45 FTE and above) and include: * Competitive salaries * Full medical, dental and vision insurance * Flexible spending accounts (FSAs) * Free wellness programs * Paid time off (PTO) * Retirement plans, including matching employer contributions * Continuing education and career development opportunities * Life insurance and short/long term disability programs **About Us** Presbyterian Healthcare Services is a locally owned, not\-for\-profit healthcare system of nine hospitals, a statewide health plan and a growing multi\-specialty medical group. Founded in New Mexico in 1908, it is the state's largest private employer with approximately 11,000 employees. Presbyterian's story is really the story of the remarkable people who have chosen to work here. Starting with Reverend Cooper who began our journey in 1908, the hard work of thousands of physicians, employees, board members, and other volunteers brought Presbyterian from a tiny tuberculosis sanatorium to a statewide healthcare system, serving more than 700,000 New Mexicans. We are part of New Mexico's history \- and committed to its future. That is why we will continue to work just as hard and care just as deeply to serve New Mexico for years to come. **About New Mexico** New Mexico's unique blend of Spanish, Mexican and Native American influences contribute to a culturally rich lifestyle. Add in Albuquerque's International Balloon Fiesta, Los Alamos' nuclear scientists, Roswell's visitors from outer space, and Santa Fe's artists, and you get an eclectic mix of people, places and experiences that make this state great. Cities in New Mexico are continually ranked among the nation's best places to work and live by Forbes magazine, Kiplinger's Personal Finance, and other corporate and government relocation managers like Worldwide ERC. New Mexico offers endless recreational opportunities to explore, and enjoy an active lifestyle. Venture off the beaten path, challenge your body in the elements, or open yourself up to the expansive sky. From hiking, golfing and biking to skiing, snowboarding and boating, it's all available among our beautiful wonders of the west. AA/EOE/VET/DISABLED. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Robotics Simulation & AI Infrastructure
jobs.description: **Company:** ------------ Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. **Job Area:** ------------- Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Multimedia Systems **General Summary:** **About Qualcomm Robotics** The Qualcomm Advanced Robotics Team is building the AI\-first stack for the next generation of general\-purpose robots — from AMRs and cobots to emerging humanoids — pairing heterogeneous compute (CPU/GPU/DSP/NPU) with a full Robotics SDK, an integrated simulation platform, and AI operations infrastructure. With our high\-performance robotics SoCs, workloads that previously required the cloud now run on\-device, at the edge, at scale. **About This Team** We build AI infrastructure for modern robotics. The simulator is a central tool in it: a modern platform developed in\-house, built on high\-performance computing and open data formats such as OpenUSD, URDF, and glTF, intended to be best\-in\-class, and tuned for Qualcomm robotics SoCs and the robots they run on. The robots span the field — tabletop manipulation with robotic arms, legged locomotion, navigation and vision, and long\-horizon tasks that carry a robot through multi\-stage scenes requiring reasoning over many steps. This is a ground\-up software effort: runtime architecture, performance, clean APIs, and developer tooling. The simulator is a first\-class target on both developer workstations and cloud compute — interactive authoring and vectorized GPU environments locally, orchestrated headless jobs at scale in the cloud. We use it to train policies, generate synthetic data for robot foundation models, gate software releases in CI, run hardware\-in\-the\-loop against real silicon, and close the sim\-to\-real gap on deployed robots. We deliver jointly with Qualcomm’s AI operations workstreams, and a meaningful slice of the engineering sits where simulation plugs into the training, dataset, and deployment infrastructure they own. **The Opportunity** You will own significant pieces of a simulation platform on the critical path of Qualcomm’s robotics products — the runtime and its abstractions, the physics and rendering integrations, the training and data\-generation paths, the HIL and CI plumbing, or the developer experience that makes all of it usable by robotics engineers who are not simulation specialists — across robot arms, legged platforms, and mobile robots. This is first and foremost a simulation role — roughly 80% of the work is the simulator itself as a critical platform component. The remaining \~20% is AI infrastructure enablement: integrating simulation into the training, dataset, and deployment pipelines owned by the AI operations team, working with them rather than replacing them. **What You’ll Do** * Design and build core simulator subsystems — scene representation and authoring, physics backends, sensor models, rendering — across the scenarios our robots work in: tabletop manipulation, legged locomotion, navigation and vision, and long\-horizon, multi\-stage tasks. * Profile and optimize simulation and training workloads — physics solvers, rendering, data pipelines — so interactive workstation sessions and training throughput at scale stay high. * Integrate and extend best\-in\-class open engines — GPU physics, USD/Hydra rendering, offline path tracing — behind clean, swappable interfaces. * Build high\-throughput paths for policy training and synthetic data generation: vectorized environments, GPU\-resident state, procedural scene variation, domain randomization, and ground\-truth labeling — consistent from an interactive workstation session to scheduled headless runs in the cloud. * Make simulation a release gate: scenario suites, deterministic replay, benchmarks, and metrics that catch regressions before they reach hardware. * Enable the continuous learning workflows that simulation feeds into, in partnership with the AI operations team: make simulation a first\-class, config\-driven stage in collect–merge–train–eval pipelines with reproducible run manifests and artifacts, so the same experiment runs locally and as containerized GPU jobs (Argo Workflows on Kubernetes) without the sim engineer owning the surrounding infrastructure. * Stand up hardware\-in\-the\-loop configurations: production robotics software running on Qualcomm silicon in communication with the simulator on the host workstation or cloud, and quantify where simulation and reality diverge — system identification, contact and actuator modeling, sensor noise, measured transfer results. * Partner with AI operations, perception, controls, and silicon teams, and own the design docs, reviews, tests, and APIs others depend on. **Who We Look For** * Strong software engineering fundamentals, with production code you can talk through in depth. * A working grasp of simulation as applied to robotics: rigid\-body dynamics, kinematics, coordinate frames, jobs.description: **About Us** RCH Solutions is a rapidly growing global provider of computational science expertise within Life Sciences and Healthcare. At RCH, our team rallies around a culture crafted for learning and achieving. We’re relentless in our pursuit for innovation and demanding of ourselves to deliver a ground\-breaking computing experience for our clients, so that they can deliver life\-saving science to humanity. **Core Values** At RCH, our Core Values are more than just words—they represent the threads that weave together the fabric of our culture. Used as a guide when interviewing new team members; as a barometer when evaluating our performance as individuals and teams, and even when deciding which customers to work with, RCH’s Values embody the behaviors upon which we measure our success and create a framework for our growth as people and professionals. Our Core Values:* Embrace Excellence: We strive for best\-in\-class delivery of innovation and service. * Be Accountable: Integrity, ownership and accountability are non\-negotiables. * Adventure Together: We are committed to fostering a culture that embraces continuous improvement. * Succeed as a Team: We believe harnessing the power of a team drives outcomes not achievable by individuals. * Boundaries and Balance: Work\-life balance is a core facet of our culture. If you share in our core values, then we encourage you to continue reading this posting as you may have found a great home for your career. **Job Description** RCH Solutions is seeking a Cloud Engineer to design, build, and operate cloud\-native services on Google Cloud Platform in support of research and bioinformatics workloads. The right candidate will develop microservices and web applications that put scientific computing directly in the hands of researchers and will build and maintain the workflow orchestration that runs bioinformatics pipelines at scale. You will function as a team member integrating cloud services, scientific applications, and upstream and downstream data systems into a coherent platform. Our ideal candidate is an experienced and talented engineer who is equally comfortable writing production code and reasoning about infrastructure, and who will be instrumental in transforming how computing services are leveraged to support our client's science. This role will involve driving architecture, roadmaps, and execution of projects that deliver GCP\-based platform services to scientific end users. You will develop and implement engineering best practices for customers and RCH applications teams; engaging in the fast\-moving realm of Life Sciences, prioritizing innovation. The cloud landscape and the bioinformatics tooling ecosystem are both continuously evolving, with new services and pipeline frameworks released constantly. You know how to distinguish hype from reality and are comfortable making recommendations that best suit our clients’ needs. **Responsibilities:*** Design, build, and deploy microservices and APIs on Google Cloud Platform to support scientific and bioinformatics workloads * Develop and maintain web applications that give researchers self\-service access to data, pipelines, and compute * Build, operate, and tune workflow orchestration for bioinformatics pipelines, including scheduling, error handling, and runtime and cost optimization * Integrate cloud services, scientific applications, and internal and third\-party data systems through well\-documented, maintainable interfaces * Ensure that all systems are compliant with company security standards and applicable regulatory requirements * Troubleshoot operational issues as they arise on supported platforms, and escalate to other IT units as necessary **Essential Qualifications:*** 3\+ years of professional experience in cloud engineering or software engineering, including production workloads on Google Cloud Platform * Experience designing and deploying microservices, including containerization and REST or gRPC API development * Experience with a workflow orchestration framework for scientific or data pipelines, such as Nextflow, Cromwell, Snakemake, or Airflow * Demonstrated systems integration experience connecting cloud services, applications, and external data sources * Web application development experience, either full stack or strong backend skills paired with working front\-end proficiency * Proficiency in Python and comfort working in a Linux environment * Excellent communication skills, including preparation of written documentation for IT colleagues and scientific end users * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Bioinformatics, or equivalent work experience **Preferred Qualifications:*** Hands\-on experience supporting bioinformatics or computational biology workloads, such as genomics and NGS pipelines, structural biology, or cheminformatics * Familiarity with GCP services including GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Storage * Experience with infrastructure as code, such as Terraform * Proficient in building Docker images * Experience with CI/CD for building and deploying containerized services * R, or other programming languages common in scientific computing * Has good knowledge of deploying or supporting GxP systems * Git, BitBucket, or other version control tools **Additional information** Great talent should benefit from a great work environment. If you join our team, you’ll have access to:* A competitive salary and bonus package based on experience. * Comprehensive health and wellness benefits, including Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance. * Company\-provided Life and Long\-Term Disability Insurance. * Company\-sponsored 401(k) Plan. * Team\-focused culture and unlimited opportunity for advancement. ***\*\*This is an onsite position and the candidate will be required to be onsite in our client facility in Collegeville, PA at least 3 days per week.*** ***\*\*Role is only open to applicants not needing sponsorship now or in the future, no third parties please.*** GsGonmNoRd

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Client Success
jobs.description: **About Rebar** --------------- Construction is a $2 trillion industry in the US alone. Most of it still runs like it’s 1995: PDFs, spreadsheets, and email. Every commercial building starts the same way. Someone opens a few hundred pages of blueprints and counts every piece of equipment, duct, and pipe by hand. Then they price it, bid it, and chase it for months. That work decides who builds what, and for how much. It has barely changed in 30 years. Rebar is building the AI platform the trades run on. Our models read blueprints the way a veteran in the trades does. Our agents then do the work that follows: counting the job, pricing it, managing the bid, and tracking it through to the order. Counts that took three days now take one. Customers spend hours a day in Rebar, and thousands of new plan sets flow through it every week. We started with HVAC contractors and their suppliers. Every other trade comes next. Here’s where we go: when a building goes up, the trades that build it run on Rebar. Agents win the job, run the job, and buy the equipment. We’re about 50 people in Union Square, growing fast, and backed by top investors. We’ve built only a fraction of what we need to. **About the Engineering Org** ----------------------------- The role of the engineer is rapidly changing. We're aware, and we're being intentional about adapting with it. We are fostering an engineering culture of growth and development. We strongly emphasize care of craft and winning together. Our core values are: * Everyone operates like an owner * Find a way * We win together That being said, the whole company still works really hard! This is something that you should read and internalize. This might not be the place for everyone. **About the Role** ------------------ We're hiring a software engineer to be the technical arm of our Client Success and Implementation teams. As we sign bigger customers, every deployment comes with more technical work attached. A contractor wants their historical projects loaded in. Another wants our analytics piped into their ERP or BI tool. Another needs an API change, so their internal systems can pull takeoff data. Today, that work lands on the core engineering team as one\-off requests, pulling them off the roadmap. We want one engineer who owns it. You will still sit in the engineering org and have strong mentorship and learning. You'll come to engineering stand\-ups, ship through our normal review process, and attend retros. Your priorities come from our customers. You can think about this role almost as a forward\-deployed engineer. You'll be on calls with customers, figuring out what they actually need and then building it. You’ll get to work with messy data, API integrations, and customer expansion. We understand the challenges and sacrifices that come with joining an early\-stage startup, and we want to emphasize that we're committed to ensuring you leave as a better, more experienced engineer and leader than when you joined. Here you'll own a hard piece of client\-side engineering, and watch it scale from hundreds to thousands of users. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Own customer data work * Build and maintain integrations * Handle customer API requests * Scope technical requirements with customers * Be the escalation path for technical issues * Turn one\-offs into product **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- We want an engineer who likes talking to customers. You should be able to sit on a call with an estimator, understand how their team works, and then go write the script that fixes their problem. You'll be working with messy real\-world data, so you should enjoy digging into it and not be scared of a 50,000\-row CSV with inconsistent columns. We are looking for engineers with good judgment, an inquisitive attitude, and the maturity to represent engineering in front of a customer. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 2\+ years of software engineering experience, or a technical client\-facing role (solutions engineer, implementation engineer, forward deployed engineer) where you wrote real code * Strong Python for scripting and data work * Comfortable with SQL and relational databases (we're on Postgres) * Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, and webhooks * Comfortable talking directly with customers, from end users to technical stakeholders * Writes things down. Your integrations and scripts should be documented well enough that someone else can run them. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Familiarity with TypeScript and React * Experience with AWS (Lambda, S3, DynamoDB) * Experience with GraphQL * Experience with integration platforms or unified APIs (e.g., Merge) * Background in construction, HVAC/mechanical, or another legacy industry * Familiarity with estimating, takeoff, ERP, or project management tools used in construction * Worked at an early\-stage or high\-growth startup **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- * **Salary**: Competitive base salary * **Equity**: Meaningful equity package, commensurate with experience * **Benefits**: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * **Perks**: + Agentic tooling budget + Lunches provided, dinners provided (after a set time) + Great culture in a high\-energy office This is a full\-time, on\-site role in NYC’s Flatiron District, steps from Madison Square Park and Union Square. Occasional travel for on\-site customer visits. *Equal Opportunity* *Rebar is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.* Compensation Range: $120K \- $165K

development, data access, query optimization, and performance considerations. * Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and evolving data models, including entity relationships, document structures, schema design, and the impact of modeling decisions on application behavior and performance. * Experience designing and delivering complex data\-intensive applications, ingestion product\-specific customer extraction functionality based on defined product specifications, including data selection, filtering, transformation, formatting, and delivery requirements. * Lead the jobs.title: AI Enablement & Infrastructure Engineer (Contract)
jobs.description: **Job Overview** **Help shape how AI works at sea, at one of the most unique communities on the planet.** We are a private residential community on a ship that never stops travelling. We're growing with AI, and what feels advanced today will look simple in a few years. We'd like you to be part of that journey: supporting our teams as they learn and build, and helping IT keep it all secure. Our teams already use AI every day, and we have a clear AI policy in place. Your job is to help them go further, faster and safely. * **Educate.** Run practical sessions for office and shipboard teams, share prompting best practices, and turn our AI Usage Policy into quick guides people actually use. * **Mature our AI products and services.** Help improve the AI tools, agents and automations we already have, so they become more reliable, useful and well supported over time. * **Support the business.** Work side by side with teams and department champions to turn good ideas into agents and apps on our approved platforms, and share the wins. * **Evaluate and manage risk.** Help teams register new agents and apps, assess their data, access and security risks, and keep safeguards in place as they grow. You'll support our Infrastructure \& Cybersecurity Manager across day\-to\-day operations and security, ashore and on board. * **Keep people productive.** Install and troubleshoot desktop apps (Microsoft 365, Teams, Adobe, browsers, AI tools) and hardware, from laptops and docks to printers, phones and meeting\-room AV. * **Run the Microsoft backbone.** Manage accounts, groups and device policies in Active Directory, Entra ID and Intune. Support SharePoint sites, permissions and sync, and Exchange Online mail flow, lists and filtering. * **Keep everyone connected.** Support wired and wireless networks, VPN, zero trust access, web security, remote desktop, and our Teams phone system and call queues. * **Onboard and offboard.** Set up laptops, accounts and apps for new joiners, and close access cleanly for leavers. * **Stay patched.** Track exploitable vulnerabilities and drive operating system and application updates and hardening, automating where possible. * **Protect and recover.** Monitor backups across cloud and on\-premises, run test restores, and help with recovery. * **Respond to threats.** Help contain and investigate incidents with our endpoint, SIEM and SOC tools, and handle phishing alerts. * **Support our cloud.** Provision, size and maintain virtual servers in Azure and AWS. * **Secure our AI.** Help assess agents and apps before go\-live, set up agent identities and approved connectors, and spot shadow AI. Who we think is the right candidate * **AI application development** — Has built and deployed an internal AI application, such as a knowledge assistant or workflow tool, using model APIs and approved company data. Can explain how the application enforces user permissions and how its outputs were tested. * **Autonomous agent development** — Has built and deployed an agent that can carry out a multi\-step business workflow and take authorized actions in connected systems. Can explain what triggers the agent, which actions it can take independently, and when it asks for human approval. * **Technical skills** — Proficient in Python or TypeScript, REST APIs, authentication, and Git. Has hands\-on experience integrating AI applications and agents with business systems such as Microsoft 365, SharePoint, or internal APIs. * **Security and governance** — Knows how to apply least\-privilege access, manage service identities and secrets, log agent actions, prevent duplicate actions during retries, and pause or disable an agent when needed. * **Evidence of experience** — Can walk through one AI application and one autonomous workflow they personally built, including how they tested failures, monitored quality and cost, and handed over ongoing operations to a named owner. **Bonus points:** Azure or AWS, Teams Phone, SIEM or EDR tools, vulnerability management, GitHub Enterprise, hospitality or maritime experience, a security certification. Pay: $76,800\.00 \- $92,600\.00 per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in Sunrise, FL 33323

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: ***Posting Type*** Remote/Hybrid ***Job Overview*** Job Overview WHO WE ARE Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI\-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high\-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial. The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work. WHAT WE DO claiR is Relativity's conversational AI experience, built for lawyers at the world's leading law firms. Running inside the Relativity aiR platform, claiR is an agentic surface into Relativity's petabytes of matter intelligence, letting users search, enrich, and generate work product from their data, with answers grounded in the matter's documents and backed by citations. The claiR team builds and ships this experience, from the AI and retrieval systems that reason across a matter to the web interface that lawyers and case teams use to explore their data and collaborate. ***Job Description and Requirements*** **ABOUT THE ROLE** This role offers an opportunity to grow as a full\-stack AI engineer on the team building claiR, the conversational AI experience lawyers use to ask questions, search, and draft from their matter data. You will work alongside the engineers and applied scientists who build claiR and gain direct exposure to how agentic features are designed, evaluated, and shipped. You will begin with well\-defined features across the stack and grow toward end\-to\-end ownership of agentic features. This Senior AI Engineer role is designed for a mid\-to\-high level engineer ready to grow quickly. The role reports to a Lead Engineer on claiR at Relativity and may be based remotely in the United States or in our Chicago office. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** * Build features across the full stack of claiR, including agent tools, prompt and context changes, services and API endpoints, and front\-end work in the claiR web app. * Work with applied scientists to extend claiR’s agentic functionality with new capabilities and features. * Write and extend evaluations, run them, and learn to interpret the results. Ship changes behind feature flags and monitor production outcomes. * Learn and practice a modern software development lifecycle from day one through small, frequent commits, feature\-flagged deployments, fast rollbacks, and best\-in\-class agentic engineering tools. * Fix bugs, improve reliability, and add tests while developing an understanding of how agentic systems fail. * Pair with Senior and Lead engineers on design and code reviews.
