jobs.title: Software Engineer III
jobs.description: **About Renaissance** When you join Renaissance®, you join a global leader in pre\-K–12 education technology! Renaissance's solutions help educators analyze, customize, and plan personalized learning paths for students, allowing time for what matters—creating energizing learning experiences in the classroom. Our fiercely passionate employees and educational partners have helped drive phenomenal student growth, with Renaissance solutions being used in over one\-third of US schools and in more than 100 countries worldwide. Every day, we are connected to our mission by exemplifying our values: trust each other, win together, strive for the best, own our actions, and grow and evolve. **Job Description** As a Software Engineer III, you will build features across the discovery layer and the products behind it: the search and browse experiences teachers use to find the right lesson, the curation tools admins use to govern what their district sees, and the services that make four separate products feel like one library. You will be making it fast and intuitive for admins to govern and curate, for teachers to find and instruct, and for students to explore and grow their respective libraries. You will work with a high degree of independence and help ensure that problems and solutions are appropriately scoped. In addition, you will be the first team to adopt Renaissance's S3 model of software development. You will be expected to build **multi\-agent orchestration**, where specialized agents coordinate on complete features and engineers shift from managing individual tasks to designing the systems that produce the work. **In this role as a Software Engineer III, you will:** * Build features across the discovery layer and the products it connects — search and browse for teachers, curation and governance for admins, exploration for students. * Develop backend services that leverage relational databases, non\-relational datastores, message queuing, and cloud infrastructure, against typed contracts. * Build and test frontend experiences in TypeScript and React, contract\-tested against the backend, with accessibility treated as a requirement rather than a follow\-up. * Write the tests and the instrumentation with the feature — unit, component, and contract tests, plus the traces, metrics, and logs that make the system debuggable. **Qualifications** **For this role, you must have:** * Professional experience building and shipping production web applications or services. * Experience developing backend services against relational databases, and comfort with non\-relational datastores, message queuing, and/or cloud infrastructure. * Excitement to help craft a new, AI\-first software development lifecycle. The idea of encoding engineering understanding into formal constraints that can be consumed by an AI workflow is an interesting problem to you, not a necessary evil. * Working knowledge of cloud operations — you can deploy across environments, read a dashboard, and troubleshoot an application problem in a cloud environment. * Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate well with distributed engineering, product, and design teams. * Bachelor's degree or equivalent industry experience. **Experience with various engineering technologies such as:** * SQL (MSSQL, PostgreSQL, etc.) * Proficiency in a typed language, ideally TypeScript, and comfort working in a strictly typed codebase. **Optionally, you could have:** * Experience leading and mentoring others * Experience with the AWS technologies * Knowledge of DevOps processes and technologies **Additional information** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. #### **Salary Range:** **The base range for this position is $99,500\.00 \- $136,800\.00\. This range is based on national market data and may vary by experience and location.** **\#LI\-Remote** **Benefits for eligible US employees include:** * World Class Health Benefits: Medical, Prescription, Dental, Vision, Telehealth * Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts * 401(k) and Roth 401(k) with company match * Paid Vacation and Sick Time Off * 12 Paid Holidays * Parental Leave (20 total weeks with 14 weeks paid) \& Milk Stork program * Tuition Reimbursement * Life \& Disability Insurance * Well\-being and Employee Assistance Programs ***Benefits listed apply to eligible U.S. employees in accordance with Renaissance's benefits eligibility criteria. Contractor and other non‑employee roles are not eligible for Renaissance employee benefits.*** Frequently cited statistics show that some women, underrepresented individuals, protected veterans and individuals with disabilities may only apply to roles if they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Renaissance, we encourage all applications. Roles evolve over time, especially with innovation, and you may be just the person we need for the future! **Equal Opportunity Employer** Renaissance is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate with respect to any term, condition or privilege of employment based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, military or veteran status, marital status, or status of an individual in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. For California Residents, please see our Privacy Notice for California Job Candidates here. **Reasonable Accommodations** Renaissance also provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act and applicable state and local laws. If accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact Talent Acquisition. **Employment Authorization** Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time. For more information about Renaissance, visit: https://www.renaissance.com

jobs.title: Account Executive, Data Cloud & AI (Mid Market)
jobs.description: **About Rippling** ------------------ Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. **About the role** ------------------ The AI \& Data Cloud Account Executive role at Rippling is one of the highest\-impact opportunities in the company today. We are experiencing explosive customer demand for our AI Agents and underlying data platform, as companies look to automate away massive amounts of manual back\-office work across HR, IT, Finance, and Operations. We are building a team of highly driven, technical, and commercially sharp “hunters” who can operate in high\-velocity sales cycles while navigating complex, strategic conversations with senior stakeholders. This role sits at the center of Rippling’s next major growth vector: enabling customers to deploy AI Agents powered by unified data and custom applications built directly on the Rippling platform. Working closely with Account Manager partners, you will own the end\-to\-end cross\-sell motion for Rippling’s Agent Platform — including Data Cloud, custom Solutions, and Rippling AI. You will help customers move from fragmented systems and manual workflows to a unified, intelligent infrastructure where AI Agents can execute work autonomously across the back office. This is a rare opportunity to: * Sell a category\-defining platform at the intersection of data, applications, and AI Agents * Capitalize on surging inbound and outbound demand from customers actively seeking AI\-driven automation * Shape how modern companies adopt and scale Agent\-based automation across their core operations If you’re looking to operate at the forefront of AI, own a greenfield growth motion, and drive meaningful revenue impact in a rapidly scaling business, this role offers unmatched upside. **What you will do** -------------------- * **Drive Revenue:** Manage the full sales cycle for AI \& Data Cloud, from initial discovery and technical scoping to closing deals. * **Technical Partnership:** Collaborate extensively with Solutions Engineers (SEs), Professional Services, or Forward Deployed Engineers to bridge the gap between "vision" and "execution". * **Pipeline Management:** Maintain rigorous discipline in Salesforce to accurately forecast revenue and consistently achieve monthly or quarterly quotas. * **Subject Matter Expertise:** Become an expert on Rippling’s Data Cloud, understanding our positioning across the competitive landscape and serving as a product advocate. * **Build \& Improve:** Exercise the courage to challenge the status quo; if you see a process that is broken, take the initiative to fix it. **What you will need** ---------------------- * **Closing Experience:** 3\+ years of closing experience, specifically selling complex SaaS platforms (preferably B2B solutions) that require integration, customization, and multi\-stakeholder implementation. * **Proven Upward Mobility:** A clear track record of internal promotion (e.g., SDR to Sr. SDR to AE) at a single high\-growth company. We value "builders" who stay to see the results of their work. * **High\-Velocity Discipline:** Experience in a fast\-paced environment. * **Startup Fluency:** Prior experience in a Series A–D startup environment where you were required to build your own playbooks rather than just follow existing ones. **Additional Information** Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a 40 mile radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role. This role will receive a competitive On\-Target Earnings (base salary \+ sales commission) \+ benefits \+ equity. The On\-Target Earnings\* for US\-based employees will be 50/50 commission split for base/variable pay, and aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here. A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below. * Commission is not guaranteed **The pay range for this role is:** 215,000 \- 215,000 USD per year(SF, NY) 205,000 \- 205,000 USD per year(Chicago, Seattle) 195,000 \- 195,000 USD per year(Remote)

jobs.title: SLM Training Engineer
jobs.description: Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us! Job Description **Job Description** Rockwell Automation is looking for an experienced SLM and Decision Model Training Engineer to build the small, fast, specialized models that make our enterprise AI agents reliable and affordable at scale. This role sits within our AI Engineering organization and focuses on two model families: small language models (SLMs) fine\-tuned for Rockwell domains and tasks, and decision models that return typed, calibrated judgments (choices, scores, and yes/no probabilities) instead of free\-form text, in the style of "System One" models such as TypeSafe's Jev. These models will route requests, classify and triage work, act as guardrails on agent actions, and evaluate agent outputs, so that large language models are used only where open\-ended reasoning is truly needed. You have a proven track record of training, fine\-tuning, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models in production, with a strong grounding in probability calibration and model evaluation. This is a Hybrid role. You will report to the Director of Agentic AI. **Your Responsibilities** * Train, fine\-tune, and distill small language models for Rockwell\-specific domains and agent tasks, such as tool selection, structured extraction, summarization, and industrial and product terminology. * Build decision models that take text or structured state plus developer\-defined questions and return typed choices, ordered scores, or yes/no probabilities that software can act on directly. * Train decision models to produce well\-calibrated probabilities, so confidence scores can drive thresholds for automating confident cases and escalating uncertain ones to people. * Apply decision models across the agent platform for model routing, request triage, guardrails (for example, whether an agent should make a tool call), and automated evaluation of LLM and agent outputs. * Build data pipelines for training and evaluation, including data curation, labeling strategies, synthetic data generation, and distillation from larger teacher models. * Design evaluation suites that measure accuracy, calibration, latency, and cost against LLM baselines, and run model\-versus\-model comparisons to guide when to use an SLM, a decision model, a classical classifier, or a large model. * Optimize models for production and edge deployment through quantization, pruning, and efficient serving, including scenarios close to industrial and plant\-floor environments. * Operate the model lifecycle with MLOps practices: experiment tracking, model registry, version pinning, monitoring for drift and calibration decay, and retraining. * Partner with agent, platform, and business teams across the enterprise to identify high\-volume, bounded decisions that benefit from specialized models, and to make build vs. buy recommendations against commercial decision and small\-model offerings. **Key Technical Skill Expectations** **Small Language Model Training:** Fine\-tune and adapt open\-weight SLMs (e.g., Phi, Llama, Mistral, Qwen, Gemma) using supervised fine\-tuning, parameter\-efficient methods such as LoRA and QLoRA, and preference optimization (e.g., DPO), with frameworks such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, TRL, and DeepSpeed. **Decision \& Discriminative Models:** Build transformer\-based classifiers, rankers, and scoring models (e.g., encoder models and cross\-encoders) that output typed decisions over a fixed answer space, including multi\-label, ordinal, and zero\-shot setups where categories are supplied at inference time. **Calibration \& Uncertainty:** Apply probability calibration methods (e.g., temperature scaling, isotonic regression) and reward\-based training for calibrated decisions, and measure calibration with reliability diagrams, expected calibration error, and Brier score. **Distillation \& Data Engineering:** Generate and curate training data, including LLM\-labeled and synthetic data, apply knowledge distillation from larger teacher models, and manage data quality, bias, and label noise. **Evaluation \& Benchmarking:** Build offline and online evaluations that compare SLMs, decision models, and LLMs on accuracy, calibration, latency, and cost, and use LLM\-as\-judge and decision\-model\-as\-judge patterns responsibly. **Model Optimization \& Serving:** Quantize and compress models (e.g., GGUF, ONNX, INT8/INT4\), and serve them efficiently with tools such as vLLM, ONNX Runtime, Triton Inference Server, or Azure AI Foundry, including edge and on\-premises deployment. **MLOps \& Governance:** Use MLflow or Azure Machine Learning for experiment tracking, model registry, CI/CD for models, monitoring, and responsible AI practices that comply with enterprise governance and security policies. **The Essentials \- You Will Have** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field. * Legal authorization to work in the U.S. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. **The Preferred \- You Might Also Have** * Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience, including 3\+ years training and deploying machine learning or NLP models in production. * Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a similar discipline. * Hands\-on experience fine\-tuning, distilling, and deploying small language models for specific enterprise tasks. * Familiarity with System One decision models such as TypeSafe's Jev, and with Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions (RLCD) or similar approaches that reward calibrated probabilities. * Experience with reinforcement learning methods for language models (e.g., RLHF, RLAIF, GRPO) and reward modeling. * Experience building model routing, guardrail, or LLM evaluation systems for agentic AI applications. * Experience deploying models to edge or industrial environments, or working with industrial and manufacturing data. * Proficiency in Python and PyTorch, and experience with GPU training infrastructure and distributed training. * 3\+ years of experience with major cloud platforms, such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). * Experience working and coordinating with a geographically diverse team across multiple time zones. * Familiarity with Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) methodologies. **What We Offer** * Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision * 401k * Paid Time off * Parental and Caregiver Leave * Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life * To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at www.raquickfind.com * We are an Equal Opportunity Employer including disability and veterans. This position is part of a job family. jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description: Kensho is S\&P Global’s hub for AI innovation and transformation. With expertise in machine learning, natural language processing, and data discovery, we develop and deploy novel solutions to innovate and drive progress at S\&P Global and its customers worldwide. Kensho's solutions and research focus on business and financial generative AI applications, agents, data retrieval APIs, data extraction, and much more. At Kensho, we hire talented people and give them the autonomy and support needed to build amazing technology and products. We collaborate using our teammates' diverse perspectives to solve hard problems. Our communication with one another is open, honest, and efficient. We dedicate time and resources to explore new ideas, but always rooted in engineering best practices. As a result, we can innovate rapidly to produce technology that is scalable, robust, and useful. We’re hiring a Senior Product Designer to own the experience across Kensho’s financial data and application products. You’ll report to the Head of Product and work closely with product, engineering and data science on how institutional investors find, use and act on financial data and AI. The work spans the whole analyst workflow, not individual features. You’ll decide how the pieces connect, both within a product and between the data and the tools analysts use to work with it. The role of design at Kensho is always being defined, and you’ll help define it. Kensho states that the anticipated base salary range for the position is $160,000 \- $200,000 USD. In addition, this role is eligible for an annual incentive bonus and equity plans. At Kensho, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. **What You’ll Do:** * Own design direction across our data and application products, from discovery through delivery * Identify UX problems and opportunities, and come with recommendations * Develop an experience strategy that covers the full analyst workflow * Run research with buy\-side and sell\-side professionals, and keep up in conversations about modeling, earnings analysis and investment process * Ideate and incubate new concepts: we see designers as builders. You’ll use AI\-assisted prototyping to get from idea to a working, testable prototype quickly. * Design for AI output: how users judge accuracy, trace sources and recover when the model is wrong * Contribute to Kensho’s design system * Help shape how the design team works, and adjust as you learn Work with engineering so the shipped product matches the design intent * **What You'll Need:** * 10\+ years of product design experience, with a portfolio showing shipped work on complex products * Working prototypes built with AI\-assisted coding tools; we use Claude Code. We’ll ask to see examples. * Working familiarity with capital markets (buy\-side workflows, sell\-side research, financial modeling) or a closely adjacent domain. You can talk with an analyst about their work without needing it translated. * Systems thinking: you design flows and structures, not isolated screens * Comfort making decisions with incomplete information and revising them * The ability to explain the reasoning behind your decisions to engineers, PMs and executives Judgment in trading off user needs, business goals and technical constraints * **How To Really Get Our Attention:** * Shipped product at a financial services firm or fintech company * Experience designing data\-dense analyst tools * Front\-end skills beyond AI\-assisted prototyping (React, HTML/CSS) * Experience with knowledge graphs: modeling entities and relationships, or designing interfaces on top of them At Kensho, we pride ourselves on providing top\-of\-market benefits, including: * Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance * 100% company paid premiums * Unlimited Paid Time Off * 26 weeks of 100% paid Parental Leave (paternity and maternity) * 401(k) plan with 6% employer matching * Generous company matching on donations to non\-profit charities * Up to $20,000 tuition assistance toward degree programs, plus up to $4,000/year for ongoing professional education such as industry conferences * Plentiful snacks, drinks, and regularly catered lunches * Dog\-friendly office (CAM office) * Bike sharing program memberships * Compassion leave and elder care leave * Mentoring and additional learning opportunities * Opportunity to expand professional network and participate in conferences and events **Recruitment Fraud Alert:** If you receive an email from a spglobalind.com domain or any other regionally based domains, it is a scam and should be reported to reportfraud@spglobal.com . S\&P Global never requires any candidate to pay money for job applications, interviews, offer letters, “pre\-employment training” or for equipment/delivery of equipment. Stay informed and protect yourself from recruitment fraud by reviewing our guidelines, fraudulent domains, and how to report suspicious activity here . We are an equal opportunity employer that welcomes future Kenshins with all experiences and perspectives. Kensho is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with an additional office location in New York City. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

jobs.title: Associate Solutions Engineer - AI
jobs.description: **About Us** ============ **Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.** **Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:** * **Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority\- and woman\-owned enterprise in the U.S.** * **Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.** * **Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.** * **World\-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.** **Job Summary** =============== The Associate Solutions Engineer / Data Center Engineer is a hands\-on technical role responsible for deploying, maintaining, and troubleshooting physical server infrastructure within lab and data center environments. This role supports the full server hardware lifecycle, including equipment installation and cabling, server configuration, out\-of\-band management, Linux administration, diagnostics, firmware management, hardware replacement, and production\-ready handoff. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable working at a Linux command line and physically installing or troubleshooting enterprise server equipment, with the ability to identify and resolve issues across hardware, BMC, networking, storage, firmware, and operating system layers. **Role Description** **Server Hardware Management** * Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise server hardware. * Diagnose failures involving CPUs, DIMMs, storage devices, RAID controllers, power supplies, network interface cards (NICs), GPUs, fans, and system boards. * Perform hardware swaps, component upgrades, firmware updates, and break/fix activities. * Review system health, hardware inventory, event logs, temperatures, power consumption, and component status. Work with enterprise GPU server platforms such as Dell XE Series, NVIDIA H200, Cisco UCS, or equivalent systems. * **Baseboard Management Controller (BMC)** * Configure and manage server BMC interfaces and out\-of\-band management using technologies such as Dell iDRAC, HPE iLO, IPMI, and Redfish. * Configure BMC networking, credentials, firmware, remote consoles, virtual media, and power controls. * Use BMC logs and hardware telemetry to diagnose server faults. Perform remote power cycling, system configuration, and operating system installation when appropriate. * **Equipment Racking and Cabling** * Rack and unrack servers, switches, storage equipment, Power Distribution Units (PDUs), and related infrastructure. * Install rails, cable\-management hardware, and other rack components. * Perform structured copper and fiber cabling, including Ethernet connections and management networks. * Maintain accurate port, cable, rack\-unit, hostname, and asset labeling. * Follow rack elevation, power distribution, airflow, and cable\-management standards. Trace and troubleshoot physical connectivity issues throughout the rack infrastructure. * **Linux Administration** * Install, configure, and support Linux operating systems, including Ubuntu Server or equivalent distributions. * Troubleshoot Linux boot, kernel, storage, networking, service, and hardware\-related issues. * Perform system administration using SSH and command\-line tools. * Configure interfaces, IP addressing, DNS, routes, bonding, and VLAN\-related settings. * Use Linux utilities such as systemctl, journalctl, dmesg, ip, ethtool, lsblk, lspci, dmidecode, and smartctl. Create Bash or Python scripts to automate repetitive server\-management activities where appropriate. * **Behaviors and Competencies** ------------------------------ * **Problem\-Solving:** Can systematically identify, isolate, and resolve hardware, firmware, networking, storage, and operating system issues. * **Detail\-Oriented:** Can identify errors or inconsistencies in configurations, logs, cabling, labeling, and component status and make necessary corrections. * **Organization:** Can prioritize technical tasks, manage personal workflow, and maintain accurate infrastructure records. * **Follow\-Up:** Can independently track assigned work and technical issues through completion without requiring reminders. * **Communication:** Can clearly communicate technical issues, findings, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions to appropriate stakeholders. * **Documentation:** Can independently create and maintain accurate technical, infrastructure, and troubleshooting documentation. * **Collaboration:** Can work effectively with engineers, infrastructure teams, vendors, and other technical resources. * **Results Orientation:** Can take ownership of assigned server infrastructure activities and drive work through successful validation and handoff. **Skill Level Requirements** **Required Skills** * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience supporting physical servers, data center infrastructure, hardware labs, or a comparable environment. * Strong knowledge of enterprise server hardware and component\-level troubleshooting. * Hands\-on experience with BMC and out\-of\-band management technologies, including IPMI, Redfish, Dell iDRAC, HPE iLO, or comparable technologies. * Demonstrated experience racking, unracking, installing, and cabling server equipment. * Strong working knowledge of Linux administration and troubleshooting. * Understanding of TCP/IP networking, Ethernet, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, and basic network troubleshooting. Ability to interpret hardware logs and systematically isolate hardware, firmware, network, storage, and operating system problems. * **Preferred Skills** * Experience supporting GPU or AI compute infrastructure, including NVIDIA GPU\-based servers. * Familiarity with high\-density or high\-performance computing environments. * Experience with IPMI tools, Ansible, Bash, or Python for server automation. * Experience with PXE/network\-based provisioning and automated Linux installation. * Familiarity with RAID, NVMe, SAS/SATA storage, and enterprise storage concepts. * Experience performing firmware and BIOS/UEFI configuration at scale. * Familiarity with server asset\-management or Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) systems. Linux certification such as Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) is a plus. * **Other Requirements** ---------------------- * Ability to safely lift, install, move, rack, and unrack server and other rack\-mounted equipment in accordance with applicable workplace safety requirements. * Ability to perform hands\-on equipment installation, cabling, component replacement, and troubleshooting within lab and data center environments. * Ability to work independently on assigned infrastructure activities and escalate issues appropriately when additional support is required. * Ability to manage a server through the deployment lifecycle, including rack installation, power and network cabling, BMC configuration, firmware/BIOS setup, Linux installation, hardware and network validation, and production\-ready handoff. The estimated annual pay range for this position is $75,000 \- $150,000 which includes a base salary. The compensation for this position is dependent on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location and, therefore, will vary from individual to individual. Benefits may include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending. Equal Employment Opportunity – M/F/Disability/Protected Veteran Status

This is a hands\-on technical role requiring strong expertise in full\-stack software development, including frontend applications, backend services, APIs, and database integrations. Code Quality, Reviews \& Engineering Standards * Write clean, well\-structured, thoroughly tested, and maintainable code. * Participate actively in peer code reviews, providing constructive feedback and promoting engineering best practices. * Help establish and maintain a collaborative development environment that encourages technical knowledge sharing. * Document software functionality, technical decisions, dependencies, and implementation requirements. * Reduce technical silos by ensuring critical platform functionality is understood by multiple members of the Engineering team. * Contribute to consistent coding standards, development processes, and technical documentation. * Support continuous improvement of softwar  application and dependency vulnerabilities. * Knowledge of application performance optimization, debugging, profiling, and resource management. * Experience implementing structured logging, monitoring, and application tracing. * Proficiency with Git, peer code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD development workflows. * Experience working within established software development lifecycle (SDLC) processes. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues and communicate delivery risks. * Demonstrated ability to work independently, collaborate across teams, and consistently meet development commitments. What Success Looks Like The successful Senior Software Developer will consistently demonstrate the ability to: * **Deliver production\-ready software:** Develop complete, tested, secure, and maintainable features that meet established architectural requirements. * **Maintain strong security standards:** Proactively prevent vulnerabilities and protect sensitive platform and customer data. * **Optimize application performance:** Deliver efficient code that supports scalability, responsiveness, and reliable platform operations. * **Improve system observability:** Ensure application failures and performance issues can be quickly identified, diagnosed, and resolved. * **Promote engineering collaboration:** Reduce technical silos through effective documentation, code reviews, and knowledge sharing. * **Demonstrate delivery accountability:** Meet commitments, communicate progress accurately, and escalate risks before they impact delivery. The ideal candidate understands that successful software development extends beyond writing functional code. It requires adherence to architectural standards, disciplined testing, security awareness, proactive communication, and a commitment to delivering reliable solutions that support the business. This individual takes ownership of their work, welcomes constructive technical feedback, and recognizes the importance of consistent engineering processes and shared technical knowledge. Above all, the successful candidate will be someone who delivers high\-quality software, works effectively within a team, and contributes to the long\-term scalability, reliability, and profitability of the company. **Compensation \& Benefits** * Competitive salary and performance\-based bonuses. * Comprehensive health, dental, vision and life insurance.. * Generous paid time off policy. * Opportunities for professional development and career advancement. * Flexible working hours and remote work options. jobs.title: Principal ML Engineer – Agentic AI
jobs.description: SS\&C is a leading provider of mission\-critical, AI\-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS\&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid\-market firms, rely on SS\&C for expertise, scale, and technology. **Job Description** **Principal Data Scientist – Agentic AI** ========================================= **SS\&C Intralinks** **About the Role** ------------------ SS\&C Intralinks is looking for a Principal Data Scientist – Agentic AI to provide technical leadership in designing, architecting, and delivering next\-generation agentic AI systems across our enterprise product ecosystem. You will work at the intersection of advanced AI research and production engineering. Beyond using existing frameworks, you will understand their internals, extend or fork them at the source\-code level, and build reusable capabilities that become the foundation for enterprise\-wide AI adoption. You will also influence technical direction across multiple product lines, set engineering standards, mentor senior engineers and data scientists, and drive build\-versus\-buy framework, model, and deployment decisions. We operate with an agile, research\-driven mindset: we continuously evaluate emerging technologies, challenge assumptions, and turn promising innovations into practical enterprise capabilities, always with a focus on reliability, scalability, security, and measurable business outcomes. **Why Join SS\&C Intralinks** ----------------------------- SS\&C Intralinks combines proprietary technology with deep industry expertise to support complex financial and healthcare operations. Our teams design, implement, and operate solutions that help clients manage data, automate processes, and scale with confidence. You will shape how agentic AI is designed and deployed across a broad enterprise software ecosystem, working with industry experts, modern AI infrastructure, large\-scale data environments, and complex real\-world workflows. jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: The semiconductor industry is experiencing one of the largest periods of growth and transformation in its history, and Tool Install design sits at the center of it. At SSOE, we design systems that connect some of the world's most advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment to the facilities that power tomorrow's technologies. From tool hookups and utility systems to subfab design, cleanroom modifications, and equipment integration, our work directly impacts the production of next\-generation chips used in AI, data centers, autonomous vehicles, consumer electronics, and advanced computing. Recognized as one of the industry's leading semiconductor design firms, SSOE combines deep technical expertise with a culture built on innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Here, you'll work alongside some of the brightest minds in engineering, leverage cutting\-edge digital and AI\-enabled tools, and contribute to projects that are shaping the future of technology. If you're looking for meaningful work, technical challenges, and a place where your ideas matter, you'll find it at SSOE. As an **Electrical Engineer** at SSOE, you'll work alongside experienced engineers, project managers, and multidisciplinary design teams to develop electrical designs for tool installations, power distribution, cleanroom environments, and facility upgrades that enable next\-generation technology manufacturing. In this role, you will be involved in electrical calculations, focusing on low to medium voltage environments. The ideal candidate possesses experience with distribution panel loading, short circuit analysis, voltage drop calculations, conduit and conductor sizing, and cable tray fills. You will have access to industry\-leading tools, collaborative leadership, and a firm culture consistently recognized as a Great Place to Work. Join us in shaping innovative design\-build projects with a relentless commitment to quality, efficiency, and collaborative excellence. AI and Innovation: At SSOE, we don’t just talk about the future, we build it. As a leader in industry AI adoption, we empower our team to work smarter by providing responsible access to the industry leading AI Large Language Models, vibe\-coding platforms, and securely integrating advanced tools into every role. From day one, you’ll receive the training and support needed to leverage AI as a core tool for enhancing productivity, sparking creativity, and streamlining complex workflows. Responsibilities: * Generate comprehensive technical project plans, specifications, drawings, and models aligned with both industry standards, client requirements, and electrical engineering best practices. * Develop detailed electrical drawings and technical documentation that support areas such as process equipment installation design packages, tool hookup design, subfab rack and lateral design, and cleanroom and facility modification support. * Determine conduit and conductor sizing, meticulously accounting for current loads and environmental variables. * Assess cable tray fills methodically to guarantee proper cable management, organization, and future scalability. * Perform detailed short circuit calculations to accurately determine fault currents, select appropriate protective devices, and ensure system safety. * Perform precise voltage drop calculations to ensure electrical system stability and compliance with industry standards. * Ensure all electrical designs rigorously comply with and exceed local, state, and national electrical codes and regulations to guarantee safety and quality. * Apply established design techniques and exercises discernment in adapting and modifying design concepts as needed. Uphold quality control by adhering to company and team design and CAD standards. * Will work with Sr. Engineers, Project Managers, and other stakeholders on specific assigned objectives, complex features, and aid in deriving possible solutions to unusual problems. * Foster collaboration, communication, strategy, and support within your team, multidisciplinary groups (Mechanical, Structural, Process/Chemical, Architectural, etc.), and inter\-company teams to optimize efficiency, quality, and resource allocation. * Conduct field verifications and site walks to identify, validate, resolve, and integrate solutions into design packages. Resolve design issues on\-site during construction if necessary. Qualifications: * Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering from an ABET\-accredited institution, qualifying candidate for professional engineering licensure in Arizona. * Successful completion of the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE/EIT) exam, with a focus on electrical engineering principles, is highly desired. * Demonstrated proficiency in AutoCAD for electrical design drafting is required. Experience with other tools such as Revit, ETAP, SKM Power Tools, and/or EasyPower is a plus. * Knowledge of electrical codes and standards (e.g., National Electric Code, NFPA, etc.). * Ability to clearly communicate technical information and design concepts to project managers, contractors, and cross\-disciplinary teams. * Salary Range: $68,000 \- $98,000/year depending on location, education, experience, and any certifications that are directly related to the position. Join us at SSOE, where your expertise will thrive in a dynamic and collaborative environment. SSOE doesn't just hire talent, we invest in it. If you're passionate about innovation, career progression, and eager to make a significant impact, we invite you to apply and become a part of our forward\-thinking team. \#LI\-Hybrid

jobs.title: Staff R&D Engineer, Simulation and Modeling
jobs.description: **About STAAR Surgical** STAAR Surgical is a global leader in implantable phakic intraocular lenses, a vision correction solution that reduces or eliminates the need for glasses or contact lenses. Dedicated solely to ophthalmic surgery since 1982, STAAR has spent 30 years designing, developing, manufacturing and marketing Implantable Collamer® Lenses (ICLs), made from its proprietary, biocompatible Collamer material. STAAR has sold more than 4 million ICLs in over 85 countries. Headquartered in Lake Forest, California, the company runs research, development, manufacturing and packaging facilities in California and Switzerland. **About the role** Developing ophthalmic devices means solving complex engineering problems in biomechanics, and simulation helps us solve them faster and with more confidence. Our R\&D teams are driving innovation and developing next\-generation products. As Staff R\&D Engineer, Simulation and Modeling, you will build STAAR's computational capability, largely from the ground up. You will set the modeling strategy, take on the hardest nonlinear problems across programs, and make simulation results a trusted part of design decisions and, over time, regulatory submissions. This is a chance to define how a growing ophthalmic company uses simulation. **What you'll do** * Solve the hardest mechanics problems. Own nonlinear analyses of soft, hyperelastic and viscoelastic lens materials, large\-deformation contact (lens folding, loading and injection) and the lens's interaction with ocular tissue. Turn loosely defined clinical scenarios into validated, high\-fidelity models. * Build model credibility. Establish verification, validation and uncertainty quantification practices, using a risk\-informed credibility framework (ASME V\&V 40\) and FDA guidance on computational modeling, so simulation can support future regulatory submissions. * Anchor models in data. Collaborate with team members and external test labs on benchtop experiments that calibrate constitutive models and validate predictions against measurement and clinical observation. * Set the simulation strategy. Define and run the R\&D modeling and simulation roadmap, including the choice of tools and methods. * Make simulation a team sport. Advise cross\-functional teams on using simulation for design optimization, risk analysis and failure investigations. Set shared standards and design\-review gates for modeling work. * Grow the next modelers. Mentor engineers on advanced modeling methods and build a culture of rigor and reproducibility. **What success looks like at Staff level** * You spot engineering risks no one has named yet and bring a modeling plan to retire them before they hit the schedule. * You align design, clinical, regulatory and leadership around computational evidence, without needing formal authority. * You balance today's design questions against long\-term investment in simulation capability. **What you bring** * A bachelor's degree in mechanical or biomedical engineering, computational mechanics or a related field. A master's or PhD is preferred. * 10\+ years of relevant experience with a bachelor's, 8\+ with a master's or 5\+ with a PhD. Graduate research in computational or soft\-tissue mechanics counts toward this. * Deep expertise in continuum mechanics and nonlinear FEA: hyperelastic or viscoelastic materials, large deformation and contact. * Advanced hands\-on use of at least one major solver (Abaqus, ANSYS, LS\-DYNA or COMSOL) and its pre\- and post\-processing tools. * Calibration of constitutive models from material test data, and validation of models against bench measurements. * The ability to explain complex models clearly to engineers, clinicians and executives, and to influence decisions without formal authority. **Nice to have** * Model credibility work under ASME V\&V 40 (and V\&V 10/20\) or the FDA guidance on assessing computational modeling credibility (final, November 2023\). * Class II or III medical device development, design controls (21 CFR 820\) and ISO 13485\. * Simulation submitted as evidence to FDA or a notified body. * Ocular, soft\-tissue or polymer device biomechanics; user subroutines (UMAT/VUMAT). * CFD or fluid–structure interaction; optical simulation (Zemax, Code V). * Surrogate, reduced\-order or machine\-learning models. * Setting up simulation compute environments (HPC or cloud) and building reusable, automated modeling frameworks. * Scripting and automation in Python, MATLAB or a solver API to build repeatable, parametric workflows. Don't meet every point? If most of this sounds like you, we'd still like to hear from you. **Backgrounds we welcome** Very few people have modeled a soft lens inside an eye, so we hire for strong mechanics and rigor. Prior medical device experience is not required. We especially welcome people from: * Other medical devices: structural heart, vascular, neurovascular, orthopedic or orthodontic simulation teams. * Tire, rubber, seals and elastomers: hyperelastic and viscoelastic modeling at production scale. * Automotive, aerospace and defense: nonlinear and explicit analysis, plus V\&V discipline. * Consumer electronics: drop, contact and soft\-material modeling. * Academic and national labs: PhDs and postdocs in biomechanics, ocular mechanics or computational mechanics. * Engineering consultancies that model medical devices for regulatory submissions. Pay range is $160K \- $200K \- Final compensation/salary will be dependent on experience *STAAR Surgical is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran or disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.* *\#USA* Location **Tustin, CA, US**Job Code **2275**\# of Openings **1**

jobs.title: Staff Application Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are** Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. **About the role:** Samsara sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world, processing 25\+ trillion data points annually across thousands of connected devices. The Samsara Application Security team protects this vast footprint end\-to\-end, spanning cloud services, internal systems, and firmware running on IoT hardware in the field. As a Staff Application Security Engineer, you'll drive the overarching technical direction for our application security and vulnerability management programs. This is a high\-visibility role where you'll influence a broad surface area while retaining the flexibility to dive deep into critical domain focus areas as security priorities evolve. **This is a remote position, open to candidates residing in the US.** #### **You should apply if:** * **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** Your efforts will result in real\-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. * **You are the architect of your own career:** If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, and countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper\-growth environment. * **You're energized by our opportunity:** The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. * **You want to be with the best:** At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high\-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best. #### **In this role, you will:** * Lead the ongoing strategy, operation, and continuous improvement of Samsara's vulnerability management program, along with other core application security programs — not just execute against an existing process, but define what the process should be. * Own and drive down mean time to remediate (MTTR) across the vulnerability backlog, as SLAs tighten. * Build and champion automation and tooling that scale vulnerability detection and response across cloud, firmware/IoT, and corporate systems, rather than relying on manual, one\-by\-one review. * Set technical and architectural direction for the program, translating leadership's strategic priorities into a concrete execution plan for the team. * Drive remediation by building trust with engineering teams and providing clear, actionable guidance — partnering with technical program management on reporting rather than owning it directly. * Mentor and level up other engineers on secure design and remediation practices, and be a technical voice other teams look to when priorities are unclear. * Communicate risk and remediation tradeoffs to engineering leadership in terms they can act on, without owning the relationship end to end. * Participate in security incident investigations involving high\-profile vulnerabilities, assessing potential impact on Samsara's infrastructure. * Be regularly on call to support critical vulnerability response. * Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices **Minimum requirements for the role:** * 10\+ years of relevant experience as a cloud engineer or security engineer, including hands\-on vulnerability management across a broad, multi\-product enterprise environment — not a single product or team's slice of it. * Proficiency in Go, Python, and JavaScript. * Demonstrated ability to independently set technical and architectural direction for a security program, and to drive remediation across a broad, multi\-surface environment without direct authority over the teams doing the fixing. re and embedded systems. * Background at a cloud\-native, AI\-forward company actively building agentic or AI\-driven products. * Experience with security automation platforms (e.g., Tines) and serverless frameworks (e.g., AWS Lambda). * Experience integrating vulnerability management into modern CI/CD pipelines with a "shift\-left" mentality. * Experience spanning SaaS, firmware, and corporate IT security programs — not just one product line. * Experience managing vulnerabilities within a FedRAMP\-certified environment. * Experience building, extending, or wiring up AI copilots/agents for security workflows (e.g., automated triage, remediation drafting). **Total Rewards** At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high\-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above\-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance\-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high\-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above\-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long\-term success: a flexible, employee\-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. **Flexible Working** At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in\-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on\-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. **Belonging at Samsara** At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. **Accommodations** Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. **Our Commitment to Authenticity** We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. **Fraudulent Employment Offers** Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. jobs.description: Responsibilities: As a valued member of our dynamic team, you’ll collaborate with project and technical leads to deliver water resources and coastal engineering analyses. experience developing or modifying model inputs, running simulations, and interpreting results is a primary qualification for this position. * Experience running ADCIRC models for storm\-surge analysis. * Experience automating the SLOSH model to run multiple simulations. * Understanding of coastal processes and flood drivers such as storm surge, tides, wind forcing, and extreme water levels. * Experience analyzing hydrometeorological data, including rainfall, streamflow, tide, or coastal water\-level records. * Experience with hydrologic or hydraulic modeling, such as HEC\-HMS and HEC\-RAS (1D and/or 2D), and familiarity with GIS tools and terrain data. * Ability to prepare clear technical reports and communicate model methods, assumptions, results, and limitations. * Familiarity with programming or scripting languages such as Python, MATLAB, R, or similar tools for data processing and analysis. * Strong teamwork and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in multidisciplinary teams. jobs.description: Job Description: Help turn emerging AI technology into the next generation of Schneider Electric offers. A multidisciplinary team of data scientists, software engineers, architects, and domain experts engages early with customers and offer teams to identify valuable problems, test the riskiest assumptions, and build high\-quality proofs of concept that demonstrate what is possible and provide a strong foundation for production teams to take forward. We work close to customers, close to data, and close to the technology. Our work spans energy management, buildings, data centers, industrial systems, predictive maintenance, equipment reliability, and optimization. This role sits at the intersection of data science, AI engineering, and software development. You will explore difficult problems, evaluate emerging technologies, develop AI approaches, and turn the most promising ideas into compelling, well\-engineered proofs of concept. **What You'll Do** * Work with customers, offer teams, domain experts, and engineers to identify high\-value AI opportunities and turn ambiguous problems into testable experiments. * Explore emerging AI technologies and real\-world data, applying machine learning, time\-series analysis, optimization, foundation models, and generative AI to quickly determine what works and what does not. * Build high\-quality, end\-to\-end proofs of concept that demonstrate technical feasibility and meaningful customer value. * Develop well\-structured, testable, and reusable software components, with sufficient documentation and engineering rigor for others to understand and extend the work. * Collaborate with downstream engineering teams to transfer successful concepts toward production, applying pragmatic judgment around scalability, cybersecurity, Responsible AI, performance, and maintainability. **Why Join the Team****?** * Build things that haven't been built before. * Stay hands\-on with data, algorithms, AI models, software, and experiments. * Work on significant challenges in energy, buildings, industrial systems, reliability, and data centers. * Participate in the entire early innovation cycle, from customer problem through demonstration and transfer. * Work alongside specialists with deep Schneider Electric domain and technical expertise. * Help determine which emerging AI technologies deserve to become real product capabilities. If you enjoy taking a difficult problem, a promising technology, and an imperfect dataset and turning them into something real, convincing, and ready for another team to take to the next level, we'd like to talk with you. jobs.title: Middle Automation QA Engineer (Playwright | TS | AI)
jobs.description: The platform serves millions of users and includes a complex ecosystem of web, mobile, backend, and integration services. The solution has been actively developed for several years and continues to evolve through new functionality, infrastructure improvements, integrations, and further QA automation. The key goal of this role is to contribute to the development and maintenance of the automated testing framework, increase automation coverage, and support reliable delivery of a complex enterprise product. **Technical Environment:** -------------------------- * Test Automation: Playwright, TypeScript, WireMock * CI/CD: Bitbucket Pipelines * Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes / AWS EKS * Backend: PHP / Symfony * Frontend: React * Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis * Cloud: AWS * AI Tools: Claude and other AI assistants **Key Responsibilities:** ------------------------- * Develop, maintain, and improve automated tests using Playwright and TypeScript. * Extend and improve the existing test automation framework. * Create and maintain automated UI, API, and end\-to\-end tests. * Analyze requirements and identify scenarios suitable for automation. * Prepare and maintain test data. * Investigate failed automated tests and identify root causes. * Improve automation coverage, stability, and maintainability. * Participate in code reviews and follow established automation standards and best practices. * Integrate and maintain automated tests within CI/CD pipelines. * Use AI\-powered tools to support test development, debugging, analysis, and maintenance. * Collaborate closely with manual QA engineers, developers, Product Managers, and other team members. * Participate in technical discussions and contribute ideas for improving QA automation processes. **Requirements:** ----------------- * 2\+ years of practical experience in test automation. * Strong hands\-on experience with TypeScript / JavaScript. * Practical experience with Playwright or strong experience with another modern web automation framework and willingness to work with Playwright. * Good understanding of web services and API principles REST / SOAP \+ practical experience with them. * Practical experience with OpenAPI / Swagger documentation and Postman or similar tools * Good understanding of test automation principles and framework structure. * Experience with API testing. * Experience with end\-to\-end testing of web applications. * Understanding of CI/CD principles and experience running automated tests in CI/CD pipelines. * Good knowledge of software testing principles, techniques, and methodologies. * Ability to analyze automated test failures and troubleshoot issues independently. * Experience working with Git and code review processes. * Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar as part of daily engineering activities. * Proactive approach, attention to quality, and willingness to improve existing automation solutions. * English level B2 or higher for communication within an international team and / EKS. * Experience with Bitbucket Pipelines. * Understanding of PHP\-based applications. * Experience testing microservice\-based systems and complex integrations. * Experience working with relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL. * Basic knowledge of Redis.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer (Sales), Backend
jobs.description: Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960\. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again. But Scout is more than just a brand, it's a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work. The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn't been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all\-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built\-in gas\-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range. At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go\-getter with unrivaled passion. Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now! **Overview** As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Sales Engineering team, you will be a core contributor to the systems that power our end\-to\-end customer vehicle purchase journey. From trade\-in and vehicle configuration through finance, leasing, and delivery — you will build reliable, well\-crafted backend services and work hands\-on with the third\-party integrations that bring those capabilities to life. You will collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and external partners to ship features that directly impact how customers experience buying a vehicle. You'll take ownership of meaningful pieces of the stack, contribute to technical decisions within your team, and grow your scope over time. This role is ideal for an engineer who writes thoughtful, production\-quality code, takes pride in building things that work reliably, and wants to deepen their experience in a complex, high\-stakes transactional domain. **What you'll do** Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick\-up truck \& rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following: * Build and maintain backend services across the customer purchase journey — writing clean, well\-tested, production\-quality code that your teammates can rely on and build upon. * Design and implement APIs, data models, and service logic that are correct, performant, and easy to evolve as requirements change. * Integrate with third\-party providers \- valuation services, lender platforms, logistics APIs, and factory systems \- building integration layers that are reliable and well\-abstracted. * Apply sound engineering patterns to the challenges of distributed systems: error handling, retries, idempotency, and observability \- both within our own services and across external dependencies. * Take end\-to\-end ownership of features: from scoping and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and monitoring in production. * Participate actively in code and design reviews: sharing knowledge, catching issues early, and helping maintain a high engineering bar across the team. * Collaborate with product managers, designers, and partner teams to understand requirements and deliver solutions that meet real user needs. * Contribute to improving team practices: documentation, testing standards, on\-call processes, and the day\-to\-day reliability of the systems you own. * Use AI\-assisted development tools thoughtfully to increase your own velocity and share effective practices with teammates. **What you'll bring** We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You'll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment. You'll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring: * Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field. * 4\+ years in software development, with a focus on back\-end technologies * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders * Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment, both independently and as part of a team * Proficiency in one of Go, Node.js, Python, Java, or Ruby * Experience with both relational and/or non\-relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis) * Experience with identity management systems (e.g., Azure AD, AWS Cognito, LDAP, Okta, Keyclock) and directory services for user authentication and management * Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and best practices * Excellent problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills, with a passion for finding elegant solutions to complex challenges **Location \& Travel Expectations**: This role will be based out of the Scout Motors location in San Ramon, California or Charlotte, North Carolina. * The responsibilities of this role require 1 day per week attendance in office with in\-person meetings and events regularly. * Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time. ***Nice to have*** * *Experience building AI/ML platform foundations or developer AI tooling.* * *Experience in automotive, mobility, retail, ecommerce, or digital consumer products.* * *Experience building multi\-tenant platforms and shared enterprise services.* * Passport required #### **What you'll gain** The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. those pipelines run on schedule. * Design and maintain custom AWS pipelines that land and process API\-restricted, unstructured, or file\-based data. **Data modeling and transformation** * Build, clients and internal teams. **Qualifications*** **Experience:** + 3\+ years of hands\-on data engineering experience building production\-grade data platforms and ELT/ETL pipelines. + Hands\-on end and communicate status clearly. + Able to explain technical issues to non\-technical colleagues in simple, actionable terms. + Values respect, inclusion, and teamwork. + Comfortable working independently across multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment. **Good to have Skills:** * Experience with ATS or recruitment marketing data, including job board and applicant data. * Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V\-BAT and X\-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia\-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. **About the role:** The Senior Staff Engineer, AI Engineering is a hands\-on individual contributor who leads complex, cross\-functional initiatives that turn AI capabilities into secure, reliable, measurable improvements in how teams work. Reporting to the Director, AI Engineering, this role contributes to technical strategy, resolves ambiguous engineering problems, and delivers reusable systems and practices adopted across engineering. The Senior Staff Engineer serves as a trusted technical advisor, working across Engineering, IT, Security, Legal, Data, and business teams to improve AI delivery, operational quality, and productivity—without relying on direct management authority. **What you’ll do** * **Lead complex AI initiatives:** Translate client needs into technical direction and executable plans, align with leadership, and drive delivery across teams with a high degree of independence. * **Build production AI capabilities:** Design and implement AI applications, agents, integrations, and shared services, balancing security, reliability, maintainability, and cost. * **Scale reusable engineering practices:** Partner with Staff and Senior Engineers to establish shared components, reference implementations, and standards that reduce duplication and improve delivery across engineering. * **Embed responsible AI controls:** Work with Security, Legal, and Data partners to implement access controls, data boundaries, evaluations, auditability, and lifecycle management. * **Demonstrate measurable value:** Establish telemetry and evaluation approaches that connect adoption to productivity, quality, operational performance, and cost improvements. * **Multiply technical effectiveness:** Mentor experienced engineers across team and department boundaries, guide difficult technical decisions, and share practical guidance that raises engineering quality. **Required qualifications:** * Substantial progressive experience delivering enterprise software, AI systems, shared platforms, or data\-intensive services, with demonstrated performance at a senior technical leadership level. * Deep hands\-on expertise building and operating production generative AI systems, including LLM integrations, retrieval architectures, agent workflows, evaluation, and enterprise integrations. * Demonstrated success leading ambiguous, technically complex initiatives across multiple teams and dependencies, with outcomes that improve engineering capabilities beyond a single team. * Strong software engineering fundamentals and architecture judgment across APIs, distributed systems, testing, security, observability, reliability, and operational cost. * Breadth across AI engineering and other disciplines such as cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, data engineering, developer platforms, or large\-scale system design. * Experience translating data handling, access control, auditability, and AI governance requirements into production engineering controls. * Track record of establishing reusable capabilities and improving engineering practices through adoption, not solely through written standards. * Ability to contribute to functional strategy, plan and deliver large initiatives, and make sound decisions with infrequent guidance. * Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority, mentor experienced engineers across team boundaries, and communicate complex decisions to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Experience consistent with this level is typically around 10 years, with demonstrated scope and impact taking precedence over tenure. **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience in regulated, defense\-adjacent, security\-sensitive, or tightly governed enterprise environments. * Experience with enterprise AI platforms, model gateways, AI coding tools, collaboration platforms, knowledge repositories, or workflow automation ecosystems. * Experience with agent evaluation, adversarial testing, permission\-aware retrieval, human approval workflows, or production AI incident response. * Experience with enterprise data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or comparable infrastructure. * Experience implementing AI usage metering, cost attribution, showback, or evidence\-based productivity measurement. Compensation Range: $234,880 \- $352,320

You will take ownership of product features across the entire development lifecycle, from architecture and implementation to deployment and production improvements. The role involves working across frontend, backend, and production systems to build scalable and reliable applications. **Key Responsibilities** * Own product features end\-to\-end, including
