jobs.title: Applied Scientist
jobs.description: Siemens builds the systems the physical world runs on: factories, power grids, buildings, trains, hospitals. Industrial and physical AI is a major opportunity in applied AI, and one of the harder ones to get right. There is a generation of AI\-powered products to build. We are an applied science organization building the science behind them. The work sits at the intersection of machine learning research, real world data, and production systems running in industrial environments. As Applied Scientist, you work on the science on a major capability area inside the pod. You take ambiguous problems through hypothesis, method selection, experimentation, and into models that run in production. You are hands on with the modeling, and you are accountable for the rigor and the outcome. This is an individual contributor role. You will work in close partnership with engineers and product managers who turn your work into product. Key responsibilities * Contribute to one or more scientific capability areas end to end, for example perception, computer vision, language and agents, time series, control, planning, or evaluation * Take problems from ambiguous product or system requirements through clear research questions, hypotheses, and success metrics * Contribute to applied research projects: literature review, method selection, experimentation, ablation, error analysis, and productization * Build and run the evaluation pipelines for the work you own: offline metrics, online experiments, robustness testing in industrial conditions * Work with engineers to take models into production grade pipelines: data readiness, training infrastructure, inference, observability * Make scientific tradeoffs in front of engineers and product managers, with evidence, and translate them into decisions the team can act on * Identify and de\-risk scaling challenges in your area: data quality, model drift, latency, throughput, cost, safety * Raise the bar on experimentation rigor, reproducibility, and documentation across the team * Apply responsible AI practices in your work: bias detection, model risk management, human in the loop controls Basic qualifications * 4\+ years in applied machine learning, AI research, or data science, with models that shipped to production and made an impact * Strong foundation in machine learning theory and practice across training, evaluation, and deployment * Demonstrated experience taking research from a paper or prototype into a model that runs reliably in production * Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks and toolchains * Strong partnership track record with engineering teams on data, training infrastructure, and inference * Clear written and verbal communication with engineers, product managers, and senior leaders Preferred qualifications * Experience applying ML in industrial or physical domains: manufacturing, automation, robotics, energy, mobility, infrastructure, healthcare * Deep expertise in one of: multimodal ML, generative AI, retrieval augmented generation, agentic workflows, time series, control, or planning * Scientific ML for physical systems: surrogate modeling, operator learning, physics\-informed ML, geometry\-aware ML, differentiable simulation, AI for semiconductor/EDA * Hands\-on experience building evaluation pipelines, running online experiments, or instrumenting production monitoring for a model you owned * Publications, patents, open source contributions, or significant internal technology transfers * Experience working with globally distributed research, product, or engineering organizations **About the Team:** We are an early\-stage engineering team solving hard technical problems at the intersection of AI, systems, and real\-world interaction. We operate with high autonomy, collaborate closely across functions, and maintain high technical standards. Principal Engineers at our company are expected to lead by example, model engineering excellence, and shape both what we build and how we build it. **Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:** We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us. $182,600 $216,700 10%

jobs.description: We have many opportunities available on our other career site pages. Click here to link to our careers page! Signet Jewelers is the world's largest retailer of diamond jewelry, operating more than 2,800 stores worldwide under the iconic brands: Kay Jewelers, Zales, Jared, H.Samuel, Ernest Jones, Peoples, Banter by Piercing Pagoda, Rocksbox, JamesAllen.com and Diamonds Direct. We are a people\-first company and this core value is at the heart of everything we do, from empowering our valued team members, to collaborating with our customers, to fostering the communities in which we live and serve. People – and the love their actions inspire – are what drive us. We’re not only proud of the love we inspire outside our walls, we’re especially proud of the diversity, inclusion and equity we’re inspiring inside. There are dynamic career paths awaiting you – rewarding opportunities to impact the lives of others and inspire love. Join us! **Forward Deployed AI Engineer IV** **Location: Dallas, TX or Akron, Ohio (Hybrid)** **Position Summary** The Forward Deployed AI Engineer connects customer\-facing teams with FDE and approved tech, and builds governed AI platforms that unlock customer\-impact innovation at Signet. This is a senior, hands\-on, individual contributor role that personally designs, builds, and deploys production AI solutions on AWS, including agents, AI workflows, and AI\-native SDLC capabilities. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. Discovery \& Solution Design — 20%** * Collaborate with business and technology teams to identify AI opportunities and define technical requirements. * Design solution architectures, evaluate feasibility, and develop implementation plans. * Independently drive technical decisions and solution direction. **2\. AI Agent \& Solution Development — 40%** * Design and build AI agents, multi\-agent workflows, and intelligent applications. * Develop full\-stack applications, APIs, and enterprise integrations. * Leverage LLMs, RAG, MCP servers, skills, plugins, and agent orchestration frameworks. **3\. AI\-Native SDLC \& Engineering Automation — 20%** * Implement AI\-assisted development, testing, and deployment workflows. * Embed with engineering teams to accelerate adoption of AI\-native SDLC practices. * Develop reusable coding agents and engineering automation solutions. **4\. Cloud Deployment \& Production Engineering — 15%** * Deploy and operate production\-grade AI solutions on AWS. * Implement CI/CD, infrastructure as code, security, monitoring, and observability. * Ensure scalability, reliability, and operational readiness. **5\. Technical Leadership \& Reusability — 5%** * Drive engineering best practices and reusable solution patterns. * Mentor engineers and share technical knowledge across teams. **Qualifications** **Core requirements:** Hands\-on AWS experience, Python and/or TypeScript, APIs, Git, CI/CD, and generative AI fundamentals. **Additional requirements** * 8\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience, including full\-stack development and shipping production systems. * Deep AWS experience, including serverless and container services, Bedrock, IAM, and security. * Has personally built and deployed agents using agentic frameworks, MCP servers, RAG, skills, and plugins. * Infrastructure as code (AWS CDK or Terraform), production monitoring, and evals. * Strong customer\-facing communication, and the ability to turn ambiguous business needs into working solutions.

jobs.description: **General Information** ----------------------- Locations * Austin, TX * Chicago, IL * Dallas, TX * Indianapolis, IN * Minneapolis, MN Business Function Strategy and consulting Date posted Wednesday, November 18, 2026 Ref \# 2475 **Description and Requirements** -------------------------------- Job Description **Location: Remote, CST required** **Who You’ll Work With** Slalom is looking for two senior\-to\-architect\-level engineers with deep expertise in Amazon Quick Suite, agentic development and semantic/knowledge\-layer design, backed by strong Apache Iceberg and AWS engineering skills. The project is open\-ended and doesn't have a fixed blueprint, so we need deep thinkers who bring ideas and build in short, iterative cycles. **What You’ll Do** * Build and tune Amazon Quick chat agents, Topics, datasets and Spaces. Connect them to Snowflake and Iceberg, and add actions that call custom Python. * Manage agent security and speed, and make sure answers account for region and units of measure. * Develop Bedrock agents with tool use, text\-to\-SQL and flows where the agent asks clarifying questions, using Python on AWS (Lambda, ECS, Step Functions). * Make AI answers explainable by showing the assumptions, the logic and the exact SQL behind them. Build evaluation harnesses and guardrails. * Design the semantic and knowledge layer: + Work out business logic from existing Power BI reports and legacy tools. + Tell apart metrics that look alike but aren't the same. + Make terms consistent across SAP, JDE and M3\. * Design medallion\-style data layering, govern a large library of reusable data blocks and integrate Atlan. * Work inside the client team, joining their stand\-ups and showing progress every week. * Run discovery with business SMEs to surface logic that isn't documented. * Write precise user stories for handoff to data engineering. * Explain AI behavior clearly to executives, administrators and engineers. **What You’ll Bring** Required * Senior/architect\-level AWS expertise, with hands\-on Amazon Quick Suite experience * Strong Python skills and experience building agents and LLM solutions across semantic and knowledge layers * Bedrock agents, tool use, text\-to\-SQL, evaluation and guardrails * Snowflake, Iceberg, S3, Glue, Athena and IAM * Comfort trying new techniques and changing course when something doesn't work * Willingness to speak up and share ideas, while staying highly organized and thoughtful Preferred * Power BI/DAX; SAP, JDE and M3 data concepts * Terraform/CloudFormation, Git, CI/CD, testing and Jira * Experience with the Atlan data catalog * Certifications: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer or AI Practitioner; AWS Certified Solutions Architect **About Us** Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer Financial Services
jobs.description: Position Type: Location(s): United States, San Diego, CA Date Posted: Job ID: R\-125993 **Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?** Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting\-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity. **Senior Software Engineer Financial Services** At the heart of the PlayStation Network is the Commerce Platform, servicing 30\+ million customers daily. The platform delivers services including product browsing, purchasing, subscription fulfillment, and payment options. **About the Role:** ------------------- We are seeking a Senior level Engineer to help drive the ongoing evolution of PlayStation’s Global Financial Systems, with a strong focus on building event\-driven pipelines and intuitive frontends. While your initial focus will be delivering scalable solutions for PlayStation’s finance systems, anticipate growth potential to expand into other areas across the business, driving efficiency and innovation. **Responsibilities:** --------------------- * Lead \& Innovate: Architect and develop robust, event\-driven microservices in Go, designed to manage high\-volume, real\-time financial transactions and data flows. * Modernize \& Refine: Translate legacy ETL and reporting systems into the modern tech stack, moving from NodeJS, Informatica to primarily React and Go * Collaborate \& Impact: Work multi\-functionally with teams across engineering, product management, finance, and compliance to ensure solutions are resilient, compliant, and strategically aligned. * Leverage AI/ML: Pioneer the integration of artificial intelligence and machine learning to automate manual finance tasks such as reconciliations, reporting, forecasting, and financial journal creation\-enhancing accuracy, efficiency, and innovation. * Real\-Time Excellence: Design, deploy, and optimize streaming technologies like Kafka to deliver real\-time financial insights and ensure rapid response capabilities. * Strategic Integration: Advocate and facilitate seamless integration of microservices across diverse financial applications and services, driving scalability, reliability, and future\-proof solutions. **Skills and Qualifications:** ------------------------------ * Education: Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field – or equivalent professional experience * 6\+ years of experience in large\-scale software engineering, specializing in event\-driven architectures and distributed systems. * Expertise in Golang or similar languages, building highly scalable, real\-time microservices as well as REST APIs * Proficiency in designing, building and maintaining single\-page applications using React or similar frameworks * Capability to automate financial processes such as payment settlements and reconciliation, revenue recognition, and royalties, with consideration of how to extend similar solutions to non\-financial systems. * Proficiency in SQL and data modeling with a wide variety of databases. Nice to have experience with additional reporting databases such as Oracle and Snowflake. * Experience working with cloud platforms, including managing hybrid cloud/on\-prem environments in AWS. * Proficiency with the following tools (or similar): Issue Tracking (e.g. JIRA, Service Now), Collaboration (e.g. Confluence, Trello), Communication (e.g. Slack, Webex, Skype for Business), Version Control (e.g. Github), Automation (e.g. Jenkins, Ansible, CloudFormation, Terraform) * Extensive experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD). You should be proficient in automating build, test, and deployment processes using modern CI/CD tools and platforms (e.g. Github Actions, Jenkins, etc). **Why SIE?** ------------ This is your opportunity to be at the forefront of designing and implementing pioneering technology that powers a global entertainment leader. You’ll work on exciting, impactful systems that touch millions of users, while also having the flexibility to grow your skills and contribute across various business areas. **Benefits \& Perks:** ---------------------- * Competitive salary * 401K with company match, education assistance, generous paid leave, and more * On\-site gym and café * Break rooms with networked PlayStation consoles and monthly game voucher * Remote work flexibility with opportunities to collaborate across global teams At SIE, we consider several factors when setting each role’s base pay range, including the competitive benchmarking data for the market and geographic location. Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our hybrid working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job\-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this role is eligible for SIE’s top\-tier benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for Sony products. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package. The estimated base pay range for this role is listed below. $177,300—$265,900 USD Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks. Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice (where applicable) for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights. **Equal Opportunity Statement:** *Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.* *We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond.* *Sony Interactive Entertainment is a Fair Chance employer and qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment.*

jobs.title: Early Career Data Engineer
jobs.description: Early Career Data Engineer*Are you ready to combine your passion for design with a meaningful and multifaceted career in the cycling industry? At Specialized, our teammates are encouraged to explore roles across a variety of functions throughout their careers. We value curiosity, a desire to try new things, and an eagerness to learn about all aspects of the business. Join us in making the world a better place through the power of bicycles and build your dream career at the same time!* As a Specialized Early Career Data Engineer, you won’t be watching from the sidelines. You’ll step into meaningful work, bring a fresh perspective, and help shape **the future of Specialized and how we show up for riders around the world.** Bring your curiosity. Bring your ideas. Bring the courage to challenge what’s been done before. You’ll work alongside people who are constantly pushing what’s possible, learn from experienced leaders, and have the opportunity to leave your mark on a brand built around riders. If you’re ready to learn fast, think differently, and **help write the next chapter of Specialized**, come ride with us. The Junior Data Engineer is responsible for building, maintaining, and optimizing trusted data products, data pipelines, and AI\-ready data assets that power reporting, analytics, operational decision\-making, and emerging AI capabilities across the organization. Working within a modern cloud\-based data platform, this role helps improve data accessibility, quality, reliability, and scalability while enabling self\-service analytics and AI innovation. The Junior Data Engineer partners closely with Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Analysts, Data Scientists, and business stakeholders to deliver curated, business\-ready datasets that accelerate decision\-making and maximize the value of enterprise data. This position provides critical delivery capacity for the Data \& Analytics team while creating a sustainable pipeline of future engineering talent. The role allows senior engineers and architects to focus on platform modernization, governance, AI enablement, and strategic initiatives while ensuring day\-to\-day engineering execution is delivered effectively. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **Data Engineering \& Data Product Development** ------------------------------------------------ * Build, maintain, and optimize data pipelines, integrations, and data products. * Develop ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform, and deliver data from enterprise systems. * Support the development of trusted, reusable datasets for analytics, reporting, operational processes, and AI initiatives. * Assist with data warehouse, lakehouse, and semantic layer development. * Contribute to scalable cloud\-based data platform solutions. **Data Quality, Reliability \& Observability** ---------------------------------------------- * Monitor pipeline performance, data quality, and platform health. * Implement data validation, reconciliation, and automated quality controls. * Support data observability and proactive issue detection. * Troubleshoot production issues and participate in root\-cause analysis. * Help establish and maintain data reliability standards and service levels. **Analytics \& Self\-Service Enablement** ----------------------------------------- * Deliver curated datasets that enable self\-service reporting and analytics. * Partner with business and analytics teams to understand and translate data requirements. * Support semantic models and business\-friendly data structures. * Improve data accessibility, documentation, and usability across the organization. * Reduce manual reporting effort through automation and standardized data assets. **AI \& Data Foundation Support** --------------------------------- * Prepare and curate data for AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics use cases. * Support the development of AI\-ready datasets, metadata, and lineage documentation. * Collaborate with governance and analytics teams to ensure data is trusted, documented, and fit for AI applications. * Support responsible AI initiatives through strong data quality This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who takes defined and scoped AI use cases from prototype to production, turning them into reliable, governed, and auditable AI agents that connect to enterprise data and applications. The successful candidate will address data readiness and integration challenges, build rigorous evaluation and auditability into every solution, and ensure deployed agents deliver measurable workflow improvements while meeting the strong governance, risk, and control standards of a regulated financial\-services environment. Working closely with the Senior Principal Architect for Agentic and MLOps Operations, business stakeholders, data and platform teams, and control partners, this role is an opportunity to be a founding member of a growing agentic AI engineering capability. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, build, and deliver production\-grade agentic AI solutions, from prototype through deployment, that automate and enhance business workflows across the investment management organization. * Assess and address data readiness at the outset of each solution: profile, map, and validate source data; resolve quality and access gaps; and build pipelines, APIs, or semantic layers that make existing systems and data consumable by AI agents. * Develop agent logic, including prompts, retrieval, tool/API integrations, and orchestration, connecting agents to enterprise data sources and business applications. * Implement deterministic validation, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop approval steps to ensure AI outputs are accurate and safe for business decisions. * Build end\-to\-end auditability into every solution capturing inputs, data sources, model versions, tool calls, outputs, and human approvals. Produce documentation and evidence for governance, risk, compliance, and audit reviews. * Create test sets and evaluation pipelines to verify accuracy, grounding, reliability, and resilience against edge cases and adversarial inputs such as prompt injection. * Partner with business users during user acceptance testing to validate that solutions deliver the intended workflow improvements, and refine solutions based on feedback. * Deploy, monitor, and maintain solutions via CI/CD and infrastructure\-as\-code, tracking quality, latency, cost, and business outcome metrics, and troubleshooting, tuning, and upgrading solutions in production. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 3\+ years of software engineering experience, including hands\-on experience building AI/ML or LLM\-based applications (production experience preferred). * Strong proficiency in Python and experience building production\-grade APIs, services, and integrations with enterprise systems. * Strong SQL and data engineering skills, including data profiling, quality validation, transformation, and pipeline development across structured and unstructured enterprise data sources. * Hands\-on experience building agentic AI solutions, including LLM tool calling, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, and multi\-step orchestration using frameworks such as LangGraph, Google ADK, or similar. * Solid working knowledge of Google Cloud Platform, particularly Vertex AI, Gemini models, and BigQuery, along with core GCP compute, storage, networking, and IAM services. * Experience designing LLM evaluation and testing approaches, including test datasets, accuracy and grounding metrics, regression testing, and guardrails against prompt injection and unsafe outputs. * Experience building auditable AI systems, including decision traceability, audit logging, lineage of data and model versions, and records of human approvals. * Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g., Terraform), containerization, observability, and cloud security practices such as identity federation, secrets management, and least\-privilege access. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to work directly with business users through acceptance testing and to document solutions for technical, risk, and governance audiences. **Nice to Have** * Experience with Microsoft Azure and Entra ID, and building on Microsoft 365 data (Exchange, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive) via Microsoft Graph or Copilot extensibility. * Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise SaaS and data sources such as Salesforce CRM, Marketo, master data management (MDM), and cloud\-hosted or on\-premises systems, including via Model Context Protocol (MCP) or API enablement of legacy systems; familiarity with TypeScript or Java for building integrations and services. * Experience delivering AI solutions in financial services or another regulated industry, including familiarity with model risk management, Responsible AI, data privacy, and investment management data. **Salary Range:** $70,000 \- $118,750 Annual The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ. *Employees are eligible to participate in State Street’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes: our retirement savings plan (401K) with company match; insurance coverage including basic life, medical, dental, vision, long\-term disability, and other optional additional coverages; paid\-time off including vacation, sick leave, short term disability, and family care responsibilities; access to our Employee Assistance Program; incentive compensation including eligibility for annual performance\-based awards (excluding certain sales roles subject to sales incentive plans); and, eligibility for certain tax advantaged savings plans.* *For a full overview, visit* *https://hrportal.ehr.com/statestreet/Home* *.* **About State Street** ====================== Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success. We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law. Discover more information on jobs at StateStreet.com/careers Read our CEO Statement **Job Application Disclosure:** It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

jobs.description: ***If you are a current State of Maine employee, please submit your application through the internal application process using the Find Jobs report in PRISM. Seasonal employees who do not have PRISM access should apply through the State’s career page and indicate on the application that they have previously worked for the State.*** --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *.* **Office of Information Technology** **Opening Date:** November 18, 2026 **Closing Date:** December 04, 2026 **Grade/Admin Unit:** 27 / Professional/Technical **Job Class Code:** 0866 **Salary:** $75,234\.74 \- $105,714\.46\*/Annually (\*includes 23\.66% recruitment and retention stipend, and eligible for a 5% training bonus) **Position Number:** 200024887 **Location:** Augusta **Telework:** Available ***Currently, this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship or STEM OPT extensions.*** You are a talented IT professional who is driven toward success, a go\-getter, always seeking ways to expand your knowledge, and encourage others to do the same. You enjoy clearing hurdles as you strive for excellence. If this describes you, we want you on our TEAM!! **OVERVIEW:** The Department of Administrative and Financial Services (DAFS) Office of Information Technology (MaineIT) provides information technology support to over 13,000 employees. MaineIT oversees large scale enterprise applications that support the critical and diverse business needs of the State of Maine and its agencies. MaineIT is seeking a highly talented individual who will represent our C.A.R.E. values in all that they do. At MaineIT we: * Practice Customer\-focus, ensuring that our customers are heard, and their needs are met. * Hold ourselves to a high level of Accountability by being transparent with our stakeholders. * Maintain an effective level of Responsiveness by providing timely updates in a proactive manner. * Strive to provide Empathy driven, people\-focused services by applying emotional intelligence skills and behaviors. **ABOUT THE JOB DETAILS:** As a Power Platform Senior Programmer Analyst with the MaineIT Application Development Group, you will be part of the Microsoft Power Platform and MS Dynamics team for the Department of Administration and Financial Services. This role is the highest technical level in all phases of applications systems analysis and design activities. The most important aspects of this work are the application of system analysis skills to formulate solutions to complex business problems using automation technologies and preparing system design plans and detailed specifications to facilitate the development and implementation of application systems. Oversite of daily support activities and other development work may be required. Work is performed under limited supervision. This position is located in Augusta, Maine. **WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?** Hybrid Work Opportunity – The employee in this position currently has the opportunity to work remotely from within the State of Maine as much as 90% of the time. * You will be a member of a highly productive technical team working closely with program partners to ensure effective and secure technical solutions for business problem. * You will have the opportunity to work in a small, independent, and flexible team environment. * You will help resolve technical issues to provide system functionality and data integration. * You will experience new and different challenges on an ongoing basis. * You will have opportunities for training and career development. **WHAT WILL YOU DO?** * As Senior Programmer Analyst, you will be joining the DAFS Application Development team and providing critical technical support and subject\-matter expertise for Microsoft Power Platform Solutions. As well as assisting with the Bureau of the Budget’s Oracle application. * You will be providing direct support to the business in their daily use of the application, troubleshooting operational issues, coordinating work performed by MaineIT staff, system upgrades, interfacing with vendors and business partners, user and technical support, and periodic user training. * Support platform maturity and integration of application lifecycle management within the Power Platform – environments, solutions, automation and delivery. * Design, develop, and implement solutions using Power Apps (Canvas and Model\-Driven), Power Automate, and Power BI * Lead the development of scalable and reusable components within Dataverse * Develop integrations between Dynamics, Power Platform, and external systems using APIs and Azure services * Establish and enforce best practices for architecture, governance, and DevSecOps * Collaborate with business stakeholders to d holidays, 12 days of sick leave,** and **3\+ weeks of vacation leave** annually. Vacation leave accrual increases with years of service, and overtime\-exempt employees receive personal leave. * **Health Insurance Coverage** – The State of Maine pays **85%\-100%** of employee\-only premiums ($11,857\.68\-$13,950\.24 annual value), depending on salary. Use this chart to find the premium costs for you and your family, including the percentage of dependent coverage paid by the State. * **Health Insurance Premium Credit** – Participation decreases employee\-only premiums by 5%. Visit the Office of Employee Health and Wellness for more information about program requirements . * **Dental Insurance** – The State of Maine pays 100% of employee\-only dental premiums ($365\.28 annual value). * **Retirement Plan** – The State of Maine contributes 14\.06% of pay to the Maine Public Employees Retirement System (MainePERS), on behalf of the employee. * **Gym Membership Reimbursement** – Improve overall health with regular exercise and receive up to $40 per month to offset this expense. * **Health and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts** – Set aside money pre\-tax to help pay for out\-of\-pocket health care expenses and/or daycare expenses. * **Public Service Student Loan Forgiveness** – The State of Maine is a qualified employer for this federal program. For more information, visit the Federal Student Aid office . * **Living Resources Program** – Navigate challenging work and life situations with our employee assistance program. * **Parental leave** is one of the most important benefits for any working parent. All employees who are welcoming a child—including non\-birthing parents and adoptive parents—receive **six weeks of fully paid parental leave** . Additional unpaid leave may also be available, under the Family and Medical Leave Act . * **Voluntary Deferred Compensation** – Save additional pre\-tax funds for retirement in a MaineSaves 457(b) account through payroll deductions. State employees are eligible for an extensive and highly competitive benefits package , covering many aspects of wellness. Learn about **additional wellness benefits** for State employees from the Office of Employee Health and Wellness . Note: Benefits may vary somewhat according to specific collective bargaining agreements and are prorated for anything less than full\-time. *There's a job and then there's purposeful, transformative work. Our aim is to create a workplace where you can learn, grow, and continuously refine your skills. Applicants demonstrate job requirements in differing ways, and we appreciate that many skills and backgrounds can make people successful in this role.* *As an Equal Opportunity employer, Maine State Government embraces a culture of respect and awareness. We are committed to creating a strong sense of belonging for all team members, and our process ensures an inclusive environment to applicants of all backgrounds including diverse race, color, sex, sexual orientation or gender identity, physical or mental disability, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, familial status or genetics.* *If you’re looking for a great next step, and want to feel good about what you do, we’d love to hear from you. Please note reasonable accommodations are provided to qualified individuals with disabilities upon request.* **Thinking about applying?** Research shows that people from historically excluded communities tend to apply to jobs only when they check every box in the posting. If you’re currently reading this and hesitating to apply for that reason, we encourage you to go for it! Let us know how your experience and passion set you apart. If you require a paper application, please download and print one HERE . **If you are unable to complete the online application, please contact the Human Resources representative listed on the job opening you are interested in applying for. They will work with you for an alternative method of submitting.**

jobs.title: AI Developer (Austin)
jobs.description: **Description** --------------- WHO WE ARE: Texas Workforce Commission (TWC) connects people with careers across the state. While we are based in Austin on the north lawn of the Texas State Capitol, we have offices statewide. We're a Family Friendly Certified Workplace with great work\-life balance, competitive salaries, extensive opportunities for training and development, and fantastic benefits. This position is based at 1411 Brazos Street, Austin in the Information Technology Division. TWC is not considering applications from individuals who require sponsorship for an employment visa, now or in the future, for this position. This includes, but is not limited to, individuals currently on H\-1B, F\-1 (OPT/CPT), or H\-4 visas. You must be a Texas resident to work for the Texas Workforce Commission or willing to relocate to Texas. WHO YOU ARE: A Multi\-Language (Python/Java) Developer: You are a versatile engineer who thrives on using the right tool for the job. You have a strong background in Python for building modern, high\-performance web applications and integrating advanced AI APIs, combined with solid experience in Java to support enterprise\-level systems. A Legacy\-to\-Modern Bridge Builder: You aren't intimidated by legacy infrastructure. You are excited by the challenge of translating, modernizing, and migrating critical state workflows away from legacy mainframes (like COBOL and Natural) and rewriting them into robust, modern Java environments. An AI\-Driven Problem Solver: You are passionate about the intersection of software engineering and Artificial Intelligence. You want to apply your Python skills to design, build, and deploy the next generation of secure, agency\-wide AI utilities (such as high\-capacity transcription engines and division\-specific intelligent agents) that improve public service delivery. A Collaborative Communicator: You enjoy working with cross\-functional teams of developers, database administrators, and business leads. You can talk legacy mainframe logic with senior database engineers, and modern API architecture with AI developers, bringing people and systems together. WHAT YOU WILL DO: The AI Developer (Programmer V\-VI) performs highly advanced to supervisory (senior\-level) computer programming and systems analysis work for TWC. In this role, you will play a key part in connecting the agency’s technical ecosystem by securely integrating new applications with existing vendor solutions, ensuring optimal performance, compliance, security, and scalability. This work is performed under minimal supervision, with opportunities for considerable to extensive latitude for the use of initiative and independent judgment. You will split your focus between driving modern, Python\-based AI innovations and executing critical legacy system migrations into modern Java architectures. YOU WILL BE TRUSTED TO: * Develop Modern AI Solutions (Python): Partner with cross\-functional teams to design, develop, and integrate secure, in\-house AI tools, high\-capacity transcription engines, and custom division\-level agents. * Modernize Legacy Systems (Java): Analyze existing business logic within mainframe systems (Natural/COBOL) and systematically refactor and rewrite those processes into clean, maintainable, and efficient Java code. * Build REST APIs \& Data Pipelines: Build and optimize secure REST APIs, web services, and data pipelines to connect frontend AI applications with core agency databases (such as Oracle and Google BigQuery). * Leverage Enterprise Cloud AI: Learn, utilize, and integrate generative AI SDKs and services from major cloud providers (e.g., Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud) to build scalable, production\-ready solutions. * Maintain Agency Governance Standards: Ensure all software solutions strictly adhere to TWC policies, data privacy guidelines, accessibility standards (Section 508/Texas EIR), and strict cybersecurity protocols. * Own the SDLC: Contribute to the full software development lifecycle, from initial concept and architectural design to deployment, maintenance, and technical documentation. * Provide Technical Direction: Offer guidance, peer reviews, and mentorship to other developers on the team to foster a collaborative culture of continuous learning. * Perform other duties as assigned. YOU QUALIFY WITH: * Programmer V: Five years of full\-time experience in data processing, computer science, computer programming, systems analysis, and/or related field. * Programmer VI: Six years of full\-time experience in data processing, computer science, computer programming, systems analysis, and/or related field. * Relevant academic credits may be applied toward experience qualifications for both of these levels. YOU ARE A GREAT FIT WITH: * Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, or a related field. * Core Programming Proficiency: Hands\-on professional experience in both Python and Java. * Database \& Big Data Experience: Familiarity with enterprise cloud data platforms (such as Google BigQuery or AWS Redshift). * Cloud AI Platforms: Familiarity with major enterprise Cloud AI Platforms (such as Google Cloud Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, or Azure AI Studio) and experience leveraging managed foundation models. * API Development: Proven experience building, consuming, and securing REST APIs and managing high\-capacity data pipelines. * Prompt Engineering: Proficiency in generative AI prompting, understanding prompt management techniques, and designing prompt templates for improved, consistent model outcomes. * Modern Tooling \& DevOps: Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies, Git version control, and standard CI/CD / DevOps practices. * Mission \& Passion: A strong desire to continuously learn about emerging AI/ML technologies and apply them to solve highly complex, real\-world problems in the public sector. * Public Sector Experience: Professional experience working within, or contracting for, local, state, or federal government agencies, with a solid understanding of public sector operational and security standards. Follow reporting best practices so performance holds up as data volumes grow. * Support migration from legacy systems into Salesforce, and import data with tools such as Data Loader. * Manage releases and deploy changes through sandboxes to production using Salesforce best practices. * Unit test your work, write test plans and test cases, support user acceptance testing, and validate results against requirements. * Create documentation for processes, policies, configuration, user guides, training, and change requests. * Identify needed system changes ahead of time, and tell users about changes before they go live. * Manage vendors for project software and hardware across the lifecycle, including vendor meetings. * Provide technical leadership and strategic direction. Define the current and future state of the platform and its integrations, working with architects and other technical staff on environment setup, configuration, and development. * Explain how technical decisions affect the business, applications, and timelines, and influence decisions accordingly. * Work with Business Consultants to confirm requirements, manage partner expectations, and weigh the business value of future project ideas. * Mentor and train State development resources. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field. * 8 to 10 years of experience in information systems analysis, design, and development, including consulting experience. * 5\+ years of development and administration on the Salesforce platform (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Community Cloud). * 5\+ years of experience with Lightning Web Components (LWC), Aura, Apex, SOQL, and JavaScript. * 5\+ years of experience building and managing Salesforce Communities. * 5\+ years of Salesforce design, analysis, configuration, customization, and coding. * 5\+ years of experience with the Salesforce data model and its data migration and integration capabilities. * 5\+ years of experience with Scrum/Agile development practices. * 3\+ years of experience with Salesforce tools such as Data Loader, the Outlook connector, Jitterbit, or MuleSoft. * Experience with REST and SOAP API integrations with internal and third\-party systems. * Strong reporting background using standard Salesforce reporting. * Ability to propose, document, and implement software lifecycle solutions. * Understanding of CRM concepts. **Preferred Qualifications** * Salesforce Platform Developer or Administrator certification. * Experience with Flosum or OwnBackup. * Public sector or Medicaid experience. **What Makes You Successful** * Strong leadership, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication with technical and business teams. * Ability to work on your own and as part of a team. * Ability to tell critical issues from minor ones, establish facts, and reach sound conclusions. * An eye for patterns and improvement opportunities across the organization. * A habit of keeping current with new technology. **How to Apply** Submit your resume with your Salesforce certifications, if you have them. Highlight the Communities, integrations, and LWC/Apex work you have built.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer - Tier II
jobs.description: Structured Communication Systems, Inc is seeking a Systems Engineer (Tier II) located in Clackamas, Oregon to join our Managed Services team. As part of our team, you will be responsible for providing technical support, troubleshooting, and resolution of customer service requests and incidents as part of Structured's Managed Services team. This position serves as a primary escalation resource for Tier I engineers, manages service tickets in accordance with established Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and ensures timely resolution through effective troubleshooting, documentation, and customer communication. **Compensation**: $74,000\.00 \- $96,000\.00 (annually) ***(Must maintain a valid driver’s license and motor vehicle insurance \- at least equal to the state’s minimum coverage requirements.)*** **About Structured** Structured Communication Systems, Inc. (Structured) is a leading provider of cybersecurity, digital infrastructure, cloud solutions, managed services, and technology consulting. We help organizations strengthen their Cyber Resilience, reduce operational risk, protect critical business assets, and maximize the value of their technology investments. Structured delivers comprehensive technology solutions and services that help organizations anticipate, withstand, respond to, and recover from cybersecurity threats and business disruptions. Our expertise spans cybersecurity, enterprise networking, cloud computing, data center infrastructure, governance, risk and compliance (GRC), artificial intelligence, and managed services. Through strategic partnerships with industry\-leading technology manufacturers, including Cisco, Palo Alto Networks, HPE Aruba Networking, Juniper Networks, Microsoft, and others, Structured delivers solutions designed to address complex business and technology challenges. Our success is built on technical expertise, trusted customer relationships, strong manufacturer partnerships, and a collaborative team culture. At Structured, It's All About the Team. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** An individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily in order to meet the qualifications required to perform this job successfully. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. * Serves as a primary escalation point for Tier I engineers, providing technical guidance and support with incident triage, troubleshooting, problem resolution, and service coordination. * Troubleshoots, diagnoses, and resolves technical issues, service requests, and incidents affecting customers and internal operations to ensure timely and effective resolution. * Collaborates with other Managed Services team members and technical resources to resolve complex or escalated issues, minimize service disruptions, and ensure effective service delivery. * Actively participates in the Managed Services team's designated customer support phone queue, maintaining availability during assigned coverage periods and responding to incoming customer communications in a timely and professional manner. * Assesses incoming customer inquiries and technical issues, performs initial troubleshooting as appropriate, and creates, updates, assigns, or escalates service tickets based on the nature and complexity of the issue. * Actively monitors and manages assigned service requests, incidents, and escalated tickets within Structured's designated ticketing system, regularly reviewing ticket queues to identify outstanding issues, prioritize responsibilities, and ensure timely progress toward resolution. * Maintains ownership and accountability for assigned service tickets throughout the ticket lifecycle, proactively following up on unresolved issues and tickets awaiting customer, vendor, or internal responses to prevent unnecessary delays. * Confirms resolution of reported technical issues, as appropriate, and ensures service tickets are properly documented and closed in accordance with established procedures. * Proactively communicates and follows up with customers throughout the service ticket lifecycle, providing regular updates on troubleshooting progress, anticipated next steps, and resolution efforts while ensuring customer questions, concerns, and outstanding technical issues are appropriately addressed. * Communicates service delays, unresolved technical issues, and necessary escalations to customers and internal stakeholders in a timely and professional manner. * Monitors and manages assigned service requests and incidents in accordance with established Service Level Agreements (SLAs), prioritizing tickets based on urgency, business impact, incident severity, and applicable response, update, and resolution timelines. * Proactively identifies service tickets at risk of exceeding established SLA timelines and takes appropriate corrective action, includ -focused communication for non\-technical audiences. * Demonstrates excellent project management, project scoping, troubleshooting, problem resolution, and documentation skills. * Possesses strong organizational and time management skills, with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to prioritize responsibilities and manage competing deadlines in a fast\-paced, high\-pressure environment. * Ability to maintain strict confidentiality. **Education and Experience** Bachelor's degree (B.A. or B.S.) in Information systems, Computer Science, or a related technical field plus two (2\) years’ experience; or five (5\) years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience in Managed Services. **General Office Computer Skills** To perform this job successfully, an individual should be an experienced user of the Microsoft Office Suite and have experience with customer relationship management (CRM) tools, such as Salesforce. **Language Skills** Ability to read, analyze, and interpret quotes and reports. Must be able to communicate effectively in English, including the ability to read, write, speak, and understand English, to perform essential job functions such as corresponding, presenting information, and responding to questions from employees, management, vendors, and customers, with or without reasonable accommodation. **Physical Demands** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to walk, stand, sit or step up to access equipment within a data center environment; use hands to, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; talk and hear. The employee is occasionally required to stoop, kneel, crouch and twist. The employee will occasionally lift and/or move up to 75 pounds. Must maintain a valid Driver’s License and motor vehicle insurance (at least equal to the state’s minimum coverage requirements), as well as have the ability to occasionally travel to customer locations and other destinations for short to medium term projects. **Working Conditions** The working conditions characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Work is performed in both a general office environment, as well as a data center environment. Within the general office environment both the lighting and temperature are generally moderate. The data center environment is generally cool in temperature and the lighting is moderate; the noise level in the data center environment is generally loud. This position may require an adjusted work schedule and evening hours in order to meet or attend vendor/customer needs. Flexibility to field phone calls or system alerts and provide remote and/or on\-site support to clients outside of normal business hours, including weekends and holidays. **Benefits** Our organization provides a full compensation package that facilitates development and growth. The benefits package includes medical, dental, vision, group life and AD\&D insurance, and long and short\-term disability coverage and 401(k). We also provide training on mutually agreed upon professional goals through a combination of self\-study courses, formal training, and on\-the\-job training. Obtaining industry\-based certifications is highly encouraged. *\*\*\* We are interested in all qualified candidates that are eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas. \*\*\** *Structured is an Equal Opportunity Employer with a strong commitment to supporting and retaining a diverse and talented workforce.*

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer - Video
jobs.description: Substack is building a new economic engine for culture, giving the brightest, most interesting, and most creative people on the internet the power of their own publishing platform. The terms of our culture should not be set by gate\-keeping legacy media or chaos\-fueling social media, but by the people who make and participate in that culture. Substack’s model, based on direct subscriptions, has fueled an explosion of independent publishing. It empowers creators with economic autonomy, creative ownership, and a direct connection to their most engaged audiences. As a Software Engineer at Substack, you are responsible for the core product platform, from APIs, low\-level services, and database operations, to frontend UI and testing. On the Video team you’ll be working on podcasting, live streaming, video and audio recording, uploading, clipping, and everything related to an excellent video product experience. Full Stack Engineers work in close partnership with designers, product thinkers, and customers directly to build out new product offerings and tooling across the platform. They are on the front\-lines of product development and are responsible for creating what’s next for Substack. **Responsibilities** * With the support of the engineering team, develop the core Substack product for creators and consumers. This is a dynamic organization with needs across the board. We expect that engineers will be able to jump into any area of the product, learn quickly and add value. * Support and collaborate with other team members, including engineers, designers, creators, support staff, and many others. * Own your work and deliver high\-quality solutions from product concept and proposal to implementation, experimentation, and measurement. * Work directly with customers to solve their problems. The entire company (CEO included) participates in customer support in order to drive empathy for our users and help us build better products. * We work with TypeScript, especially Node/Express and React, and Postgres. It’s helpful if you know these technologies already, if not, we’ll be excited to help you learn. * We work to stay on the leading edge of AI tooling, to both improve our internal workflows, as well as utilize them in product to improve publisher capabilities and experiences **Requirements** * 4\+ years of non\-internship professional full stack web software development. * Proficiency with Node.js and React is an advantage. * Have a degree in Computer Science or have the equivalent industry experience. * Independent and autonomous. We’re too small to micromanage, and expect that every person at the company owns their work and can be a leader. * Take pride in building elegant and delightful product experiences. Substack works best when it gets out of the way so creators can focus on creating and connecting with their readers. * Enjoy collaboration with a diverse group of thinkers while bringing our own unique experience and background to the team. * Believe in Substack’s mission to build a better business model for content creation. * Proficiency with video processing frameworks and libraries such as FFmpeg is an advantage. * Experience with workflow systems such as Temporal is an advantage. Substack’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, and exceptional benefits. Our cash compensation salary range for this role is $140,000 \- $260,000\. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above. Substack is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or transgender status), age, national origin, veteran or disability status. We’re seeking people passionate about enabling independent expression and building a better business model for creators. If you want to see what media, communities, and content can become when unmoored from advertising models, and you have the skills and experience to contribute, we’d love to meet you. Please see our Privacy Notice for details regarding Substack's collection and use of personal information relating to the application and recruitment process by clicking here.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Hub \- San Francisco **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Engineering, Product, Design, and MarketingEngineering **Compensation** ---------------- $227K – $284K • Offers Equity *Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role, requiring 3 days per week in our SF Hub. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in\-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.* **About Superhuman** -------------------- Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs's collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here. **The Opportunity** ------------------- We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer who takes real ownership and does well in a fast\-moving, ambitious, and problem\-oriented environment. You’ll work hands\-on with improving our LLMs, and using them to solve for high\-impact product opportunities. You’ll own part of the direction of our AI work: framing the right problems, finding their most effective solution, and helping shape the roadmap. This role is a bit of a hybrid of machine learning/engineering with product. It would suit someone already in an AI Engineering role, as well as software engineers or data scientists that have gone deep into shaping models (themselves) to propel them forward. What you’ll do * Lead entire AI/ML initiatives from problem definition through delivery. * Influence technical direction and roadmap decisions by framing problems clearly and backing choices with evidence. * Partner with product, engineering, and design to deliver high\-impact models. * Strengthen our ML practices and infrastructure, including evals, training pipelines, and model serving. * Mentor teammates and share knowledge to raise the bar across the team. By 30 days, you will have: * Upgraded an existing feature to be meaningfully smarter and/or faster, and shared what you learned with the team. * Reviewed our evaluation approach and improved or built evals for our core features. * Found the highest\-leverage opportunities in our AI stack and started shaping priorities with the team. By 90 days, you will have: * Led the delivery of AI features that address valuable customer use cases. * Fine\-tuned models for our specific needs and set repeatable practices others can build on. * Developed new processes to speed up how we utilize new AI models. **Qualifications** ------------------ * A track record of owning and shipping production AI/ML systems end\-to\-end, with the independence and judgment expected of a senior engineer. * A blend of modern LLM expertise and structured problem\-solving. You can work backward from a user problem, frame the right technical question, and define how to evaluate success. That structured problem\-solving might come from product engineering, technical consulting, or comparable experience. * Deep hands\-on experience in LLM post\-training and/or inference optimization, with evidence of exceptional results in a specific problem area. For example: + Building a model that outperforms strong alternatives on a specialized task through thoughtful dataset development, supervised fine\-tuning, preference tuning, or reinforcement learning. * Making LLMs substantially faster or more efficient through tailored quantization, speculative decoding, or other inference techniques.The ability to go beyond established recipes: diagnosing failure modes, designing experiments, and adapting methods to the problem at hand.Strong evaluation judgment. You design evals grounded in user needs, distinguish meaningful improvements from benchmark gains, and establish practices that catch regressions before users do. * Experience serving and optimizing models at scale, with a practical understanding of the trade\-offs between latency, throughput, uptime, and cost. * Strong production Python and fluency with data, including building and cleaning datasets, analyzing results in Python or SQL, and working comfortably with modern training and serving stacks. * Experience influencing technical direction and helping other engineers succeed through clear reasoning, collaboration, and mentoring. Nice to have * Experience spanning both LLM post\-training and inference optimization. * Successful application of preference tuning or reinforcement learning to improve real\-world model performance. * Speech or long\-context experience, especially with noisy, lengthy transcripts. * Experience establishing ML infrastructure, evaluation practices, or model development workflows at a startup or growth\-stage company. How you work * Ownership: You take ambiguous problems and drive them to clear outcomes without waiting for perfect specs. * High standards: You care about quality and detail, you’re tenacious, and you raise the bar for everyone around you. * Pragmatic and results\-driven: You pick the right hills to climb and find the fastest way up. * A generalist who dives deep: You might work on data one day and training methods or infrastructure the next. * Clear communicator: You explain technical results and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non\-technical partners. * Multiplier: You make the people around you better through mentorship, reviews, and knowledge\-sharing. **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing the following and more: * Excellent health care (including a wide range of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and fertility benefits) * Disability and life insurance options * 401(k) and RRSP matching * Paid parental leave * 20 days of paid time off per year, 12 days of paid holidays per year, two floating holidays per year, and flexible sick time * Generous stipends (including those for caregiving, pet care, wellness, your home office, and more) * Annual professional development budget and opportunities Superhuman takes a market\-based approach to compensation, so base pay may vary by location. For more information about our compensation zones and locations where we currently support employment, please refer to this page. If a location of interest is not listed, please speak with a recruiter for additional information. Base pay may vary considerably depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The expected salary ranges for this position are outlined by compensation zone and may be modified in the future. **We encourage you to apply** ----------------------------- At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all to apply—especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech organizations. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, political belief, or any other characteristic protected by law. Superhuman is an equal opportunity employer and a participant in the US federal E\-Verify program (US). We also abide by the Employment Equity Act (Canada). Compensation Range: $227K \- $284K

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Supernova Technology** Founded in 2014, we offer the industry’s first and only cloud\-based, fully\-customizable, end\-to\-end software solution to automate securities\-based lending from origination through the life of the loan. By combining thought leadership in suitability and risk management with industry\-leading education and the latest technology, Supernova enables advisors to deliver holistic, goals\-based advice and to help their clients achieve financial wellness. We partner with the industry’s largest banks, most prominent insurance companies and leading online brokerages to democratize access to securities\-based lending and better the entire financial ecosystem. **Why Join Supernova?** At Supernova Technology, we believe that the best results come from a team that is passionate, driven, and supported in all aspects of their professional lives. Here, you’ll work alongside talented and innovative individuals who are committed to driving the future of securities\-based lending technology. We foster a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and growth, where each person’s contributions make a real impact. **About the Role** As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a critical role in defining the architecture and technical vision for Supernova’s cloud\-based Security\-Based Lending (SBL) SaaS platform. You will be responsible for designing scalable, high\-performing, and secure systems that support our business services and APIs. We are looking for a technical leader who is passionate about software design, architecture, and emerging technologies, with a proven track record of building and evolving complex software systems. jobs.title: SAP MM Consultant
jobs.description: **About Tessera** ----------------- Tessera is an AI platform that drives business transformation and unlocks new value for enterprises. The Platform's agents deliver governed execution across ERP, CRM, HCM and finance systems, cutting timelines from years to weeks and costs by more than half. **Role Summary** ---------------- We are seeking a senior SAP MM Consultant to own materials management and its data on SAP S/4HANA migrations and data harmonisation: the material master, purchasing, inventory and the open documents that run them. You own the target design, the MM data migration from mapping to cutover, and the proof that it works after the load. This is a doer role, not an advisory one. **How the Work Is Different** ----------------------------- Tessera is a software company, not a services firm: we do not sell hours, and the Platform's AI agents do the heavy lifting — process analysis, data profiling, conversion and validation. You bring the SAP judgment: you specify the work, check what comes back against SAP models, tables and real data, and own the calls a client signs. Our success measure is the client's adoption of the Platform. A consultant leaves and takes the capability with them; when you leave, the capability stays with the client. That is why we hire SMEs on a path to become Forward Deployed Engineers, one of the most sought\-after roles in tech, with Platform certification and support from our FDE team along the way. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **1\. Materials and procurement design.** Own the material master design — views, plant and storage data, MRP data, units of measure — and the interfaces with plant maintenance, projects and finance. Work through the MM simplification items and use fit\-to\-standard to decide what to keep, change or retire. **2\. MM data migration ownership.** Own the MM data migration workstream end to end: object scope, source\-to\-target field mapping, value mapping and transformation rules, load order and sign\-off criteria. Keep the mapping document as the system of record for every mapping decision, and track each open point from workshop to closure. **3\. Mock loads, validation and reconciliation.** Run iterative mock loads and dress rehearsals. Pilot on a selective test batch before full loads. Read the load logs and classify each failure as a data defect, a mapping defect, a configuration gap or a tooling issue. Check units of measure, material types, valuation classes, blanks and duplicates before each load, and show a reconciliation after it: record counts, field\-level samples and checks in target transactions. **4\. Cutover and hypercare.** Set the open PO and requisition cut\-off rules, the inventory freeze and the load timing for cutover. Support dress rehearsals and production loads, and own data issues in your object scope during hypercare. **5\. Client engagement.** Lead mapping workshops with business data owners and drive each issue to sign\-off, on several engagements at once, with clear written handoffs. **6\. AI agents and adoption.** Set the requirements and acceptance criteria the agents work to, act as the final quality gate on their output, turn findings into reusable rules, and enable the client's team to run the Platform on their own. **Data Objects in Scope** ------------------------- You own the functional design, mapping, validation and sign\-off for MM data objects. The core objects cover the procure\-to\-pay chain: material master, suppliers, purchasing master data, requisitions and agreements, purchase orders, and goods receipts and invoices. Inventory, valuation, classification and batches are desired. Maintenance, project and service procurement and supplier EDI set you apart. **Technical \& Functional Skills** ---------------------------------- **Material master:** material types, views and organisational levels, field selection, units of measure and conversions, valuation classes, MRP data and classification. **Purchasing:** requisitions and purchase orders, account assignment categories, info records, source lists, contracts and scheduling agreements, release strategies and pricing in purchasing. **Inventory management and valuation:** goods movements and movement types, stock types, physical inventory, price control and valuation areas, posting period dependencies, and the SAP S/4HANA inventory data model (MATDOC). **Invoice verification and integration:** logistics invoice verification, GR/IR clearing, account determination for inventory postings, and integration with FI, CO, PM, PS and SD. **Business Partner and CVI:** supplier conversion to Business Partner through CVI — BP roles and groupings, number ranges, field mapping, the CVI Cockpit and synchronisation, the usual tax and bank data errors, and their impact on procure\-to\-pay. **Data migration:** field and value mapping, SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit (staging tables), BAPI and IDoc\-based loads, load order driven by master data dependencies, error\-log analysis, validation before the load, and a reconciliation you can show — including mapping from Oracle or another ERP where fields have no direct target. **Client\-facing:** run workshops with procurement, inventory, maintenance and plant owners; present design decisions, trade\-offs and risks to business and technical stakeholders; hold the scope boundary and say no in a way that keeps the relationship; get decisions recorded and signed off. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 10\+ years in SAP MM configuration, used in the last 2 to 3 years. * 2\+ full data migration lifecycles to SAP S/4HANA (from SAP ECC, Oracle or another ERP) with functional ownership of MM data objects — mapping, validation and sign\-off, not only process or configuration roles. * Several mock loads or dress rehearsals, with data defects resolved across cycles, and at least one production cutover. * Hands\-on CVI: supplier conversion to Business Partner on at least one SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA migration. * A CV with named engagements: client, year and your own deliverable. * One concrete case of AI or automation in your own SAP work: the task, the tool and the result. Drafting documents with a chatbot does not count. * Experience delivering to large enterprise clients in a distributed team, with strong written discipline. * Based in the United States. * Fluent English. * Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Maintenance and project procurement: MRO and spare parts, reservations, and MM–PM and MM–PS integration. * Experience in utilities or another asset\-intensive industry. * Migration and cleansing tools such as SAP Data Services, Syniti or SNP. * SQL or basic ABAP literacy, to run reconciliation queries and read table structures. * SAP MDG for supplier and material data. * Central procurement on SAP S/4HANA. * More than one SAP S/4HANA transition path: greenfield, brownfield or selective data transition. * Work in regulated or audit\-heavy environments (SOX). * SAP S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement certification. *No third party may recruit, solicit candidates, publish job opportunities, use Tessera Labs' name or branding, or represent that they are acting on behalf of Tessera Labs without prior written authorization. Any such activity conducted without explicit written consent is strictly prohibited.* Compensation Range: $170K \- $220K
