modularization to improve scalability, observability, and developer velocity. * Define and own the entire lifecycle of your systems: API design, data modeling, deployment (CI/CD), live\-traffic monitoring, integration and load testing, telemetry \& data analysis, experiment design (A/B tests), and continuous iteration. * Influence and evolve our architecture: propose and lead initiatives to decompose monoliths, migrate legacy code, build shared frameworks and reusable service components; evaluate new backend technologies and lead their adoption. * Apply AI\-driven tools and automation frameworks to speed up development, code analysis, testing, and reliability. * Leverage intelligent telemetry, analytics, and optimization pipelines to improve service performance and resilience. * Define observability standards, telemetry pipelines, and fault\-tolerance strategies for production\-grade distributed systems. * Partner closely with product, mobile, and data teams to deliver seamless, high\-quality experiences across all platforms. * Drive technical discussions, mentor developers, and influence strategic direction across backend and infrastructure domains. ### **Who You Are** * A technical leader with the ability to create and lead roadmaps/initiatives that align to high\-level business objectives. * Deep expertise in Go, with additional experience in PHP for legacy systems is a bonus * Proven track record of architecting modular, maintainable, and high\-performance microservices. * Strong background in system design, observability, and performance optimization. systems that serve millions of users. * You architect for observability, reliability, and production\-readiness: you understand instrumentation, SLOs/SLIs, fault\-tolerance, runbooks, incident triage, scalable telemetry pipelines, and production diagnostics for backend systems. * You have been a technical leader (not just an individual contributor): you've influenced roadmap decisions, contributed to multi\-team initiatives, mentored/led developers, driven culture/process improvements, and interfaced with senior developer/product leadership. **Base Salary Range** The expected base salary range and Gold data layers to separate raw source data, standardized and cleansed data, and business\-ready analytical data. * Develop robust transformation processes for data cleansing, validation, documentation, problem\-solving, communication, and cross\-functional teamwork skills.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data & AI Tools
jobs.description: **About Tires\-Easy** Every day, Tires\-Easy ships more than 10,000 tires across the United States, changing how people shop for tires and reshaping the $60B replacement tire market through a faster, smarter approach to automotive e\-commerce. We pair deep coverage of top\-name and budget\-friendly brands with a nationwide drop\-ship network, and we use technology, automation, and AI to make every step faster and easier for our customers. Our leadership team comes from outside traditional tire retail, and it shows. We operate in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment with a strong emphasis on operational excellence, accountability, and disciplined growth. Decisions take days, not quarters. We’re building a team that owns results, sees its impact quickly, and drives execution at scale. If you’re curious, action\-oriented, and ready to help build a fast\-growing business, apply now. **About the role** ------------------ Build the software that connects Tires Easy’s existing data sources to employees and AI assistants. You'll own the semantic layer, supporting services, and internal tools that help teams answer business questions, build reports, and automate recurring work. You'll also define and roll out our internal knowledge platform, exploring document retrieval, enterprise search, and knowledge graphs to determine what best serves users. You'll shape the roadmap with business owners and see your work used across the company. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role with no direct reports. You'll report to the VP of Technology, who leads Data, AI, Infrastructure, and IT. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * Own the semantic software layer: data models, measures, caching, and the implementation of agreed business metrics * Define metrics with business owners, obtain their approval, and reconcile implementations against source systems and existing reports * Build regression tests that detect unintended changes to metric logic using controlled test data and approved expectations * Build and operate services, APIs, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that connect users and AI assistants to approved data, with authentication, access controls, and performance monitoring * Build AI skills and agent workflows that automate recurring business processes, with evaluations and appropriate human review * Connect existing warehouse and business\-system data to end users through the semantic layer and application services; partner with infrastructure and data engineers who deliver the underlying data * Write and optimize SQL for data consumption, and collaborate with data engineers on the models your services need * Train and support users, document workflows, and use feedback and adoption data to prioritize improvements * Evaluate, build, and roll out knowledge retrieval and search capabilities, preserving source permissions and measuring answer quality * Use coding agents throughout delivery while maintaining engineering standards for architecture, testing, security, code review, and production support **What success looks like in the first six months** --------------------------------------------------- * Deliver an agreed set of business metrics with owner\-approved definitions, reconciled results, and automated regression tests * Roll out a priority AI workflow that business teams adopt, and measure its effect on recurring manual work * Evaluate knowledge\-platform approaches and launch an initial capability with permission\-aware retrieval and documented quality checks **Eligibility requirements** ---------------------------- * At least 50% overlap with Pacific Time working hours * Available for occasional after\-hours support for production incidents * Fluent in speaking, reading, and writing English * Reliable high\-speed internet access for remote work **Skills \& experience** ------------------------ * Substantial professional software engineering experience, typically 7\+ years, including delivery of data products or internal tools used by business teams * 5\+ years of Python experience * 5\+ years of deploying applications on AWS * Strong agentic coding skills: break problems into tasks, guide coding agents, review changes, diagnose failures, and verify production behavior. We value demonstrated delivery and judgment over expertise in a particular language * Strong SQL and relational data modeling skills, with the ability to investigate query performance and reconcile results * Experience translating business definitions into reusable data models and tested metrics; semantic\-layer experience is valuable * Strong software engineering fundamentals: service and API design, debugging, testing, and the ability to work across languages and unfamiliar codebases * Hands\-on experience building LLM applications with tool use and structured data access, and evaluating their reliability and output quality * Testing discipline across software and data, including automated regression tests in CI * Able to work directly with business leaders, turn ambiguous questions into precise definitions, and explain results clearly * Independent and self\-motivated, with the ability to take a tool from an unclear need through rollout and ongoing support * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience **Nice to have** ---------------- * Semantic platforms such as Cube, dbt Semantic Layer, or LookML, and Power BI data models or DAX * Retrieval\-augmented generation, enterprise search, knowledge graphs, or knowledge\-base systems * Docker and AWS * E\-commerce, retail, supply chain, or pricing background **The pay range for this role is:** 150,000 \- 200,000 USD per year(El Segundo, CA)

jobs.title: Growth Engineer
jobs.description: **About Tolmo** --------------- Tolmo is cybersecurity for the age of AI. Coding agents now ship software faster than any human team can review or secure it; 100\+ pull requests per engineer per week is no longer an outlier, and attackers are using the same agents to find and exploit weaknesses in days, not months. The old playbook of quarterly pentests and endless alert queues breaks at this speed. We're building a new security playbook. Tolmo runs a fleet of AI security agents that reason over a live graph of your entire production system (code, CI, cloud, and telemetry) and continuously attack a faithful copy of it like a real adversary. Every finding arrives validated, with its blast radius and a remediation plan that lands in your workflow, ready for a coding agent to fix. Hours to integrate, days to your first validated finding. We've done this before: Tolmo's founders built Sqreen (acquired by Datadog) and led security products that thousands of organizations trusted. We're backed by Accel and Y Combinator and just getting started. **The role** ------------ Most growth teams wait on engineering. Here, you are the engineering. As our Growth Engineer, you build the machine that turns curious engineers and security leaders into customers: the website, the signup and onboarding funnel, lead capture, attribution, and the agents and automations that give a small marketing team far more reach than its size suggests. You'll sit between marketing, product, and sales, work directly with the founders, and ship to production every week. **Show us, don't tell us: send something you built that grew, whether a site, a tool, an experiment, or a side project. It's the first thing we'll look at.** **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Own tolmo.com:** performance, SEO, experiments, and the pages and interactive tools that go out with every launch and campaign. * **Build the funnel:** from first visit to first validated finding, including signup, onboarding, activation, and the moments that turn a trial into a deal. * **Run the experiment loop:** place small bets every week, test them properly, and keep a written log of what we learned. * **Own the data plumbing:** event tracking, attribution, product analytics, and the pipes from the website and product into the CRM, with privacy and consent built in from the start. * **Automate the busywork:** AI agents for account research, personalized outreach, content repurposing, and reporting, so people spend their time on the work only people can do. * **Ship free tools people share:** scanners, checklists, and calculators that are useful on their own and bring the right people to us. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * Engineer first: 4\+ years shipping production software, strong TypeScript, and comfort across front end, APIs, and data. * You've owned growth outcomes, not just tickets: signups, activation, conversion, or pipeline you moved and can show us. * Fluency with product analytics and experimentation tools (e.g., PostHog, Amplitude, Segment), and the statistics to read results honestly. * You build with AI coding agents daily (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor), and you've replaced at least one recurring chore with a script or an agent. * Product taste and an ear for copy: you notice when a page, a form, or an email is off, and you fix it. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience at a developer tools, security, or infrastructure company with a product\-led motion. * SEO and programmatic content at scale. * Hands\-on with CRM and go\-to\-market tooling (e.g., Attio, HubSpot, Clay). * Something you built on the side that people actually use. **Compensation \& benefits** ---------------------------- * **Competitive salary**, depending on level and experience. * **Early\-stage equity:** you're joining early; you'll own a real piece of what we build. * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, and the equipment you need to do your best work. * Based in San Francisco; we work in person. *Tolmo is building a team with wide\-ranging backgrounds, perspectives, and paths into security; we think it makes our product and judgment better. If you're excited about this role but don't match every point above, we'd still like to hear from you. We're an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants of every background.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Build Innovative Technology. Make an Impact. Grow Your Career.** **TouchTronics, Inc. \| Elkhart, Indiana** **$75,000–$85,000 Annually \| Full\-Time \| On\-Site \| FLSA Exempt** **Your Next Career Opportunity Starts Here!** --------------------------------------------- Are you passionate about technology, solving complex challenges, and creating innovative software solutions? **TouchTronics, Inc. is seeking a talented and motivated Software Engineer to join our engineering team!** At TouchTronics, great ideas become real\-world technology. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** Trailhead Biosystems merges developmental biology with computerized experimental design to develop novel iPSC research products. Trailhead Biosystems is the pioneer of High\-Dimensional Design\-of\-Experiment (HD\-DoE®), a powerful platform that differentiates human induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) into virtually any desired cell type with unparalleled precision and efficiency. We are moving beyond traditional trial\-and\-error methods by implementing Quality by Design (QbD) principles and utilizing DoE combined with Multivariate Data Analysis (MVDA). We are seeking a forward\-thinking AI Engineer to join our R\&D team and help build the intelligent systems that drive our cellular engineering workflows. **Why Join Us?** As an AI Engineer at Trailhead, you will not just be managing data; you will be part of a team that is revolutionizing how we explore cell biology, using intelligent systems to direct human iPSC differentiation with unprecedented reproducibility and accuracy * Generate Computer\-Based Experimental Designs: Drive advanced cell culture workflows through AI\-supported design, drastically reducing the time and number of experiments needed for optimization. * Model Biological Complexity: Mathematically model the effector/response space to perform virtual experiments, allowing us to predict how specific additives will create desirable cell culture fates before physical testing. * Decipher Gene Expression: Gain deep knowledge into how culture conditions affect gene expression, addressing complex optimization challenges regarding cell purity and potency. * Master Manufacturing Variance: Use data\-driven insights to understand and control variance in cell manufacturing methods, ensuring consistent, high\-quality outcomes. **The Role** As an AI Engineer, you will be instrumental in deploying Agentic AI frameworks that can reason, plan, and execute complex scientific tasks. You will build autonomous multi\-agent systems capable of analyzing proprietary biological data, managing knowledge graphs, and optimizing experiments. Working within a robust Azure cloud architecture, you will turn research concepts into production\-grade tools that empower our scientists to work faster and smarter. **Responsibilities** * Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with research scientists, biologists, and product managers to translate complex scientific challenges into actionable technical requirements and scalable AI solutions. * Develop Agentic AI Solutions: Design and build autonomous AI agents that leverage our proprietary biological datasets to automate complex analytical workflows, from experimental design to data interpretation. * Fine\-Tune Domain\-Specific Models: Fine\-tune open\-weights models (e.g., Llama, Mistral) on our proprietary biological datasets to create specialized models capable of understanding cell differentiation pathways and effector\-response relationships. * Proprietary Data Architecture \& UI: Architect, build and maintain a secure proprietary database and automated data ingestion pipelines (ETL/ELT), while developing intuitive user\-friendly interfaces and APIs that help scientists to easily query, visualize, and interact with our proprietary data. * Build \& Maintain Knowledge Graphs: Integrate GenAI models with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j) to map complex relationships between cell lines, reagents, and genetic markers, enabling the AI to perform deep reasoning over structured biological data. * Orchestrate Multi\-Agent Systems: Design and implement sophisticated multi\-model, multi\-agent architectures using state\-of\-the\-art frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or CrewAI. Your systems will coordinate multiple specialized agents to solve multi\-step problems collaboratively. * Production Deployment on Azure: Lead the deployment of AI solutions into a secure Azure cloud environment. You will be responsible for setting up monitoring, ensuring observability (logging, tracing), and managing the lifecycle of models using MLOps best practices (e.g., Azure Machine Learning, MLflow). * RAG \& Information Retrieval: Implement Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to ground Large Language Models (LLMs) in our internal scientific corpus, ensuring high accuracy and reduced hallucinations in technical outputs. * Evaluation \& Benchmarking: Design, implement, and own automated LLM evaluation frameworks and benchmarking suites to quantify model accuracy, reliability, and business impact. * Guardrails \& Quality Assurance \& Policy Making: Establish and maintain robust guardrails, observability, and quality gates to mitigate hallucinations, ensure AI safety, and prevent jailbreaking. Help build policies, governance, and procedures. * Documentation: Create and maintain clear technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and runbooks to ensure system reproducibility and facilitate team knowledge sharing. * Ownership: Own end\-to\-end model performance and reliability across different systems, including continuous monitoring, logging, and regression testing. **Qualifications \& Requirements** Education: * Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computational Biology or a related quantitative field. Experience: * 3\-5 years of professional experience in software engineering with a dedicated focus on AI/ML. * 2\+ years of experience developing agentic AI systems and RAG pipelines using large language models, bringing prototypes through to scalable production. Technical Skills: * Agentic Frameworks: Strong proficiency with orchestration frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Microsoft Semantic Kernel, or AutoGen. Experience building agents that utilize tool calling and function execution is essential. * Programming: Expert\-level fluency in Python and familiarity with modern software development practices (CI/CD, Git, containerization with Docker/Kubernetes). * Cloud Architecture: Demonstrated experience deploying scalable applications on Microsoft Azure. Familiarity with Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, and Azure Functions is highly preferred. * Data Engineering \& Knowledge Graphs: Experience designing schemas and querying graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, RDF/SPARQL) and working with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus). * MLOps: Practical knowledge of model monitoring, evaluation frameworks (e.g., Ragas, LangSmith), and deploying models via REST APIs (FastAPI). Soft Skills: * Ability to translate complex technical concepts for cross\-functional teams, including biologists and lab scientists. * Strong problem\-solving skills with a "builder" mindset, you enjoy taking projects from prototype to production. * Collaborative spirit with a desire to work in a fast\-paced, research\-driven environment. Nice to Have: * Experience in biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or healthcare sectors. * Familiarity with biological data standards or bioinformatics workflows. Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: About the Team The Uber Eats Delivery Search team builds large\-scale machine learning systems that help consumers discover relevant merchants, products, and items across Uber Eats. We are transforming Search through two major initiatives: Search as an LLM (SaaL), evolving traditional retrieval and ranking into an LLM\-native Search architecture, and Whole\-Page Quality, developing AI\-powered evaluation and diagnostic capabilities to systematically identify customer\-facing defects and improve end\-to\-end Search experiences. Our team tackles challenging ML problems spanning large language model training and optimization (CPT, SFT, RL), semantic retrieval, generative Search, model evaluation, and production ML systems at Uber scale. Role \& Responsibilities As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on the Delivery Search team, you will design, develop, and deploy ML solutions that power next\-generation Search experiences. Specifically, you will: * LLM Training \& Optimization: Develop, train, and optimize large language models for Search using continued pretraining (CPT), supervised fine\-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning (RL), and advanced model optimization techniques. * Search Relevance \& Semantic Understanding: Build and improve ML models for semantic retrieval, ranking, and catalog understanding to deliver relevant, personalized, and context\-aware Search results across diverse markets and merchant catalogs. * Whole\-Page Quality \& Evaluation: Develop LLM\-based quality judges, automated evaluation frameworks, and defect detection models to assess end\-to\-end Search experiences, identify recurring quality issues, and drive measurable improvements. * ML Experimentation \& Production Systems: Design scalable model training, evaluation, and inference pipelines; conduct offline and online experiments; and deploy and monitor ML models in production. * Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Independently drive complex ML projects from design through production, partnering with ML Infrastructure, Backend Engineering, Data Science, and Product teams to deliver measurable customer impact. Basic Qualifications * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including hands\-on development and deployment of production ML systems. * Strong proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. * Solid foundation in machine learning, deep learning, algorithms, and scalable software engineering. * Experience developing, training, and evaluating ML models using large\-scale datasets. * Proven ability to independently deliver ML solutions from problem formulation and experimentation through production deployment. * Experience with model evaluation, performance analysis, and offline or online experimentation. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with large language models, generative AI, and training techniques such as CPT, SFT, or RL. * Experience with large\-scale Search, recommendation, information retrieval, or ranking systems. * Familiarity with LLM\-based evaluation, automated quality assessment, or defect detection. * Experience with distributed ML training, inference optimization, or production ML infrastructure. * Demonstrated ability to collaborate across engineering teams, lead technical projects, and mentor other engineers. jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Data Engineering
jobs.description: Software Engineer II \| Global Intelligence, Data Platform About the team Global Intelligence helps Uber understand competitive landscapes and marketplace dynamics across Mobility and Delivery. We partner with scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to transform complex data into trusted insights that inform product, pricing, and marketplace decisions. Our engineering team builds the data foundations behind these insights: integrating external sources, developing scalable data pipelines and models, and creating reusable platform capabilities. We leverage AI to accelerate data integration, improve data understanding, and make our platform easier to operate and use. About the role We’re looking for a Software Engineer II to build reliable, scalable, and intelligent data systems for Global Intelligence. You will take ownership of data platform capabilities from problem definition and technical design through implementation and production operations. Working with engineers, scientists, and product, you’ll navigate incomplete requirements, resolve ambiguity, and translate business and analytical needs into maintainable engineering solutions. This role combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands\-on data engineering. You’ll build ETL/ELT pipelines, design data models and contracts, strengthen data quality, and apply AI to meaningfully improve our workflows and products. What you’ll do * **Drive problems from discovery to production.** Work with stakeholders to clarify ambiguous requirements, identify dependencies, evaluate alternatives, and deliver solutions with measurable impact. * **Design and build ETL/ELT systems.** Develop scalable ingestion and transformation pipelines that integrate heterogeneous external and internal data sources, supporting incremental processing, orchestration, backfills, and recovery. * **Develop durable data models.** Define dataset grain, keys, relationships, and historical behavior, build reusable models that support analytical, scientific, and downstream product needs. * **Establish data contracts.** Define and maintain expectations for schemas, semantics, freshness, completeness, and compatibility. Manage schema evolution and changes across producers and consumers. * **Build quality into the platform.** Implement validation, reconciliation, automated testing, and observability to detect missing, duplicated, delayed, or inconsistent data before it affects downstream decisions. * **Apply system\-design judgment.** Make thoughtful tradeoffs across correctness, scalability, reliability, latency, cost, and maintainability. Reuse existing infrastructure and develop shared abstractions where appropriate. * **Build with and for AI.** Identify and evaluate opportunities to use AI for workflows such as schema mapping, data extraction, quality investigation, and developer productivity. Build the validation, evaluation, and safeguards needed to make these capabilities dependable. * **Own production outcomes.** Monitor pipeline health and data reliability, troubleshoot incidents, address root causes, and improve operational tooling and documentation. * **Collaborate and raise engineering quality.** Contribute to code reviews and design discussions, share knowledge, and improve the maintainability and usability of the systems you support. and maintainable. **Key Duties and Responsibilities** * **Build and Integrate** * Design, build, test, and maintain features across our Salesforce and AWS\-based applications. * Build integrations and APIs that exchange data securely with partner systems. * Build data pipelines and reports that help programs track and measure their work. * **Cloud and Quality** * Build cloud services using infrastructure as code, designed to stay portable across providers. * Keep each partner organization's data separate, secure, and auditable. * Write automated tests, take part in code review, and automate deployments. * Monitor and improve reliability, performance, and cost. * **Working With Agents and People** * Direct AI agents through design, coding, and testing, and own every change that reaches production. * Contribute to architecture discussions and technical decisions. * Work with the Product Manager and program teams to understand needs and support partner onboarding. * Document This role provides the opportunity to cultivate software development skills in a higher education environment. **About** **UTS**: **University Technology Services (****UTS****)**, the central IT service provider for the University of Utah, reports to the U’s **Chief Information Officer** and is responsible for many of the U’s shared IT services including the wired and wireless network; Campus Information Services (CIS) portal; UMail, telephone, and online collaboration; digital learning technologies; information security; software licensing; and a host of other IT systems and services. **About the University of Utah**: Located in Salt Lake City, the U is the flagship institution of the State of Utah’s system of higher education, home to **arts and museum venues** and a member of the **BIG****\-12 Conference**. **Skiing and snowboarding opportunities** are a short distance from campus, and opportunities to pursue activities from **biking to hiking to fishing abound**. Salt Lake City is home to the **Utah Symphony and Opera**, **Ballet West**, **professional sports teams**, and a wide range of other cultural and recreational activities. **Responsibilities** **Web Developers (Full Stack), I** Utilize server\-side (e.g., Node.js, Typescript, Python), client\-side (e.g., HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React), and database (e.g., PostgreSQL, MongoDB) tools to create websites from concept to finished product (front\-end and back\-end). Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand needs and translate into technical requirements. Possess functional knowledge of all layers of computer software development. Proficiency in server, network, and hosting environments, relational and non\-relational databases, how to interact with APIs, user interface/experience, quality assurance, version control systems, and security. Work closely with other engineers, designers, and leadership to build, test, and deploy new features and products, creating the most effective and efficient web applications with well\-documented code. Create tools that enhance how users see and interact with the site, taking into consideration accessibility, usability, multi\-browser compatibility and performance. Implement security and data protection and monitor and reduce cyber security risk. Requires basic skill set and proficiency. Conducts work assignments as directed. Job Code: P34851 Grade: P16 **Minimum Qualifications** **EQUIVALENCY****STATEMENT****:** 1 year of higher education can be substituted for 1 year of directly related work experience (Example: bachelor’s degree \= 4 years of directly related work experience). **Web Developers (Full Stack), I:** Requires a bachelor’s (or equivalency) \+ 2 years of directly related work experience or a master’s (or equivalency) degree. **Preferences** Prior knowledge of or experience with AWS preferred. Strong collaboration and communication skills. Preferred degree in computer science or IT. **Type** Benefited Staff **Special Instructions Summary** **Additional Information** The University is a participating employer with Utah Retirement Systems (“URS”). Eligible new hires with prior URS service, may elect to enroll in URS if they make the election before they become eligible for retirement (usually the first day of work). Contact Human Resources at (801\) 581\-7447 for information. jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: About the Company Unstuck Labs is an Arlington, Virginia\-based venture studio and software development company founded in 2017\. The company helps startups, businesses, and government organizations build modern digital products. Its areas of expertise include custom software development, web and mobile applications, artificial intelligence, cloud solutions, and product development. Job Description Unstuck Labs is seeking a motivated Full Stack Developer to help build, enhance, and maintain modern web applications and software products. The ideal candidate will have experience working with frontend and backend technologies, developing APIs, managing databases, and delivering scalable software solutions. Key Responsibilities * Design, develop, and maintain full\-stack web applications. * Build responsive user interfaces using React and TypeScript. * Develop backend services, APIs, and database integrations. * Write clean, reusable, and maintainable code. * Collaborate with product designers and engineering teams. * Troubleshoot application issues and improve system performance. * Participate in code reviews, testing, and deployment activities. * Support the development of AI\-powered software features. * Contribute to application architecture and technical improvements. Requirements * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, or similar technologies. * Understanding of backend development and RESTful APIs. * Knowledge of databases and server\-side application development. * Familiarity with Git and software development workflows. * Strong problem\-solving and communication skills. * Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced development environment. Preferred Skills * Experience with Node.js and modern frontend frameworks. * Familiarity with cloud platforms and deployment processes. * Knowledge of AI integration and automation tools. * Experience with startup environments or product development. * Understanding of Agile development practices. Benefits Potential benefits may include health insurance, paid time off, professional development, flexible working arrangements, and opportunities to work on innovative software projects. Actual benefits depend on the employer's policies and offer. Pay: $85,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Relocation assistance * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, LLM
jobs.description: **About Upstart** At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence. As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress. We’re proudly digital\-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80\+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital\-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in\-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in\-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you. If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you. **The Team:** At Upstart, our Applied AI team's mission is threefold: * **Agent Platform:** Build and support the platform that makes it straightforward for non technical users across Upstart to build, launch, and operate AI agents (voice/chat/text) reliably. * **Borrower and Applicant Assistant Orchestration:** Build the orchestration layer behind a unified personal assistant that shares context across specialized agents, giving applicants and borrowers a cohesive, assistant\-like experience. * **Borrower\-Connected Internal Workflows:** Improve internal operational workflows that directly connect to applicant and borrower experiences, making them faster, smarter, and more efficient. As **Principal Engineer, LLM** you will serve as a technical pathfinder and force multiplier for this team and the product squads we partner with. Rather than owning internal developer\-tooling infrastructure or training foundation models from scratch, your mandate is to compress the time between an ambiguous idea and a reliable, user\-facing AI system, while raising the applied AI bar across every squad you touch. This role operates on an explicit **80/20 charter**: * **0\-to\-1 Product and Architecture Pathfinder (\~80%):** Rapidly prototype high\-ambiguity bets across our agent platform, cross\-agent context orchestration, borrower\-facing assistant experiences, and internal workflows. Partner directly with Product and Design to validate non\-deterministic UX, establish clean architectural patterns, and hand off battle\-tested evaluation contracts for engineering squads to scale. * **AI\-Native Engineering Catalyst (\~20%):** While dedicated internal teams own Upstart's broader AI developer tooling and software\-factory initiatives, you will serve as a visible practitioner on the product side. You will lead by example with agentic coding workflows and tight verification harnesses, partner with our internal tooling teams as an early adopter ("customer zero"), and help product squads adopt higher\-leverage ways of working. Because AI systems are non\-deterministic, user experience is part of the architecture. Whether you are designing cross\-agent handoffs, borrower\-facing assistant flows, or internal operational tools, you will navigate real\-world trade\-offs across latency, unit economics, reliability, and user trust, and push back constructively when a simpler deterministic approach is the right call. **How you’ll make an impact** * **De\-risk 0\-to\-1 bets across the stack:** Rapidly prototype ambiguous initiatives spanning multi\-agent context sharing, UX for non technical users, platform primitives for launching agents, and borrower\-connected internal workflows. * **Deliver durable evaluation contracts, not throwaway handoffs:** Treat prototype code as disposable proof of concept, and hand off to engineers what they actually need to build production services with confidence: golden datasets, automated evaluation harnesses, documented failure\-mode maps, latency/cost benchmarks, and clean architectural blueprints. * **Partner cleanly from spike to production:** Align early with receiving squad tech leads to surface system constraints, support joint go/no\-go decisions with Engineering and Product leadership (including killing unviable bets early), and stay engaged through initial productionization to review early PRs and debug edge\-case model behavior. * **Design non\-deterministic n, and user trust are critical. **Position location** This role is available in the following locations: Remote **Time zone requirements** The team operates on the East/West coast time zones. **Travel requirements** As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in\-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in\-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2\-4 consecutive days at a time. At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k). United States \| Remote \- Anticipated Base Salary Range $238,400—$330,200 USD **What you'll love** At Upstart, our benefits for full\-time employees are designed to support your health, financial well\-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect: * Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly * Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada) * Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only) * Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada. * Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only) * Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security * Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements * Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country) * Family\-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life\-centered resources * Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only) * Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well\-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you * Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from * Connection and community through team events, all\-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs) * Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro\-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec. Upstart is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Just as we are dedicated to improving access to affordable credit for all, we are committed to inclusive and fair hiring practices. *If you require reasonable accommodation in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please email candidate\_accommodations@upstart.com* https://www.upstart.com/candidate\_privacy\_policy

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About WSI Technologies** WSI Technologies equips public safety and child advocacy professionals with mission\-critical tools for recording, managing and sharing interviews. Child advocacy centers, law enforcement agencies, prosecutors and health departments use our products in rooms where the recording may end up in court. Reliability, security and usability are non\-negotiable. ### **About the role** We're a small team and this is the most senior engineering seat on it. We're leaning harder into AI\-assisted development and tightening up our architecture, and we need an experienced backend engineer to lead both. You should be strong on the fundamentals (API design, databases, cloud infrastructure, security, performance), because you'll be making those calls every day. You're excited about how AI is changing the way software ships. You already use tools like Claude Code, OpenAI Codex or Gemini CLI to move faster, and you care that what they produce actually works. We want to merge a change and know it's tested, deployed and reversible without anyone holding their breath. Getting us there is the first six months of the job. You'll report to our VP of Technology and Operations, who sets product direction and still ships code. You'll direct a contract development team day to day. ### **What we expect you to challenge** We already know these could be better. You'll find more. * Too many manual steps between merging a change and seeing it in production. * Rolling a database change out to every customer safely. * How the platform performs and scales in production. * How much we trust code an AI agent wrote, and what we check before it ships. ### **What you'll own** **Architecture and code** * The architecture of the cloud platform, and the reasoning behind it. * Hands\-on development and code review. You write production code every week. * Technical lead on our next major product area and on our AI features. **Path to production** * Build, test and release pipelines from pull request to production, with rollback. * Schema changes and data migrations that roll out to every customer safely. **Azure production** * Production in Azure: access and identity, monitoring that catches problems before customers do, cost and incident response. * Reliability, performance and scale as customers and recordings grow. **Team** * How the team uses AI coding agents, and what has to be true before their code ships. * Day\-to\-day technical direction for a contract development and QA team. * Final technical escalation for the cloud platform and its integrations. ### **The stack you'll work in** * **Cloud platform (your focus):** C\# and ASP.NET Core, SQL Server with Entity Framework Core, and a TypeScript front end, hosted on Microsoft Azure. * **AI features:** transcription, speaker identification, translation and summaries. * **Build and test:** Azure DevOps, GitHub, and automated unit and end\-to\-end tests. * **Operations tooling:** PowerShell, Python and .NET. * **Also in the product family:** an on\-premises recording platform and a Windows tablet app. You won't lead these, but the cloud platform syncs with them. ### **What you bring** **Required** * Curiosity. A mindset to figure it out. You dig until you understand why, and you fix the cause, not the symptom. * 4\+ years building production software, including recent hands\-on work as a lead developer or architect. * Strong C\# and ASP.NET Core, and SQL Server with Entity Framework Core. * Hands\-on Azure: compute, data, messaging, storage, identity and networking. You have run production there, not only deployed to it. * Daily, practical use of AI coding agents, and a clear view of where they need guardrails. * You have built release pipelines and automated test gates that a team trusted enough to deploy on. * Experience leading other developers' work through design and code review. * Clear writing. A design, a root\-cause summary and a runbook are all part of the job. * Authorization to work in the US, and the ability to pass the fingerprint\-based background check some of our customers require. **Highly preferred** * Infrastructure as code with Bicep or Terraform. * Media processing: video, audio or speech\-to\-text. * Multi\-tenant SaaS data design and migrations. * Customers in public safety, government, healthcare or another regulated field, plus familiarity with CJIS, HIPAA or SOC 2\. * Experience working with an offshore or contract development team. **What this role is not** * It isn't product management. Roadmap and priorities are set for you. You decide how the work gets built. * It isn't a management\-only role. You write code. * It isn't a field role. Installs and on\-site customer work belong to other teams. * It doesn't run the compliance program. That runs with outside assessors. You supply the engineering controls and the evidence. ### **What's in it for you** * **High impact:** your work is used every day in public safety and child advocacy. * **Real ownership:** the platform's architecture and its path to production are yours. * **Growth:** exposure to the wider Valsoft and Fluent Software Group portfolio. * **Benefits:** competitive pay, health benefits and flexible time off If you're unsure whether to apply, apply. Nobody checks every box. What matters is that you learn fast and want to own the outcome. *We use AI\-powered tools (including transcription and automated note\-taking) during portions of our interview process to support a consistent and thorough candidate experience. Candidates who require alternative accommodation may request it at any stage of the recruitment process.* *Fluent Software Group is committed to building diverse, equitable, and inclusive teams. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences, and all qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, gender, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.* *Employment is contingent on a background check and pre\-employment drug screen.* \#WSI

jobs.description: Key Functions and Expected Performance: Within VIPER, the primary responsibilities will be to contribute to and help maintain core software infrastructure for pulsar timing array (PTA) and Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA) gravitational\-wave data analysis, and to support projects across the broader Astronomy Group. The research software engineer will: * Develop, maintain, and extend inference pipelines for PTA and LISA data analysis. * Contribute to simulation\-based inference and neural posterior estimation pipelines for gravitational\-wave parameter estimation. * Support software efforts across the Astronomy Group, including time\-domain and multi\-messenger data pipelines. * Communicate and help establish open\-source software best practices, including version control, testing, code review, and documentation. * Interact with collaborators across VIPER, the Astronomy Group, and external collaborations such as NANOGrav, the International Pulsar Timing Array (IPTA), and the LISA Consortium. * Provide software and computing strategy input to support grant proposals and funding applications led by VIPER and Astronomy Group faculty. * Help evaluate and establish responsible practices for AI/LLM\-assisted software development within the group. There will also be opportunities for on\-going skill development in software engineering and scientific computing, including mentoring from faculty and senior researchers, and support for attending relevant tutorials, workshops, and conferences (e.g., SciPy, PyAstro, NANOGrav/IPTA meetings). The research software engineer will join a growing community of graduate students, postdocs, and faculty across VIPER and the Astronomy Group. **Qualifications** At least 3 years of experience with software development in a research or research\-supporting context, including: * Experience doing software development in a research environment (including academic contexts such as graduate school or postdoctoral appointments, or research\-oriented industry). * Experience with the scientific Python ecosystem (NumPy, SciPy, Matplotlib, etc.). * Experience with collaborative version control systems (especially Git and GitHub). * Experience with collaborative software engineering practices, including coding standards and code review. * Experience writing documentation and supporting user communities. * Experience managing multiple concurrent projects. * Technical and scientific curiosity with a collaborative attitude. *Preferred Qualifications* * Proficiency with a compiled language (C, C\+\+, Rust, Cython, Fortran, etc.) * Experience with Bayesian inference and MCMC or nested\-sampling methods. * Experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g., JAX, PyTorch) and/or simulation * based inference. * Experience with HPC, GPU computing, and/or code profiling and optimization. * Working knowledge of applied mathematics and numerical methods. * Working knowledge of astrophysics, particularly gravitational\-wave or pulsar\-timing * science. * Experience querying and transforming data in databases and common astronomical * file eformats (e.g., FITS, HDF5\).

jobs.title: Manager, IT Security
jobs.description: **Position summary** ==================== Velocity Clinical Research is creating a dedicated IT Security department, and this role is its founding leader. The Manager, IT Security will design, stand up and run the company's information security program from the ground up, turning today's distributed security activities into a single, accountable function with clear strategy, policy, operations and reporting. The successful candidate is a hands\-on builder who is equally comfortable writing a security strategy for the executive team, triaging an alert at 2 a.m., and walking a site coordinator through a phishing simulation. Because Velocity operates clinical research sites that handle patient health information and regulated trial data for sponsors, this leader must balance strong protection with the practical realities of a fast\-moving, multi\-site clinical operation. The role partners closely with Enterprise IT, Legal, Quality, Human Resources and site operations, and serves as the company's primary point of contact on information security matters for sponsors, auditors **Core competencies** ===================== **Builder mindset:** comfortable creating structure, process and teams where little exists, and prioritizing ruthlessly with limited resources.**Risk\-based judgment:** makes pragmatic decisions that protect patients, data and the business without slowing clinical operations unnecessarily.**Influence and partnership:** earns trust across IT, operations, research sites and executive leadership, and drives change without relying on authority alone.**Calm under pressure:** leads clearly and decisively during security incidents.**Integrity and discretion:** handles sensitive information and situations with the highest professional standards.**Key responsibilities** ======================== **Security strategy, governance and leadership** ------------------------------------------------ * Define the mission, charter, operating model and organizational structure of the IT Security department. * Develop and maintain the information security strategy and multi\-year roadmap aligned with business objectives and risk appetite. * Select and implement a control framework (for example NIST CSF 2\.0, ISO/IEC 27001 or CIS Controls) and measure maturity against it. * Author, publish and maintain security policies, standards and procedures, and run the exception process. * Report program status, key risks and metrics to the CIO, executive leadership and, as requested, the Board. * Assist with the management of the department budget, including tools, services and staffing. **Team building and talent** ---------------------------- * Build the hiring plan and recruit the department's analyst and/or engineer. * Evaluate and manage managed security service providers (MSSP, MDR or SOC\-as\-a\-service) where they are the right fit. * Coach and develop team members, set goals and create a culture of accountability and continuous learning. **Security operations and incident response** --------------------------------------------- * Establish 24x7 security monitoring and alerting, whether in\-house, outsourced or hybrid. * Create and own the incident response plan and playbooks, lead investigations, and coordinate containment, recovery and post\-incident review. * Run tabletop exercises with IT, Legal, Compliance, Communications and executive leadership. * Coordinate with Legal and Privacy on breach assessment and regulatory or sponsor notifications. **Vulnerability, endpoint and infrastructure security** ------------------------------------------------------- * Stand up a vulnerability management program covering servers, endpoints, cloud services, network and applications, with risk\-based remediation timelines. * Partner with Enterprise IT on secure configuration baselines, patching, endpoint protection and network segmentation across corporate offices and research sites. * Commission and manage penetration tests and remediation tracking. **Identity, access and data protection** ---------------------------------------- * Strengthen identity and access management, including multi\-factor authentication, privileged access, conditional access and periodic access reviews. * Lead data classification and data loss prevention for patient health information, personal data and sponsor\-confidential trial data. * Ensure encryption, backup and recovery controls protect critical systems and data. **Risk, compliance and audit** ------------------------------ * Maintain the information security risk register and lead periodic risk assessments. * Ensure security controls support the applicable HIPAA Security Rule obligations, FDA 21 CFR Part 11 expectations for computerized systems, Good Clinical Practice data integrity requirements, and applicable state and international privacy laws. * Serve as the security lead for sponsor audits, security questionnaires, customer due diligence and external assessments. * Partner with Quality and Compliance on validated systems, change control and audit readiness. **Third\-party and vendor risk** -------------------------------- * Build a third\-party risk management process for vendors that handle company, patient or sponsor data, including technology platforms used in trial conduct. * Review security terms in contracts and business associate agreements with Legal and Finance. **Secure architecture and acquisitions** ---------------------------------------- * Embed security requirements into technology selection, architecture reviews, change management and the software release process, working closely with application development staff. * Lead security due diligence and integration for newly acquired research sites and businesses. **Security awareness and culture** ---------------------------------- * Launch and run a company\-wide security awareness program, including onboarding training, phishing simulations and role\-based training for site staff. * Be a visible, approachable advocate for security across the organization. **Qualifications** ================== **Required** ------------ * Bachelor's degree in information security, computer science, information systems or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8 or more years of progressive information security experience, including at least 2 years leading a security program, team or major security function. * Demonstrated experience building or substantially maturing a security program, ideally in a growing or multi\-site organization. * Hands\-on knowledge of incident response, vulnerability management, security monitoring, identity and access management, and cloud security. * Working knowledge of at least one major control framework (NIST CSF, ISO/IEC 27001, CIS Controls or similar). * Experience in a regulated environment, with a working understanding of HIPAA and data privacy requirements. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain risk in business terms to executives and non\-technical staff. **Preferred** ------------- * Experience in clinical research, life sciences, pharmaceutical, healthcare or another FDA\-regulated industry. * Experience securing Microsoft 365 and Azure environments, including Entra ID, Intune, Defender and Purview. * Experience selecting and managing MSSP or MDR providers. * Experience preparing an organization for SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001 or HITRUST assessment. **Certifications (one or more preferred)** ------------------------------------------ * CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional) * CISM (Certified Information Security Manager) * CISA, CRISC, CCSP or relevant GIAC certifications

jobs.description: * Engineering * San Francisco * Full Time **About Vercel:** ----------------- Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. **About the Role:** ------------------- Vercel started as the home for frontends. The Languages and Runtimes team is making it the home for the rest of the application: APIs, background workers, AI agents, and the services that connect them. This past year we took Python on Vercel to general availability, launched Vercel Services so frontends and backends deploy together as one project, and, alongside our Compute team, helped bring always\-on background workers to the platform. Our work spans the path from source code to a running process: tooling that understands an application’s structure, packages its dependencies, and runs it on Vercel, plus language runtimes, SDKs, private service\-to\-service communication, and production observability. Much of it is making existing applications run efficiently without asking developers to rework them, whether that means taming large dependency sets, cutting cold starts, precompiling Python bytecode at build time, or serving a framework’s static assets straight from the CDN. Next, we’re bringing first\-class support to Go and Rust, from builds and packaging to runtime integration and SDKs, and improving observability so developers can see how their services connect and where requests spend their time. You’ll work across these layers, following problems from a developer’s application down to how it builds and executes. **What You Will Do:** --------------------- * Build and maintain backend services and infrastructure using Python and Rust. * Improve serverless Python execution, including dependency management, runtime behavior, startup performance, and resource efficiency. * Design distributed systems that support reliable deployment and execution of customer applications and AI workloads. * Develop cloud infrastructure and deployment automation using Infrastructure as Code. * Investigate performance bottlenecks and production issues across services, runtimes, and infrastructure. * Partner with engineering and product teams to turn developer needs into reliable platform capabilities. * Own the services you ship, including monitoring, incident response, and participation in an on\-call rotation. **About You:** -------------- * Experience shipping and operating backend software in production, with strong Python skills and practical experience with Rust. * Hands\-on experience with cloud infrastructure, such as AWS, and an understanding of compute, networking, storage, and service deployment. * Familiarity with distributed systems, concurrency, asynchronous execution, and the tradeoffs involved in building reliable services. * Experience with containers, CI/CD, and infrastructure automation tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation. **Compensation \& Benefits:** ----------------------------- * Competitive compensation package, including equity. * Inclusive healthcare package. * Mentorship and opportunities to attend events that build your network and skills. * Flexible time off. * Equipment and a work\-from\-home budget to set up your workspace. jobs.title: Engineer III - Embedded Software
jobs.description: **Who We Are** Vermeer equips customers doing important work around the world. We are global, driven by innovation and growing. The equipment we make manages natural resources, connects people and feeds and fuels communities. We live out a caring culture, we demonstrate agility, we keep a focus on customers and are stewards of our resources. These beliefs drive our culture, determine how we treat others and steer our business. **Work Shift** 1 \- First Shift**Job Summary** Are you passionate about embedded systems and ready to deepen your impact? In this role, you’ll take ownership of moderately to highly complex embedded software development for Vermeer’s intelligent equipment. You’ll collaborate across disciplines, mentor peers, and help shape the evolution of machine control systems that power our off\-highway machinery.**What You’ll Do** 1\. Develop, integrate, test, and debug moderately to highly complex embedded software for Vermeer machine control systems and operator displays. 2\. Coordinate with test technicians, production, and service teams to support the testing, manufacturing, and servicing of embedded systems. 3\. Provide technical direction and informal mentorship to less\-experienced engineers and stakeholders. 4\. Contribute to the definition, analysis, and allocation of software requirements and support the development of machine\-level testing strategies. 5\. Apply model\-based design tools such as MATLAB/Simulink and/or Danfoss Plus\+1 Guide to support control system development. 6\. Support the design and implementation of Human Machine Interface (HMI) and virtual instrument components for embedded applications. 7\. Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of embedded software with mechanical, hydraulic, and electrical systems. **What We’re Looking For** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Agricultural Engineering, or related field with an emphasis in embedded systems, with a minimum 4 years of relevant experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience. * Proficiency in embedded programming languages such as C, C\+\+, or Qt. * Working knowledge of mechanical and hydraulic systems and their influence on embedded software design. * Advanced experience with Controller Area Network (CAN) communication protocols, including SAE J1939\. * Proficiency in model\-based design tools (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink, Danfoss Plus\+1 Guide). * Familiarity with agile software development methodologies and DevOps practices such as Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD). * Demonstrated ability to analyze stakeholder needs and translate them into software specifications. * Strong understanding of electronic circuits, microcontroller architectures, oscilloscopes, signal generators, and power supply systems. **Travel** * Occasional travel is expected of this position. **Work Location** HYBRID: Some of a team member’s day\-to\-day work may be best done at a location other than a Vermeer campus. We operate the world’s most sophisticated processing networks capable of handling more than 65k secure transactions a second across 80M merchants, 15k Financial Institutions, and billions of everyday people. While working with us you’ll get to work on complex distributed systems and solve massive scale problems centered on new payment flows, business and data solutions, cyber security, and B2C platforms. The Opportunity: We are looking for Versatile, curious, and energetic Software Engineers who embrace solving complex challenges on a global scale. As a Visa Software Engineer, you will be an integral part of a multi\-functional development team inventing, designing, building, and testing software products that reach a truly global customer base. While building components of powerful payment technology, you will get to see your efforts shaping the digital future of monetary transactions. The Work itself: * Build and maintain AI\-powered platforms, tools, and services that solve engineering productivity and customer challenges * Implement solutions leveraging agentic AI, LLMs, and machine learning to automate workflows and improve software quality * Create APIs, integrations, and platform capabilities that enable AI features across CMS products * Develop scalable services that integrate AI into commercial payment and money movement systems for B2B, B2C, P2P, and G2C use cases * Collaborate with engineering teams to identify opportunities for AI integration and drive adoption * Participate in experimentation with new AI technologies and contribute to technical standards * Work on both internal engineering tools and customer\-facing AI features Essential Functions: * Works with product owners to gather and refine requirements across CMS products, considering existing tools and solutions * Develops and designs moderately advanced solutions that are robust, scalable, and integrate AI capabilities with Visa's technical ecosystem * Provides domain expertise on AI/ML technologies and their application to engineering and customer problems * Plays a significant role in the development and delivery of new features within products from end\-to\-end * Contributes to technical decision\-making for AI adoption and standards This is a hybrid position. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.**Qualifications** Basic Qualifications • 5\+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD, OR 8\+ years of relevant work experience. experience with a PhD, OR 8\+ years of relevant work experience. • Master's degree in Math, Science, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems or related field AND minimum three (3\) years of experience in a directly related field OR Bachelor's degree in Math, Science, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems or related field AND minimum five (5\) years of experience in a directly related field OR Minimum eight (8\) years of directly related experience • Experience with AI frameworks, LLMs, or generative AI (Claude, GPT, LangChain, etc.) • Knowledge of AI\-powered development tools or building AI\-enabled applications • Experience applying AI to engineering challenges or customer\-facing features • Understanding of commercial payments, money movement, B2B payables, or payment processing • Experience with cloud platforms, microservices, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) • Knowledge of API design, integration patterns, and distributed systems • Familiarity with observability, monitoring, or DevOps practices The Skills You Bring • Energy and Experience: A growth mindset that is curious and passionate about technologies and enjoys challenging projects on a global scale • Challenge the Status Quo: Comfort in pushing the boundaries, ‘hacking’ beyond traditional solutions • AI Experience: Familiarity with agentic AI, LLMs, AI frameworks, or machine learning applications • Language Expertise: Expertise in one or more general development languages (e.g., Java, C\#, C\+\+) • Builder: Experience building and deploying modern services and web applications with quality and scalability • Learner: Constant drive to learn new technologies such as Angular, React, Kubernetes, Docker, etc. • Partnership: Experience collaborating with Product, Test, Dev\-ops, and Agile/Scrum teams • We do not expect that any single candidate would fulfill all of these characteristics. For instance, we have exciting team members who are really focused on building scalable systems but didn’t work with payments technology or web applications before joining Visa. **Information for US Applicants** For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $149,400\.00 to $ 238,500\.00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Develop agents that can perceive, reason, plan, act, and learn, utilizing Python and relevant AI libraries and frameworks. * Analyze and Evaluate Agent Behavior. Critically assess agent performance, understand the complexities of multi\-agent systems and human\-agent interaction, and identify risks. * Navigate Ethical Landscapes. Identify, analyze, and address the ethical challenges and safety considerations inherent in developing and deploying autonomous AI systems, applying principles of responsible AI. * Apply Agentic AI to Solve Problems. Conceptualize and build functional AI agents for practical applications, demonstrating the ability to integrate diverse concepts into cohesive business solutions. * Deep understanding of prompt engineering concepts, LLM fine\-tuning, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG). * Familiarity with MCP servers or comparable model\-serving/hosting platforms. * Excellent problem\-solving skills, strong communication, and a collaborative attitude. * Strong analytical skills with the ability to extensively analyze and improve business processes and workflows. * Demonstrated expertise in designing, implementing, and optimizing AI\-driven functionalities integrated with ServiceNow, such as custom Agentic AI skills, GenAI integrations, and intelligent automation. * Strong technical background in ServiceNow\-specific development tools and frameworks (UI Policies, UI Macros, UI Pages, Client Scripts, Script Includes, Business Rules, Mid Server Configuration \& Architecture, Import Sets, Transform Maps, Update Sets). * Strong knowledge of the CMDB, data modeling, data strategies, and integrations. * Knowledge of ServiceNow ITSM/ITOM product portfolio including Change Management, Discovery, and Service Mapping. * Relevant certifications such as Certified ServiceNow Admin (CSA), Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS), or Certified Application Developer (CAD) are highly desirable. **Information for US Applicants** For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $127,000\.00 to $ 202,700\.00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About WebBank** ----------------- WebBank (the “Bank”) is a Utah chartered Industrial Bank headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah. As “The Bank Behind the Brand®”, WebBank is a national issuer of consumer and small business credit products through Strategic Partner (Brand) platforms, which include retailers, manufacturers, finance companies, software as a service (SaaS) and financial technology (FinTech) companies. The Bank is a leading player in the digital lending space, driving innovation in financial products through embedded finance with Strategic Partner platforms. WebBank engages in a full range of banking activities including consumer and commercial loan products, revolving lines of credit, credit cards, private\-label card issuance, auto\-refinancing and more. The Bank provides capital in the form of asset\-backed lending and other credit facilities to Strategic Partner platforms, credit funds, and other lenders with a targeted focus on specialty finance assets. The Bank is also a leading provider of commercial insurance premium finance products through its wholly owned subsidiary National Partners. **Job Summary** --------------- WebBank's engineering team is small, and every engineer owns their work from the first conversation with the business through production. We are looking for a senior full\-stack engineer to take ownership of our partner\-facing platforms. These are the applications our Strategic Partners use to work with the Bank. You will ship features, set the quality bar through code review and testing, make sure we know when something breaks before a partner does, and mentor newer engineers. **Our stack:** TypeScript, Node.js (Fastify), React, PostgreSQL (Aurora), SQL Server, AWS (ECS, Lambda, S3, SQS, CloudFront), Terraform, Bitbucket Pipelines. **Primary Responsibilities (Job Duties)** ----------------------------------------- **You Will:** * Own one or more partner\-facing applications end to end, covering design, build, test, deploy and support. * Turn business needs into requirements and a technical design. Before you build, confirm stakeholder buy\-in, end\-user involvement and a plan for adoption. * Raise the team's engineering standards. Review pull requests, write unit, integration and end\-to\-end tests, and leave systems better documented than you found them. * Build the monitoring, alerting and logging our partner\-facing systems need. Your checks should catch broken behavior, not just dead servers. * Mentor junior engineers through pairing, design and code reviews and constructive feedback. * Work within the Bank's change\-management and security controls. We work in a regulated environment, and that is part of the job. * Communicate clearly in writing and in person with both technical and non\-technical audiences. **Company Perks** ----------------- **You Get:** * **Paid Time Off (PTO) –** Generous paid time off plus paid parental leave * **Health insurance –** Plans include an employer paid medical option, dental and vision coverage, plus we offer health savings accounts * **401(k) –** WebBank matches up to the first 6 percent of employee contributions and both the employee's contributions and WebBank's match are fully vested immediately * **Life and Disability Insurance –** Life insurance and long and short\-term disability insurance plans are 100% employer paid * **Tuition Reimbursement –** WebBank provides reimbursement for classes needed to obtain certain degrees, up to $5,250 per academic year Requirements: **Qualifications** ------------------ **You Have:** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering, including ownership of production web applications. * Strong TypeScript/Node.js and React skills. * Strong SQL. You can design a relational schema, write performant queries and read a query plan. * Hands\-on AWS experience. You have deployed, operated and debugged services, not just called their APIs. * Infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar). * Experience instrumenting production systems: structured logging, metrics and actionable alerts. * A proven track record of testing and code review as habits, not afterthoughts. * Strong debugging skills. You can read, troubleshoot and take ownership of code you didn't write. * A bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience. **Nice to Have:** * Google Cloud Platform (GCP). * Multi\-tenant SaaS, B2B portals or partner integrations. * Banking, lending or other regulated fintech experience. * SQL Server or data warehouse knowledge and experience. * Atlassian (Jira) app development.
