jobs.description: **E T Consultant** **Job \#:** req39425 **Organization:** World Bank **Sector:** Disaster Risk Management **Grade:** EC2 **Term Duration:** 1 year 0 months **Recruitment Type:** Local Recruitment **Location:** Washington, DC,United States **Required Language(s):** English **Preferred Language(s):** French, Spanish or Portuguese **Closing Date:** 12/4/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC **Description** At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1\.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data\-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who\-we\-are/ibrd The World Bank Group (WBG) Infrastructure Vertical provides public and private solutions to operational teams and clients across the WBG to produce scalable impact. Its mandate is to deliver knowledge for impact to support the WBG to achieve its goals in support of our mission and specifically: providing guidance on creating more and better jobs by: (i) supporting foundational infrastructure and human capital, (ii) policy environment, and (iii) enabling and mobilizing private sector capital. With 60 years of experience, the WBG is poised to support the sector becoming an engine of growth and jobs through improving policies and governance, foundational infrastructure and private sector investments. WBG lending in the sector is expected to grow substantially. The Infrastructure VPU’s objectives in driving outcomes include replicating and scaling effective solutions, enhancing thought leadership and innovation, and delivering timely knowledge to client teams. For more information: https://www.worldbank.org/en/topic/infrastructure The Disaster Management, Solutions \& Impact Unit (KIUSD) supports low and middle\-income countries to understand, manage, and reduce their risks from natural hazards and climate change. Within KIUSD, the Global Facility for Disaster Reduction and Recovery (GFDRR) umbrella trust fund is a global partnership that helps low\- and middle\-income countries better understand and reduce their vulnerability to natural hazards and climate change. GFDRR supports analytics and technical assistance to governments in the most vulnerable countries and communities where it will have the greatest positive impact. As a donor\-funded program, GFDRR consults regularly with donors and actively strives to maintain and develop new partnerships for increased impact. For more information: https://www.gfdrr.org/en GFDRR follows a demand\-driven model, linking country needs with technical expertise, financing, and partnerships to deliver impact at scale. GFDRR’s 2026\-20230 strategy emphasizes measurable results, introducing a strengthened results framework with specific quantitative targets, including a goal to improve climate resilience for 100 million people by 2030\. GFDRR is structured in four priority areas, two crosscutting areas and comprised of 10 thematic areas (or global programs): **Priority 1: Strengthening Risk\-Informed Decision Making** * Digital Earth * Disaster Risk Analytics **Priority 2: Reducing Risk and Mainstreaming Disaster Risk Management (DRM)** * Building Regulation for Resilience \- Resilient Housing * City Resilience – Urban Heat Resilience * Nature\-based Solutions for Climate Resilience * Resilient Infrastructure * Resilient Human Development Infra \- Safer Schools \- Health Systems **Priority 3: Enhancing Financial Preparedness and Leveraging Financing to Manage Disaster and Climate Risks** * Disaster Risk Finance **Priority 4: Improving Disaster Preparedness and Resilient Recovery** * Emergency Preparedness and Response * Hydromet Services and Early Warning Systems **Crosscutting areas:** * Disaster \-Fragility, Conflict, and Violence Nexus * Inclusive Disaster Risk Management and Gender Equality Each thematic area invests in knowledge and tools development being responsive to the needs of WBG clients. Tools range from policy and regulatory frameworks review, stakeholder engagements, geospatial analysis combined with solution suitability analysis, rapid post\-disaster assessments, risk quantification (some tool and their applications can be accessed on GFDRR’s website). Additionally, GFDRR has teams dedicated to grant monitoring and GFDRR impact evaluation and learning, as well as communications and knowledge management. Please note this position is financed by a Trust Fund and renewal is contingent upon availability of funding, in addition to other factors, including but not lim for tool development. * Contribute to program deliverables, including preparation of GFDRR communication and dissemination materials, results monitoring, reporting, budgeting, and branding. * Influence capability development at enterprise scale, not just within a single tool or team. * Conduct other tasks, as needed, to support the overall objective of the position. **Selection Criteria** * Advanced University Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Statistics, or related field with strong computational elements, with minimum five years of relevant experience; a bachelor’s degree with a minimum of 7 years of relevant experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience. * At least five years of progressively responsible professional experience (internships excluded), with a focus on software development and integration of technologies. * At least three years of experience designing and delivering hands\-on capacity building programs for enterprises. **Technical expertise:*** Demonstrated expertise in designing and building autonomous, multi\-step AI agents and utilizing advanced orchestration frameworks. * Expert\-level knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs), generative AI architectures, and text analytics, including Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques. * Extensive experience implementing Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures using enterprise\-grade managed search services and vector databases, incorporating continuous feedback loops (e.g., human\-in\-the\-loop/human\-in\-command labeling, relevance tuning) to improve retrieval quality. * Demonstrated ability to design, develop, and deploy scalable, high\-quality software and AI solutions across multiple platforms. Hands\-on experience building enterprise applications that meet complex business requirements with minimal supervision. * Strong programming, geospatial, and quantitative skills, including fluency in Python for geospatial workflows, cloud computing, Google Earth Engine, and open\-source GIS tools (e.g., QGIS). * Experience with and/or interest in disaster risk management, urban planning, civil infrastructure systems and financing are strongly preferred. **International \& Interpersonal Skills:*** International experience and demonstrated ability to work in diverse, multicultural environments are required. * Knowledge of the World Bank key Resilience and Disaster Risk Management priorities and programs is a plus but not essential. * Excellent organizational skills with ability to work under tight deadlines and handle multiple requests simultaneously, while being detail oriented. * Mentors and guides junior engineers to elevate the team’s core competencies, while simultaneously establishing foundational AI practices, such as enterprise prompt design frameworks and user personalization strategies. * Excellent written and spoken English is essential; knowledge of other languages—especially Spanish, French, and Portuguese—is highly desirable. **WBG Culture Attributes:** 1\. Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders. 2\. Thoughtful risk\-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact. 3\. Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results. World Bank Group Core Competencies *As per WBG policy, an Extended Term (ET) appointment is subject to a lifetime maximum of three (3\) years. Former and current ET staff who have completed or are in the process of completing their third\-year ET appointment are not eligible for future ET appointments.* *We are proud to be an equal opportunity and inclusive employer with a dedicated and committed workforce, and do not discriminate based on gender, gender identity, religion, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or disability.* *Learn more about working at the* *World Bank* *and* *IFC* *including our values and inspiring stories.*

able to explain technical decisions to non\-technical audiences and build working relationships across teams * Self\-directed and comfortable supporting the needs of multiple teams, systems, and products **Key Competencies / Preferred Qualifications** * **Collaboration \& Influence:** Builds strong working relationships with teams outside their own, aligns stakeholders with competing needs, and earns trust through follow\-through * **Effective Communication:** Writes clear design documents and decision records, and explains complex system choices to technical and non\-technical stakeholders alike * **Leadership:** Leads through expertise and initiative: mentors others, drives design discussions, raises the technical bar, and interviews thoughtf  with event streaming or messaging platforms (e.g., Kafka, Azure Event Hubs, Service Bus) or ETL/ELT tools (e.g., Dagster, Airflow) is a plus * **Energy Industry \& Customer Understanding:** Background in data\-intensive environments (e.g., equities/commodities trading) or a strong desire to learn the wholesale electric power industry **At Yes Energy, we value connecting directly with candidates. We kindly ask that third\-party recruiters and agencies not submit resumes, as we are not open to external recruiting partnerships.** **ABOUT YES ENERGY** **Overview** Yes Energy delivers real\-time market data and electric power trading decision solutions. Over 1,000 market participants use Yes Energy solutions daily. The business is a leader in all aspects of information content collection and management, developing and delivering data and market analytics solutions. Since its inception in 2008, Yes Energy has become a trusted and respected supplier of innovative and reliable solutions focused on the needs of power market analysts, traders, and trade managers. Yes Energy has a team of 400\+ amazing professionals in Boulder, CO (HQ); Boston, MA; Chicago, IL; Glendora, CA; Richmond, VA; London, United Kingdom; Auckland, New Zealand; and Bucharest, Romania. **Culture** Yes Energy has been named one of the Best Places to Work in Colorado, and we have the culture to prove it. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer, Taxonomy, AI Data Modeling, MLOps, YouTube Business
jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process. This role may also be located in our Playa Vista, CA campus. Applicants in the County of Los Angeles: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; Chicago, IL, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA; Los Angeles, CA, USA; San Bruno, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience in data engineering, data modeling, or building and operating production ETL/ELT pipelines and distributed data warehouses. * 3 years of experience writing production code in Python or a general\-purpose programming language, and with SQL for data analysis. * Experience building or scaling text classification, natural language processing (NLP), or machine learning data pipelines. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline or equivalent professional experience. * Experience designing ontologies, versioned taxonomies, semantic layers, or metadata management platforms for large\-scale unstructured text, transcript, image, or video datasets. * Experience optimizing ML vs. LLM compute unit economics using vector embeddings, lightweight classifiers, evaluation golden sets, and AI coding tools. * Experience building APIs or architecting data models from the ground up. **About the job** ----------------- Much of the organization's most valuable signal sits in high\-volume unstructured data, including support call transcripts, partner feedback, images, and video metadata. Today, extracting insights often relies on fragmented spreadsheets and costly per\-document Large Language Model (LLM) inference. As a Senior Data Engineer in Technical Solutions, you will build the data foundation and metadata infrastructure that enables business teams and AI agents to understand YouTube's creator, partner, and support operations. You will replace ad\-hoc workflows with durable, deterministic infrastructure: versioned taxonomies and ontologies, vector\-embedding classification pipelines optimized for compute unit economics, and governed semantic data layers that allow stakeholders and AI tools to query business concepts accurately. Working across global engineering, analytics, and operations teams, you will own solutions end to end from scoping and data modeling through evaluation and production deployment. At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $156000 \- $226000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design, version, and govern business taxonomies, ontologies, and metadata frameworks that establish shared ground truth for analysts, operational tools, and AI agents. * Build scalable text and multimodal classification pipelines using vector embeddings, lightweight ML models, and LLMs to convert unstructured transcripts and feedback into deterministic signals. * Define accuracy benchmarks, build human\-labeled evaluation golden sets, and monitor production pipeline quality and compute unit economics. * Architect relational and semantic data layers in distributed warehouses so business users and LLM tools can query concepts reliably in plain language. * Partner with executives, engineers, analysts, and vendor teams to scope ambiguous problems, author design documents, and ship end\-to\-end production systems. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. jobs.title: Android Engineer
jobs.description: **About Zero Homes** -------------------- Our mission is to rebuild American communities through healthy, affordable homes. At Zero Homes, we operate on a simple premise: when you make contractors successful, homeowners win. The current home services industry is fragmented, complex, and opaque, which is frustrating for homeowners and exhausting for contractors. We are changing this by building a home upgrade marketplace that enables a simple, central, transparent process for homeowners and contractors to complete projects. Through our platform we handle design, quoting, procurement, and customer service, allowing our contractor network to focus on what they do best and make them money: delivering projects. For homeowners, this delivers a predictable, high\-quality, and transparent experience—transforming home upgrades from a source of anxiety into a seamless experience.Our vision is to create a world where homeowners and contractors in all 50 states can leverage our platform to execute thousands of projects every week within the next 36 months. We work by a clear set of values: * **Be a "can kid," not a "can’t kid":** We own our outcomes and go to extraordinary lengths to solve problems. * **Go fast, be clear:** Speed is our advantage, and we sweat the details to deliver an extraordinary customer experience. * **Customer \& Contractor Obsessed:** We have a deep, personal understanding of the work to be done. We stay curious about our contractors' craft and the stories of our homeowners. * **Win, as a team:** We are building an iconic business that will reinvent the industry, and will do so together. If you are ready to build a world\-class consumer experience that genuinely rebuilds American communities, come build with us. **About the Role \& Your Impact** --------------------------------- The ZeroHome app is our most important digital touchpoint with homeowners. It lets them get a design and quote for their HVAC project without an in\-person sales visit. As an Android Engineer, you will own features end to end on Android, and grow into iOS as you go. You will work in six\-week cycles on a small team of a designer, a product representative, one or two engineers, and a lead engineer. You will take well\-scoped projects, bring options and questions, and grow quickly with guidance and review from senior engineers. You will also help build Field, a contractor tool we have not built yet. How we work: our team builds the app with AI as the main interface to the code, and we will be upfront about that from your first conversation. We consider applicants at more than one level, and we share the likely level and pay range before any onsite. **Who You Are** =============== You go where the product needs you, even when that means learning a part of the stack you have never touched. You treat a customer\-reported bug as the most important signal you get, and you dig into the rough edges real users hit. You are curious about what AI lets one engineer do. You would rather reuse a sound solution than invent a novel one, and you lean on tests, established patterns, and your teammates' review. You are building your judgment about the line between recklessness and accepted risk, and you like working in person with your team, in front of a whiteboard. **What You'll Do** ================== * **Ship Features:** Deliver well\-scoped features end to end on Android, with review from senior engineers. * **Fix What Users Hit:** Drop in\-flight work to unblock a homeowner who hits a bug, and jobs.title: Senior Security Platform Engineer I – Splunk, Analytics & Automation'
jobs.description: **At Zotec Partners, our People make it happen** Transforming the healthcare industry isn’t easy. But when you build a team like the one we have, that goal can become a reality. Our accomplishments can’t happen without our extraordinary people – the men and women across the country who make up our diverse Zotec family and help make this company a best place to work. Over 25 years ago, we started Zotec with a clear vision, to partner with physicians to simplify the business of healthcare. Today we are more than 900 employees strong and we continue to use our incredible talent and energy to bring that vision to life. We are a team of **Innovators, Collaborators and Doers.** We’re seeking a **Senior Security Platform Engineer I** to join us. This role provides independent ownership of Zotec's security data platform. You will lead Zotec's side of our Splunk Cloud expansion, then build out cross\-tool analytics and automation, while mentoring junior engineers on the team. Zotec runs a distributed Splunk Enterprise environment (including Enterprise Security and ITSI) alongside a small Splunk Cloud instance. We are growing our Splunk Cloud Victoria footprint to roughly 2 TB/day, with Splunk taking over hosted upgrades and patching. Our InfoSec enterprise data lake is part of the same platform. After the migration, about half of this work shifts from running Splunk to cross\-tool security analytics, integrations, and automation. You will own the platform independently, set day\-to\-day technical direction, and escalate strategy and budget decisions to leadership. **What you’ll do:*** **Platform** + Administer, troubleshoot, and tune the distributed Splunk Enterprise environment (search head and indexer clusters, heavy forwarders, deployment server) through migration. + Lead Zotec's side of the Splunk Cloud Victoria expansion: app and add\-on readiness, heavy\-forwarder review, historical data and federated search, cutover, validation, and stabilization. + After migration, coordinate Splunk\-run upgrades of the hosted platform, Enterprise Security, and ITSI, checking dependencies beforehand and validating afterward. + Maintain the components that remain with Zotec: forwarders, collectors, the deployment server and their operating systems, apps and add\-ons, roles, and retention. + Manage ingest volume and license consumption, including routing and reduction (e.g., Cribl) where approved. + Work Splunk support cases and coordinate changes with Infrastructure through the Change Review Board. * **Analytics and Automation** + Automate recurring security metrics and reports across tools, documenting each metric's definition, source, calculation, and limits. + Build and maintain delivery of security data into the InfoSec enterprise data lake. + Run logging\-coverage assessments with application teams and track gaps to remediation. + Build repeatable workflows that reduce manual reporting and data work. * **Team** + Mentor and review the work of junior engineers; keep runbooks current so that no one person holds the platform. + Translate requirements from Security, IT, and application teams into maintainable solutions. + Participate in the on\-call rotation. * **AI Platform Data** + Onboard and maintain logs from the AI tools Zotec uses (such as Claude, ChatGPT, Bedrock, and OpenTelemetry feeds) and from AI security tooling. + Automate the data behind monthly AI usage reporting and allowed\-model and shadow\-AI views. + Maintain Zotec's Splunk AI integrations, including the Splunk\-built MCP server and related skills, within InfoSec access rules. **What you’ll bring to Zotec:*** **Required Qualifications** + 3\+ years of hands\-on Splunk administration or engineering in a distributed production environment. + Strong SPL, data onboarding, parsing, CIM normalization, and dashboarding skills; Enterprise Security and/or ITSI experience. + Linux administration; troubleshooting of connectivity, authentication, and data collection. + Python (preferred) or PowerShell automation with REST APIs. + Git and controlled deployment practices. + SQL or similar for validating data and calculations. + Understanding of security logging, least privilege, and PHI protection. * **Preferred Qualifications** + Splunk Cloud Victoria administration or migration experience. + Splunk Certified Admin, Architect, or ES Admin. + Cribl or OpenTelemetry experience. + Data lake or analytics\-platform delivery experience. + Healthcare or similarly regulated environment experience (HIPAA, HITRUST, PCI). + Experience mentoring junior engineers. At Zotec, our purpose is to make healthcare work better for everyone. We value trust, excellence, and care in how we work with our clients and each other. You’ll have the opportunity to take ownership of your work, contribute ideas, and learn from experienced colleagues who want you to succeed. If that sounds like the kind of team you’d like to join, we’d like to talk with you. Learn more about our organization, by visiting us at www.zotecpartners.com E\-Verify and Equal Opportunity Employer n1p6EZtpfZ

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Computer Vision
jobs.description: ### **About Mecka AI** Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI. We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware\-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems. We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real\-world data, simulation, learning\-based systems, and deployed hardware. ### **The role** Mecka captures how people move, work and interact with the physical world. The footage is messy: hands disappear behind objects, cameras turn quickly, and motion blur hides the details. You’ll build models that make sense of it—and turn it into accurate 3D data that robotics teams can train on. We’re looking for machine learning engineers with depth in pose estimation, SLAM or 3D reconstruction who want to own what happens after the experiment works. You’ll train models, investigate where they fail and get them running reliably in production, working across the perception stack along the way. ### **What you’ll do** * **Build models for the problems in front of us.** You’ll train vision models from scratch on large multi\-view, multi\-sensor datasets, developing new losses and architectures where existing methods fall short. * **Work through the difficult footage.** You’ll tackle motion blur, fast rotation, heavy occlusion and partial views of hands, bodies and objects. * **Find out where your models fail.** You’ll evaluate them on our own video, measuring real error and failure rates alongside public benchmark results. * **Own the path to production.** You’ll optimize GPU performance, make results reproducible, integrate models into our data pipeline and ship releases you can roll back. * **Follow problems through to a fix.** You’ll reproduce customer\-reported issues, understand what went wrong and deliver a fix. You’ll also prototype quickly as new perception problems come up. ### **What you’ll bring** * **Strong machine learning fundamentals.** You’re comfortable building and training models with Python and PyTorch. * **Experience training large vision models from scratch.** Your experience goes beyond running or fine\-tuning existing models. * **Depth in a computer vision specialty.** You’ve worked deeply in at least one area, such as pose estimation, SLAM or 3D reconstruction. * **Experience owning models in production.** You’ve shipped a model or perception component and stayed responsible for it afterward. * **Comfort with the work as it is.** You can make progress with noisy real\-world data and adapt when priorities shift. ### **Nice to have** Experience in one or more of these areas would be valuable: * **Hand and body tracking:** 3D hand and full\-body tracking, mesh recovery, human\-object and human\-scene interaction, and estimating contact with objects and the ground. * **SLAM, VIO and calibration:** Learned ego\-motion, optical flow, online calibration and metric scale. * **3D reconstruction and objects:** Feed\-forward or per\-scene reconstruction, Gaussian splatting or NeRF, and neural 3D object estimation from egocentric video. If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply — we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, we will partner with you to meet your needs. We may use AI\-assisted tools to help evaluate applications against the requirements of this role. These tools support our recruiting team in identifying qualified candidates but do not replace human judgment or limit which applications may be reviewed or considered. Compensation Range: CA$140K \- CA$200K

jobs.description: **About Stuut** =============== Stuut is the AI coworker that runs order\-to\-cash for the world’s leading enterprises. Across order management, credit, collections, payments, cash application, disputes and deductions, Stuut does the work end to end and keeps going until the cash hits the bank. Over 150 companies, spanning the mid\-market to the Fortune 50, including Honeywell, ZoomInfo and PerkinElmer, use Stuut to unlock up to 40% more cash flow and cut DSO by 47%. More than $3 billion has moved through the platform to date. Founded in New York by Tarek Alaruri and Ben Winter, Stuut has raised $93 million from Insight Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, M12, Microsoft’s Venture Fund, and others. Learn more at stuut.ai. *THE ROLE* At Stuut, you’ll build and lead the data engineering team. You’ll hire and manage the data engineers, own the roadmap, and still build and review pipelines yourself. We ingest data from a lot of client systems: invoices, payments, customers and the rest of the order\-to\-cash record, much of it from ERPs. It arrives in a different shape, and with different gaps, for every customer. Your team builds and runs the pipelines that land it, clean it, model it, and get it to our product, our customers’ dashboards and our AI agents, on time and correct. Our stack is Python and Postgres, Estuary CDC into Snowflake, and dbt for transformation and testing. Sigma runs our customer dashboards, and Ask Stuut, our analytics agent, queries the same Snowflake models. We share data with customers through Snowflake data sharing, and Inngest and DBOS run our scheduled jobs. The foundation is in place. Most of what sits on top of it is still yours to build. *WHAT YOU’LL DO* * Manage, hire and grow the data engineering team, and set the bar through design and code review. * Own the data roadmap with product, engineering and leadership: what the team takes on and in what order. * Build and run the ingestion pipelines that land client data in Snowflake, including CDC from Postgres through Estuary, backfills and schema changes. * Own how we model data in Snowflake. We use dbt, and you’ll set the standards for how models are structured, tested, reviewed and deployed. * Monitor and alert on pipeline health: replication lag, failed or late runs, stale tables and unexpected changes in volume. * Track data completeness and accuracy for every customer, so we catch a problem before they do. * Keep core receivables metrics consistent everywhere they appear: in the product, in dashboards and in Ask Stuut. * Improve data latency and warehouse cost as volume and customer count grow. * Build the pipelines that serve warehouse data back to the product, including the data our AI agents and models rely on. *YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU…* * Have 5\+ years of hands\-on experience building and running production data pipelines in Python and SQL. * Have led a data team as a manager or tech lead, and have hired and grown engineers. * Have deep, hands\-on Snowflake experience in production. This one is required. You also know dbt well and have opinions on what good looks like. * Have run CDC from a production database into a warehouse and know the ways it breaks. * Have run a large data cleanup end to end: traced a gap back to its cause source by source, backfilled millions of rows without blocking live syncs, and added the checks that kept it fixed. * Have decided what to do when a source system simply doesn’t have the field you need, and written the rule down so everyone derives it the same way. * Have set data contracts with customers for files and data shares, and pushed back when what they sent wasn’t good enough. * Care about data quality and observability: testing, freshness, lineage, alerting. * Have worked on multi\-tenant data, where every customer looks a little different. * Can prioritize across many stakeholders and explain the trade\-offs plainly. *BIG PLUS* * Experience with financial data: invoices, payments, ERP exports, order\-to\-cash. * You’ve built pipelines that feed ML models or AI agents. * You’ve shipped customer\-facing analytics, like embedded dashboards or data shares. **US Compensation** * Top\-of\-market salary and equity package * Benefits (for U.S.\-based full\-time employees) * Medical, dental \& vision insurance coverage for you * 401(k) \& Match * Equity * Flexible PTO * Parental Leave **Stuut is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a team with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.** We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the application and interview process. If you need any accommodations, please do not hesitate to reach out. Compensation Range: $275K \- $315K
